text: wakwambiliilya, anasayanzi kuma sukulu wa stanford wa dawa matangaasie kuseuvya kwa muio mweu wa kuthima ula utonya kuvathukanya cell na muvae : kachip kaini katonya uprinitiwa kala katonya usoovwa kutumia printa ya inkjet standard kwa centi imwe ya U.S.
translation: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: wakwambiliilya, anasayanzi kuma sukulu wa stanford wa dawa matangaasie kuseuvya kwa muio mweu wa kuthima ula utonya kuvathukanya cell na muvae : kachip kaini katonya uprinitiwa kala katonya usoovwa kutumia printa ya inkjet standard kwa centi imwe ya U.S.
translation: Mnamo Jumatatu, wanasayansi kutoka Shule ya Tiba ya Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford walitangaza uvumbuzi wa kifaa kipya cha utambuzi ambacho kinaweza kupanga seli kwa aina: kidude kidogo kinachoweza kuchapwa, na ambacho kinaweza kutengenezwa kwa kutumia printa ya kawaida ya kupuliza rangi, yawezekana kwa takribani senti moja ya Marekani kwa kila moja.

text: Atongoi ma ũkunĩkĩli measya ũkwatĩkani wa tene wa kanza, kĩthũĩ, ũkimu na ndetema kwĩ awau ala me nthĩ syĩ ĩkya, kũla ũtonyekano wa'ũvoa wa maũwau ta kanza ya nondo noũtonye kwĩthĩwa wĩ nusu ya ala me nthĩ nthuangi.
translation: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Atongoi ma ũkunĩkĩli measya ũkwatĩkani wa tene wa kanza, kĩthũĩ, ũkimu na ndetema kwĩ awau ala me nthĩ syĩ ĩkya, kũla ũtonyekano wa'ũvoa wa maũwau ta kanza ya nondo noũtonye kwĩthĩwa wĩ nusu ya ala me nthĩ nthuangi.
translation: Watafiti wakuu wanasema hili linaweza kuleta ugunduzi wa mapema wa saratani, kifua kikuu, ukimwi na malaria kwa wagonjwa katika nchi zenye mapato ya chini, ambapo viwango vya kupona kwa magonjwa kama vile saratani ya matiti vinaweza kuwa nusu ya vile vya nchi tajiri.

text: Ndege kwa ĩsyĩtwa ya JAS 39C Gripen nĩyeethĩiwe na mbaga saa 9.30 sya kwakya (0230 UTC) na kũlivũka, na kũtũma vĩasala wa kũkuana na ndege kũvũngwa kĩwanzanĩ kyũ kya ndege.
translation: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Ndege kwa ĩsyĩtwa ya JAS 39C Gripen nĩyeethĩiwe na mbaga saa 9.30 sya kwakya (0230 UTC) na kũlivũka, na kũtũma vĩasala wa kũkuana na ndege kũvũngwa kĩwanzanĩ kyũ kya ndege.
translation: JAS 39C Gripen ilianguka kwenye barabara kuu karibu masaa ya 9:30 asubuhi (0230 UTC) na kulipuka, kwa hivyo ikafunga uwanja wa ndege kwa ndege za kibiashara.

text: Mutwai usu wa ndeke nuikiithiw'e ta mutongoi wa ndeke isu sya kau Dilokrit Pattavee.
translation: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Mutwai usu wa ndeke nuikiithiw'e ta mutongoi wa ndeke isu sya kau Dilokrit Pattavee.
translation: Rubani alitambuliwa kama Kiongozi wa Kikosi Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Isese sya mauvoo sya kuu syalivoti kana ngali ya kiwanzani kya ndeke yavaluka isembete ikaokoe.
translation: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Isese sya mauvoo sya kuu syalivoti kana ngali ya kiwanzani kya ndeke yavaluka isembete ikaokoe.
translation: Vyombo vya habari vya ndani vinaripoti kwamba gari la zimamoto la uwanja wa ndege lilibingirika wakati wa kuitikia.

text: vĩdal ũla wĩna myaka 28 analĩkĩle barca mbũa itatũ mbĩtũkũ kũma sevĩlla.
translation: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: vĩdal ũla wĩna myaka 28 analĩkĩle barca mbũa itatũ mbĩtũkũ kũma sevĩlla.
translation: Vidal mwenye umri wa miaka 28 alikuwa amejiunga na Barca misimu mitatu iliyopita kutoka Sevilla.

text: Kũma athĩ Catalan-capital, Vidal athaũkĩte mathaũ mala 49 kwa kĩkũndĩ kĩũ.
translation: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Kũma athĩ Catalan-capital, Vidal athaũkĩte mathaũ mala 49 kwa kĩkũndĩ kĩũ.
translation: Tangu kuhamia katika mji mkuu wa Catalan, Vidal alikuwa amechezea klabu yake michezo 49.

text: Maandamano mambiie kindu saa 11:00 (UTC+1) Whitehall ila isianitye na mũomo ũsungawa ni askali wa kulika Downing Street, vala Mũsũmbi wikalaa.
translation: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Maandamano mambiie kindu saa 11:00 (UTC+1) Whitehall ila isianitye na mũomo ũsungawa ni askali wa kulika Downing Street, vala Mũsũmbi wikalaa.
translation: Maandamano yalianza takriban saa 5 saa za ndani (UTC+1) katika Whitehall mkabala na mlango wa Mtaa wa Downing unaolindwa na polisi, Makao rasmi ya Waziri Mkuu.

text: O ĩtina wa saa 11.00 kũvĩka, alei nĩmavingie nzĩa ngalĩko ya yĩũlũ ya Whitehall.
translation: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: O ĩtina wa saa 11.00 kũvĩka, alei nĩmavingie nzĩa ngalĩko ya yĩũlũ ya Whitehall.
translation: Muda mfupi baada ya saa 5, waandamanaji walizuia trafiki kwenye njia ya kuelekea kaskazini katika Whitehall.

text: Twi 11:20, asikali makulilye aandamani masyoke itina kwa kasila, meimea kana maila umbalanzi kwithwa na uthasyo wa kuandamana na kuvunga nzia.
translation: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Twi 11:20, asikali makulilye aandamani masyoke itina kwa kasila, meimea kana maila umbalanzi kwithwa na uthasyo wa kuandamana na kuvunga nzia.
translation: Saa 11 dakika 20, polisi waliwataka waandamanaji warudi nyuma kando ya barabara, wakisema kwamba walihitaji kusawazisha haki ya kuandamana na msongamano wa magari.

text: Saa ĩtano na mĩongo ĩlĩ na kenda, mũkomo ũu nĩ welekeĩle Whitehall, mbee wa Trafalgar Square, ũtee wa Strand, wavita Aldwych na wambata Kingsway welekele Holborn vala Conservative Party maina na ũmbano wa Spring Forum utelini wa Grand Connaught.
translation: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Saa ĩtano na mĩongo ĩlĩ na kenda, mũkomo ũu nĩ welekeĩle Whitehall, mbee wa Trafalgar Square, ũtee wa Strand, wavita Aldwych na wambata Kingsway welekele Holborn vala Conservative Party maina na ũmbano wa Spring Forum utelini wa Grand Connaught.
translation: Karibu 11:29, maandamano yalisonga juu katika Whitehall, kupita Trafalgar Square, kupitia Strand, kupita karibu na Aldwych na juu katika Kingsway kuelekea Holborn ambapo Chama cha Conservative kiliendesha Mkutano wa Majira ya Mchipuo kwenye hoteli ya Grand Connaught Rooms.

text: Lekoti ya kyongo kwa kyongo ya Nadal na Muukananda usu ni 7-2.
translation: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Lekoti ya kyongo kwa kyongo ya Nadal na Muukananda usu ni 7-2.
translation: Rekodi ya Nadal dhidi ya Kanada ni 7-2.

text: O mituki nusindiwe ingi ni Raonic nthini wa Brisbane Open.
translation: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: O mituki nusindiwe ingi ni Raonic nthini wa Brisbane Open.
translation: Hivi karibuni alipoteza dhidi ya Raonic kwenye Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal akwatie poindi 88% syusĩe ki ĩthaũnĩ na asinda na poindi 76 ĩthaũnĩ ya mbee.
translation: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Nadal akwatie poindi 88% syusĩe ki ĩthaũnĩ na asinda na poindi 76 ĩthaũnĩ ya mbee.
translation: Nadal alipata 88% ya pointi kwenye mechi na kushinda pointi 76 kwenye utumishi wa kwanza.

text: Itina wa ithau, Musumbi Clay aisye, "Niiw'a nimutanu muno nikwithwa nisyokie laundi sya muthya sya maundu ala me vata. Nivaa none kana nonisinde ithau yii."
translation: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Itina wa ithau, Musumbi Clay aisye, "Niiw'a nimutanu muno nikwithwa nisyokie laundi sya muthya sya maundu ala me vata. Nivaa none kana nonisinde ithau yii."
translation: Baada ya mechi, Mfalme wa Clay alisema, "Nina msisimko tu kuhusu kuwa tena katika raundi za mwisho za tukio muhimu zaidi. Niko hapa kujaribu kushinda hii."

text: "Mathangu ma Panama" ni undu wa mwavuli wa kindu ta ndokyumendi milioni ikumi kuma ovisi wa miao wa Mossack Fonseca ya Panamana, yalikíie marhanguni twi 2016.
translation: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: "Mathangu ma Panama" ni undu wa mwavuli wa kindu ta ndokyumendi milioni ikumi kuma ovisi wa miao wa Mossack Fonseca ya Panamana, yalikíie marhanguni twi 2016.
translation: "Karatasi za Panama" ni jina la kijumla la takriban stakabadhi milioni kumi kutoka kwa Kampuni ya sheria ya Panama ya Mossack Fonseca, zilizofichuliwa kwa vyombo vya habari katika majira ya kuchipua ya 2016.

text: Mavalũa asu moonanishe vengi ikũmi na inya syatetheeisye makastoma athui kũvitha mambilioni ma Ndola sya US ni kenda maikaive koti na syindũ ingi syaile.
translation: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Mavalũa asu moonanishe vengi ikũmi na inya syatetheeisye makastoma athui kũvitha mambilioni ma Ndola sya US ni kenda maikaive koti na syindũ ingi syaile.
translation: Stakabadhi hizo zilionyesha kuwa benki kumi na nne ziliwasaidia wateja wakwasi kuficha mabilioni ya dola za Marekanai ili kuepuka kulipa ushuru na kanuni nyinginezo.

text: Ikanzeti ya Uungelesa ila yitawa The Guardian, yaumisye woni kana vengi wa Deutsche niwatongoesya ta kindu imwe kwa itatu ya kambuni 1200 sya shell ila syeaniasya uu.
translation: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Ikanzeti ya Uungelesa ila yitawa The Guardian, yaumisye woni kana vengi wa Deutsche niwatongoesya ta kindu imwe kwa itatu ya kambuni 1200 sya shell ila syeaniasya uu.
translation: Gazeti la Uingereza liitwalo The Guardian lilipendekeza kuwa benki ya Kijerumani ilidhibiti theluthi ya kampuni 1200 za Shell zinazotumika kufanikisha haya.

text: Kwai maandamano nthi yonthe, kusikatanwa kauta kwa ung'endili, na ndongoi sya silikali sya Iceland na Pakistan syakola wia.
translation: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Kwai maandamano nthi yonthe, kusikatanwa kauta kwa ung'endili, na ndongoi sya silikali sya Iceland na Pakistan syakola wia.
translation: Kulikuwa na maandamano kote ulimwenguni, mashtaka kadhaa ya jinai, huku viongozi wa serikali za Aislandi na Pakistani wakijiuzulu.

text: Asyaiwe Hong Kong, Ma asomeie univasiti ya New York na sukulu wa miao wa Harvard na kwa imwe niweethiiwe ena kaati ya vamanendi ta mwikali wa kuu.
translation: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Asyaiwe Hong Kong, Ma asomeie univasiti ya New York na sukulu wa miao wa Harvard na kwa imwe niweethiiwe ena kaati ya vamanendi ta mwikali wa kuu.
translation: Mzaliwa wa Hong Kong, Ma alisomea katika kituo kikuu cha New York na shule ya Chuo cha Sheria cha Harvard na kwa wakati mmoja alikuwa na "kadi ya kijani" ya mkazi wa kudumu wa Amerika.

text: Hsieh avangaa uu ivinda ya usakuani kana Ma no atoloke nthi ivinda ya mathina.
translation: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh avangaa uu ivinda ya usakuani kana Ma no atoloke nthi ivinda ya mathina.
translation: Hsieh aliashiria wakati wa uchaguzi kwamba huenda Ma akatoroka nchini wakati wa matatizo.

text: Hsieh no waisye kana munengani wa kyeni Ma ai muno muno kwiseuvya kwi kila kyai nthini wake.
translation: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Hsieh no waisye kana munengani wa kyeni Ma ai muno muno kwiseuvya kwi kila kyai nthini wake.
translation: Hsieh pia alidai kuwa Ma aliyeonekana mzuri sana kwenye picha alikuwa mwenye mtindo zaidi kuliko maana.

text: Ona kutw'ika vai kusikatana, Ma niwasindie nesa iulu wa ngwatanio sya unyanya wa vakuvi na mainland China.
translation: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Ona kutw'ika vai kusikatana, Ma niwasindie nesa iulu wa ngwatanio sya unyanya wa vakuvi na mainland China.
translation: Hata kwa mashtaka haya, Ma alishinda kimuhimu katika jukwaa akitetea uhusiano wa karibu zaidi na bara la Kichina.

text: Mũthaũki wa ũmũnthĩ nĩwe Alex Ovechkin wa Washington Capitals.
translation: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Mũthaũki wa ũmũnthĩ nĩwe Alex Ovechkin wa Washington Capitals.
translation: Mchezaji wa Siku wa Leo ni Alex Ovechkin wa Washington Capitals.

text: Aĩ na ngolu ili na atetheesya mala elĩ kũu usindini wa Washĩngton wa ngolu itano kwa itatũ masindite Atlanta Thrashers.
translation: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Aĩ na ngolu ili na atetheesya mala elĩ kũu usindini wa Washĩngton wa ngolu itano kwa itatũ masindite Atlanta Thrashers.
translation: Alikuwa na goli mbili na saidizi mbili katika ushindi wa Washington wa 5-3 dhidi ya Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Utethyo wa mbee wa Ovechkin wa kiwioo wai ithauni ya usindi yina rookie Nicklas Backstrom.
translation: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Utethyo wa mbee wa Ovechkin wa kiwioo wai ithauni ya usindi yina rookie Nicklas Backstrom.
translation: Usaidizi wa kwanza wa usiku wa Ovechkin ulikuwa kwenye bao la ushindina mgeni Nicklas Backstrom;

text: mbao yake ya keli ya utuku ũsu yai yake ya miongo thanthatu musimuni usu, aitwika muthauki wa mbee kuvunga mbao 60 kwa mbata kwa musimu umwe kuma 1955-96, ila jaromir Jagr na Mario Lemieux kila umwe mavikie mailistoni isu.
translation: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: mbao yake ya keli ya utuku ũsu yai yake ya miongo thanthatu musimuni usu, aitwika muthauki wa mbee kuvunga mbao 60 kwa mbata kwa musimu umwe kuma 1955-96, ila jaromir Jagr na Mario Lemieux kila umwe mavikie mailistoni isu.
translation: goli lake la pili katika usiku lilikuwa lake la 60 kwenye msimu, hivyo kuwa mchezaji wa kwanza kufunga magoli 60 au zaidi kwenye msimu tangu 1995-96, wakati Jaromir Jagr na Mario Lamieux kila mmoja alifikia hatua hiyo.

text: Batten yai namba 190 kwa Amelika 400 ala athui twi 2008 yina uthui wa mbilioni $2.3.
translation: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Batten yai namba 190 kwa Amelika 400 ala athui twi 2008 yina uthui wa mbilioni $2.3.
translation: Batten aliwekwa katika nafasi ya 190 katika orodha ya Wamarekani 400 Tajiri Zaidi ya 2008 kwa utajiri unaokadiriwa kuwa dola bilioni 2.3.

text: Niwaminie masomo kuma College of Arts and Sciences ya University of Virginia mwaka wa 1950 na niwatetheeasya sukulu ũu mũno.
translation: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Niwaminie masomo kuma College of Arts and Sciences ya University of Virginia mwaka wa 1950 na niwatetheeasya sukulu ũu mũno.
translation: Alihitimu kutoka Chuo cha Sanaa na Sayansi cha Chuo Kikuu cha Virginia mnamo 1950 na alikuwa mfadhili muhimu wa taasisi hiyo.

text: Kolokolo wa Abu Ghraib ula wĩ nthi ya Iraq niwakwatw'a mwaki saa sya ithokoo.
translation: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Kolokolo wa Abu Ghraib ula wĩ nthi ya Iraq niwakwatw'a mwaki saa sya ithokoo.
translation: Jela la Abu Ghraib la Iraki limewashwa moto wakati wa ghasia.

text: Yela ithukie ila muvungwa ututmiiwe nai na vamanyikanie itina wa asikali ma Amelika moosie usukani.
translation: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Yela ithukie ila muvungwa ututmiiwe nai na vamanyikanie itina wa asikali ma Amelika moosie usukani.
translation: Jela ilikuwa na sifa mbaya baada ya udhalilishaji wa mahabusu kugunduliwa humo baada ya majeshi ya US kuchukua uongozi.

text: Piquet Jr. niwavalukile masindanoni ma Grand Prix kuuya Singapore mwakani wa 2008 itina wa uthyumuo munini wa Fernando Alonso, kiko kila kyalasimithisye ngali nini ya kutongoesya yietwe.
translation: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Piquet Jr. niwavalukile masindanoni ma Grand Prix kuuya Singapore mwakani wa 2008 itina wa uthyumuo munini wa Fernando Alonso, kiko kila kyalasimithisye ngali nini ya kutongoesya yietwe.
translation: Piquet mdogo alianguka katika Grand Prix ya Singapori mara tu baada ya kituo cha mapema cha matengenezo kwa Fernando Alonso, na kuleta gari la usalama.

text: O ila ngali syai mbee wa Alonso syaendie unywa mauta ungu wa ngali ya usuvĩi, aambatie kwosa usindi.
translation: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: O ila ngali syai mbee wa Alonso syaendie unywa mauta ungu wa ngali ya usuvĩi, aambatie kwosa usindi.
translation: Huku magari yaliyokuwa mbele ya Alonso yakiingia kuwekwa mafuta chini ya gari la usalama, alienda mbele yao kuchukua ushindi.

text: Piquet Jr. avutiwe itina wa Hungarian Grand Prix ya 2009.
translation: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Piquet Jr. avutiwe itina wa Hungarian Grand Prix ya 2009.
translation: Piquet Jr. alifutwa kazi baada ya kipindi cha 2009 cha Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Saa 8:46 a.m siungamite, kuvindya niyavalukile ndunyu, kwonany'a saa o ila ndeke ya mbee yaathie vala yaaile kuatha.
translation: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Saa 8:46 a.m siungamite, kuvindya niyavalukile ndunyu, kwonany'a saa o ila ndeke ya mbee yaathie vala yaaile kuatha.
translation: Saa 8:46 kamili, unyamavu ulitanda mjini kote, kuashiria wakati hasa ambapo ndege ya jeti ilipiga lengo.

text: Laini ili sya kyeni syakomana syaseuvya skywards wioo wonthe.
translation: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Laini ili sya kyeni syakomana syaseuvya skywards wioo wonthe.
translation: Miali miwili ya mwanga imeundwa ili kuelekea juu usiku kucha.

text: Mwako niuendee wa ngolova itano nzau kwa saiti, ve ukui katikati na paki ya ulilikany'o vu kati.
translation: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: Mwako niuendee wa ngolova itano nzau kwa saiti, ve ukui katikati na paki ya ulilikany'o vu kati.
translation: Ujenzi wa ghorofa tano mpya unaendelea katika eneo, na kituo cha usafirishaji na mbuga ya ukumbusho zikiwa katikati.

text: Shoo ya PBS ina ikombe mbee wa ndasani ili, na yithwaa yinguvi kwi Sesame Street na Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
translation: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Shoo ya PBS ina ikombe mbee wa ndasani ili, na yithwaa yinguvi kwi Sesame Street na Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
translation: Onyesho la PBS lina tuzo zaidi ya dazeni mbili za Emmy, na muda wake ni mfupi kuliko tu Sesame Street na Mister Roger's Neighborhood.

text: Kila kilungu kya shoo kyasyiasya utumani ivukuni vulani na indi kiikyungusa utumani usu kwisila ngewa kauta.
translation: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Kila kilungu kya shoo kyasyiasya utumani ivukuni vulani na indi kiikyungusa utumani usu kwisila ngewa kauta.
translation: Kila kipindi cha onyesho kingeangazia mada katika kitabu maalum na kisha kuchunguza mada hiyo kupitia hadithi nyingi.

text: Kila shoo nikuete wendekethyo wayo kwa mavuku ala syana syaile umantha ila methi laivulali.
translation: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: Kila shoo nikuete wendekethyo wayo kwa mavuku ala syana syaile umantha ila methi laivulali.
translation: Kila onyesho pia lingetoa mapendekezo ya vitabu ambavyo watoto wangepaswa kutafuta walipokwenda katika maktaba.

text: John Grant, kuma WNED Buffalo ivukuni yake Reading Rainbow home station anaisye "Reading Rainbow niyamanyiisye syana niki syaile kusoma, …wendo wa kusoma - kivindi kiu kyanengie syana vinya wa kwosa ivuku na kusoma."
translation: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: John Grant, kuma WNED Buffalo ivukuni yake Reading Rainbow home station anaisye "Reading Rainbow niyamanyiisye syana niki syaile kusoma, …wendo wa kusoma - kivindi kiu kyanengie syana vinya wa kwosa ivuku na kusoma."
translation: John Grant, kutoka WNED Buffalo (kituo cha nyumbani cha Reading Rainbow) alisema "Reading Rainbow iliwafunza watoto ni kwa nini wasome,…kupenda kusoma — [onyesho] liliwahimiza watoto kuchukua kitabu na kusoma."

text: Amwe nimaikiaa, vamwe na John Grant, musango na uvinduku wa mesilya ma kisomo kya televiseni nikwatumie series ithela.
translation: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Amwe nimaikiaa, vamwe na John Grant, musango na uvinduku wa mesilya ma kisomo kya televiseni nikwatumie series ithela.

text: Akunikili ma nzeve measya mbua ngito mũno ila yi maili 645 (kĩlomita 1040) Ũthũĩlonĩ wa Syũa wa kithama kya Cape Verde nyina ni itonya kũthela itanaanang'a nthi nũmũ.

text: Oyu tũĩ Fred ena nzeve ya maili 105 kwa ĩsaa yĩmwe (165km/h) na elekele yĩũlũ ya ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa.
translation: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Oyu tũĩ Fred ena nzeve ya maili 105 kwa ĩsaa yĩmwe (165km/h) na elekele yĩũlũ ya ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa.
translation: Fred hivi sasa ina upepo wa maili 105 kwa saa (kilomita 165 kwa saa) na inaelekea kaskazini magharibi.

text: Fred nĩkyo kĩseve kĩla kĩvĩnya kĩvyũ kyaaĩthĩwa vaasa ĩtheo na ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa wa Atlantĩc kũma kwambĩa kwa ũtũmĩĩ wa mitambo, na kĩseve kya katatũ kwĩthĩwa ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa ndikilii 35 ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa.
translation: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Fred nĩkyo kĩseve kĩla kĩvĩnya kĩvyũ kyaaĩthĩwa vaasa ĩtheo na ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa wa Atlantĩc kũma kwambĩa kwa ũtũmĩĩ wa mitambo, na kĩseve kya katatũ kwĩthĩwa ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa ndikilii 35 ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa.
translation: Fred ndicho kimbunga cha kitropiki chenye nguvu zaidi kuwahi kurekodiwa kusini na mashariki katika Atlantiki kufikia sasa tangu ujio wa picha za setalaiti, na kimbunga kikuu cha tatu tu katika rekodi mashariki mwa 35° Magharibi.

text: Jonny Reid, ndeleva mũtetheesya wa A1GP kĩkũndĩ kya New Zealand, ũmũnthĩ nĩwĩkĩĩe ũvoo kwa kũtwaa ngalĩ mĩtũkĩ vyũ na kũsĩnda Auckland Harbour Bridge ũla wĩna ũkũũ wa myaka 48, New Zealand kwa ũw'o.
translation: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Jonny Reid, ndeleva mũtetheesya wa A1GP kĩkũndĩ kya New Zealand, ũmũnthĩ nĩwĩkĩĩe ũvoo kwa kũtwaa ngalĩ mĩtũkĩ vyũ na kũsĩnda Auckland Harbour Bridge ũla wĩna ũkũũ wa myaka 48, New Zealand kwa ũw'o.
translation: Johnny Reid, dereva mwenza wa timu ya A1GP ya Nyuzilandi, leo ameweka historia kwa kuendesha mbio zaidi katika Daraja la Bandari ya Auckland, Nyuzilandi, lenye miaka 48, kihalali.

text: Reid niweethiiwe akivikia mituki ya kilomita 160 kwa isaa mara muonza iulu wa kiao atwaite ngali nini muvai wa AIGP, o ila ingi yitawa wanake mwiu ya ku New Zealand.
translation: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Reid niweethiiwe akivikia mituki ya kilomita 160 kwa isaa mara muonza iulu wa kiao atwaite ngali nini muvai wa AIGP, o ila ingi yitawa wanake mwiu ya ku New Zealand.
translation: Bw. Reid aliweza kuendesha gari la A1GP la New Zealand, Urembo Mweusi kwa kasi zaidi ya kilomita 160 kwa saa mara saba juu ya daraja.

text: Asikali ma nthi ya New Zealand manai na ivinda yumu kutumia maasini yoo ya kuthima siviti kwa munduume ukwitwa Reid nundu wa wanake mwiu munini, na ivinda ila asikali matonyie kuthima siviti ya Reid ni ila waendie mbola na kiwango kya 160km/h.
translation: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Asikali ma nthi ya New Zealand manai na ivinda yumu kutumia maasini yoo ya kuthima siviti kwa munduume ukwitwa Reid nundu wa wanake mwiu munini, na ivinda ila asikali matonyie kuthima siviti ya Reid ni ila waendie mbola na kiwango kya 160km/h.
translation: Polisi wa New Zealand walikua na shida kutumia bunduki zao za rada ya kasi kuona jinsi Mr Reid alivyoendesha gari kwa sababu ya vile urembo ulikua chini, wakati polisi waliweza kumuweka Bwana Reid wakati alipopunguza mwendo hadi 160 Km/h.

text: Peter Castello, mwiiya wa kĩnandu wa Australia na mũndũũme ũla wĩna ũtonyekano mũnene mũno wa kũũngamĩa nthĩ ĩtina wa muungamĩi wa nthĩ John Howard ta mũũngamĩi wa kyama kya Ũthasyo nĩwĩkisye ũkwatĩlĩĩli wake ĩtina wa kambũni ũseũvasya vinya wa kĩniũkĩlĩa Australia.
translation: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Peter Castello, mwiiya wa kĩnandu wa Australia na mũndũũme ũla wĩna ũtonyekano mũnene mũno wa kũũngamĩa nthĩ ĩtina wa muungamĩi wa nthĩ John Howard ta mũũngamĩi wa kyama kya Ũthasyo nĩwĩkisye ũkwatĩlĩĩli wake ĩtina wa kambũni ũseũvasya vinya wa kĩniũkĩlĩa Australia.
translation: Peter Kostello, mweka hazina wa Australia na mtu aliye na uwezekano mkubwa wa kurithi nafasi ya Waziri Mkuu Yohana Howad kama kiongozi wa Chama Huria ametupa msaada wake kwa tasnia moja ya nguvu za nyuklia huko Australia.

text: Mr. Castello aisye kana ila kuseuvya vinya wa nuclear kwethiwa kwina vata wa ki mbesa, Australia yailitwe kuatiia kuutumia.
translation: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Mr. Castello aisye kana ila kuseuvya vinya wa nuclear kwethiwa kwina vata wa ki mbesa, Australia yailitwe kuatiia kuutumia.
translation: Bwana Kostello alisema kuwa utoaji wa nguvu za nyuklia ukifanikiwa kiuchumi, Australia inapaswa kufuata matumizi yake.

text: "Kethwa nikutwika ya kuthoosya, nitwaile ithwa nayo. Vailye uu, vai mwiao wa kuleana na vinya wa nuclear" Munduume Costello aisye uu.
translation: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: "Kethwa nikutwika ya kuthoosya, nitwaile ithwa nayo. Vailye uu, vai mwiao wa kuleana na vinya wa nuclear" Munduume Costello aisye uu.
translation: "Kama itakuwa ya kibiashara, tunapaswa kuwa nayo. Yaani, hakuna upingaji wa nishati ya nyuklia kikanuni, Bw Costello alisema.

translation: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Maloya me nguma ma ngiliki, Sakis Kechagioglou na George Nikolakopoulos nimoovya y'ela ya Athen wa Korydallus, nundu makwatiwe na mavityo ma ungei na ulusani.
translation: Mawakili maarufu wa Ugiriki, Sakis Kechagiogluo na George Nikolakopoulos wametiwa korokoroni katika jela ya Athens ya Korydallus, kwani walipatikana na hatia ya kula rushwa na ufisadi.

text: Nũndũ wa kĩtũmĩ kĩĩ, thĩna ũũ mũnene mbaĩnĩ sya greek nĩwaũmĩlĩlwe nĩ nĩ asĩlĩ ma mĩao mĩkya ĩla yaĩ mĩvĩtũ.
translation: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Nũndũ wa kĩtũmĩ kĩĩ, thĩna ũũ mũnene mbaĩnĩ sya greek nĩwaũmĩlĩlwe nĩ nĩ asĩlĩ ma mĩao mĩkya ĩla yaĩ mĩvĩtũ.
translation: Kama matokeo, sakata kubwa ndani ya jamii ya kisheria ya Ugiriki imeibuliwa kupitia kufunuliwa kwa vitendo haramu ambavyo majaji, mawakili, wanenea, na wanasheria wamefanya katika miaka iliyopita.

text: Syumwa nini mbitu, itina wa uvoo kuandikithwa ni mundu wa mauvoo Makis Triantafylopoulos showni yake ya tv yi nguma "Zoungla" nthini wa Alpha tv, mumemba wa mbunge na musili, Petros Mantovalos niwasilielwe kana amemba ma ufisi wake nimatwaiisye ulusani na ungei muvatane ni silikali.
translation: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Syumwa nini mbitu, itina wa uvoo kuandikithwa ni mundu wa mauvoo Makis Triantafylopoulos showni yake ya tv yi nguma "Zoungla" nthini wa Alpha tv, mumemba wa mbunge na musili, Petros Mantovalos niwasilielwe kana amemba ma ufisi wake nimatwaiisye ulusani na ungei muvatane ni silikali.
translation: Wiki chache zilizopita, baada ya taarifa iliyochapishwa na mwanahabari Makis Triantafylopoulos kwenye kipindi chake maarufu cha televisheni "Zoungla" katika Alpha TV, mbunge na Mwanasheria, Petros Mantouvalos alifanywa kujiuzulu kwani memba wa ofisi yake walikuwa wamehusika katika hongo haramu na ufisadi.

text: Iulu wa uu, musili munene wa makoani Evangelos Kalousis ni woviwe kolokoloni itina wa kwithiwa na mavityo ma ung'ei wa mbesa sya mweenenthi na mituo itailite.
translation: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Iulu wa uu, musili munene wa makoani Evangelos Kalousis ni woviwe kolokoloni itina wa kwithiwa na mavityo ma ung'ei wa mbesa sya mweenenthi na mituo itailite.
translation: Waaidha, hakimu mkuu Evangelos Kalousis alifungwa jela kwani alipatikana na hatia ya ufisadi na tabia mbaya.

text: Roberts aemie vyu kuneena iulu wa yila witikilaa kana thayu niwambiia, ikulyo ya vata muno uililya maundu ma kumya mavu, aasya kana ni utonya kwithiwa wi uthuku kuneena iulu wa maundu ma nthini.
translation: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Roberts aemie vyu kuneena iulu wa yila witikilaa kana thayu niwambiia, ikulyo ya vata muno uililya maundu ma kumya mavu, aasya kana ni utonya kwithiwa wi uthuku kuneena iulu wa maundu ma nthini.
translation: Roberts alikataa kabisa kusema ni lini anaamini uhai huanza, swali muhimu inapozingatiwa maadili ya uavyaji mimba, akisema kwamba ingekuwa kinyume na maadili kutoa maoni kuhusu mambo maalum ya matukio ambayo yanawezekana.

text: Niweekie, ateo, ndeto sya mbee syaaite kana Roe v. Wade ai "mwiao musakue wa nthi", yiithingiliila vata wa koti nene na utwi wayo.
translation: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Niweekie, ateo, ndeto sya mbee syaaite kana Roe v. Wade ai "mwiao musakue wa nthi", yiithingiliila vata wa koti nene na utwi wayo.
translation: Hata hivyo, alirudia tamko lake la awali kwamba Roe dhidi ya Wade ilikuwa "sheria iliyoafikiwa ya nchi", akisisitiza umuhimu wa maamuzi thabiti ya Mahakama Kuu.

text: Na ingi niwaikiithisye kana niwikiie kwithwa na kimbithi kila Roe meekwatasya nakyo.
translation: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Na ingi niwaikiithisye kana niwikiie kwithwa na kimbithi kila Roe meekwatasya nakyo.
translation: Alithibitisha pia kuwa aliamini katika haki iliyodokezwa ya faragha ambayo uamuzi wa Roe ulitegemea.

text: Maroochydore aminite iulu wa ithau, ena poindi thanthatu iulu wa Noosa e wakeli.
translation: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Maroochydore aminite iulu wa ithau, ena poindi thanthatu iulu wa Noosa e wakeli.
translation: Maroochidore ilikuwa imemaliza juu ya ngazi, alama sita wazi mbele ya Noosa kwa nafasi ya pili.

text: Ngaliko syeli syikomania ithauni mweene ya nusu vala Noosa wasindie asindi na poindi 11.
translation: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Ngaliko syeli syikomania ithauni mweene ya nusu vala Noosa wasindie asindi na poindi 11.
translation: Pande hizo mbili zilikutana katika nusu fainali kuu ambapo Noosa ilishinda kwa pointi 11.

text: Maroochydore indi asindie caboolture kuu mwisoni.
translation: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Maroochydore indi asindie caboolture kuu mwisoni.
translation: Kisha Maroochydore iliwashinda Caboolture katika Fainali Ndogo.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae nĩ mũvaĩ wa mũsyĩ wa Dromaeosauridae na nĩ mwendwau wa Velociraptor.
translation: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae nĩ mũvaĩ wa mũsyĩ wa Dromaeosauridae na nĩ mwendwau wa Velociraptor.
translation: Hesperonychus elizabethae ni spishi ya familia Dromaeosauridae na ni binamu ya Velociraptor.

text: Isuni yii ya kuya nyama yausiwe ni maw'ia na yatalikanaa ta yitembeaa na maau eli mena mbwaa iilye ta sya ndinosa ila iulukaa.
translation: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Isuni yii ya kuya nyama yausiwe ni maw'ia na yatalikanaa ta yitembeaa na maau eli mena mbwaa iilye ta sya ndinosa ila iulukaa.
translation: Ndege huyu mwindaji aliye na manyoya kamili na mwenye damu ya joto aliaminika kutembea wima kwa miguu miwili na makucha kama Dinosau mdogo mwenye mwendokasi.

text: Waa wa keli wai munene, isyitwa yiu ya Hesperonychus yiana kila kiumini "waa wa ngaliko ya uthuo wa sua".
translation: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Waa wa keli wai munene, isyitwa yiu ya Hesperonychus yiana kila kiumini "waa wa ngaliko ya uthuo wa sua".
translation: Ukucha wake wa pili ulikuwa mkubwa, na kuleta chimbuko la jina Hesperonikasi linalomaanisha "ukucha wa magharibi."

text: Kwongeleela ĩũlũ wa mbalavu isu syatũkaa, nzeve nthũku mũno nĩ ĩsiĩĩte wĩa wa ũtangĩĩa andũ.
translation: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Kwongeleela ĩũlũ wa mbalavu isu syatũkaa, nzeve nthũku mũno nĩ ĩsiĩĩte wĩa wa ũtangĩĩa andũ.
translation: Pamoja na barafu iliyoponda, hali kali za hewa zimekuwa zikizuia juhudi za uokoaji.

text: Pittman aisye kana maundu mayĩsa kũseũvya mũvaka kyũmwa kĩla kyaatĩe.
translation: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Pittman aisye kana maundu mayĩsa kũseũvya mũvaka kyũmwa kĩla kyaatĩe.
translation: Pittman alipendekeza kwamba hali hazingeboreka hadi wakati fulani wiki ijayo.

text: Kiasi na wimbu wa vaketi ya ia, kwianana na Pittman nikw'o kuthuku kwa avungi kwa ivinda ya myaka 15 mithelu.
translation: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Kiasi na wimbu wa vaketi ya ia, kwianana na Pittman nikw'o kuthuku kwa avungi kwa ivinda ya myaka 15 mithelu.
translation: Kiasi na unene wa tando hilo la barafu, kulingana na Pittman, ndicho kibaya zaidi ambacho kimewahi kuwa kwa wawindaji kwa miaka 15 iliyopita.

text: Uvoo niendaa anduni ma Red Lake kwa ngelekany'o mathiko ma Jeff Weise na kukwatwa kwa andu atatu ala maumie, mumanyiwa umwe ni wakwatiwe kukonanywa na uvithukii wa school matuku 21 mwai wa Katatu.
translation: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Uvoo niendaa anduni ma Red Lake kwa ngelekany'o mathiko ma Jeff Weise na kukwatwa kwa andu atatu ala maumie, mumanyiwa umwe ni wakwatiwe kukonanywa na uvithukii wa school matuku 21 mwai wa Katatu.
translation: Habari zilienea katika jamii ya Red Lake leo wakati mazishi ya Jeff Weisse na watatu kati ya waathiriwa tisa yalifanywa kwamba mwanafunzi mwingine alikamatwa kuhusiana na upigaji risasi kwenye shule mnamo 21 Machi.

text: Anene maneenie ndeto nini matanamba kĩvĩtũkĩtha kualesitiwa kwa mũthenya ũsu.
translation: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Anene maneenie ndeto nini matanamba kĩvĩtũkĩtha kualesitiwa kwa mũthenya ũsu.
translation: Mamlaka ilisema machache kirasmi zaidi ya kuthibitisha ukamataji wa leo.

text: Ona vailye uu, mundu wina livoti yiulu wa ukunikili atavisye Minneapolis Star- Tribune kana ai Louis Jourdain, kana ka myaka 16 wa Red Lake Tribunal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.
translation: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Ona vailye uu, mundu wina livoti yiulu wa ukunikili atavisye Minneapolis Star- Tribune kana ai Louis Jourdain, kana ka myaka 16 wa Red Lake Tribunal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.
translation: Hata hivyo, asili iliyo na ufahamu wa uchunguzi iliambia Star-Tribune ya Minneapolis kuwa ni Louis Jourdian, mwana mwenye umri wa miaka 16 wa Mwenyekiti wa Red Lake Tribunal Floyd Jourdain.

text: Nginya onyu kuinamanyikana ni ndivi syiva syikwikiwa kana ni chau chaathiiie askali kamwana kau lakini ikoani ni ivingue kotini munene wa syana.
translation: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Nginya onyu kuinamanyikana ni ndivi syiva syikwikiwa kana ni chau chaathiiie askali kamwana kau lakini ikoani ni ivingue kotini munene wa syana.
translation: Haijulikani kwa wakati huu ni mashtaka gani yatawekwa au ni kipi kilielekeza mamlaka kwa mvulana huyo lakini kesi ya vijana imeanza katika mahakama ya shirikisho.

text: Lodin o ingi niwaisye athukumi mamuie kukanzoo isindano yiu nikenda kuokoa Afghans muisyo wa kukosa usuvio wa usakuani ungi.
translation: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Lodin o ingi niwaisye athukumi mamuie kukanzoo isindano yiu nikenda kuokoa Afghans muisyo wa kukosa usuvio wa usakuani ungi.
translation: Lodin pia alisema maafisa waliamua kufuta kurudiwa kwa kura ili kuokoa watu wa Afghan gharama na hatari kwa usalama ambayo ingeletwa na uchaguzi mwengine.

text: Andu ma kuete wiw'ano maisye kana nimeethiie undu ute mutheu iulu wa kativa ka Afghan ula utonya kuvuthiisya kitumi kya usyokewa kwa kula.
translation: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Andu ma kuete wiw'ano maisye kana nimeethiie undu ute mutheu iulu wa kativa ka Afghan ula utonya kuvuthiisya kitumi kya usyokewa kwa kula.
translation: Wanadiplomasia walisema kwamba walipata tata za kutosha katika katiba ya Kiafgani kuamua kwamba duru ya pili ya uchaguzi haikuwa ya lazima.

text: Ii ĩyendanasya na lipotĩ sya vu mbee kana kũngamya usakũani uu tĩ kuatĩia kativa.
translation: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Ii ĩyendanasya na lipotĩ sya vu mbee kana kũngamya usakũani uu tĩ kuatĩia kativa.
translation: Hii inapinga ripoti za awali, ambazo zilisema kuwa kughairi duru ya pili ya uchaguzi kungekuwa dhidi ya katiba.

text: Ndeke isu iendete Irkutsk na yitwaitwe ni asikalima nthini.
translation: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Ndeke isu iendete Irkutsk na yitwaitwe ni asikalima nthini.
translation: Ndege ilikuwa inaelekea Irkutsk na ilikuwa ikiendeshwa na majeshi ya ndani.

text: Komitii ya ukulyo wa ukunikili niyambiiw'e.
translation: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Komitii ya ukulyo wa ukunikili niyambiiw'e.
translation: Uchunguzi ulianzishwa ili kupeleleza.

text: II -76 yithiitwe yi ivinda yamwanya kwa nthi ya Russia na asikali sya Soviet kuma 1970s, na yai inoona mbanga nthuku muno ku Russia mwei muthelu.
translation: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: II -76 yithiitwe yi ivinda yamwanya kwa nthi ya Russia na asikali sya Soviet kuma 1970s, na yai inoona mbanga nthuku muno ku Russia mwei muthelu.
translation: Il-76 imekuwa sehemu kuu ya wanajeshi wa Urusi na Sovieti tangu miaka ya 1970, na tayari walikuwa wameona ajali mbaya huko Urusi mwezi uliopita.

text: Matukũ 7 mwai wa Ĩkumi inzini niyatilikanie itina wa kũmbũka, indi vaiĩ mũndũ wa'ũmĩa. Russia kwa ivinda ikuvi niyaungamisye II-76s itina wa mbanga isu.
translation: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Matukũ 7 mwai wa Ĩkumi inzini niyatilikanie itina wa kũmbũka, indi vaiĩ mũndũ wa'ũmĩa. Russia kwa ivinda ikuvi niyaungamisye II-76s itina wa mbanga isu.
translation: Mnamo Oktoba 7 injini ilijitenga wakati wa kuruka, bila majeraha. Urusi iliweka Il-76 kando baada ya ajali hiyo.

text: Maĩli 800 sya mũtambo wa maũta wa Trans-Alaska nĩsyavingĩwe kũatĩĩa kwĩtĩka kwa ngili sya mĩtũngĩ ya maũta ngalĩko ĩtheo ya Faĩrbanks, Alaska.
translation: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Maĩli 800 sya mũtambo wa maũta wa Trans-Alaska nĩsyavingĩwe kũatĩĩa kwĩtĩka kwa ngili sya mĩtũngĩ ya maũta ngalĩko ĩtheo ya Faĩrbanks, Alaska.
translation: Maili 800 za Mfumo wa Trans-Alaska Pipeline zilifungwa kufuatia umwagikaji wa maelfu ya mapipa ya mafuta yasiyosafishwa kusini mwa Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Kwaa kwa mwaki nundu wa undu withwaa wi muvange wa mwaki niw'o utumie relief valves ivunguka na mauta metika vakuvi na kipetro station 9 kya Fort Greely.
translation: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Kwaa kwa mwaki nundu wa undu withwaa wi muvange wa mwaki niw'o utumie relief valves ivunguka na mauta metika vakuvi na kipetro station 9 kya Fort Greely.
translation: Ukosefu wa umeme kufuatia jaribio la kawaida la amri ya moto ulisababisha vilango vya kutuliza kufunguka na mafuta yasiyosafishwa yalifurika karibu na kituo cha pampu cha Fort Greely.

text: Munukani wa vaavu wathukia nzeve nikenda system na mauta ithee nesa kwa itangi ila yitonya ukua ndoma 55,000 (milioni 2.3 sya mitungi).
translation: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Munukani wa vaavu wathukia nzeve nikenda system na mauta ithee nesa kwa itangi ila yitonya ukua ndoma 55,000 (milioni 2.3 sya mitungi).
translation: Ufunguzi wa vilango uliruhusu kuachiliwa kwa shinikizo kwa mfumo na mafuta yalitiririka kwenye pedi hadi kwenye tangi ambalo linaweza kubeba mapipa 55,000 (galoni milioni 2.3).

text: Ia ma wioo ma wakatatũ, maima ma matangi nĩ metaa kũmana na kũneneva nũndũ wa ũvyũvũ nthĩni wa matangi.
translation: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Ia ma wioo ma wakatatũ, maima ma matangi nĩ metaa kũmana na kũneneva nũndũ wa ũvyũvũ nthĩni wa matangi.
translation: Kufikia Jumatano alasiri, matundu ya tanki yalikuwa bado yanavuja labda kutokana na upanuzi wa kijoto ndani ya tanki.

text: Kĩsio kĩngĩ kĩnene ĩtheo wa matangi kyaĩkĩtonya kwĩkĩwa mĩtũngĩ ya ũkũa maũta 104,500 ĩla itaĩ mbĩkĩe kĩndũ.
translation: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Kĩsio kĩngĩ kĩnene ĩtheo wa matangi kyaĩkĩtonya kwĩkĩwa mĩtũngĩ ya ũkũa maũta 104,500 ĩla itaĩ mbĩkĩe kĩndũ.
translation: Eneo lingine ndogo chini ya tangi zenye uwezo wa kuhifadhi mapipa 104,500 bado halikuwa limejazwa hadi kiwango chake.

text: Mawoni, televiseniini, mai iita ya mbee anene ma Iran meetikilie kana isii syina wanaangiko.
translation: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Mawoni, televiseniini, mai iita ya mbee anene ma Iran meetikilie kana isii syina wanaangiko.
translation: Maoni ya moja kwa moja kwenye televisheni, yalikuwa ya mara ya kwanza kwa wakuu wa serikali ya Irani kukubali kuwa vikwazo vilikuwa na athari yoyote.

text: Ni vamwe na kwikiiwa isuisi sya mbesa na kusiiwa ni European Union kwa kumaalya mauta mate matheu, o vala ukwati wa nthi ya Iran ukwataa 80% nthini wa ukwati wayo wa kuma nza.
translation: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Ni vamwe na kwikiiwa isuisi sya mbesa na kusiiwa ni European Union kwa kumaalya mauta mate matheu, o vala ukwati wa nthi ya Iran ukwataa 80% nthini wa ukwati wayo wa kuma nza.
translation: Inahusisha vikwazo na umoja wa Ulaya kupiga marufuku kwa usafirishaji wa mafuta yasiyosafishwa, ambapo uchumi wa Iran unapokea 80% ya mapato ya nje.

text: Nthĩnĩ wa livoti yoo ya mĩtũkĩnĩ ya kĩla mwei, OPEC yaisye kana ũti wa maũta ma petro nĩwaendĩe nthĩ kwa ivinda ya myaka mbaũ na matangĩ mĩlĩonĩ 2.8 kwa mũthenya ũmwe.
translation: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Nthĩnĩ wa livoti yoo ya mĩtũkĩnĩ ya kĩla mwei, OPEC yaisye kana ũti wa maũta ma petro nĩwaendĩe nthĩ kwa ivinda ya myaka mbaũ na matangĩ mĩlĩonĩ 2.8 kwa mũthenya ũmwe.
translation: Katika ripoti yake ya kila mwezi ya hivi karibuni, Shirika la Nchi Zinazosafirisha nje Petroli ilisema mauzo ya nje ya ghafi yamepungua sana kwa miongo miwili kwa mapipa milioni 2.8 kwa siku.

text: Mutongoi mũnene wa nthĩ ĩsũ, Ayotollah Ali Khameneĩ, aeleĩsye ũtengemeo wa maũta ta "mũteko" ũla wambĩĩe mbee wa ũvĩndũkũ wa ũĩsilamũ wa ĩran mwaka wa 1979 na vala nthĩ yaĩle kwĩyũmya.
translation: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Mutongoi mũnene wa nthĩ ĩsũ, Ayotollah Ali Khameneĩ, aeleĩsye ũtengemeo wa maũta ta "mũteko" ũla wambĩĩe mbee wa ũvĩndũkũ wa ũĩsilamũ wa ĩran mwaka wa 1979 na vala nthĩ yaĩle kwĩyũmya.
translation: Kiongozi mkuu wa nchi, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, ameelezea utegemeaji wa mafuta kama "mtego" ulioanza kabla ya mapinduzi ya Kiislamu ya Irani mnamo 1979 na ambao nchi inafaa kujiokoa kutokana nao.

text: Ĩla Kapusoo yavika nthĩ na kulika yayayanĩ, ta saa kumi na ĩmwe wa kwakya (masaa ma ngalĩko ya umĩlo wa syũa), nĩ kwendekanaa kũete kyeni kwa andũ ala me ngalĩko ya Ĩũlũ ya California, Oregon, Nevada, na Utah.
translation: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Ĩla Kapusoo yavika nthĩ na kulika yayayanĩ, ta saa kumi na ĩmwe wa kwakya (masaa ma ngalĩko ya umĩlo wa syũa), nĩ kwendekanaa kũete kyeni kwa andũ ala me ngalĩko ya Ĩũlũ ya California, Oregon, Nevada, na Utah.
translation: Wakati kibonge kitakapofika Duniani na kuingia kwenye angahewa, takriban saa 11 asubuhi (saa za mashariki), kinatarajiwa kutoa onyesho lenye mwangaza kwa wakaaji wa California Kaskazini, Oregon, Nevada na Utah.

text: Kavusuu isu yiithiwa muno iilye ta ndata ila ivalukaa matuni utuku.
translation: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Kavusuu isu yiithiwa muno iilye ta ndata ila ivalukaa matuni utuku.
translation: Kibumba hicho kitaonekana kama vimondo vinavyopita angani.

text: Kapsoo isu yiendaa kilomita 12.8 kana maili 8 kwa sekondi imwe, yi mitũki yithi kũma San Francisco nginya Los Angeles kwa ndatika imwe.
translation: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Kapsoo isu yiendaa kilomita 12.8 kana maili 8 kwa sekondi imwe, yi mitũki yithi kũma San Francisco nginya Los Angeles kwa ndatika imwe.

text: Stardust nikwia lekoti itaaiwa kwa kwithwa nokyo kyombo kila ki mituki vyu kusyokethya vaa iulu wa nthi, iivunzya lekoti ila yai inaiwa mwei wakatano 1969 kusyokethyani kwa Apollo X.
translation: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Stardust nikwia lekoti itaaiwa kwa kwithwa nokyo kyombo kila ki mituki vyu kusyokethya vaa iulu wa nthi, iivunzya lekoti ila yai inaiwa mwei wakatano 1969 kusyokethyani kwa Apollo X.
translation: Stardust itaweka rekodi mpya ya wakati wote kwa kuwa chombo cha angani chenye kasi ya juu zaidi kurudi Duniani, na kuvunja rekodi ya awali iliyowekwa mnamo Mai 1969 wakati wa kurudi kwa moduli ya udhibiti ya Apollo X.

text: "Nikuthi ngaliko ya uthuiloni wa sua ya iulu wa California na nikwakany'a yayaya kuma California kwisila Oregon na ungi kwisila Nevada na Idaho na iilika Utah," Tom Duxbury, munene wa pronjekiti ya Stardust niwe waisye uu.
translation: "It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah," Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: "Nikuthi ngaliko ya uthuiloni wa sua ya iulu wa California na nikwakany'a yayaya kuma California kwisila Oregon na ungi kwisila Nevada na Idaho na iilika Utah," Tom Duxbury, munene wa pronjekiti ya Stardust niwe waisye uu.
translation: Kitapita juu ya pwani ya magharibi ya California kaskazini na kitaangaza anga kutoka California kupitia Oregon ya kati na kuendelea kupitia Nevada na Idaho na katika Utah, Tom Duxbury, meneja wa mradi wa Stardust, alisema.

text: Ũtwĩ wa mũtũmĩa Rũdd kwĩkĩa saĩĩ mwĩw'ano wa nzeve wa Kyoto nĩwatũmĩe nthĩ ya ũnĩted States ĩengwa, na kwooũ nthĩ ya ĩsũ nĩyo ĩkwĩtha yĩ nthĩ yoka ĩla yĩtĩkĩlanĩte na mwĩwano ũsũ.
translation: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Ũtwĩ wa mũtũmĩa Rũdd kwĩkĩa saĩĩ mwĩw'ano wa nzeve wa Kyoto nĩwatũmĩe nthĩ ya ũnĩted States ĩengwa, na kwooũ nthĩ ya ĩsũ nĩyo ĩkwĩtha yĩ nthĩ yoka ĩla yĩtĩkĩlanĩte na mwĩwano ũsũ.
translation: Uamuzi wa Bw. Rudd kusaini makubaliano ya hali ya hewa ya Kyoto unatenga Marekani, ambayo sasa itakuwa nchi ya pekee iliyostawi kutoridhia mkataba huo.

text: Silikali ila yai ya kusuvia ya Australia niyaleile kuvitukithya Kyoto, iyasya kana nikwananga ekonomi nundu wa kutengemea muno kuta nthi sya nza kwa makaa, o ila nthi ingi ta India na Kyaina mayaavatwa ni kumya.
translation: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Silikali ila yai ya kusuvia ya Australia niyaleile kuvitukithya Kyoto, iyasya kana nikwananga ekonomi nundu wa kutengemea muno kuta nthi sya nza kwa makaa, o ila nthi ingi ta India na Kyaina mayaavatwa ni kumya.
translation: Serikali ya awali ya kihafidhina ya Australia ilikataa kuridhia Kyoto, ikisema ingeharibu uchumi kwa utegemeaji wake mkubwa wa uuzaji nje wa makaa-mawe, wakati nchi kama India na China hazikufungwa na malengo ya uzalishaji wa vichafuzi.

text: Nĩ wo ukwatĩ munene kati ka isitoli ya eBay.

text: Kambuni yiikwatya kwongela vaita woo kuma kundu na kumesya nguma isio ila Skype itumiawa muno, ta Kyaina, Umiloni wa sua wa Europe, na Brazil.

text: Asomi ma saenzi nimethiitwe mayiliwa kana Ence ladus yithiawa na vinya wayo ta umo wa mbete ya ia ila yithiuukite Saturn.

text: Enceladus nikyo kindu kila kitungaa kyeni muno kwa solar system, kitungite ta 90 vaasendi ya kyeni kya sua kila kimiathaa.
translation: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Konami ula niwe mumithya wa ithau yii ni waisye umunthi ithanguni ya Japan maiulekya ithau ya Six Days in Fallujah.
translation: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Ĩthaũ yumanaa na kaũ wa kelĩ wa Fallujah, kaũ mũthũku mũno katĩ wa asikalĩ ma Amelika na Iraq.

translation: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Mwĩao wa ũtangaasi ũnenganaa ũndũ mũtandao ũkũtũmĩka, ona vala kwĩkĩa mũvangonĩ kĩla kĩ mũtandaonĩ, nĩ nginya yĩthe yumĩte vandũnĩ vala ve saava.

translation: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Kuma mwambiio wayo, Onion itwikite embaya ya uvoo wa mathalau, yina kindu kya uprindiwa, wembusaiti ila yakusisye aeni mate ma kawaita 5,000,000 twi mweini wa ikumi, kuthoosya kwa kiimundu, mauvoo ma masaa 24, podcasts, na ila atlas ya nthi yonthe inavunguiwe oyu yitawa Our Dumb World.
translation: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Kuma mwambiio wayo, Onion itwikite embaya ya uvoo wa mathalau, yina kindu kya uprindiwa, wembusaiti ila yakusisye aeni mate ma kawaita 5,000,000 twi mweini wa ikumi, kuthoosya kwa kiimundu, mauvoo ma masaa 24, podcasts, na ila atlas ya nthi yonthe inavunguiwe oyu yitawa Our Dumb World.

translation: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Jesus wa myaka mĩongo ĩlĩ na ũmwe ookie Manchester City mwaka mũthelu mwai wa mbee 2017 kuma kĩlavu kya Brazil kya Palmeiras kwa ndĩvi ya milioni £27.
translation: Yesu aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka 21 alijiunga na Manchester City Januari mwaka uliopita 2017 kutoka klabu cha Kibrazili Palmeiras kwa ada iliyoripotiwa kuwa dola milioni 27.

text: Kuma ivinda yu, muthauki uu wa Brazil athaukite mathauni 53 timuni ino na akavinga mala 24.
translation: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Kuma ivinda yu, muthauki uu wa Brazil athaukite mathauni 53 timuni ino na akavinga mala 24.
translation: Tangu wakati huo, Mbrazili huyo ameshiriki pakubwa kwa ajili ya klabu hicho kwenye mechi 53 katika mashindano yote na amefunga mabao 24.

text: Ndakitali Lee no wonanisye w'ia wake iulu wa livoti ila syaitye kana syana sya Turkey yu nisikwatitw'e ũwau wa ĩkua ya avian A (H5N1) mate awau.
translation: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Ndakitali Lee no wonanisye w'ia wake iulu wa livoti ila syaitye kana syana sya Turkey yu nisikwatitw'e ũwau wa ĩkua ya avian A (H5N1) mate awau.
translation: Dkt. Lee pia alieleza wasiwasi wake kuhusu ripoti kwamba watoto katika Uturuki sasa wameambukizwa virusi vya homa ya ndege A(H5N1) bila kuugua.

text: Ni waisye isomo imwe syaasya uwau usu no nginya withe utena vinya mwingi ni kenda uvike nthi yonthe.
translation: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Ni waisye isomo imwe syaasya uwau usu no nginya withe utena vinya mwingi ni kenda uvike nthi yonthe.
translation: Baadhi ya tafiti zinapendekeza kwamba ni lazima ugonjwa huo upunguze uwezo wa kuua kabla ya kusababisha janga la kimataifa, alisema.

text: Ve wia kana awau nomaendee kũkwatya andũ angĩ aingĩ kwa kũkwatĩĩa mawĩa moo ma kĩla mũthenya syonany'a sya homa ĩsu syaendeea kwĩthĩwa ite nthũku mũno.
translation: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Ve wia kana awau nomaendee kũkwatya andũ angĩ aingĩ kwa kũkwatĩĩa mawĩa moo ma kĩla mũthenya syonany'a sya homa ĩsu syaendeea kwĩthĩwa ite nthũku mũno.
translation: Kuna wasiwasi kuwa wagonjwa wanaweza kuendelea kuambukiza watu wengi kwa kuendelea na shughuli zao za kila siku kama dalili za homa hiyo zitabaki kuwa pole.

text: Leslie Aun, mũneeni wa Komen Foundation, aisye kyama kĩu nĩkyosie mwĩao mweũ ũla ũtetĩkĩlasya ũtethyo kana kũnengane mbesa kũnewe syama ila syendee kũkunĩkĩlwa kĩ mĩao.
translation: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Leslie Aun, mũneeni wa Komen Foundation, aisye kyama kĩu nĩkyosie mwĩao mweũ ũla ũtetĩkĩlasya ũtethyo kana kũnengane mbesa kũnewe syama ila syendee kũkunĩkĩlwa kĩ mĩao.
translation: Leslie Aun, msemaji wa Shirika la Komen, alisema kuwa shirika hilo lilipitisha sheria mpya ambayo hairuhusu ruzuku au ufadhili kutolewa kwa mashirika ambayo yanafanyiwa upelelezi wa kisheria.

text: Mũvango wa Komen wakunie maluvuku Planned Parenthood nundu wa ukunikili ula wuendeeye wa undũ Planned Parenthood itumiaa na kũandikithya mbesa syake ula wiikwa ni muungamei Cliff Stearns.
translation: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Mũvango wa Komen wakunie maluvuku Planned Parenthood nundu wa ukunikili ula wuendeeye wa undũ Planned Parenthood itumiaa na kũandikithya mbesa syake ula wiikwa ni muungamei Cliff Stearns.
translation: Sera ya Komen ilisitisha Planned Parenthood kwa sababu ya uchunguzi unaosubiri jinsi Planned Parenthood hutumia na kuripoti pesa zake ambao unaongozwa na Mwakilishi Cliff Stearns.

text: Mĩao nĩ kũthĩana na ũmya wa kotĩ kana nĩ ũtũmĩkaa kũtetheesya kũmya mavũ kwĩsĩla kũvanga ũsyaĩ wĩyanĩ wake ta mwene kĩvĩla wa kamĩtĩĩ wa kũsĩsya na kũthĩana na maũndũ, ĩla yĩthaa yĩ ũngũ wa mwavũlĩ wa nyũmba ya vĩnya na kamĩtĩĩ ka mbesa.
translation: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Mĩao nĩ kũthĩana na ũmya wa kotĩ kana nĩ ũtũmĩkaa kũtetheesya kũmya mavũ kwĩsĩla kũvanga ũsyaĩ wĩyanĩ wake ta mwene kĩvĩla wa kamĩtĩĩ wa kũsĩsya na kũthĩana na maũndũ, ĩla yĩthaa yĩ ũngũ wa mwavũlĩ wa nyũmba ya vĩnya na kamĩtĩĩ ka mbesa.
translation: Stearns anapepeleza kama ushuru hutumika katika utoaji wa mimba kupitia uzazi uliopangwa katika jukumu lake kama mwenyekiti wa Usimamizi na Upelelezi kwenye kamati ndogo, ambayo iko chini ya kamati ya nyumba, nishati na biashara.

text: Gavana wa tene wa Massachusetts Mitt Romney niwasindie usakuani munini wa kyama kya Florida Republican wakeli enda mbee wa 46 percenti ya kula.
translation: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Gavana wa tene wa Massachusetts Mitt Romney niwasindie usakuani munini wa kyama kya Florida Republican wakeli enda mbee wa 46 percenti ya kula.
translation: Gavana wa awali wa Massachusetts Mitt Romney alishinda uchaguzi wa msingi wa urais wa Chama cha Republican wa Florida Jumanne kwa zaidi ya asilimia 46 ya kura.

text: Muneeni wa tene wa mbunge ya Amerika Newt Gingrich okie namba ili ena kilungu kya 32 ilu wa yiana.
translation: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Muneeni wa tene wa mbunge ya Amerika Newt Gingrich okie namba ili ena kilungu kya 32 ilu wa yiana.
translation: Spika wa Nyumba wa zamani wa Marekani Newt Gingrich alikuwa wa pili kwa asilimia 32.

text: Ta kwa nzia ya musindi kwosa syonthe, Florida niyanenganie delegates oonthe me miongo itano kwa Romney, ila yakutwikithisye musĩndi wa usakũani wa Republican Party.
translation: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Ta kwa nzia ya musindi kwosa syonthe, Florida niyanenganie delegates oonthe me miongo itano kwa Romney, ila yakutwikithisye musĩndi wa usakũani wa Republican Party.
translation: Kama jimbo la mshindi-huchukua-yote. Florida ilimtunukia Romney wajumbe wake wote hamsini, hivyo kumsukuma mbele kama mgombeaji mkuu katika uchaguzi wa Chama cha Republican.

text: Ombany'a ma maandamano asu maisye andu ta 100,000 nimanaumilile misyini ya German ta Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.
translation: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: Ombany'a ma maandamano asu maisye andu ta 100,000 nimanaumilile misyini ya German ta Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.
translation: Watayarishaji wa maandamano walisema kwamba takribani watu 100,000 walitokea katika miji ya Ujerumani kama vile Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, na Hanover.

text: Ku Berlin, polisi nimatalile andu muatianio wa andu ta 6,500.
translation: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: Ku Berlin, polisi nimatalile andu muatianio wa andu ta 6,500.
translation: Katika Berlin, polisi walikadiria waandamanaji 6,500.

text: Maandamano manai nginya o Paris, Sofia kuu Bulgaria, Vilnius kuu Lithuania, Valetta kuu Malta, Tallinn kuu Estonia na Edinburgh na Glasgow kuu Scotland.
translation: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: Maandamano manai nginya o Paris, Sofia kuu Bulgaria, Vilnius kuu Lithuania, Valetta kuu Malta, Tallinn kuu Estonia na Edinburgh na Glasgow kuu Scotland.
translation: Maandamano pia yalifanyika katika Paris, Sofia huko Bulgaria, Vilnius huko Lithuania, Valetta huko Malta, Tallinn huko Estonia, na Edinburgh na Glasgow huko Uskoti.

text: London andu mavikite 200 ni mekiie mukomo nza wa mauvisi ma eene ma mĩao ya kumĩthya ala anene.
translation: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: London andu mavikite 200 ni mekiie mukomo nza wa mauvisi ma eene ma mĩao ya kumĩthya ala anene.
translation: Katika London, takribani watu 200 waliandamana nje ya ofisi za baadhi ya wenye hakimiliki.

text: Mwei muthelu, kunai maandamano manene kuu Poland ila nthi isu yasainiie ACTA, kula kwatumie silikali ya Polish kuamua kulea kuvitithya wiw'ano usu, kwa oyu.
translation: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Mwei muthelu, kunai maandamano manene kuu Poland ila nthi isu yasainiie ACTA, kula kwatumie silikali ya Polish kuamua kulea kuvitithya wiw'ano usu, kwa oyu.
translation: Mwezi uliopita, kulikuwa na maandamano makubwa huko Poland wakati nchi hiyo ilisaini Mkataba wa Kupambana na Biashara za Bidhaa Bandia, ambao umesababisha serikali ya Polandi kuamua kutoidhinisha makubaliano hayo, kwa sasa.

text: Latvia na Slovakia syeli syi mbola kukwatana na ACTA.
translation: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Latvia na Slovakia syeli syi mbola kukwatana na ACTA.
translation: Lativia na Slovakia wamechelewesha mchakato wa kujiunga na ACTA

text: Ikundi ya Animal Liberation na yila ya Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals kana RSPCA maendeeye na kwitya kwikiwa kwa lasima kwa kamera sya CCTV mwakoni yoonthe ya kusuvia nyamu ku Australia.
translation: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Ikundi ya Animal Liberation na yila ya Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals kana RSPCA maendeeye na kwitya kwikiwa kwa lasima kwa kamera sya CCTV mwakoni yoonthe ya kusuvia nyamu ku Australia.
translation: Uhuru wa Wanyama na Jamii ya Kifalme ya Uzuiaji wa Ukatili kwa Wanyama (RSPCA) wanatoa tena wito wa kuwekwa kwa kamera za CCTV kwa lazima katika vichinjio vyote vya Australia.

text: Inisipekita kwa isyitwa David O'Shannesy wa RSPCA New South Wales nutavisye ABC kana uthiani ula watwaiw'e wa kusisya nyunyi muvai wa Abbatoirs kyaile kwithiwa no kindu kya kila ivinda ku Australia.
translation: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: Inisipekita kwa isyitwa David O'Shannesy wa RSPCA New South Wales nutavisye ABC kana uthiani ula watwaiw'e wa kusisya nyunyi muvai wa Abbatoirs kyaile kwithiwa no kindu kya kila ivinda ku Australia.
translation: Inspekta David O'Shannesy wa RSPCA Wales mpya kusini aliambia ABC kuwa ufuatiliaji na ukaguzi wa maiti wafaa kuwa mahali pa kawaida pale Australia.

text: "Kamela syaũmulĩka nonginya ikatũma wonany'o kwĩ andũ ala mathũkũmanaa na nyamũ kana maũseo masyo nĩmo me vata vyũ."
translation: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: "Kamela syaũmulĩka nonginya ikatũma wonany'o kwĩ andũ ala mathũkũmanaa na nyamũ kana maũseo masyo nĩmo me vata vyũ."
translation: "Kamera ya siri bila shaka ingetuma ishara imara kwa wale watu wanaofanya kazi na wanyama kwamba ustawi wao ni wa kipaumbele cha juu."

text: Ũkunĩkĩli wa kũthingitha kwa nthĩ yonthe wa nthĩ ya Amelika mavunĩ woonanisye vayai kũthingitha kwa nthĩ ya Iceland kyumwanĩ kyu kyatongoetye.
translation: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Ũkunĩkĩli wa kũthingitha kwa nthĩ yonthe wa nthĩ ya Amelika mavunĩ woonanisye vayai kũthingitha kwa nthĩ ya Iceland kyumwanĩ kyu kyatongoetye.
translation: Ramani ya kimataifa ya zilizala ya Utafiti wa Jiolojia wa Marekani haikuonyesha zilizala huko Aisilandi katika wiki iliyotangulia.

text: Ũvisi wa ũthima nzeve wa Iceland waĩsye kana vaĩ iseso ya muthingitho wa nthĩ waa tangaaswa kĩsionĩ kya Hekla nthĩnĩ wa masaa 48 mavĩtũku.
translation: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Ũvisi wa ũthima nzeve wa Iceland waĩsye kana vaĩ iseso ya muthingitho wa nthĩ waa tangaaswa kĩsionĩ kya Hekla nthĩnĩ wa masaa 48 mavĩtũku.
translation: Ofisi ya Hali ya Hewa ya Iceland pia iliripoti kutokuwa na shughuli za tetemeko la ardhi katika eneo la Hekla masaa 48 yaliyopita.

text: Muthingithu wa nthi ula wi vata watumie ivinda yiisenzya weekikie mwei wa katatu matuku 10 yiulu wa kw'oko kwa aka ngaliko ya volcano summit caldera.
translation: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Muthingithu wa nthi ula wi vata watumie ivinda yiisenzya weekikie mwei wa katatu matuku 10 yiulu wa kw'oko kwa aka ngaliko ya volcano summit caldera.
translation: Shughuli kuu ya mtetemeko wa ardhi iliyokuwa na matokeo ya mbadiliko wa awamu ilikuwa imetokea mnamo 10 Machi upande wa kaskazini mashariki mwa bonde kuu la kilele cha volikano.

text: Matu maiu mate uko na volokano ni makusiiiwe nthi wa I kiima.
translation: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Matu maiu mate uko na volokano ni makusiiiwe nthi wa I kiima.
translation: Mawingu mazito yasiyo na uhusiano na shughuli zozote za volkano yaliripotiwa katika chini ya mlima.

text: Matu maonanisye utonyi wa kuete kulanilw'a kwa kana mũlipũko waw'o wai uneekika.
translation: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Matu maonanisye utonyi wa kuete kulanilw'a kwa kana mũlipũko waw'o wai uneekika.
translation: Mawingu yalitoa uwezekano wa mkanganyiko kuhusu kama mlipuko halisi ulifanyika.

text: Luno niyakuite mikono kati wa 120-160 kubik mita ya mauta ila yaanangikie na iuutani nene vamwe na makumbo syamisukuma yalika nanthi kiw'uni.
translation: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Luno niyakuite mikono kati wa 120-160 kubik mita ya mauta ila yaanangikie na iuutani nene vamwe na makumbo syamisukuma yalika nanthi kiw'uni.
translation: Luno ilikuwa na mita 120-160 za ujao za mafuta ndani yake wakati ilipoharibika na upepo mkali na mawimbi yakaisukuma ndani ya kizuizi cha maji.

text: Helikopta yoovoisy'e andũ ikũmi na ilĩ ala mathũkũmaa ndekeni isũ na ũla woomiite aũmiite iyũũ eweka.
translation: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Helikopta yoovoisy'e andũ ikũmi na ilĩ ala mathũkũmaa ndekeni isũ na ũla woomiite aũmiite iyũũ eweka.
translation: Helikopta ziliwaokoa wafanyakazi hao kumi na wawili na jeraha la pekee lilikuwa pua lililovunjika.

text: Meli ya mita 100 yaĩ nzĩanĩ ĩendete kwosa mbolea yam'yo ya kawaita na mwambĩĩonĩ anene makĩaa I meli noyĩse kwĩta mũio nthĩ.
translation: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Meli ya mita 100 yaĩ nzĩanĩ ĩendete kwosa mbolea yam'yo ya kawaita na mwambĩĩonĩ anene makĩaa I meli noyĩse kwĩta mũio nthĩ.
translation: Meli hiyo ya mita 100 ilikuwa safarini kuchukua mzigo wake wa kawaida wa samadi na mwanzoni maafisa walihofia meli hiyo huenda ikamwaga mzigo.

text: Miao ila ikwendekethwa niyavitukithiwe nyumbani syonthe ili twi 2011.
translation: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Miao ila ikwendekethwa niyavitukithiwe nyumbani syonthe ili twi 2011.
translation: Marekebisho yaliyopendekezwa tayari yalipitia nyumba zote mbili mnamo 2011

text: Nikusenziw'e ila ivindani ya legisaltive na muthea wa keli wavutwa mbee ni marepresenative ma nyumba na indi yavitithw'a muthemba ta usu ni seneti wa kwambiliilya.
translation: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Nikusenziw'e ila ivindani ya legisaltive na muthea wa keli wavutwa mbee ni marepresenative ma nyumba na indi yavitithw'a muthemba ta usu ni seneti wa kwambiliilya.
translation: Mabadiliko yalifanywa katika hiki kipindi cha sheria wakati hukumu ya pili ilipofutwa kwanza na Nyumba ya Wawakilishi kasha ikapitishwa katika njia sawa na Seneti Jumatatu.

text: Kuvaluka kwa musoa wa keli ula umitye woni wa ulea ngwatano sya aka kwa aka kana aume kwa aume no kuvingue muomo wa mitwaano mithenya ii mbeeni.
translation: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Kuvaluka kwa musoa wa keli ula umitye woni wa ulea ngwatano sya aka kwa aka kana aume kwa aume no kuvingue muomo wa mitwaano mithenya ii mbeeni.
translation: Kutofaulu kwa hukumu ya pili, ambayo inapendekeza kupigwa marufuku kwa ndoa za jinsia moja, kunaweza kuwezesha ndoa za kiraia katika siku za usoni.

text: Kuatiia mutalala usu, HJR-3 nikulilw'a ingi ni ala mekusakua usakuani ula ungi 2015 kana 2016 mekale mutalatalani.
translation: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Kuatiia mutalala usu, HJR-3 nikulilw'a ingi ni ala mekusakua usakuani ula ungi 2015 kana 2016 mekale mutalatalani.
translation: Kufuatia mfumo huu, HJR-3 itakaguliwa tena na bunge litakaloteuliwa mnamo mwaka 2015 au 2016 ili kubaki katika mchakato.

text: Mosindi ma Vautier nza wa kundairect ni vamwe na mukomo wa nzaa twi 1973 iulu wa kila woona ta kusiiwa kwa kisiasa.
translation: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Mosindi ma Vautier nza wa kundairect ni vamwe na mukomo wa nzaa twi 1973 iulu wa kila woona ta kusiiwa kwa kisiasa.
translation: Mafanikio ya Vautier nje ya ukurugenzi ni pamoja na kususia chakula mnamo 1973 dhidi ya kile alichoona kama udhibiti wa kisiasa.

text: Miao ya French niyasenziw'e. Mutetei wake asyokie ingi kwa ukuu wa 15 ila walikile ulei wa French ivindani ya kau wa keli wa nthi yonthe.
translation: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Miao ya French niyasenziw'e. Mutetei wake asyokie ingi kwa ukuu wa 15 ila walikile ulei wa French ivindani ya kau wa keli wa nthi yonthe.
translation: Sheria ya Ufaransa ilibadilishwa. Uanaharakati wake ukarudi nyuma kwa miaka 15 ambapo alijiunga na Upinzani wa Ufaransa wakati wa Vita vya Dunia vya II.

text: Niwandokyumendie iulu wake mweene ivukuni ya 1998.
translation: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Niwandokyumendie iulu wake mweene ivukuni ya 1998.
translation: Alijirekodi katika kitabu cha 1998.

text: Twi 1960s niwasyokie ingi kwa wiyathi mweu wa nthi ya Algeria kusomethya iulu wa kumithya sinema.
translation: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Twi 1960s niwasyokie ingi kwa wiyathi mweu wa nthi ya Algeria kusomethya iulu wa kumithya sinema.
translation: Mnamo 1960 alirudi Algeria iliyokuwa imepata uhuru ili kufunza uelekezaji wa filamu.

text: Mujapani Judola Hitoshi Saito, musindi wa mitila ili sya thaavu sya Olimpic, niwakw'a ena ukuu wa miaka 54.
translation: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Mujapani Judola Hitoshi Saito, musindi wa mitila ili sya thaavu sya Olimpic, niwakw'a ena ukuu wa miaka 54.
translation: Judoka Hitosi Saito Mjapani, mshindi wa medali mbili za dhahabu za Olimpiki amekufa akiwa na miaka 54.

text: Kitumi kya kikwu kinatangaasiwe ta kanza ya itema yitawa intrahepatic bile.
translation: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Kitumi kya kikwu kinatangaasiwe ta kanza ya itema yitawa intrahepatic bile.
translation: Chanzo cha kifo kilitangazwa kama saratani ya kifereji cha nyongo kilicho ndani ya ini.

text: Akw'iiie ku Osaka muthenya wa wakeli.
translation: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Akw'iiie ku Osaka muthenya wa wakeli.
translation: Alifariki katika Osaka Jumanne.

text: Ota oũ ũla waĩ mũsĩndĩ wa olympik na nthĩ yonthe, saĩto nĩwe waĩ mũnene ngwatanĩo ya ũmanyĩsya wa Japan judo fedaratĩon.
translation: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Ota oũ ũla waĩ mũsĩndĩ wa olympik na nthĩ yonthe, saĩto nĩwe waĩ mũnene ngwatanĩo ya ũmanyĩsya wa Japan judo fedaratĩon.
translation: Pamoja na kuwa bingwa wa Olimpiki na Dunia, Saito alikuwa mwenyekiti wa kamati ya mafunzo ya Shirikisho la Judo la Japani wakati wa kifo chake.

text: Andũ ta 100 nĩmanavikie kyamanĩ kutania ulilikany'o wa mbee wa endwa ala mũtwaano woo waĩ mwaka mũthelu.
translation: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Anivasali yaw'o ĩvanĩĩwe matuku me ovu itina, maovishoo maisye ou.
translation: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Endwa asu manatwaanite Texas mwaka umwe muthelu na mooka Buffalo kutaanania na anyanyae na andu ma musyi woo.
translation: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

translation: Wanandoa hao walikuwa wameoana katika Texas mwaka mmoja uliopita na wakaja Buffalo kusherehekea na marafiki na jamaa.

text: Muume usu wa ukuu wa myaka 30, ula wasyaiwe ku Buffalo, numwe wa ala ana manoowaiwe kuathanani kuu, ateo muka ndanaaumia.
translation: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Muume usu wa ukuu wa myaka 30, ula wasyaiwe ku Buffalo, numwe wa ala ana manoowaiwe kuathanani kuu, ateo muka ndanaaumia.
