text: Karno ni yisikie muno lakini mwalimu wa kisungu ula wavundiesye ivanda ya kisomo kya matuku aa na King's Glory ula waisye kana ena amanyiwa 9,000 mwambioni wa wia wake.
translation: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Karno ni yisikie muno lakini mwalimu wa kisungu ula wavundiesye ivanda ya kisomo kya matuku aa na King's Glory ula waisye kana ena amanyiwa 9,000 mwambioni wa wia wake.
translation: Karno ni mwalimu maarufu wa Kiingereza lakini mwenye utata ambaye alifunza chini ya Elimu ya Kisasa na King's Glory ambaye alidai kuwa na wanafunzi 9,000 katika kilele cha kazi yake.

text: Nthini wa notis syake atumiie ndeto asyai amwe moonie syi sya vinya, na atumia kithyomo kya mbumangano kilasini.
translation: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Nthini wa notis syake atumiie ndeto asyai amwe moonie syi sya vinya, na atumia kithyomo kya mbumangano kilasini.
translation: Katika maelezo yake alitumia maneno ambayo wazazi wengine walichukulia kuwa ya kiupuzi na mara nyingi alitumia matusi darasani.

text: Kĩsomo Kya matũkũ aa nĩkya mũsĩkatĩe nũndũ was kũmĩthya mathangũ manene ma kũtavanya ngalĩ ate mũnenge mwĩao na kũkeng'ana ayasya kana aĩ mũnene wa kĩsũngũ.
translation: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Kĩsomo Kya matũkũ aa nĩkya mũsĩkatĩe nũndũ was kũmĩthya mathangũ manene ma kũtavanya ngalĩ ate mũnenge mwĩao na kũkeng'ana ayasya kana aĩ mũnene wa kĩsũngũ.
translation: Elimu ya Kisasa ilimlaumu kwa kuchapa matangazo makubwa kwenye mabasi bila idhini na kudanganya kwa kusema kwamba alikuwa mwalimu mkuu wa Kiingereza.

text: O ĩngi ni usikatĩitwe kutula mĩao ya kumĩthya indĩ ndaa na ndaaĩvĩthwa.
translation: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: O ĩngi ni usikatĩitwe kutula mĩao ya kumĩthya indĩ ndaa na ndaaĩvĩthwa.
translation: Pia alilaumiwa awali kwa kukiuka hakimiliki, lakini hakushtakiwa.

text: Mumanyiw'a wa tene aisye kana atumiie "ndeto syavitiwe ni ivinda kilasini, asomethya undu utonya utuma nduu na notes, na ai undumwe na munyanyae wa mumanyiw'a."
translation: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Mumanyiw'a wa tene aisye kana atumiie "ndeto syavitiwe ni ivinda kilasini, asomethya undu utonya utuma nduu na notes, na ai undumwe na munyanyae wa mumanyiw'a."
translation: Mwanafunzi wa awali alisema kwamba 'alitumia lugha ya mtaani darasani, kufunza ujuzi wa kutongoza katika maandishi, na alikuwa kama tu rafiki wa wanafunzi.'

text: Nthĩnĩ wa myaka mĩongo ĩtatũ mĩthelu, ona itina wa kwĩthwa yĩ nthĩ ya komunisti, Kyaina ninaseuvisye ekonomi ya soko.
translation: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Nthĩnĩ wa myaka mĩongo ĩtatũ mĩthelu, ona itina wa kwĩthwa yĩ nthĩ ya komunisti, Kyaina ninaseuvisye ekonomi ya soko.
translation: Wakati wa miongo mitatu iliyopita, licha ya kubaki kuwa jimbo la kikomunisti, China imekuza uchumi wa soko.

text: Maendeeo ma mbee me na uvinduku maetiwe ni utongoi wa Deng Xiaoping.
translation: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Maendeeo ma mbee me na uvinduku maetiwe ni utongoi wa Deng Xiaoping.
translation: Marekebisho ya kwanza ya kiuchumi yalifanywa chini ya uongozi wa Deng Xiaoping.

text: Kuma ivinda yu, saisi ya ekonomi ya Kyaina yianite mavinda 90.
translation: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Kuma ivinda yu, saisi ya ekonomi ya Kyaina yianite mavinda 90.
translation: Tangu wakati huo, saizi ya uchumi wa China imekua mara 90.

text: Kwa ila ya mbee mwaka muthelu China ni inatee ngali mbingi nthi sya nza kwi Germany na yavita United States ta soko nene ya ngali.
translation: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Kwa ila ya mbee mwaka muthelu China ni inatee ngali mbingi nthi sya nza kwi Germany na yavita United States ta soko nene ya ngali.
translation: Kwa mara ya kwanza, mwaka uliopita China iliuza nje magari mengi kuliko Ujerumani na ikapita Marekani kama soko kubwa zaidi kwa tasnia hii.

text: GDP ya Kyaina nitonya kwithwa yi nene kwi ya Amelika nthĩnĩ wa myaka mĩongo ĩlĩ.
translation: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: GDP ya Kyaina nitonya kwithwa yi nene kwi ya Amelika nthĩnĩ wa myaka mĩongo ĩlĩ.
translation: Huenda Pato la Taifa la China likawa kubwa kuliko la Marekani ndani ya miongo miwili.

text: Kĩuutani kya kana kya mwaka wa 2010 kya Atlantic kila kitawa Tropical Storm Danielle ni kyambiie ngaliko ya ũmilo wa sua ya ũkanga wa Atlantic.
translation: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Kĩuutani kya kana kya mwaka wa 2010 kya Atlantic kila kitawa Tropical Storm Danielle ni kyambiie ngaliko ya ũmilo wa sua ya ũkanga wa Atlantic.
translation: Dhoruba ya Kitropiki Danielle, iliyotajwa kuwa dhoruba ya nne ya msimu wa vimbunga vya Atlantiki vya 2010, imejiunda mashariki mwa Bahari ya Atlantiki.

text: Kiuutani kyu, kila ki ta maili 3,000 kuma Miami, Florida, yina iseve sya mituki ya maili 40 kwa isaa ila ni kilomita 64 kwa isaa.
translation: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Kiuutani kyu, kila ki ta maili 3,000 kuma Miami, Florida, yina iseve sya mituki ya maili 40 kwa isaa ila ni kilomita 64 kwa isaa.
translation: Dhoruba hiyo, iliyo takribani maili 3,000 kutoka Miami, Florida, ina kiwango cha juu thabiti cha upepo cha maili 40 kwa saa (kilomita 64 kwa saa).

text: Masayandisti naku National Hurricane Center matatithisye kana Danielle nukwikia vinya hurricane tuivika Wakatatũ.
translation: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Masayandisti naku National Hurricane Center matatithisye kana Danielle nukwikia vinya hurricane tuivika Wakatatũ.
translation: Wanasayansi katika Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Vimbunga wanabashiri kwamba Danielle itaimarika kuwa kimbunga kufikia Jumatano.

text: Undu ngwona storm ii ta yivaasa kuvaluka, ni vinya muno kutatithya impact yayo kwa nthi ya Amelika kana Caribbean.
translation: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Undu ngwona storm ii ta yivaasa kuvaluka, ni vinya muno kutatithya impact yayo kwa nthi ya Amelika kana Caribbean.
translation: Wakati dhoruba bado haijafikia kuporomoka kwa ardhi, inabakia kuwa vigumu kupima athari zinazoweza kukumba Marekani au Karibian.

text: Asyaitwe musyi munene wa Croatia, Zagreb, Bobek akwatie nguma ila wathaukiaa Partizan Belgrade.

text: vĩnya wa kĩw'ũ wĩthĩawa wĩmũlũmũ nũndũ kĩw'ũ kĩthĩawa kĩkwatanĩte mũno kũteũndũ kĩkwatanĩte na nzeve yĩũlũ wa kyo.
translation: Nguvu za mvuto kwenye sura hutokea kwa sababu molekyuli za maji katika sura ya maji huvutana kwa nguvu zenyewe kwa zenyewe kuliko jinsi zinavyovutwa na molekyuli za hewa zilizo juu yake.

text: Twindu twa kiwu tutumaa tuseuvya kikonde kitekwoneka iulu wa kiwu kila kituma syindu ta singano u vuloti yiulu wa kiwu.
translation: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water's surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Twindu twa kiwu tutumaa tuseuvya kikonde kitekwoneka iulu wa kiwu kila kituma syindu ta singano u vuloti yiulu wa kiwu.
translation: Molekuli za maji hutengeneza ngozi isiyoonekana katika uso wa maji ambayo huwezesha vitu kama sindano kuelea juu ya maji.

text: Ũtee wa kasamũ ka ũtwaĩa mbalavunĩ wĩthĩaa na ndee ilĩ syĩna ĩima ya mũvilingo katĩ katĩ wa sy'o. Ndee isu ilĩ situmaa ũkwati wa mbalavu wĩthĩwa mũseango, o na syĩ mbalyũũle.
translation: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Ũtee wa kasamũ ka ũtwaĩa mbalavunĩ wĩthĩaa na ndee ilĩ syĩna ĩima ya mũvilingo katĩ katĩ wa sy'o. Ndee isu ilĩ situmaa ũkwati wa mbalavu wĩthĩwa mũseango, o na syĩ mbalyũũle.
translation: Ukengele katika kibao cha kisasa cha kutelezea una ncha mbili zenye uwazi uliobonyea katikati yao. Ncha hizo mbili huruhusu kushikilia vizuri kwa barafu, hata wakati imebenuliwa.

text: Nũndũ mũthya wa kawembe nĩwĩkũmbĩte vanĩnĩ, kawembe kasonga saĩndĩ ĩmwe kana ĩla ĩngĩ, mũthya ũla ũtĩnene na ĩw'a nĩwĩkũmbaa.
translation: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Nũndũ mũthya wa kawembe nĩwĩkũmbĩte vanĩnĩ, kawembe kasonga saĩndĩ ĩmwe kana ĩla ĩngĩ, mũthya ũla ũtĩnene na ĩw'a nĩwĩkũmbaa.
translation: Kwa sababu ukengele umepindika kidogo upande wa chini, jinsi ukengele unavyoelekea upande mmoja au mwingine, ncha ambayo inaambatana na barafu pia inajipinda.

text: Kĩĩ kĩtũmaa skaters mavĩndũka. Ĩmbw'a skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skater ndavĩndũka ndasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aka, skater ndasĩsya kw'okonĩ kwa aka.
translation: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kĩĩ kĩtũmaa skaters mavĩndũka. Ĩmbw'a skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skater ndavĩndũka ndasisya kw'oko kwa aũme, skates syavĩndũka syasisya kw'oko kwa aka, skater ndasĩsya kw'okonĩ kwa aka.
translation: Hii husababisha mtelezaji kugeuka. Ikiwa vitelezi vitageuka kulia, mtelezaji anageuka kulia, ikiwa vitelezi vitageuka kushoto, mtelezaji anageuka kushoto.

text: Nikana itunge vinyani wasyo wa mbeeni, no nginya silekasya vinya usu wi yiulu ula syakwatie kuma kyenini kyu.
translation: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Nikana itunge vinyani wasyo wa mbeeni, no nginya silekasya vinya usu wi yiulu ula syakwatie kuma kyenini kyu.
translation: Ili kurejea katika hali yao ya awali ya nishati, ni lazima ziondoe nishati ya ziada zilizopata kutoka kwa mwangaza.

text: mekaa ũũ kwĩsĩla kũmya kaĩndo kanĩnĩ vyũ ka kyenĩ ketawa "photon".
translation: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: mekaa ũũ kwĩsĩla kũmya kaĩndo kanĩnĩ vyũ ka kyenĩ ketawa "photon".
translation: Hufanya hivi kwa kutoa chembe ndogo ya mwanga inayoitwa "fotoni".

text: Andu ma saenzi metaa nzia ii "stimulated emission ya radiation" nundu atomu syithwaa syi stimulated ni kyeni kingí, vakatuma photon sya kyeni syuma, na kyeni ni muthemba wa radiation.
translation: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Andu ma saenzi metaa nzia ii "stimulated emission ya radiation" nundu atomu syithwaa syi stimulated ni kyeni kingí, vakatuma photon sya kyeni syuma, na kyeni ni muthemba wa radiation.
translation: Wanasayansi huita mchakato huu "utoaji wa mionzi uliosisimuliwa" kwani atomu husisimuliwa na mwanga mkali, na kusababisha utoaji wa fotoni ya mwanga, na mwanga ni aina ya mionzi.

text: Ivisa ila yiatiie yionany'a atoms iyumya protons. Na kwa uw'o protons syithwaa syi o nini vanini kwi isu syi visani.
translation: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Ivisa ila yiatiie yionany'a atoms iyumya protons. Na kwa uw'o protons syithwaa syi o nini vanini kwi isu syi visani.
translation: Picha inayofuata inaonyesha atomu zikitoa fotoni. Kwa hakika, katika hali halisi fotoni ni ndogo zaidi kuliko zile zilizo kwenye picha.

text: Protons ona syithwa syi niini kuvita syindu ila iseuvitye atomu!
translation: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Protons ona syithwa syi niini kuvita syindu ila iseuvitye atomu!
translation: Fotoni ni ndogo hata kuliko vitu vinavyotengeneza atomu!

text: Itina wa masaa maana ma uthukumi koma ka ngulovu mwisowe nikaunguie na I ngulovu yaeka kwakana.
translation: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Itina wa masaa maana ma uthukumi koma ka ngulovu mwisowe nikaunguie na I ngulovu yaeka kwakana.
translation: Baada ya mamia ya saa za operesheni, hatimaye uzi wa balbu unaungua na balbu ya nuru haiwezi kufanya kazi tena.

text: Ngulovu nĩyendaa ukuanw'a ingĩ. Nuseo kwisuvia ila uukuany'a I ngulovu.
translation: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Ngulovu nĩyendaa ukuanw'a ingĩ. Nuseo kwisuvia ila uukuany'a I ngulovu.
translation: Balbu ya mwanga basi inahitaji kubadilishwa. Ni muhimu kuwa na uangalifu wakati wa kuibadilisha balbu ya mwanga.

text: Mbee, swikyi ya ithau ya kyeni yienda amba uvow'a kana waya ukuuwe.
translation: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Mbee, swikyi ya ithau ya kyeni yienda amba uvow'a kana waya ukuuwe.
translation: Kwanza, swichi ya taa nyepesi inahitaji kuzimwa au waya kutengwa.

text: Uu nundu mwaki wa sitima undu ulikite soketini vala paati isu ya kyuma yii na ngulovu yukaa ukomeea no yiukune shoko kethwa nuukwata nthini wa soketi kana kwa base ya kyuma kya ngulovu o ila yikwatene na soketi.
translation: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Uu nundu mwaki wa sitima undu ulikite soketini vala paati isu ya kyuma yii na ngulovu yukaa ukomeea no yiukune shoko kethwa nuukwata nthini wa soketi kana kwa base ya kyuma kya ngulovu o ila yikwatene na soketi.
translation: Hii ni kwa sababu umeme unaopita ndani ya soketi ambamo sehemu ya metali ya balbu hukaa unaweza kukupa mshtuko mkubwa wa umeme ukikugusa sehemu ya ndani ya soketi ama sehemu ya metali ya balbu ikiwa bado ina sehemu iliyobakia kwenye tundu.

text: Imutha yi vata muno ya circulatory system ni ngoo, ila ikunaa nthakame.
translation: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Imutha yi vata muno ya circulatory system ni ngoo, ila ikunaa nthakame.
translation: Kiungo kikuu cha mfumo wa mzunguko ni moyo, ambao hupiga damu.

text: Nthakame yumaalukilaa tiuvuni witawa arteries na yĩisyokela tiuvuni syitawa mikiva. Tiuvu ila miniini vyu yitawa capillaries.
translation: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Nthakame yumaalukilaa tiuvuni witawa arteries na yĩisyokela tiuvuni syitawa mikiva. Tiuvu ila miniini vyu yitawa capillaries.
translation: Damu inatoka moyoni katika mirija inayoitwa ateri na inarudi moyoni katika mirija inayoitwa vena. Mirija midogo kabisa huitwa kapilari.

text: Maeo ma triceratops mei matonya utilany'a o na ti matu me moka ateo nginya maka na mii myetu.
translation: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Maeo ma triceratops mei matonya utilany'a o na ti matu me moka ateo nginya maka na mii myetu.
translation: Meno ya triseratopu yangeweza kuponda si majani pekee, bali pia matawi na mizizi migumu sana.

text: Asomi amwe ma sainzi masuaniaa kana ndainoso syaie miti ya maliu na ndawa, ila muthemba wa miti wakwatikanaa muno Cretaceous.
translation: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Asomi amwe ma sainzi masuaniaa kana ndainoso syaie miti ya maliu na ndawa, ila muthemba wa miti wakwatikanaa muno Cretaceous.
translation: Baadhi ya wanasayansi wanadhani kwamba Triseratopu walikula sikadi, ambazo ni aina ya mmea uliokuwa wa kawaida katika Kretasea.

text: Miti isu yielye minathi nini yina miva mbũi na matu meutonyana.
translation: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Miti isu yielye minathi nini yina miva mbũi na matu meutonyana.
translation: Mimea hii inaonekana kama mtende mdogo wenye taji ya majani yenye ncha kali, yenye miiba.

text: Triceratops yai itonya kutumia munyuka wayo mulumu kuya matu itanamba kuya itina ya muti usu.
translation: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Triceratops yai itonya kutumia munyuka wayo mulumu kuya matu itanamba kuya itina ya muti usu.
translation: Triseratops angeutumia mdomo wake wenye nguvu kuyatoa majani kabla ya kula shina.

text: Andu ma Saienzi measya miti ino yi sumu mwingi na vaitonyeka kwitha ndainosa ya miisaa, ona vala umunthi ve nyamu simisaa kwa ngelekany'o kasuku (usyao wa ndainosa) niyiisaa matu kana matunda me sumu.
translation: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Andu ma Saienzi measya miti ino yi sumu mwingi na vaitonyeka kwitha ndainosa ya miisaa, ona vala umunthi ve nyamu simisaa kwa ngelekany'o kasuku (usyao wa ndainosa) niyiisaa matu kana matunda me sumu.
translation: Wanasayansi wengine wanadai kuwa mimea hii ina sumu kali na kwa hiyo hakuna uwezekano kuwa dinosaria yeyote aliila, ingawa leo hii wavivu na wanyama wengine kama kasuku (kizazi cha dinosaria) wanaweza kula majani au matunda ya sumu.

text: Vinya wa Io, utonya kungusya ata? Ukaelya kuungama iulu wa Io, uito waku wailite kwithiwa wi munini mbee wa uito waku wi kuu nthi.
translation: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Vinya wa Io, utonya kungusya ata? Ukaelya kuungama iulu wa Io, uito waku wailite kwithiwa wi munini mbee wa uito waku wi kuu nthi.
translation: Mvuto wa lo ungewezaje kunivuta? Kama ungesimama katika uso wa lo, ungekuwa na uzani mdogo kuliko ulionao duniani.

text: Mundu wa uito wa paundi 200 vaa nthi atonya kuma paundi 36 kuya Io. Kwoou vinya ula ukusasya syindu syelekele nthi, ku withiawa wi muoleku.
translation: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Mundu wa uito wa paundi 200 vaa nthi atonya kuma paundi 36 kuya Io. Kwoou vinya ula ukusasya syindu syelekele nthi, ku withiawa wi muoleku.
translation: Mtu aliye na uzito wa pauni 200 (kilogramu 90) duniani anaweza kuwa na uzito wa pauni 36 (kilogramu 16) kwenye lo. Kwa hivyo mvuto, bila shaka, huvuta kidogo sana kwako.

text: Sua yii vandũ vomũ va kũungama ta nthi ino. Sua yiseovetwe na nzeve, mwaki na ũsũu (plasma).
translation: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Sua yii vandũ vomũ va kũungama ta nthi ino. Sua yiseovetwe na nzeve, mwaki na ũsũu (plasma).
translation: Jua halina ganda gumu kama Dunia ambayo unaweza kusimama kwayo. Jua zima limetengenezwa kwa gesi, moto, na gesi ya utegili.

text: Nzeve iendeeaa na kuvutha o undu uendete vaasa na sua.
translation: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Nzeve iendeeaa na kuvutha o undu uendete vaasa na sua.
translation: Gesi huwa nyembamba kadiri unavyosonga mbali na Jua.

text: Ngalĩko ya nza ĩla twonaa twasyaĩsya syũa ĩĩtawa protosphere, nĩkw'o kwasya "mũvĩla wa kyeni".
translation: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ngalĩko ya nza ĩla twonaa twasyaĩsya syũa ĩĩtawa protosphere, nĩkw'o kwasya "mũvĩla wa kyeni".
translation: Sehemu ya nje tunayoona tunapotazama jua inaitwa photosphere, kumaanisha "mpira wa mwanga".

text: Ta myaka ngili itatũ ĩtinanĩ, mwakani wa 1610, mũsoomi wa ndata wa Italy Galileo Galilei aatũmĩie kamasini ka kwonan'ya syĩndũ syi kuasa nesa kwona kana Venus ithiawa na ilungu, o ta ũndũ mwai wĩthĩawa.
translation: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Ta myaka ngili itatũ ĩtinanĩ, mwakani wa 1610, mũsoomi wa ndata wa Italy Galileo Galilei aatũmĩie kamasini ka kwonan'ya syĩndũ syi kuasa nesa kwona kana Venus ithiawa na ilungu, o ta ũndũ mwai wĩthĩawa.
translation: Takribani miaka elfu tatu baadaye, mnamo 1610, Mnajimu Muitaliano Galileo Galilei alitumia darubini kuangalia kwamba Zuhura ina awamu, kama vile mwezi.

text: Mavinda mekĩkaa nũndũ tũ no ngalĩko ya Venus (kana ya mwei) ĩla ĩng'ethanĩsye na syũa yĩna kyeni. Mavinda ma Venus nĩmakwataa mbau ngewa ya Copernicus ĩla yasyaa kana vulaneti nithyũlũlũkĩte syũa.
translation: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Mavinda mekĩkaa nũndũ tũ no ngalĩko ya Venus (kana ya mwei) ĩla ĩng'ethanĩsye na syũa yĩna kyeni. Mavinda ma Venus nĩmakwataa mbau ngewa ya Copernicus ĩla yasyaa kana vulaneti nithyũlũlũkĩte syũa.
translation: Awamu hufanyika kwa sababu tu upande wa Zuhura (au wa Mwezi) unaoegemea upande wa Jua hupata mwanga. Awamu za Zuhura ziliunga mkono nadharia ya Kopernikasi kwamba sayari zinazunguka Jua.

text: ĩndĩ, myaka minini itina twĩ 1639, astronoma umwe wa muvai wa mũũsũngũ wetawa Jeremiah Horrocks niwoonie transit ya Venus.
translation: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: ĩndĩ, myaka minini itina twĩ 1639, astronoma umwe wa muvai wa mũũsũngũ wetawa Jeremiah Horrocks niwoonie transit ya Venus.
translation: Kisha, miaka michache baadaye mwaka wa 1639, mnajimu Mwingereza aliyeitwa Jeremiah Horrocks alitazama safari ya Venus.

text: Uungelesa ni ya kwatie muuo wa kilungu kiasa itina ya kukilya vinya ingi Danelaw.
translation: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Uungelesa ni ya kwatie muuo wa kilungu kiasa itina ya kukilya vinya ingi Danelaw.
translation: Uingereza ilikuwa na uzoefu wa kipindi kirefu cha amani baada ya kushinda upya Danelaw.

text: O na vamwe na uu mwakani wa 991 Ethelred akomanie na nguthu ya asikali nene kwi ingi yonthe kuma ila ya Guthrum myaka iana mbeeni.
translation: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: O na vamwe na uu mwakani wa 991 Ethelred akomanie na nguthu ya asikali nene kwi ingi yonthe kuma ila ya Guthrum myaka iana mbeeni.
translation: Walakini mnamo 991 Ethelred alikabiliwa na kundi la manowari la Viking kubwa kuliko lolote tangu la Guthrum karne moja mapema.

text: Matongoiwe ni Olaf Trygvasson wa Norweg ula waina wendi wa kwosa nthi yake kuma mokoni ma Denmark.
translation: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Matongoiwe ni Olaf Trygvasson wa Norweg ula waina wendi wa kwosa nthi yake kuma mokoni ma Denmark.
translation: Manowari hizi ziliongozwa na Olaf Trygvasson, Mnorwei aliye na matarajio ya kurudisha nchi yake kutoka kwa utawala wa Kidenmaki.

text: Itina wa syindu sya kuaa ngoo sya a jeshi sya mbee, Ethelred niwai na utonyi wa kwitikilana na mawendi ma Olaf, ula wasyokie Norway kutatithya kwosa usumbi wake ena usindi muvulany'e.
translation: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Itina wa syindu sya kuaa ngoo sya a jeshi sya mbee, Ethelred niwai na utonyi wa kwitikilana na mawendi ma Olaf, ula wasyokie Norway kutatithya kwosa usumbi wake ena usindi muvulany'e.
translation: Baada ya vipingamizi vya kwanza vya kijeshi, Ethelred aliweza kukubaliana kimasharti na Olaf, ambaye alirudi Norwe ili kujaribu kupata ufalme wake, kwa mafanikio mseto.

text: Kithyomo kya Hangeul ni kyo kithyomo ki kyoka kila kyaseuvisye na kitumi. Kyaseuvisye mwaka wa 1444 ivinda ya Musumbi Sejong (1418-1450).
translation: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Kithyomo kya Hangeul ni kyo kithyomo ki kyoka kila kyaseuvisye na kitumi. Kyaseuvisye mwaka wa 1444 ivinda ya Musumbi Sejong (1418-1450).
translation: Hangeul ndiyo alfabeti ya kipekee iliyovumbuliwa kimakusudi inayotumika kimaarufu kila siku. Alfabeti hiyo ilivumbuliwa mwaka wa 1444 wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mũsumbĩ Sejong aĩ mũsumbĩ wa kana wa Ũsumbĩ wa Joseon na ũmwe wa ala mane'twe ndaĩa mũno.
translation: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Mũsumbĩ Sejong aĩ mũsumbĩ wa kana wa Ũsumbĩ wa Joseon na ũmwe wa ala mane'twe ndaĩa mũno.
translation: Mfalme Sejong alikua ndiye mfalme wa nne kwenye Nasaba ya Joseon na ndiye aliyezingatiwa Zaidi.

text: Mwambililyoni eetie muvango usu wa ndeto wa Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ila niyo "mawasya ala maw'o ma uvundusya andu".
translation: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Mwambililyoni eetie muvango usu wa ndeto wa Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, ila niyo "mawasya ala maw'o ma uvundusya andu".
translation: Mwanzoni aliipatia alfabeti ya Hangeul jina la Hunmin Jeongeum, kumaanisha "sauti sahihi za maagizo kwa watu".

text: Ve ngewa mbingi sya undu Sanskrit wasyaiwe. Imwe ni kuthama kwa Aryan kuma ngaliko ya uthuilo wa sua kuka India na ala mookie na kithyomo kyoo.
translation: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Ve ngewa mbingi sya undu Sanskrit wasyaiwe. Imwe ni kuthama kwa Aryan kuma ngaliko ya uthuilo wa sua kuka India na ala mookie na kithyomo kyoo.
translation: Kuna nadharia nyingi kuhusu vile Sanskrit ilikuja kuwepo. Mojawapo ni kuhusu uhamaji wa Aryan kutoka magharibi hadi India waliokuja na lugha yao.

text: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kya tene na kivw'ananithw'a na Kilatino kila kinaeenawa Yulovu kikyoka.
translation: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kya tene na kivw'ananithw'a na Kilatino kila kinaeenawa Yulovu kikyoka.
translation: Sanskrit ni lugha ya kale na inaweza kulinganishwa na lugha ya Kilatini inayozungumzwa Uropa.

text: Ivuku yila ya tene muno yisikie iulu wa nthi yaandikiwe Sanskrit. Itina wa kukwatanwa na Upanishads, Sanskrit yathelile vyu.
translation: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Ivuku yila ya tene muno yisikie iulu wa nthi yaandikiwe Sanskrit. Itina wa kukwatanwa na Upanishads, Sanskrit yathelile vyu.
translation: Kitabu cha mapema zaidi kijulikanacho duniani kiliandikwa kwa Sanskrit. Baada ya utungaji wa Upanishads, Sanskrit ilififia tu kwa sababu ya mfumo wa viwango.

text: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kimwe kivinya na kithw'ii, kila kithiitwe ta mwabiliilyo wa ithyomo mbingi sya matuku aa sya India, o undu Latini niyo mwambiliilyo wa ithyomo sya asungu ta kivalanza na kiisipania.
translation: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Sanskrit ni kithyomo kimwe kivinya na kithw'ii, kila kithiitwe ta mwabiliilyo wa ithyomo mbingi sya matuku aa sya India, o undu Latini niyo mwambiliilyo wa ithyomo sya asungu ta kivalanza na kiisipania.
translation: Sanskrit ni lugha tata na tajiri sana, ambayo imekuwa chanzo cha lugha nyingi za kisasa za Kihindi, kama vile Kilatini ilivyo chanzo cha lugha za Kizungu kama vile Kifaransa na Kispanya.

text: Kaũ wa kũũkitĩa France wĩ mũthelu, Germany yaambĩsye kwiyũmbany'a kuvithukia kithama kya Uungelesa.
translation: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Kaũ wa kũũkitĩa France wĩ mũthelu, Germany yaambĩsye kwiyũmbany'a kuvithukia kithama kya Uungelesa.
translation: Vita kwa Ufaransa vikiwa vimekwisha, Ujerumani ilianza kujitayarisha kuvamia kisiwa cha Uingereza.

text: Germany yatwie kũvithũkĩwa kyu isyitwa ya "Operation Sealion". Míio mingi ngito ya asikali ma ita ma úúngelesa yai inaa ila maumiw'e kuma Dunkirk, kwoou ita ndyai na vinya muno.
translation: Germany code-named the attack "Operation Sealion". Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Germany yatwie kũvithũkĩwa kyu isyitwa ya "Operation Sealion". Míio mingi ngito ya asikali ma ita ma úúngelesa yai inaa ila maumiw'e kuma Dunkirk, kwoou ita ndyai na vinya muno.
translation: Ujerumani ililipa shambulio jina lililosimbwa la "Operation Sealion". Silaha nyingi nzito na vifaa vya Jeshi la Uingereza vilikuwa vimepotea wakati wa kutoka Dunkirk, kwa hivyo jeshi lilikuwa dhaifu kiasi.

text: Indi a jeshi ma kiw'uni ma usumbi mai o na vinya mwingi kwii ajeshi ma kiw'uni ma Germany ("Kriegsmarine") na mai matonya kwananga aliki onthe ma vinya matumitwe kwisila nzia ya Kisungu.
translation: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy ("Kriegsmarine") and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Indi a jeshi ma kiw'uni ma usumbi mai o na vinya mwingi kwii ajeshi ma kiw'uni ma Germany ("Kriegsmarine") na mai matonya kwananga aliki onthe ma vinya matumitwe kwisila nzia ya Kisungu.
translation: Lakini Nevi ya Kifalme bado ilikuwa imara sana zaidi ya Nevi ya Ujerumani ("Kriegsmarine") na ingeweza kuangamiza kikosi chochote cha ushambuliaji kilichotumwa katika Mlango-bahari wa Uingereza.

text: O na vamwe na uu, meli o nini sya jeshi ya kiusumbi nosyo syaungeemw'e vakuvi na nzia ila syai itonya utumiwa kulikililwa na vinya nundu anene ma jeshi ya kiw'uni ni maakiaa kwisa ulikywa kiw'uni ni kau wa nzeveni wa a German.
translation: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: O na vamwe na uu, meli o nini sya jeshi ya kiusumbi nosyo syaungeemw'e vakuvi na nzia ila syai itonya utumiwa kulikililwa na vinya nundu anene ma jeshi ya kiw'uni ni maakiaa kwisa ulikywa kiw'uni ni kau wa nzeveni wa a German.
translation: Kwa hali yoyote, ni meli chache sana za jeshi la kifalme zilizo karibu na njia za uvamizi kwa sababu wanahofia kusamishwa na mashambulizi ya hewa ya Kijerumani.

text: Twambiisye na kuelesya mivango ya Italy. Italy yai muinae wa Germany na Japan.
translation: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Twambiisye na kuelesya mivango ya Italy. Italy yai muinae wa Germany na Japan.
translation: Hebu tuanze na maelezo kuhusu mipango ya Italia. Italia ilikuwa hasa "kaka mdogo" wa Ujerumani na Japani.

text: Ita syake sya nthi mbumu na kiwuni syai mbozu ona vala ni yaakite meli inya nzau kau utanamba ambiia.
translation: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ita syake sya nthi mbumu na kiwuni syai mbozu ona vala ni yaakite meli inya nzau kau utanamba ambiia.
translation: Ilikuwa na jeshi dhaifu na nevi dhaifu, ingawa walikuwa wamejenga tu meli nne mpya kabla ya kuanza kwa vita.

text: Ieleelo nene sya Itali syai nthi sya Avilika. Kukwata nthi isu, mendaa ithwa na kikosikya kya asikali, nikenda kikosi kyu kisile ukanga wa Mediterranean na meivivúkia Avilika.
translation: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ieleelo nene sya Itali syai nthi sya Avilika. Kukwata nthi isu, mendaa ithwa na kikosikya kya asikali, nikenda kikosi kyu kisile ukanga wa Mediterranean na meivivúkia Avilika.
translation: Malengo makuu ya Italiano yalikuwa nchi za Kiafrika. Ili kunasa nchi hizo, walihitaji kuwa na pedi ya kurushia vikosi, ili vikosi viweze kusafiri katika Bahari ya Mediteranea na kuishambulia Afrika.

text: Kwondu wa uu, mai no mavetangaa vyu ngome sya asungu ku Misili. Eka kiu, meli sya kau sya Itali iyaaile ukuna wia ungi.
translation: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Kwondu wa uu, mai no mavetangaa vyu ngome sya asungu ku Misili. Eka kiu, meli sya kau sya Itali iyaaile ukuna wia ungi.
translation: Kwa hayo, walihitaji kuondoa kambi na meli za Uingereza kutoka Misri. Zaidi ya hatua hizo, manowari za Italia hazikupaswa kufanya lingine lolote.

text: Oyu undu wa Japan. Japan kyai kithama, ta Britain.
translation: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Oyu undu wa Japan. Japan kyai kithama, ta Britain.
translation: Sasa kwa Japani. Japani ilikuwa nchi ya kisiwa, kama vile Uingereza.

text: Meli sya ungu wa kiwu iseuvitwe kwisila ungu wa kiwu, na syikalaa vau kwa ivinda yiasa.
translation: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Meli sya ungu wa kiwu iseuvitwe kwisila ungu wa kiwu, na syikalaa vau kwa ivinda yiasa.
translation: Sabmarini ni meli zilizoundwa kusafiri chini ya maji, na kubaki hapo kwa muda mrefu.

text: Meli sya kaũ ni syatumiiwe kaũni wa mbee wa nthi yonthe na wa keli. Ivinda yiũ syai na mbola muno na syaumasya mavuti mbola.
translation: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Meli sya kaũ ni syatumiiwe kaũni wa mbee wa nthi yonthe na wa keli. Ivinda yiũ syai na mbola muno na syaumasya mavuti mbola.
translation: Nyambizi zilitumiwa katika vita vya pili vya dunia. Wakati huo zilisonga polepole sana na zilikuwa na masafa mafupi sana ya upigaji risasi.

text: Mwambiioni wa kaũ matembeaa muno ulũ wa ukanga indĩ ila ngasi yaambie kuseuvya na kitha nyĩ nzeo maendie nthini wa kiwũ ni kenda maikonekane.
translation: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Mwambiioni wa kaũ matembeaa muno ulũ wa ukanga indĩ ila ngasi yaambie kuseuvya na kitha nyĩ nzeo maendie nthini wa kiwũ ni kenda maikonekane.
translation: Mwanzoni mwa vita zilisonga mara nyingi juu ya bahari, lakini kadiri rada ilivyoanza kukua na kupata usahihi zaidi nyambizi zililazimika kuzama chini ya maji ili kuepuka kuonekana.

text: Meli sya Germany syeetawa U-boat. Andu ma Germany ni matembeaa kiwuni nesa na nimatwaa meli syoo nesa.
translation: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Meli sya Germany syeetawa U-boat. Andu ma Germany ni matembeaa kiwuni nesa na nimatwaa meli syoo nesa.
translation: Manowari za Ujerumani ziliitwa nyambizi. Wajerumani walikuwa wazuri sana kwa kuabiri na kuendesha manowari zao.

text: Nundu wa kwona nesa na submarinezi, itina wa kaũ andu ma Germani mayiikika kwithiwa nasyo mbingi.
translation: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Nundu wa kwona nesa na submarinezi, itina wa kaũ andu ma Germani mayiikika kwithiwa nasyo mbingi.
translation: Kwa sababu ya mafanikio yao na nyambizi, baada ya vita Wajerumani hawaaminiki kuwa na nyingi zazo.

text: Yii! Musumbi Tutankhamun, ula saaingi witawa "Musumbi Tut" kana "Musumbi kimwana" numwe kati wa ala me nguma ma tene na asumbi ma Misili ma ivinda yii.
translation: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Yii! Musumbi Tutankhamun, ula saaingi witawa "Musumbi Tut" kana "Musumbi kimwana" numwe kati wa ala me nguma ma tene na asumbi ma Misili ma ivinda yii.
translation: Ndiyo! Mfalme Tutankhamuni, ambaye wakati mwingine hutambuliwa kama "Mfalme Tuti" au "Mfalme Mvulana", ni mmojawapo wa wafalme wa zamani wa Misri wanaojulikana sana katika nyakati za sasa.

text: Kwendeesya, ndoneka ekĩtũmĩ kĩnene ĩvĩnda ya tene na ndaĩ mũandĩke mũno mavũkũnĩ ma asũmbĩ matene.
translation: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Kwendeesya, ndoneka ekĩtũmĩ kĩnene ĩvĩnda ya tene na ndaĩ mũandĩke mũno mavũkũnĩ ma asũmbĩ matene.
translation: Kwa kushangaza, hakuchukuliwa kuwa muhimu katika zamani za kale na hakurekodiwa kwenye nyingi za orodha za wafalme.

text: Onou wiovo, kuvumbuwa kwa kavuli kake mwaka wa 1922 ni kwamunengie nguma muno. O yila tuvuli twingi twavithukiawa na kuywa, kavuli kaa katyaakiitwa ni mundu.
translation: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Onou wiovo, kuvumbuwa kwa kavuli kake mwaka wa 1922 ni kwamunengie nguma muno. O yila tuvuli twingi twavithukiawa na kuywa, kavuli kaa katyaakiitwa ni mundu.
translation: Hata hivyo, ugunduzi wa kaburi lake mnamo 1922 ulimfanya mtu mashuhuri. Huku makaburi mengi ya zamani yakiporwa, kaburi hili liliachwa karibu bila kusumbuliwa kamwe.

text: Syĩndũ mbĩngĩ ila ithikĩtwe syĩna Tũtankhamũn nĩsyasuviiwe nesa, vamwe na makili ma mavisa ma kwasa maseũvĩtwe kũma syũmanĩ na mavĩanĩ me mwoo.
translation: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Syĩndũ mbĩngĩ ila ithikĩtwe syĩna Tũtankhamũn nĩsyasuviiwe nesa, vamwe na makili ma mavisa ma kwasa maseũvĩtwe kũma syũmanĩ na mavĩanĩ me mwoo.
translation: Vitu vingi vilivyozikwa na Tutankhamun vimehifadhiwa vizuri, ikiwa ni pamoja na maelfu ya sanaa zilizoundwa kutoka kwa madini ya thamani na mawe adimu.

text: Kukundua kwa ndia sya waya kwatumie makasya ma Assyria mavutha, mituki, na kwithwa issemba mituki kwi asikali na makasya ala angi.
translation: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Kukundua kwa ndia sya waya kwatumie makasya ma Assyria mavutha, mituki, na kwithwa issemba mituki kwi asikali na makasya ala angi.
translation: Uvumbuzi wa magurudumu ya spoki ulifanya magari ya Ashuru yawe mepesi, haraka, na yaliyo tayari zaidi kushinda askari na magari mengine.

text: maangĩ kũma mbũtanĩ syoo nthũkũ mũno nosyĩtonye maĩma ona kwĩsĩla ĩsĩĩnĩ syoo sya kũkita sya asĩkalĩ moo.ta 1000 B.C., Asĩlĩa nĩmambĩĩsye ita syambee sya kũkita syĩ mbalasĩnĩ.
translation: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: maangĩ kũma mbũtanĩ syoo nthũkũ mũno nosyĩtonye maĩma ona kwĩsĩla ĩsĩĩnĩ syoo sya kũkita sya asĩkalĩ moo.ta 1000 B.C., Asĩlĩa nĩmambĩĩsye ita syambee sya kũkita syĩ mbalasĩnĩ.
translation: Mishale kutoka kwenye nyuta zao hatari ingeweza kupenya ngao za askari wapinzani. Takribani 1000 BC, Waashuru walianzisha farasi wa kwanza wa vita.

text: Cavalry ni yeshi ila yukitaa yi muongoni wa mbalasi. Saddle iyambite kuseuvwa, kwoou cavalry ya Assyria yokitie miongoni nthei ya mbalasi kyoo.
translation: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Cavalry ni yeshi ila yukitaa yi muongoni wa mbalasi. Saddle iyambite kuseuvwa, kwoou cavalry ya Assyria yokitie miongoni nthei ya mbalasi kyoo.
translation: Askari farasi ni jeshi linalopigana juu ya farasi. Matandiko yalikuwa bado hayajavumbuliwa, kwa hivyo askari farasi wa Ashuru walipigana kwenye migongo tupu ya farasi wao.

text: Nitwisi anasiasa aingi ma ukiliki anasayanzi, na asanii. Muno muno mundu ula wisikie muno kwa kithio kii ni Homer, mutungi usu wi nguma wa shaili, ula waandikie utungi wi mwanya isomoni ya Kikiliki: shaili ta Iliad na Odyssey.
translation: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Nitwisi anasiasa aingi ma ukiliki anasayanzi, na asanii. Muno muno mundu ula wisikie muno kwa kithio kii ni Homer, mutungi usu wi nguma wa shaili, ula waandikie utungi wi mwanya isomoni ya Kikiliki: shaili ta Iliad na Odyssey.
translation: Tunawajua wengi wa wanasiasa, wanasayansi na wasanii wa Ugiriki. Yamkini mtu anayejulikana sana katika utamaduni huu ni Homer, malenga wa mashairi aliyekuwa kipofu, aliyebuni tungo mbili bora sana za fasihi ya Kigiriki: mashairi Iliad na Odyssey.

text: Sophocles na Aristophanes ni aandiki ma mathau mesikie na mathau moo ni mosawa ta amwe kati wa ala maseo ma kuandikwa.
translation: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Sophocles na Aristophanes ni aandiki ma mathau mesikie na mathau moo ni mosawa ta amwe kati wa ala maseo ma kuandikwa.
translation: Sophocles na Aristophanes bado ni waandishi maarufu wa michezo ya kuigiza na michezo yao huzingatiwa kuwa miongoni mwa kazi kubwa za fasihi ya ulimwengu.

text: Mũndũ ũngĩ wĩ ngũma mũno wa Greek nĩ mwĩkĩ wa masavũ Pythagoras, ũla wĩsĩkanĩe mũno kwa mwĩao wake wa kũtaanya kwa ngalĩko sya triangle yĩ kona ĩmwe yĩ ndikilii mĩongo kenda.
translation: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Mũndũ ũngĩ wĩ ngũma mũno wa Greek nĩ mwĩkĩ wa masavũ Pythagoras, ũla wĩsĩkanĩe mũno kwa mwĩao wake wa kũtaanya kwa ngalĩko sya triangle yĩ kona ĩmwe yĩ ndikilii mĩongo kenda.
translation: Mgiriki mwingine maarufu ni Pythagoras, anayejulikana sana kwa nadharia zake maarufu za hisabati kuhusu uhusiano wa pande za pembe tatu zenye pembemraba.

text: Kwi utalo kivathũkany'o wa ũtalo wa andũ ala maneneenaa Kihindi. Ni kitalitwe kwitha kithyomo kya keli kana kya kana kwa ithyomo ila syineenawa mũno iũlu wa nthi.
translation: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Kwi utalo kivathũkany'o wa ũtalo wa andũ ala maneneenaa Kihindi. Ni kitalitwe kwitha kithyomo kya keli kana kya kana kwa ithyomo ila syineenawa mũno iũlu wa nthi.
translation: Kuna makadirio yanayotofautiana kuhusu idadi ya watu wanaozungumza Kihindi. Inakadiriwa kuwa kati ya lugha nambari mbili na nne inayozungumzwa zaidi duniani.

text: Namba ya andu ala maneenaa kithyomo kyoo nisenzasya na itengemeaa kethwa mineenele yoo ithengeanie no italwe.
translation: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Namba ya andu ala maneenaa kithyomo kyoo nisenzasya na itengemeaa kethwa mineenele yoo ithengeanie no italwe.
translation: Idadi ya wazungumzaji wenyeji hutofautiana kulingana na kama lahaja zinazohusiana kwa karibu sana zinahesabiwa au la.

text: Wĩanany'o wĩ katĩ wa aneeni milioni 340 ĩna nginya milioni 500, na kuvikiia andu milioni 800 no maelewa kĩthyomo kĩu.
translation: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Wĩanany'o wĩ katĩ wa aneeni milioni 340 ĩna nginya milioni 500, na kuvikiia andu milioni 800 no maelewa kĩthyomo kĩu.
translation: Makadirio yanafikia wasemaji milioni 340 hadi milioni 500, na watu wengi kama milioni 800 wanaweza kuielewa lugha hiyo.

text: Hindi na Urdu nundumwe kwa undu siumini ateo ni kivathukany'o kwa kuandika; kwa kuneena kwa kila muthenya, aneeni ma syeli nomew'ane.
translation: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Hindi na Urdu nundumwe kwa undu siumini ateo ni kivathukany'o kwa kuandika; kwa kuneena kwa kila muthenya, aneeni ma syeli nomew'ane.
translation: Kihindi na Kiurdu zinafanana kwa msamiati lakini tofauti katika hati; katika mazungumzo ya kila siku, wazungumzaji wa lugha zote mbili wanaweza kuelewana.

text: Myakani ya 1500 kĩthĩo cha Estonia ya Yiulũ chaalyũkitwe ni Germany.
translation: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Myakani ya 1500 kĩthĩo cha Estonia ya Yiulũ chaalyũkitwe ni Germany.
translation: Karibu karne ya 15, Estonia kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya ushawishi mkubwa wa kiutamaduni wa Ujerumani.

text: Mamonks amwe ma german meenda kũete ngaĩ vakũvĩ na andũ moo, na kwoũ maseũvya kĩthyomo kya estonĩan.
translation: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Mamonks amwe ma german meenda kũete ngaĩ vakũvĩ na andũ moo, na kwoũ maseũvya kĩthyomo kya estonĩan.
translation: Watawa wengine wa Kijerumani walitaka kumleta Mungu karibu na watu asili, kwa hivyo wakabuni lugha halisi ya Kiestonia

text: Yaseuvitw'e kuma kwi namba sya Germany na namba imwe "~O/~o" yongelwa.
translation: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Yaseuvitw'e kuma kwi namba sya Germany na namba imwe "~O/~o" yongelwa.
translation: Ilihusishwa na alfabeti ya kijerumani na alfabeti moja "Õ/õ" ikaongezwa.

text: O ivinda yiendete, ndeto mbingi ila syaumiw'e kuma German coalesced. Uu niw'o wai mwambiio wa umanyi.
translation: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: O ivinda yiendete, ndeto mbingi ila syaumiw'e kuma German coalesced. Uu niw'o wai mwambiio wa umanyi.
translation: Kadiri muda ulivyopita, maneno mengi yaliyoombwa kutoka Ujerumani yalichanganyika. Huu ulikuwa mwanzo wa uelewa.

text: Kawaita, ula ukwosa kivila aile uthi imwe kwa ita itina wa umina sukulu.
translation: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Kawaita, ula ukwosa kivila aile uthi imwe kwa ita itina wa umina sukulu.
translation: Kitamaduni, mrithi wa kiti cha enzi angeenda moja kwa moja kwa uanajeshi baada ya kuhitimu shuleni.

text: O vailye uu, Charles aendie kimanyisyo kinene kya Trinity College, Cambridge vala wasomeie Antropology na Archaeology, na itina history, akwete 2:2 (ndikilii ya kilasi kya keli kya nthi).
translation: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: O vailye uu, Charles aendie kimanyisyo kinene kya Trinity College, Cambridge vala wasomeie Antropology na Archaeology, na itina history, akwete 2:2 (ndikilii ya kilasi kya keli kya nthi).
translation: Walakini, Charles alienda katika Trinity College, Cambridge mahali alisomea Anthropolojia na Akiolojia, na baadaye Historia, akapokea 2:2 (shahada ya pili kutoka chini).

text: Charles niwe wai memba wa mbee wa nyumba isu ya kiusumbi ya Britain kunengwa ndikilii.
translation: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Charles niwe wai memba wa mbee wa nyumba isu ya kiusumbi ya Britain kunengwa ndikilii.
translation: Charles alikuwa memba wa kwanza wa Familia ya Kifalme ya Kiingereza kuzawadiwa shahada ya digrii.

text: Turkey (Thrace ya umilo wa sũana Rumelia nthi wa Balkan Peninsula) yithiawa 3 iũlũ wa 100 ya nthi isũ.
translation: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkey (Thrace ya umilo wa sũana Rumelia nthi wa Balkan Peninsula) yithiawa 3 iũlũ wa 100 ya nthi isũ.
translation: Uturuki ya Ulaya (Thrace mashariki au Rumelia katika rasi ya Balka) inajumuisha asilimia 3 ya nchi.

text: Kĩsio kya Turkey nĩ kĩnene kũvita ilomita 1,600 (1,000 mi) ũasa na ilomita 800 (500 mi), kĩna mũvyanũ wa kona ĩnya.
translation: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Kĩsio kya Turkey nĩ kĩnene kũvita ilomita 1,600 (1,000 mi) ũasa na ilomita 800 (500 mi), kĩna mũvyanũ wa kona ĩnya.
translation: Wilaya ya Uturuki ni zaidi ya kilomita 1,600 (maili 1,000) urefu na kilomita 800 (maili 500) upana, na takriban umbo la mstatili.

text: Kĩsio kya Turkey, vamwe na ĩia, yosete mwanya wa sikwea wa kilomita 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), o vala sikwea sya kilomita 755,688 (291,773 sq mi), syingaliko ya itheo ya kwoko kwa aka wa nthi ya Asia na sikwea sya kilomita 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) ku Europe.
translation: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Kĩsio kya Turkey, vamwe na ĩia, yosete mwanya wa sikwea wa kilomita 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), o vala sikwea sya kilomita 755,688 (291,773 sq mi), syingaliko ya itheo ya kwoko kwa aka wa nthi ya Asia na sikwea sya kilomita 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) ku Europe.
translation: Sehemu ya Uturuki, pamoja na maziwa, imekalia kilomita mraba 783, 562 (maili mraba 300, 948), ambazo kilomita mraba 755,688 (maili mraba 291,773) kati yake ziko kusini magharibi mwa Asia na kilomita mraba 23,764 (maili mraba 9,174) ziko barani Ulaya.

text: Isio sya Turkey nisyo namba 37 kwithwa syi nene nthi yonthe, na ni vakuvi na saisi wa Metropolitan France na Uungelesa ikwatanitw'e.
translation: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Isio sya Turkey nisyo namba 37 kwithwa syi nene nthi yonthe, na ni vakuvi na saisi wa Metropolitan France na Uungelesa ikwatanitw'e.
translation: Eneo la Uturuki huifanya kuwa nchi ya 37 kwa ukubwa duniani, na ina takriban saizi za Ufaransa ya Uropa na Uingereza kwa pamoja.

text: Turkey ithyululitwe ni ukanga ngaliko itatu: Ũkanga wa Aegean ngaliko ya ulwe, Ukanga mwiu ngaliko ya iulu na ukanga wa Mediterranean ngaliko ya itheo.
translation: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Turkey ithyululitwe ni ukanga ngaliko itatu: Ũkanga wa Aegean ngaliko ya ulwe, Ukanga mwiu ngaliko ya iulu na ukanga wa Mediterranean ngaliko ya itheo.
translation: Uturuki imezungukwa na maziwa katika pande tatu: Bahari ya Aegea upande wa magharibi, Bahari Nyeusi upande wa kaskazini na Bahari ya Mediterania upande wa kusini.

text: Luxembourg yina isitoli ndaasa indi yaekie kuungamiwa kuma 1839.
translation: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Luxembourg yina isitoli ndaasa indi yaekie kuungamiwa kuma 1839.
translation: Luxembourg ina historia ndefu lakini uhuru wake ni wa kutoka mwaka wa 1839.

text: Ivindani ya umunthi ngaliko imwe sya Belgium syai sya Luxembourg kuma ivindani ya tene ateo yatwikie Belgian itina wa 1830s ila Belgium yokitie.
translation: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Ivindani ya umunthi ngaliko imwe sya Belgium syai sya Luxembourg kuma ivindani ya tene ateo yatwikie Belgian itina wa 1830s ila Belgium yokitie.
translation: Baadhi ya sehemu za sasa za Ubelgiji zilikuwa sehemu ya Lusembagi zamani lakini zikawa za Kibelgiji baada ya Mapinduzi ya Kibelgiji ya 1830.

text: Luxembourg yiendekethetye kwithwa yi nthi itendete ngaliko imwe ateo andu nimatuie vo ivindani ya kau wa mbee na wa keli ni Germany.
translation: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Luxembourg yiendekethetye kwithwa yi nthi itendete ngaliko imwe ateo andu nimatuie vo ivindani ya kau wa mbee na wa keli ni Germany.
translation: Lusembagi daima imejaribu kuwa nchi isiyoegemea upande wowote lakini ilichukuliwa na Ujerumani katika Vita vya kwanza na vya pili vya Dunia.

text: Twĩ 1957 Luxembourg niyatwikie memba wa organization ila umunthi yisikie ta ngwatanio ya Europe.
translation: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Twĩ 1957 Luxembourg niyatwikie memba wa organization ila umunthi yisikie ta ngwatanio ya Europe.
translation: Mnamo 1957 Luxembourg ikawa memba mwanzilishi wa shirika ambalo leo linajulikana kama Umoja wa Ulaya.

text: Drukgyal Dzong ni nyumba nene muno mbanangiku yi nthi wa utongoi wa Buddha ngalikoni ya iulu ya kivalo kya Paro (utui wi Phondey).
translation: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Drukgyal Dzong ni nyumba nene muno mbanangiku yi nthi wa utongoi wa Buddha ngalikoni ya iulu ya kivalo kya Paro (utui wi Phondey).
translation: Drukgyal Dzong ni ngome iliyoharibika na monasteri ya Kibudhi katika sehemu ya juu ya Wilaya ya Paro (katika Kijiji cha Phondrey).

text: Vatwikanaa kana twi 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel niwaakie tauni ya tene nikenda atanie usindi wake iulu wa isalu sya Tibetan-Mongol.
translation: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Vatwikanaa kana twi 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel niwaakie tauni ya tene nikenda atanie usindi wake iulu wa isalu sya Tibetan-Mongol.
translation: Inasemekana kwamba mnamo 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel aliunda ngome hiyo kama ukumbusho wa ushindi wake dhidi ya vikosi vya Tibeti na Mongoli.

text: Mwaki wa 1951 niwatialilye matialyo amwe ma Drukgyal Dzong kwa ngelekany'o ivisa ya Zhabrung Ngawang Namgyal.
translation: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Mwaki wa 1951 niwatialilye matialyo amwe ma Drukgyal Dzong kwa ngelekany'o ivisa ya Zhabrung Ngawang Namgyal.
translation: Mnamo 1951, moto ulifanya baadhi tu ya masalio ya Drukgyal Dzong kubakia, kama vile picha ya Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Itina wa mwaki, ngome isu niyaiiwe yi nzuviiku, iitalikana ta imwe ya moseo ala makusasya atalii ku Bhutan.
translation: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Itina wa mwaki, ngome isu niyaiiwe yi nzuviiku, iitalikana ta imwe ya moseo ala makusasya atalii ku Bhutan.
translation: Baada ya moto, ngome ilihifadhiwa na kulindwa, na kubaki kuwa mojawapo ya vivutio vya kusisimua zaidi vya Bhutan.

text: Ivindani ya sengyali ya 18 Cambondia yeeyithiie ivinyiitwe kati wa atu eli me vinya, Thailand na Vietnam.
translation: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ivindani ya sengyali ya 18 Cambondia yeeyithiie ivinyiitwe kati wa atu eli me vinya, Thailand na Vietnam.
translation: Wakati wa karne ya 18 Kambodia ilijipata imebanwa katikati mwa majirani wawili wenye nguvu, Thailandi na Vietnam.

text: A Thai malikie na vinya Cambodia maita maingi muno myakani ya maana ikumi na nyanya na kwi mwaka wa 1772 maananga Phnom Phen vyu.
translation: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: A Thai malikie na vinya Cambodia maita maingi muno myakani ya maana ikumi na nyanya na kwi mwaka wa 1772 maananga Phnom Phen vyu.
translation: Wathai walivamia Kambodia mara kadhaa katika karne ya 18 na mnamo 1772 wakaangamiza Phnom Phen.

text: Myakanĩ ya mũthia ya sengyalĩ ya 18 andũ ma Vietnam o namo nĩmavithũkĩie Cambodia.
translation: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Myakanĩ ya mũthia ya sengyalĩ ya 18 andũ ma Vietnam o namo nĩmavithũkĩie Cambodia.
translation: Katika miaka ya mwisho ya karne ya 18 Wavietinamu pia waliivamia Kambodia.

text: 18% ya andu ma venezuela mayithaa na wia, na aingi ma andu ala me wiani muthukumaa ivalua.
translation: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: 18% ya andu ma venezuela mayithaa na wia, na aingi ma andu ala me wiani muthukumaa ivalua.
translation: Asilimia kumi na nane ya Wavenezuela hawana ajira, na wengi wa wale walioajiriwa hufanya kazi katika sekta isiyo rasmi.

text: Ene nthi ma Venenzuela ala ni ilí íúlú wa itatu ala mathukumaa nimekaa úu kwa sekita isu, vakuvi na kwota ya wía miveani isu na imwe íúlú wa itano mathukumaa kwa anglikasa.
translation: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ene nthi ma Venenzuela ala ni ilí íúlú wa itatu ala mathukumaa nimekaa úu kwa sekita isu, vakuvi na kwota ya wía miveani isu na imwe íúlú wa itano mathukumaa kwa anglikasa.
translation: Thuluthi mbili ya Wavenezuela ambao hufanya kazi hufanya hivyo katika sekta ya huduma, karibu robo yao hufanya kazi katika viwanda na humusi hufanya kazi katika kilimo.

text: Muvea museo wa ene nthi ma Venezuela ni mauta, vala nthi isu nitesaa mauta nthi ingi, o na kutwika ni vaasendi imwe kwa muvea usu.
translation: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Muvea museo wa ene nthi ma Venezuela ni mauta, vala nthi isu nitesaa mauta nthi ingi, o na kutwika ni vaasendi imwe kwa muvea usu.
translation: Sekta muhimu kwa Wavenezuela ni mafuta, ambapo nchi hiyo ni wauzaji nje, ingawa ni asilimia moja tu wanaofanya kazi katika sekta ya mafuta.

text: Tene kwa wĩyathĩ wa nthĩ ĩsũ, ataalamũ ma mĩũnda ya Singapore matetheeĩsye kũvĩndũa kĩthũkũma kĩũ kyatwĩkũ mũũnda mũnene wa nthĩ ĩsũ.
translation: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Tene kwa wĩyathĩ wa nthĩ ĩsũ, ataalamũ ma mĩũnda ya Singapore matetheeĩsye kũvĩndũa kĩthũkũma kĩũ kyatwĩkũ mũũnda mũnene wa nthĩ ĩsũ.
translation: Mapema katika uhuru wa nchi, utaalamu wa Singapori katika Bustani za Mimea uliisaidia katika kukigeuza kisiwa hicho kuwa Mji wa Bustani wa kitropiki.

text: Twi 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, ilaa ya aibrid niyo yasakuiwe ta ilaa ya nthi isu.
translation: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Twi 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, ilaa ya aibrid niyo yasakuiwe ta ilaa ya nthi isu.
translation: Mnamo 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, okidi mseto, lilichaguliwa kama ua la kitaifa la nchi hiyo.

text: Kila mwaka vaaya ta mwaini wa ikumi vakuvi nyamu milioni 1.5 ila iisaa matu nisyelekelaa uini wa ngali sya itheo, iikila usi wa Mara, kuma iimani sya iulu kwoondu wa mbua.
translation: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Kila mwaka vaaya ta mwaini wa ikumi vakuvi nyamu milioni 1.5 ila iisaa matu nisyelekelaa uini wa ngali sya itheo, iikila usi wa Mara, kuma iimani sya iulu kwoondu wa mbua.
translation: Kila mwaka karibu Oktoba wala-mimea milioni 1.5 husafiri kuelekea nyanda za kusini, na kuvuka Mto Mara, kutoka vilima vya kaskazini kwa ajili ya mvua.

text: Na indi iisyoka ngaliko ya iulu yisilite ngaliko ya uthuiloni wa sua, iikila usi wa Mara ingi itina wa mbua ya mwai wa Kana.
translation: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Na indi iisyoka ngaliko ya iulu yisilite ngaliko ya uthuiloni wa sua, iikila usi wa Mara ingi itina wa mbua ya mwai wa Kana.
translation: Kisha tena kurudi kaskazini kupitia magharibi, na kuvuka mto Mara mara nyingine tena, baada ya mvua karibu Aprili.

text: Kĩsĩonĩ kya serengetĩ kĩna vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ serengetĩ, kĩsĩo kĩvathe kya Ngorongoro na maswa game reserve nthĩ ya Tanzanĩa na vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ maasaĩ mara kenya.
translation: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kĩsĩonĩ kya serengetĩ kĩna vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ serengetĩ, kĩsĩo kĩvathe kya Ngorongoro na maswa game reserve nthĩ ya Tanzanĩa na vandũ va nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ maasaĩ mara kenya.
translation: Eneo la Serengeti lina Mbuga la Kitaifa la Serengeti, Eneo la Uhifadhi la Ngorongoro na Hifadhi ya Wanyamapori ya Maswa katika Tanzania na Hifadhi ya Kitaifa ya Maasai Mara katika Kenya.

text: Kumanya kuseovya nzia sya kumanyana kwendaa umanyi wa unduũ syindũ syialyũkite na syithio vamwe na syindũ ila isomawa ilasini sya kũmanyana (kwatianisya mavisa, kuseuvya vindio na wasya, kuea ngewa na ingi.
translation: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kumanya kuseovya nzia sya kumanyana kwendaa umanyi wa unduũ syindũ syialyũkite na syithio vamwe na syindũ ila isomawa ilasini sya kũmanyana (kwatianisya mavisa, kuseuvya vindio na wasya, kuea ngewa na ingi.
translation: Kujifunza kuunda vyombo vya habari vyenye mwingiliano kunahitaji ujuzi wa kawaida na wa jadi, na vile vile vifaa vilivyotengenezwa katika darasa la mwingiliano (hadithi za vibao, uhariri wa sauti na video, hadithi za hadithi, nk.)

text: Ndisaini ya mituki yendaa ukasisya ingi ngewa ite na uw'o iulu wa ivindi sya kumya maumoo na kumanya kwisilya nziani syi kivathukany'o.
translation: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Ndisaini ya mituki yendaa ukasisya ingi ngewa ite na uw'o iulu wa ivindi sya kumya maumoo na kumanya kwisilya nziani syi kivathukany'o.
translation: Ubunifu wenye maingiliano huhitaji kwamba ukague tena dhana zako kuhusu uzalishaji wa midia na ujifunze kufikiria kwa njia zisizo nyoofu.

text: Nzĩa sya ũvũlano syendaa ĩseũvya sya wĩa kwĩtha syĩna ũũmwe, na ĩngĩ syaĩle kwĩtha kĩla ĩmwe ĩtonya kũeleeka yĩoyoka.
translation: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Nzĩa sya ũvũlano syendaa ĩseũvya sya wĩa kwĩtha syĩna ũũmwe, na ĩngĩ syaĩle kwĩtha kĩla ĩmwe ĩtonya kũeleeka yĩoyoka.
translation: Ubunifu wa maingiliano unahitaji kuwa sehemu za mradi ziunganike, lakini pia ziwe na mantiki kama sehemu tofauti.

text: Kĩtelemo kya'ũlika ĩngĩ kyũkaa mĩtũkangĩ kwĩ kĩtelemo kya syĩthĩo (nĩvethĩawa ĩvinda ĩnini ya ũthũmũa na ũtaanĩa), yĩkalangaa mũno, na noyĩthĩwe nthũku mũnango.
translation: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Kĩtelemo kya'ũlika ĩngĩ kyũkaa mĩtũkangĩ kwĩ kĩtelemo kya syĩthĩo (nĩvethĩawa ĩvinda ĩnini ya ũthũmũa na ũtaanĩa), yĩkalangaa mũno, na noyĩthĩwe nthũku mũnango.
translation: Ubaya wa lenzi za kupanua au kupunguza mwonekano ni kwamba utata wa kiangalifu na idadi ya elementi za lenzi zinazohitajika kufikia urefu wa kiangalifu ni kubwa zaidi kuliko za lenzi kuu.

text: Kii ti kindu kya usumbua nundu andu ala maseuvasya malenzi methwaa mathimite kilasi kya iulu ila mekuseuvya I lenzi.
translation: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Kii ti kindu kya usumbua nundu andu ala maseuvasya malenzi methwaa mathimite kilasi kya iulu ila mekuseuvya I lenzi.
translation: Hili linaendelea kuwa suala lisilo la muhimu jinsi watengenezaji wa lenzi wanavyofikia viwango vya juu katika uzalizaji wa lenzi.

text: Kii ni kitonyethyete lenzi sya kuthengeesya syindũ syũmya visa nzeo kũte ila syitakunitwe na lenzi ya kuthengeesya syindu.
translation: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Kii ni kitonyethyete lenzi sya kuthengeesya syindũ syũmya visa nzeo kũte ila syitakunitwe na lenzi ya kuthengeesya syindu.
translation: Hii imewezesha lenzi za kukuza kutoa picha zenye ubora unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule unaofikiwa na lenzi zenye urefu msingi usiobadilika.

text: Undu ungi muthuku wa lenzi sya kunzuum ni kana aparture ila ithwaa na mwiso (siviti) ya lenzi yithwaa yi nthi.
translation: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Undu ungi muthuku wa lenzi sya kunzuum ni kana aparture ila ithwaa na mwiso (siviti) ya lenzi yithwaa yi nthi.
translation: Ubaya mwingine wa lenzi za ukuzaji ni kuwa kilango kipana zaidi (kasi) cha lenzi kwa kawaida huwa cha chini.

text: Ii iseuvasya lenzi itembesa mbingi itatumika nesa ila wi vandu vate kyeni nesa na utena flashi.
translation: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Ii iseuvasya lenzi itembesa mbingi itatumika nesa ila wi vandu vate kyeni nesa na utena flashi.
translation: Hii hufanya lenzi za kukuza za bei ya chini vigumu kutumia katika hali ya mwangaza duni bila mwako.

text: Kĩmwe kya mathĩna ala methĩawa mũno ĩla mũndũ ũkũvĩndũa movĩe kũthĩ kwa DVD nĩkũvĩndũa mala maĩngĩ.
translation: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kĩmwe kya mathĩna ala methĩawa mũno ĩla mũndũ ũkũvĩndũa movĩe kũthĩ kwa DVD nĩkũvĩndũa mala maĩngĩ.
translation: Shida moja ya kawaida wakati wa kujaribu kubadilisha sinema kwenda kwa muundo wa DVD ni kuskani zaidi.

text: Tiivii mbingĩ iseũvĩtw'e itanĩthye wanda.
translation: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Tiivii mbingĩ iseũvĩtw'e itanĩthye wanda.
translation: Vipindi vingi vya televisheni nyingi hutengenezwa kwa njia ya kufurahisha umma.

text: Kwa kitumi kiu, kindu kyonthe wonaa kwa TV kyai na mivaka, iulu, itheo na ngaliko.
translation: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Kwa kitumi kiu, kindu kyonthe wonaa kwa TV kyai na mivaka, iulu, itheo na ngaliko.
translation: Kwa sababu hiyo, kila kitu mnachokiona kwenye runinga kilikatwa mipaka, juu, chini na pande.

text: Kii kikawa kuikiithya kana ivisa yu niyausua kioo kiima. Kii nikyo kitawa overscan.
translation: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Kii kikawa kuikiithya kana ivisa yu niyausua kioo kiima. Kii nikyo kitawa overscan.
translation: Hii hufanywa ili kuhakikisha picha inafunika skrini yote. Hiyo inaitwa kuskani kulikokithiri.

text: Kwa vaatĩĩ nthũkũ, ĩla ũseũvya DVD, syĩndĩ ĩla syĩ vakũmĩ na mũthya sĩyũmĩlaa, na etha yĩ vĩsa yũ ya vĩndĩo yĩna maandĩko vakũvĩ na mũthya ngalĩko ya nthĩ, maandĩko asũ mayonekanaa onthe.
translation: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Kwa vaatĩĩ nthũkũ, ĩla ũseũvya DVD, syĩndĩ ĩla syĩ vakũmĩ na mũthya sĩyũmĩlaa, na etha yĩ vĩsa yũ ya vĩndĩo yĩna maandĩko vakũvĩ na mũthya ngalĩko ya nthĩ, maandĩko asũ mayonekanaa onthe.
translation: Kwa bahati mbaya, unapotengeneza DVD, kuna uwezekano kingo zake zitakatwa pia, na kama video ilikuwa na maandishi ya tafsiri yaliyokuwa karibu sana na chini, pia hayataonyeshwa.

text: Medieval ii ya uthaukia yiilye ya tene nithuthitye kuimangini, ietete mavisa, banquets na Arthurian chivalry.
translation: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Medieval ii ya uthaukia yiilye ya tene nithuthitye kuimangini, ietete mavisa, banquets na Arthurian chivalry.
translation: Kasri la kiasili la zama za kati lilichochea dhana, na kuleta picha za mashindano ya kivita, karamu na uungwana wa Kiartha.

text: Ona ũkaũngama katĩ ya mĩako mianangĩkũ yĩkalĩte vandũ va mĩaka ngili ũmwe nĩ laisi kũsũanĩa na kũete akilini mawasya na mĩnyũngo ya kaũ sya ũkĩtĩw'e tene, ngĩnya ũkesa ĩthĩa no wĩw'e mbalasĩ ĩtembeete na wĩa kũma avũngwanĩ.
translation: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ona ũkaũngama katĩ ya mĩako mianangĩkũ yĩkalĩte vandũ va mĩaka ngili ũmwe nĩ laisi kũsũanĩa na kũete akilini mawasya na mĩnyũngo ya kaũ sya ũkĩtĩw'e tene, ngĩnya ũkesa ĩthĩa no wĩw'e mbalasĩ ĩtembeete na wĩa kũma avũngwanĩ.
translation: Hata kwa kusimama katikati mwa magofu ya miaka elfu ni rahisi kuwa na taswira ya sauti na harufu ya vita vilivyopita kitambo, na karibu kusikia mlio wa kwato kwenye barabara za mawe na kunusa uoga kutoka kwenye jela za chini kwa chini.

text: Indi, masuania maitu me iulu wa uw'o? W'o niki nyumba sya asumbi syaakiwe? Syaseuviw'e na kwakwa ata?
translation: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Indi, masuania maitu me iulu wa uw'o? W'o niki nyumba sya asumbi syaakiwe? Syaseuviw'e na kwakwa ata?
translation: Lakini fikira zetu zina misingi ya ukweli? Mbona ngome zilijengwa pale mwanzoni? Zilibuniwa na kujengwa vipi?

text: Ituteny'e nda ivinda yii, Kirby Muxloe Castle ni ta nyumba nzeo kwi castle ya w'o.
translation: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ituteny'e nda ivinda yii, Kirby Muxloe Castle ni ta nyumba nzeo kwi castle ya w'o.
translation: Kwa kawaida ya kipindi hicho, Ngome ya Kirby Muxloe ni zaidi ya nyumba ambayo imeimarishwa kuliko ngome ya kweli.

text: Ndilisa syake mbize na nguta mbonzu siyaisyisiiya kũvithukĩwa kwa kĩlũngũ kĩasa.
translation: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ndilisa syake mbize na nguta mbonzu siyaisyisiiya kũvithukĩwa kwa kĩlũngũ kĩasa.
translation: Madirisha yenye glasi kubwa na kuta nyembamba hazingeweza kupinga shambulio kwa muda mrefu.

text: myakanĩ ya 1480, ĩla mwako wambĩĩĩwye nĩ mũsũmbĩ Hastĩngs, nthĩ ĩsũ yaĩna mũũo na ita syendekana nũndũ wa tũkũndĩ tũnĩnĩ twa Maraũders.
translation: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: myakanĩ ya 1480, ĩla mwako wambĩĩĩwye nĩ mũsũmbĩ Hastĩngs, nthĩ ĩsũ yaĩna mũũo na ita syendekana nũndũ wa tũkũndĩ tũnĩnĩ twa Maraũders.
translation: Katika miaka ya 1480, wakati ujenzi wake ulipoanzishwa na Bwana Hastings, nchi ilikuwa yenye amani kiasi na ulinzi ulihitajika tu dhidi ya vikundi vidogo vya wanyang'anyi.

text: Kwĩanany'a vinya yaĩ nthĩa ĩla nthĩ sya Europe syatũmĩie kũtatĩthya kwiia ũnene wa nthĩ syonthe sya Europe.
translation: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kwĩanany'a vinya yaĩ nthĩa ĩla nthĩ sya Europe syatũmĩie kũtatĩthya kwiia ũnene wa nthĩ syonthe sya Europe.
translation: Usawasishaji wa mamlaka ulikuwa mfumo ambamo mataifa ya Ulaya yalitafuta kudumisha uhuru wa majimbo yote ya Ulaya.

text: Mũvango wai kana nthĩ syonthe sya Ũsũngũnĩ syaĩlĩlwe nĩ kũsiĩa nthĩ ĩmwe ndĩkethĩwe na vinya mwingĩ, na kwoou silikalĩ sya nthĩ syonthe nĩsyalyũlaa ngwatanĩo syasyo kĩla ĩvinda nĩkana syĩkale sikwatĩĩe ũu.
translation: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Mũvango wai kana nthĩ syonthe sya Ũsũngũnĩ syaĩlĩlwe nĩ kũsiĩa nthĩ ĩmwe ndĩkethĩwe na vinya mwingĩ, na kwoou silikalĩ sya nthĩ syonthe nĩsyalyũlaa ngwatanĩo syasyo kĩla ĩvinda nĩkana syĩkale sikwatĩĩe ũu.
translation: Dhana ilikuwa kwamba mataifa yote ya Ulaya lazima yangejaribu kuzuia taifa moja lisiwe lenye nguvu, na basi serikali za kitaifa mara nyingi zilibadili muungano wao ili kudumisha usawa.

text: Kau wa utianiwa wa Spanish niw'o wai kau wa mbee ula wai na kieleelo kya kumbalanzi vinya.
translation: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Kau wa utianiwa wa Spanish niw'o wai kau wa mbee ula wai na kieleelo kya kumbalanzi vinya.
translation: Vita vya Urithi wa Uhispania viliashiria vita vya kwanza ambavyo shida yake kuu ilikuwa usawa wa madaraka.

text: Uu wai undu wai vata kwa uvinduku, ta vinya wa European ndukethwaa vo mayifanya nimesi ungai muno na kau. Indi, myaka miongo itatu ya kau yithwa wi kau wa muthya wa kau wa kiindini.
translation: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Uu wai undu wai vata kwa uvinduku, ta vinya wa European ndukethwaa vo mayifanya nimesi ungai muno na kau. Indi, myaka miongo itatu ya kau yithwa wi kau wa muthya wa kau wa kiindini.
translation: Hii iliashiria mabadiliko muhimu, kwani mamlaka ya Uingereza hawangeweza tena kujifanya kuwa vita vya kidini. Hivyo, Vita hivyo vya Miaka Thelathini vingekuwa vita vya mwisho kuitwa vita vya kidini.

text: Ikalu ta Artemis yila yi Ephesus ni yaanangiwa matuku 21 mwai wa Muonza, 356 BCE ila yakwatiwe mwaki ni Herostratus.
translation: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Ikalu ta Artemis yila yi Ephesus ni yaanangiwa matuku 21 mwai wa Muonza, 356 BCE ila yakwatiwe mwaki ni Herostratus.
translation: Hekalu ya Artemis kule Ephesus iliharibiwa julai 21, 356 BCE kwa kisa cha moto kilichotekelezwa na Herostratus.

text: Kwianana na I ngewa, musukumo wake wai nguma kwa nzia syonthe. Aeveso, me athatu, ni matangaanzie kana isyitwa ya Herostratus yiikaa andikwe.
translation: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Kwianana na I ngewa, musukumo wake wai nguma kwa nzia syonthe. Aeveso, me athatu, ni matangaanzie kana isyitwa ya Herostratus yiikaa andikwe.
translation: Kulingana na hadithi, motisha wake ulikuwa umaarufu kwa gharama yoyote. Waefeso, kwa kukasirika, walitangaza kuwa jina la Herostratus lisirekodiwe daima.

text: Mundu wa tene wa Greek, Strabo niwawetie isyitwa yila tutumiaa umunthi. Ikalu ni yanaangiwe wioo ula Alexander the Great wasaiwe.
translation: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Mundu wa tene wa Greek, Strabo niwawetie isyitwa yila tutumiaa umunthi. Ikalu ni yanaangiwe wioo ula Alexander the Great wasaiwe.
translation: Mwanahistoria wa Kigiriki Strabo alibaini hilo jina, ambalo ndilo tunavyolijua leo. Hekalu liliharibiwa usiku ule ule Alexander Mkuu alizaliwa.

text: Alexander ta musumbi, ni weenyumisye kuipa ikalu yakwe ingi indi andu ni maleile. Ikalu yii yaakiwe ingi itina wa Alexander kwitwa 323 BCE.
translation: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Alexander ta musumbi, ni weenyumisye kuipa ikalu yakwe ingi indi andu ni maleile. Ikalu yii yaakiwe ingi itina wa Alexander kwitwa 323 BCE.
translation: Alexander, kama mfalme, alijitolea kugharimia ujenzi upya wa hekalu, lakini toleo lake lilikataliwa. Baadaye, baada ya Alexander kufa, hekalu lilijengwa upya mnamo 323 BCE.

text: Ikiithya kw'oko kwaku ni kuleelu undu vatonyeka o mbato uendee uthauka noti isu nesa- na ingi ndukatate kwikala uisongya syaa syaku muno na vinya.
translation: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ikiithya kw'oko kwaku ni kuleelu undu vatonyeka o mbato uendee uthauka noti isu nesa- na ingi ndukatate kwikala uisongya syaa syaku muno na vinya.
translation: Hakikisha mkono wako umetulia iwezekanavyo huku ukicheza sauti zote kwa usahihi - pia jaribu usifanye misogeo yoyote isiyo muhimu kwa vidole vyako.

text: Uu yu, nũũnoa o vanini. Lilikana vai vata wa utina mbunguo utumiite vinya mwingi nikenda wĩw'e wasya wongeleka ta kwa piano.
translation: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Uu yu, nũũnoa o vanini. Lilikana vai vata wa utina mbunguo utumiite vinya mwingi nikenda wĩw'e wasya wongeleka ta kwa piano.
translation: Hivi, utajisumbua kidogo iwezekanavyo. Kumbuka hakuna haja ya kugonga vibonye kwa nguvu nyingi ili kutoa sauti kubwakama kwenye piano.

text: Kinandani, nikana ukwate wasya wa iulu, utumiaa tuwaya tula twi uthing'ito kana mituki mbingaingi.
translation: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Kinandani, nikana ukwate wasya wa iulu, utumiaa tuwaya tula twi uthing'ito kana mituki mbingaingi.
translation: Kwenye kodiani, kupata sauti ya ziada, unatumia viriba na shinikizo au kasi zaidi.

text: Masũanĩa mataeleeka nĩ kũatĩĩa ũũmwe, ũmanyĩkani, kana kũmanya wi makini kwa ũw'o wa vyũ, ũ'Ngai, ũw'o wa kĩĩveva, kana Ngai.
translation: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Masũanĩa mataeleeka nĩ kũatĩĩa ũũmwe, ũmanyĩkani, kana kũmanya wi makini kwa ũw'o wa vyũ, ũ'Ngai, ũw'o wa kĩĩveva, kana Ngai.
translation: Utatanishi ni kuau tekeleza ushirika na, utambulisho na, ufahamu wa ukweli wa mwisho, uungu, ukweli au Mungu.

text: Mũĩkĩi amanthaa ũmanyĩ waw'o, mĩw'ĩle, kana kũelewa mũno kwa ũw'o mũtheũ/ũngaĩ.
translation: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Mũĩkĩi amanthaa ũmanyĩ waw'o, mĩw'ĩle, kana kũelewa mũno kwa ũw'o mũtheũ/ũngaĩ.
translation: Mwamini hutafuta uzoefu wa moja kwa moja, uelewa au maarifa ya ukweli/mungu au miungu

text: Aatĩĩ maatĩaa maũndũ mana ma mwĩkalĩle, kana mĩĩkile ya maũndũ ĩla yaĩlĩtwe kwĩ maũndũ asu.
translation: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Aatĩĩ maatĩaa maũndũ mana ma mwĩkalĩle, kana mĩĩkile ya maũndũ ĩla yaĩlĩtwe kwĩ maũndũ asu.
