translation: Wafuasi hutafuta njia fulani za kuishi, au mazoea ambayo yanakusudiwa kulea uzoefu huo.

text: Mysticism no ivathukanw'e kuma kwa uikii ungi wa ndini na kuthaitha kwa kulilya utuika wa mundu we mweene kwoondu ukwiyiw'a, muno muno ala ma muuo, woni, useo, o na mwikalo wa ecstatic.
translation: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Mysticism no ivathukanw'e kuma kwa uikii ungi wa ndini na kuthaitha kwa kulilya utuika wa mundu we mweene kwoondu ukwiyiw'a, muno muno ala ma muuo, woni, useo, o na mwikalo wa ecstatic.
translation: Imani ya mafumbo inaweza kutofautishwa na aina nyingine za imani na ibada ya kidini kwa msisitizo wake wa uzoefu wa kibinafsi wa moja kwa moja wa hali ya kipekee ya ufahamu, hasa zile za sifa za amani, maarifa, raha au hata msisimko.

text: Ukalasinga ni ndini kuma condineti nini ya Aindi. Yumite kuu Punjab ivindani ya sengyali ya 15 kuma vala matilikanile nthini wa kithio kya Hindu.
translation: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ukalasinga ni ndini kuma condineti nini ya Aindi. Yumite kuu Punjab ivindani ya sengyali ya 15 kuma vala matilikanile nthini wa kithio kya Hindu.
translation: Kalasinga ni dini kutoka bara ndogo la India. Ilianzia eneo la Punjab katika karne ya 15 kutokana na mgawanyiko wa kimadhehebu katika tamaduni za Kihindu.

text: Kalasinga monaa muikiio woo wi kivathukany'o na Hinduism ateo nimetikilaa maumite kwa Hindu na kithio kyoo.
translation: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Kalasinga monaa muikiio woo wi kivathukany'o na Hinduism ateo nimetikilaa maumite kwa Hindu na kithio kyoo.
translation: Makalasinga huchukulia imani yao kuwa kando na Uhindu ingawa wanatambua mizizi na tamaduni zake katika Ubaniani.

text: Andu ma Sikh metaa ndini yoo Gurmat, ila ni Punjabi kwa "nzia ya guru".Guru kindu kya vata kwa ndini sya Aindi indi nthi wa Sikhism mwanya munene ula useovasya muikiio wa Sikh.
translation: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Andu ma Sikh metaa ndini yoo Gurmat, ila ni Punjabi kwa "nzia ya guru".Guru kindu kya vata kwa ndini sya Aindi indi nthi wa Sikhism mwanya munene ula useovasya muikiio wa Sikh.
translation: Sikhs huiita dini yao Gurmat, ambayo ni Kipunjabi kwa "njia ya guru". Guru ni kipengele msingi cha dini zote za India lakini Ukalasinga umechukua umuhimu ambao hubuni msingi wa imani za Kalasinga.

text: Ndini isu yambiliiilw'e mwakani senjali ya 15 ni Guru Nanak kuma 1469-1539. Ni vaatiie kwa vakuvi alimu angi keenda.
translation: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Ndini isu yambiliiilw'e mwakani senjali ya 15 ni Guru Nanak kuma 1469-1539. Ni vaatiie kwa vakuvi alimu angi keenda.
translation: Dini ilianzishwa karne ya 15 na Guru Nanak 1469-1539). Palifuatilia urithi wa walimu tisa.

text: Ona uu wiovo, mwaka wa 1956, mawatho ma Krushchevs nimeekiiwe mutianini yila maandamano maumbukie ku Poland, athukumi maileana na unyivu wa liu na kuolwa kwa misaala, yavindukie na watw'ika muatianio wa kuleana na ukomyunisiti.
translation: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ona uu wiovo, mwaka wa 1956, mawatho ma Krushchevs nimeekiiwe mutianini yila maandamano maumbukie ku Poland, athukumi maileana na unyivu wa liu na kuolwa kwa misaala, yavindukie na watw'ika muatianio wa kuleana na ukomyunisiti.
translation: Hata hivyo, mnamo Juni 1956, ahadi za Kruschev ziliwekwa katika jaribio wakati maandamano katika Polandi, ambapo wafanyakazi walikuwa wakipinga upungufu wa chakula na kukatwa kwa mishahara, yaligeuka kuwa maandamano ya jumla dhidi ya Ukomunisti.

text: Ona kwĩthĩwa muthianĩ, Krushchev nĩwatumie matangi kũtũngĩĩsya mũuo, nĩwanengie wendi na tamaa ya kĩmbesa mwanya waũnyuva Wladyslaw Gomulka ũla wesĩwe mũno nĩ kana ethĩwe mũũngamũũ wa silikalĩ.
translation: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ona kwĩthĩwa muthianĩ, Krushchev nĩwatumie matangi kũtũngĩĩsya mũuo, nĩwanengie wendi na tamaa ya kĩmbesa mwanya waũnyuva Wladyslaw Gomulka ũla wesĩwe mũno nĩ kana ethĩwe mũũngamũũ wa silikalĩ.
translation: Ingawa hatimaye, Kruschev alituma vifaru kurejesha utulivu, aliridhia baadhi ya mahitaji ya kiuchumi na akakubali kumteua mtu maarufu Wladyslaw Gomulka kama waziri mkuu mpya.

text: Kualyulwa ki umunthi kwa Kyanda kya Indus kwai kualyulwa kwa ivindani ya kati kuu kiseseni kya India ya iulu kuthyuukite kilungu kinene kya pakistani ya umunthi na ilungu ingi sya ulweni wa iulu wa India na umothoni wa iulu wa Afghanistan.
translation: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Kualyulwa ki umunthi kwa Kyanda kya Indus kwai kualyulwa kwa ivindani ya kati kuu kiseseni kya India ya iulu kuthyuukite kilungu kinene kya pakistani ya umunthi na ilungu ingi sya ulweni wa iulu wa India na umothoni wa iulu wa Afghanistan.
translation: Ustaarabu wa Indus Valley ulikuwa wa Enzi za Shaba kaskazini magharibi mwa bara ndogo la Hindi, ukijumuisha kwa wingi Pakistani ya sasa na sehemu za kaskazini magharibi mwa Hindu na kaskazini magharibi mwa Afganistani.

text: Kĩsomo kyaendeeie mbũsĩnĩ sya ĩndũs vala yaũmĩsye ĩsyĩtwa yayo.
translation: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Kĩsomo kyaendeeie mbũsĩnĩ sya ĩndũs vala yaũmĩsye ĩsyĩtwa yayo.
translation: Ustaarabu ulinawiri katika bonde la Mto Indus ambapo ulitoa jina lake.

text: O na kau asomi amwe measyaa kana tondu ualyuulo wa iliko na maisha ma andu kuvikiia maisha ma umunthi no waii kw'o utee was usi ula mulau oyu wa Sarasvati, wailile kwitwa mituki ualyulo-wa-Sarasvati, kuu namo angi maikwita ualyulo wa Harappa itina wa Harappa, vala vai vandu va, mbee musyini usu kwinzwa myakani ya 1920.
translation: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: O na kau asomi amwe measyaa kana tondu ualyuulo wa iliko na maisha ma andu kuvikiia maisha ma umunthi no waii kw'o utee was usi ula mulau oyu wa Sarasvati, wailile kwitwa mituki ualyulo-wa-Sarasvati, kuu namo angi maikwita ualyulo wa Harappa itina wa Harappa, vala vai vandu va, mbee musyini usu kwinzwa myakani ya 1920.
translation: Ingawa baadhi ya wasomi hukisia kwamba kwa sababu ustaarabu pia ulikuwapo katika mabonde ya Mto Sarasvati uliokauka sasa, unafaa kuitwa Ustaarabu wa Indus-Sarasvati, huku wengine wakiuita Ustaarabu wa Harappa, kutokana na Harappa, eneo lake la kwanza kuchimbwa katika miaka ya 1920.

text: Usumbiko wa ta ita wa usumbi wa Lomu niwatetheeisye kutwaa mbee maendeeo ma uiiti.
translation: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Usumbiko wa ta ita wa usumbi wa Lomu niwatetheeisye kutwaa mbee maendeeo ma uiiti.
translation: Tabia za kijeshi za Milki ya Kirumi zilisaidia sana kwa maendeleo ya matibabu.

text: Ndakitali syambiiw'e kuandikwa ni Emperor Augustus na ona maseuvya Roman Medical Corps ma mbee ma kutumia itina wa kau.
translation: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Ndakitali syambiiw'e kuandikwa ni Emperor Augustus na ona maseuvya Roman Medical Corps ma mbee ma kutumia itina wa kau.
translation: Madaktari walianza kuajiriwa na Mtawala Augustus na hata kuunda kitengo kikubwa cha kwanza cha Matibabu cha Kirumi kwa ajili ya kutumika baada ya vita.

text: Matakitali ma uthinzi maina umanyi wa ndawa syi kivathukany'o syivo movaini ila yumaa ngiini sya popi na kopolamaini kuma ngiini sya ambeini.
translation: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Matakitali ma uthinzi maina umanyi wa ndawa syi kivathukany'o syivo movaini ila yumaa ngiini sya popi na kopolamaini kuma ngiini sya ambeini.
translation: Madaktari wa upasuaji walikuwa na uelewa wa vitulizo kadhaa zikiwamo mofini kutoka kwa mbegu za mpopi na scopolamina kutoka kwa mbegu za henbeni.

text: Ni matwikite me aseo muno kwa utila awau mamutha kumavonokya kuma kwa ganrene vamwe na tourniquets na mwikiva kuvunga nikenda nthakame yieke kuma.
translation: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ni matwikite me aseo muno kwa utila awau mamutha kumavonokya kuma kwa ganrene vamwe na tourniquets na mwikiva kuvunga nikenda nthakame yieke kuma.
translation: Walipata kuwa na ustadi wa kukata viungo vya mwili ili kuokoa wagonjwa kutokana na gangrini na vile vile mafundo na vibanio vya mishipa ili kutuliza mtiririko wa damu.

text: Kwa sengyali kauta, unene wa Roman watumie ukwati munene muveani wa ndawa na weethwa na umanyi mwingi ula twisi umunthi.
translation: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Kwa sengyali kauta, unene wa Roman watumie ukwati munene muveani wa ndawa na weethwa na umanyi mwingi ula twisi umunthi.
translation: Katika karne nyingi, milki ya Kirumi ilipelekea faida kubwa katika uga wa tiba na ikaunda mengi ya maarifa tunayoyajua leo.

text: Kukunza mathangu kwa pureland ni kukunza mathangu kwi miao kana no ikunza yimwe yitonya kwikwa kwa ivinda yimwe, makunza momu munango ta kukunza na itina timetikile, na makunza monthe methiawa kunduni kwenekee.
translation: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Atalĩĩ matembea kũndũ kĩvathũkany'o nthĩ kana omakasakũa kũtembea vandũ vamwe.
translation: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Atalĩĩ matembea kũndũ kĩvathũkany'o nthĩ kana omakasakũa kũtembea vandũ vamwe.
translation: Watalii wanaweza kutembelea alama tofauti za ardhi za nchi maalum au wanaweza tu kuchagua kuangazia eneo moja tu.

text: Asungũ ala masũmbikite nthi ino moona ũu ni meetisye ũtethyo.

text: Asungũ ala masũmbikite nthi ino moona ũu ni meetisye ũtethyo.
translation: Wakoloni, walipoona shughuli hii, pia waliita wasaidizi.

text: ĩkũndĩ nĩ sya lasĩmĩthasya mwĩ nya ya mbee yĩovo 1st na 3rd New Hampshĩre regĩments ya aũme 200, nthĩ wa kolonel John stark na James Reed (ala ĩtĩma nĩmatwĩkĩe generals).
translation: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: ĩkũndĩ nĩ sya lasĩmĩthasya mwĩ nya ya mbee yĩovo 1st na 3rd New Hampshĩre regĩments ya aũme 200, nthĩ wa kolonel John stark na James Reed (ala ĩtĩma nĩmatwĩkĩe generals).
translation: Majeshi yanayoimarisha nafasi za mbele ni pamoja na ya 1 na ya 3 ya majeshi ya New Hampshire yaliyo na wanaume 200, yaliyo chini ya makanali John Stark na James Reed (ambao baadaye wote walikuwa majenerali).

text: Aume ma Stark meevithite wiioni mwiso wa ngaliko ya yiulu ya vala akoloni mai.
translation: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Aume ma Stark meevithite wiioni mwiso wa ngaliko ya yiulu ya vala akoloni mai.
translation: Wanaume wa Stark walichukua nafasi kando ya uzio upande wa kaskazini mwa nafasi ya Mkoloni.

text: Yĩla low tide mavingũie mwanya ũtee wa ũsĩ wa Mystic, ngalĩko ya ĩũlĩ wa umĩloni wa syũa wa Peninsula, mongeleelie wiio kwa mĩtũkĩ na ũkũta mũkuvĩ wa ĩvia ngalĩkonĩ ya ĩũlũ wathelela mũthianĩ wa kĩw'ũ kaũteenĩ kanini ka ũsĩ.
translation: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Yĩla low tide mavingũie mwanya ũtee wa ũsĩ wa Mystic, ngalĩko ya ĩũlĩ wa umĩloni wa syũa wa Peninsula, mongeleelie wiio kwa mĩtũkĩ na ũkũta mũkuvĩ wa ĩvia ngalĩkonĩ ya ĩũlũ wathelela mũthianĩ wa kĩw'ũ kaũteenĩ kanini ka ũsĩ.
translation: Wakati kupwa kwa maji kulifungua mwanya katika Mto Mystic katika kaskazini mashariki mwa rasi, waliendeleza ua kwa haraka kwa ukuta mfupi wa mawe upande wa kaskazini na kuishia kwenye ukingo wa maji katika pwani ndogo.

text: Gridley kana Stark aiie kilungu vakuvi vuti iana yimwe (mita miongo itatu) mbee wa wiio na anengane watho kana o na uu ndakaathe mbika ma kawaita mamivitukithye.
translation: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Gridley kana Stark aiie kilungu vakuvi vuti iana yimwe (mita miongo itatu) mbee wa wiio na anengane watho kana o na uu ndakaathe mbika ma kawaita mamivitukithye.
translation: Gridley au Stark aliweka nguzo umbali wa kama futi 100 (mita 30) mbele ya uzio na akaamuru kwamba hakuna atakayeiwasha moto hadi watu wa kawaida watakapokuwa wameipita.

text: Vulani ya Amerika yeekwety'e kwambiisya mavithukii kuma ngali itatu syi kivathukany'o.
translation: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Vulani ya Amerika yeekwety'e kwambiisya mavithukii kuma ngali itatu syi kivathukany'o.
translation: Mpango wa Marekani ulitegemea uanzishaji wa mashambulio yaliyoratibiwa kutoka pande tatu tofauti.

text: Munene John Cadwalder ai ambiisya mbithũkio ya ita sya Britain ula wi Bordentown ni kenda maikaetewe ũtethyo.
translation: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Munene John Cadwalder ai ambiisya mbithũkio ya ita sya Britain ula wi Bordentown ni kenda maikaetewe ũtethyo.
translation: Jenerali John Cadwalder alianzisha shambulio la kupotosha dhidi ya ngome ya Uingereza katika Bordentown, ili kuzuia usaidizi wowote.

text: Munene wa jeshi James Ewing atwaa asikali ma jeshi maana muonza muingo wa ũsi kũu Trenton Ferry, akoosa kiao kya Assumnpink Creek na kusiia mumaitha wonthe ndakasembe.
translation: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Munene wa jeshi James Ewing atwaa asikali ma jeshi maana muonza muingo wa ũsi kũu Trenton Ferry, akoosa kiao kya Assumnpink Creek na kusiia mumaitha wonthe ndakasembe.
translation: Jenerali James Ewing angewachukua wanamgambo 700 na kuvuka mto huko Kivukio cha Trenton, kutwaa kwa nguvu daraja iliyoko juu ya Asunpink Creek na kuwazuia wanamgambo wowote adui kutoroka.

text: Nguthu ila nene ya vinya wa aũme 2.400 yakĩlaa usi maili kenda ngaliko ya iulu ya Trenton, na ikaana nguthu ili, kimwe uungu wa Greene na kingi uungu wa Sullivan, ni kana maambiisye ukuna kau wa mbee wa kwakya.
translation: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Nguthu ila nene ya vinya wa aũme 2.400 yakĩlaa usi maili kenda ngaliko ya iulu ya Trenton, na ikaana nguthu ili, kimwe uungu wa Greene na kingi uungu wa Sullivan, ni kana maambiisye ukuna kau wa mbee wa kwakya.
translation: Kikosi kikuu cha ushambuliaji chenye wanaume 2,400 kilivuka mto maili tisa kaskazini mwa Trenton, kisha kugawanyika kwa vikundi viwili, kimoja chini ya Greene na kingine chini ya Sullivan, ili kuanzisha shambulio kabla ya macheo.

text: Nũndũ wa ũalyũko kuma ĩsemba ya kwota kũthi ya nusu ya maĩli, vata wa mĩtũkĩ yu ti munene mũno naw'o ũũmĩĩsyo ũtw'ĩkĩte wa vata vyũ.
translation: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Nũndũ wa ũalyũko kuma ĩsemba ya kwota kũthi ya nusu ya maĩli, vata wa mĩtũkĩ yu ti munene mũno naw'o ũũmĩĩsyo ũtw'ĩkĩte wa vata vyũ.
translation: Kwa mabadiliko kutoka mbio za robo hadi nusu maili, kasi huwa yenye umuhimu mdogo zaidi na ustahimilivu ukawa hitaji lenye umuhimu kabisa.

text: Kilasi kya mbee kya miler nusu, mundume utonya usinda ndatika ili, ailwe ni kwithwa e na siviti nzeo, ateo kwi yumiisya kwaile ithwa kwivo saa syonthe sya muisyo.
translation: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Kilasi kya mbee kya miler nusu, mundume utonya usinda ndatika ili, ailwe ni kwithwa e na siviti nzeo, ateo kwi yumiisya kwaile ithwa kwivo saa syonthe sya muisyo.
translation: Kwa kweli mkimbiaji wa daraja la kwanza wa nusu maili, mtu anayeweza kufuzu kwa dakika mbili, lazima awe na kasi ya kutosha, lakini uvumilivu lazima ustawishwe wakati wote wa hatari.

text: Kũsemba vandũ vaasa ivinda ya mbevo na kũthi njimu ya kuseovya mwii wa iũlu ni nzi nzeo ya kwiseovya weteele ivinda ya kũsemba.
translation: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Kũsemba vandũ vaasa ivinda ya mbevo na kũthi njimu ya kuseovya mwii wa iũlu ni nzi nzeo ya kwiseovya weteele ivinda ya kũsemba.
translation: Mbio kiasi za mashambani katika msimu wa baridi, pamoja na shughuli katika ukumbi wa mazoezi kwa ajili ya sehemu ya juu ya mwili, ndiyo maandalizi bora ya msimu wa mbio.

text: Kula nesa kuitumaa asembi ala anini masembe nesa kwi kwoka indi ni kuseo kwa uima woo wa mwii.
translation: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kula nesa kuitumaa asembi ala anini masembe nesa kwi kwoka indi ni kuseo kwa uima woo wa mwii.
translation: Mazoea ya lishe sahihi pekee haiwezi kuzalisha usomi wa utendaji, ila yanaweza kuathiri kwa kiasi kikubwa na ustawi wa wakimbiaji wachanga kwa ujumla.

text: Kwikala na uima museo wi mbalanzi, kunywa kiw'u nesa, na kuelewa nesa maundu ma kwongeleela maundu ta asu kutumaa musembi ethwa e na mosungio maseo na ingi mayendeew'a ni ithau.
translation: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Kwikala na uima museo wi mbalanzi, kunywa kiw'u nesa, na kuelewa nesa maundu ma kwongeleela maundu ta asu kutumaa musembi ethwa e na mosungio maseo na ingi mayendeew'a ni ithau.
translation: Kudumisha uwiano bora wa kawi, kuwa na mazoea ya unywaji wa maji yenye ufanisi, na kuelewa vipengele tofauti vya mazoea ya ziada kunaweza kusaidia wanariadha kuboresha utendaji wao na kuongeza raha yao katika spoti hiyo.

text: Kũsemba vandũ vakũvi ni ĩthaũ ya mbesa nini indĩ kwina maũndũ mate ma w'o ĩũlũ wa mĩio ila yiendekaa ithaũni yiĩ.
translation: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Kũsemba vandũ vakũvi ni ĩthaũ ya mbesa nini indĩ kwina maũndũ mate ma w'o ĩũlũ wa mĩio ila yiendekaa ithaũni yiĩ.
translation: Mbio za umbali wa kati ni spoti isiyo ghali sana; hata hivyo, kuna dhana nyingi potovu kuhusu zana chache zinazohitajika ili kushiriki.

text: Syindu no siuwe o undu ikwendeka, indi mbingi syasyo syithiawa na utethyo munini kana vathei iulu wa matokeo.
translation: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Syindu no siuwe o undu ikwendeka, indi mbingi syasyo syithiawa na utethyo munini kana vathei iulu wa matokeo.
translation: Bidhaa zinaweza kununuliwa zinapotakikana, lakini nyingi zitakuwa na athari ndogo au isiyo halisi kwa utendaji.

text: Asembi no mew'e mendeew'a ni kindu onakethwa syiina utethyo mwianiu kwoo.
translation: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Asembi no mew'e mendeew'a ni kindu onakethwa syiina utethyo mwianiu kwoo.
translation: Wanariadha wanaweza kuhisi wanapendelea bidhaa hata kama haina manufaa halisi.

text: Atom noyoswe ta ĩmwe kwa mavia me vata mũno ma kwaka syĩndũ syonthe.
translation: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Atom noyoswe ta ĩmwe kwa mavia me vata mũno ma kwaka syĩndũ syonthe.
translation: Atomu inaweza kuchukuliwa kama mojawapo ya mawe msingi ya ujenzi ya dutu zote.

text: Nĩkĩndũ kĩ vĩnya kũkwatya na kĩthaa na, kwĩanana na Bohr model, nĩũkĩlĩa sya katĩ syĩthaa ĩthyũlũlũkĩtwe nĩ tũlũngũ tũnĩnĩ twitawa elekĩtronĩ, ota ũndũ planetĩ ĩthĩũkaa sũa - sĩsya ĩvĩsa ya 1.1.
translation: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nĩkĩndũ kĩ vĩnya kũkwatya na kĩthaa na, kwĩanana na Bohr model, nĩũkĩlĩa sya katĩ syĩthaa ĩthyũlũlũkĩtwe nĩ tũlũngũ tũnĩnĩ twitawa elekĩtronĩ, ota ũndũ planetĩ ĩthĩũkaa sũa - sĩsya ĩvĩsa ya 1.1.
translation: Ni chombo tata ambacho kulingana na mfano uliorahisishwa wa Bohr, kina nyuklia ya kati inayozungukwa na elektroni, sawa na sayari zinavyozunguka jua - ona Mchoro 1.1.

text: Nucleus yĩthĩawa na ilungu ilĩ - neurons na protons.
translation: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Nucleus yĩthĩawa na ilungu ilĩ - neurons na protons.
translation: Nyuklia ina chembe mbili - nyutroni na protoni.

text: Vulotoni syithiawa na uvano wa kwongela wa mwaki wa sitima, indi nasyo niutuloni siyithiawa na mwaki ona vanini. Elekituloni nasyo syithiawa na uvano wa kuola wa mwaki wa sitima.
translation: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Vulotoni syithiawa na uvano wa kwongela wa mwaki wa sitima, indi nasyo niutuloni siyithiawa na mwaki ona vanini. Elekituloni nasyo syithiawa na uvano wa kuola wa mwaki wa sitima.
translation: Protoni zina chaji chanya ya umeme wakati neutroni hazina chaji. Elektroni zina chaji hasi ya umeme.

text: Nĩ kenda kũsĩsya mũwaũ, nĩ lasĩma wambe kũsĩsya vala vekĩkĩe kĩko kyũ nĩ kenda wĩthwe wĩmũsũvĩĩkũ.
translation: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Nĩ kenda kũsĩsya mũwaũ, nĩ lasĩma wambe kũsĩsya vala vekĩkĩe kĩko kyũ nĩ kenda wĩthwe wĩmũsũvĩĩkũ.
translation: Ili Kumwangalia mwathirika, ni lazima kwanza uchunguze eneo ili kuhakikisha usalama wako.

text: Ni wailitwe kumanya muungamo wa muumiw'a withi vakuvi nake na syonekany'o ila syukaa o mana.
translation: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Ni wailitwe kumanya muungamo wa muumiw'a withi vakuvi nake na syonekany'o ila syukaa o mana.
translation: Unahitaji kugundua nafasi ya mwathiriwa unapoenda kumkaribia na kiashiria vyovyote vya kawaida vya hatari.

text: Ila uumia uitata kutetheesya, no ukite kwananga maundu vyu.
translation: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Ila uumia uitata kutetheesya, no ukite kwananga maundu vyu.
translation: Ikiwa utaumia ukijaribu kusaidia, huenda utafanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi tu.

text: Ukunikili ũu weethiie kuthĩnĩka ngoo mũno, wia na kwona thina ni syithiawa ivinda ya woo na kwonza kwa mũongo wa nthi.
translation: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ukunikili ũu weethiie kuthĩnĩka ngoo mũno, wia na kwona thina ni syithiawa ivinda ya woo na kwonza kwa mũongo wa nthi.
translation: Utafiti ulionyesha kwamba mafadhaiko, uoga na kutia janga chumvi kulipatanisha uhusiano kati ya uchungu na ulemavu kwa walio na maumivu ya sehemu ya chini ya mgongo.

text: No mauito ma mathina, ti kukw'a ngoo na wia waí kauta kila kyumwa nundu wa mavinda ma PA.
translation: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: No mauito ma mathina, ti kukw'a ngoo na wia waí kauta kila kyumwa nundu wa mavinda ma PA.
translation: Ni athari tu za kutia janga chumvi, si mafadhaiko na uoga, zilizokuwa na masharti ya vipindi vya PA vya mara kwa mara kila wiki.

text: Ala me isesoni yimwe meendaa ukwatwa mbau kwa mwonekano muthuku wa woo uivathukany'a ivathukany'o sya woo utathelaa na kwiw'a utemwianie nundu wa kutinda uendete.
translation: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ala me isesoni yimwe meendaa ukwatwa mbau kwa mwonekano muthuku wa woo uivathukany'a ivathukany'o sya woo utathelaa na kwiw'a utemwianie nundu wa kutinda uendete.
translation: Walioshiriki katika shughuli za mara kwa mara walihitaji usaidizi zaidi kubainisha tofauti za uchungu sugu na hisia za usumbufu kutokana na msogeo wa kawaida wa kimwili, kuhusiana na mtazamo hasi wa uchungu.

text: Woni, kana utonyi wa kwona itengemeaa na mutalatala wa mamutha ma kumanya kana metho.
translation: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Woni, kana utonyi wa kwona itengemeaa na mutalatala wa mamutha ma kumanya kana metho.
translation: Uonaji, au uwezo wa kuona hutegemea viungo vya hisia vya mfumo wa kuona au macho.

text: Ve mithemba mingi ya mumbo wa metho, kivathukany'o kiyongeleka kwianana na mawendi ma I kyumbe.
translation: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Ve mithemba mingi ya mumbo wa metho, kivathukany'o kiyongeleka kwianana na mawendi ma I kyumbe.
translation: Kuna miundo tofauti ya macho, yaliyo ya utata tofauti kulingana na mahitaji ya kiumbe.

text: Kuseuvw'a na miundo yi kivathukanio syithiawa na mautonyi me kivathukany'o, syithiawa na nivindukaa mituki kwianana na uvinduku wa makumbo na syithiawa na levoo syi kivathukany'o sya usungio, o ingi nisyendaa nzia syi kivathukany'o ni kana sielewe ni kila i kwikiwa na namba syi kivathukany'o ithukume nesa.
translation: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Kuseuvw'a na miundo yi kivathukanio syithiawa na mautonyi me kivathukany'o, syithiawa na nivindukaa mituki kwianana na uvinduku wa makumbo na syithiawa na levoo syi kivathukany'o sya usungio, o ingi nisyendaa nzia syi kivathukany'o ni kana sielewe ni kila i kwikiwa na namba syi kivathukany'o ithukume nesa.
translation: Miundo tofauti ina uwezo tofauti, ni myepesi kwa masafa tofauti ya mawimbi na yana viwango tofauti vya ukali, pia inahitaji uchakataji tofauti ili kuelewa ingizo na nambari tofauti ili kufanya kazi kwa ubora.

text: Utalo ni muvulany'o wa syindu sya kivathukany'o nthini wa kisio vulani.
translation: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Utalo ni muvulany'o wa syindu sya kivathukany'o nthini wa kisio vulani.
translation: Idadi ni mkusanyiko wa viumbehai wa spishi maalum ndani ya eneo fulani la kijiografia.

text: Ila andu oonthe mavyanene me kwa populeshoni vamwe na tavia syoo metawa monomorphic.
translation: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Ila andu oonthe mavyanene me kwa populeshoni vamwe na tavia syoo metawa monomorphic.
translation: Wakati kila mmoja katika idadi ya wakazi ni sawa kwa kuzingatia tabia fulani ya maumbile wanajulikana kama wanajinsia moja.

text: Ila andũ moonania mithemba kauta ya tavia na methaa masensye maketha na tavia mbingi.
translation: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Ila andũ moonania mithemba kauta ya tavia na methaa masensye maketha na tavia mbingi.
translation: Wakati watu wanaonyesha tofauti kadhaa za tabia fulani wanasemekana kuwa polimofiki.

text: Mithwa íatianíaa na itua kundu kivathukany'o.
translation: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Mithwa íatianíaa na itua kundu kivathukany'o.
translation: Makoloni ya siafu huandamana na kuishi katika awamu tofauti vilevile.

text: Ivinda yasyo ya kutembea, nguku itembea kwatuka na iithyumua ivinda ya muthenya.
translation: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Ivinda yasyo ya kutembea, nguku itembea kwatuka na iithyumua ivinda ya muthenya.
translation: Katika awamu ya kuhamahama, siafu huandamana usiku na kusimama na kukita kambi mchana.

text: Mũkolonĩ ambĩa mwendo wa aĩthĩ leũ wambĩa kũthela.ĩvĩndanĩ yĩĩ, mũkolonĩ nĩwaseũvasya tũsũmba tũla twa vĩndũawa kĩla mũthenya.
translation: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Mũkolonĩ ambĩa mwendo wa aĩthĩ leũ wambĩa kũthela.ĩvĩndanĩ yĩĩ, mũkolonĩ nĩwaseũvasya tũsũmba tũla twa vĩndũawa kĩla mũthenya.
translation: Koloni huanza awamu ya kuhamahama wakati chakula kilichopo kimepunguka. Katika awamu hii, koloni hutengeneza viota visivyo vya kudumu ambavyo hubadilishwa kila siku.

text: Kila imwe ya savali kana maseso aya ikuaa ilungu ya mithenya ta ikumi na muonza.
translation: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Kila imwe ya savali kana maseso aya ikuaa ilungu ya mithenya ta ikumi na muonza.
translation: Kila moja haya mabwawa ya kuhamahama au maandamano hudumu takriban siku 17.

text: seli ni kyau? Ndeto seli yumanite na ndeto ya Kilatini "sela", ila imaanisyaa "kasumba kanini", na ndeto ino yakwataniw'e vamwe ni mutumii wa nduluvini aisisya undu kikuniko kya suva kiseuvitwe.
translation: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: seli ni kyau? Ndeto seli yumanite na ndeto ya Kilatini "sela", ila imaanisyaa "kasumba kanini", na ndeto ino yakwataniw'e vamwe ni mutumii wa nduluvini aisisya undu kikuniko kya suva kiseuvitwe.
translation: Seli ni nini? Neno cell linatokana na neno la Kilatini "cella", linalomaanisha "chumba kidogo", na lilibuniwa mara ya kwanza na mtaalamu wa hadubini alipokuwa akitazama muundo wa dutu ya mwaloni.

text: Seli niyo uniti ya syindu syonthe syi thau, na syindu syonthe syithwaa iseuvitw'e ni imwe kana seli mbingi.
translation: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Seli niyo uniti ya syindu syonthe syi thau, na syindu syonthe syithwaa iseuvitw'e ni imwe kana seli mbingi.
translation: Seli ni sehemu msingi ya vitu vyote vilivyo hai, na viumbehai wote wameundwa kwa moja au zaidi ya seli hizi.

text: Seli syithwaa syi laisi na maana ila uusoma yiulu wa maisa, ona syitawa "mavia ala makite maisa".
translation: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Seli syithwaa syi laisi na maana ila uusoma yiulu wa maisa, ona syitawa "mavia ala makite maisa".
translation: Seli ni msingi na muhimu kwa kujifunza hali ya maisha, na kwa kweli mara nyingi inatambulika kama vitalu vya kujenga maisha.

text: Nervous system niyo itumaa imbasi kwa naavu mwiini w'on the nikenda nthakame yikale itembeete mwiini na ite usumbuwa.
translation: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Nervous system niyo itumaa imbasi kwa naavu mwiini w'on the nikenda nthakame yikale itembeete mwiini na ite usumbuwa.
translation: Mfumo wa neva hudumisha hali ya ndani kwa kutuma mipwito ya neva mwilini kote ili kudumisha mkondo wa damu pia bila usumbufu.

text: Ũmanyĩthani ũũ wa naavu noũtũmwe mĩtĩkĩ mũno mwĩĩnĩ w'onthe ĩla ĩtethasya kwiia mwĩĩ vate mbanga ya kũtelemw'a nĩ kĩndũ kyonthe.
translation: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Ũmanyĩthani ũũ wa naavu noũtũmwe mĩtĩkĩ mũno mwĩĩnĩ w'onthe ĩla ĩtethasya kwiia mwĩĩ vate mbanga ya kũtelemw'a nĩ kĩndũ kyonthe.
translation: Mipwito hii ya neva inaweza kutumwa haraka sana mwilini kote ambayo huweka mwili salama dhidi ya hatari yoyote.

text: ĩuutani ii syithiwa kisio kinini kute ĩuutani ila ingi syi vinya, ingi no syanange syindu ila syi nziani ya syo.
translation: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: ĩuutani ii syithiwa kisio kinini kute ĩuutani ila ingi syi vinya, ingi no syanange syindu ila syi nziani ya syo.
translation: Vimbunga hupiga sehemu ndogo ikilinganishwa na dhoruba zingine kali, lakini vinaweza kuharibu kila kitu kilichopo njiani mwao.

text: Syĩuutani ni syikuua miti, ikaumwa ivwaũ nyumbani na ikaukilywa ngali kiseveni. Syiũutani ila nthũkũ vyũ syikalaa masaa atatũ.
translation: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Syĩuutani ni syikuua miti, ikaumwa ivwaũ nyumbani na ikaukilywa ngali kiseveni. Syiũutani ila nthũkũ vyũ syikalaa masaa atatũ.

text: Ilingi ii nene syina kiseve kya nginya 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

translation: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

translation: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ndũlũvenĩ ino syatumiaa lenzi ili kuthikithya syindu syi kuasa syikale ta syi vakuvi na nene.
translation: Darubini hizi zilitumia mchanganyiko wa lenzi mbili kufanya vitu vilivyo mbali kuonekana kuwakaribu na kubwa.

text: Itomo na utoonu kukethaa na itu na ni mituo ya ngwatanio ila aingi matetheka, kukethaa syindu mbingi sya kukwata na nthini wa ivinda inini mena utoonu.
translation: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Itomo na utoonu kukethaa na itu na ni mituo ya ngwatanio ila aingi matetheka, kukethaa syindu mbingi sya kukwata na nthini wa ivinda inini mena utoonu.
translation: Tamaa na ubinafsi siku zote zitakuwa nasi na ni hali ya ushirikiano kwamba wakati wengi wanafaidika siku zote kutakuwa na mengi ya kufaidi kwa muda mfupi kwa kutenda kiubinafsi.

text: Ni wikwatyo andu mamanye kana wendi woo munene ni kuthukumana na andu angi me vamwe.
translation: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ni wikwatyo andu mamanye kana wendi woo munene ni kuthukumana na andu angi me vamwe.
translation: Kwa matumaini, watu wengi watagundua kwamba chaguo lao bora la kudumu ni kufanya kazi pamoja na wengine.

text: Andũ aĩngĩ mendaa mũthenya andũ makathĩ ndatanĩ ĩngĩ na kũmanya nthĩ ĩngĩ, andũ amwe maseng'aa nĩkyaũ kĩkũ na amwe maĩkĩĩa alĩens kana thayũ ĩngĩ nosyĩkale ndatanĩ ĩngĩ.
translation: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Andũ aĩngĩ mendaa mũthenya andũ makathĩ ndatanĩ ĩngĩ na kũmanya nthĩ ĩngĩ, andũ amwe maseng'aa nĩkyaũ kĩkũ na amwe maĩkĩĩa alĩens kana thayũ ĩngĩ nosyĩkale ndatanĩ ĩngĩ.
translation: Watu wengi huota kuhusu siku ambayo wanadamu wanaweza kusafiri kwa nyota nyingine na kuvumbua ulimwengu mwingine. Watu wengine hushangaa ni nini iko huko nje, wengine wanaamini kuwa wageni au maisha mengine yanaweza kuishi kwenye sayari nyingine.

text: Ateo, kethwa ũũ nũkwĩkĩka no ithwa ite ĩvĩnda yĩasa. Ndata syĩthaa itaanĩe na vaasa mũno na maili trĩlĩonĩ katĩ wa ndata ĩla nĩ "mũtũĩ".
translation: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Ateo, kethwa ũũ nũkwĩkĩka no ithwa ite ĩvĩnda yĩasa. Ndata syĩthaa itaanĩe na vaasa mũno na maili trĩlĩonĩ katĩ wa ndata ĩla nĩ "mũtũĩ".
translation: Lakini, iwapo hili litawahi kutokea labda halitatokea kwa muda mrefu sana. Nyota zimetawanyika sana kiasi kwamba kuna matrilioni ya maili katikati ya nyota ambazo ni "majirani".

text: Noethwa muthenya umwe, nzukuku syaku ikethwa siungye iulu wa nthi ya syindu nzaanu syiisenga iulu wa ancestors moo ma tene?
translation: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Noethwa muthenya umwe, nzukuku syaku ikethwa siungye iulu wa nthi ya syindu nzaanu syiisenga iulu wa ancestors moo ma tene?
translation: Pengine siku moja, vitukuu wako watasimama juu ya ulimwengu wa kigeni wakiwaza kuhusu mababu zao wa zamani?

text: nyamũ ĩseũvĩtwe n cells mbĩngĩ.syĩĩsa syĩndũ na sĩyĩthĩa nthĩnĩ wa syo.nyamũ mbĩngĩ no ĩtembee.
translation: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: nyamũ ĩseũvĩtwe n cells mbĩngĩ.syĩĩsa syĩndũ na sĩyĩthĩa nthĩnĩ wa syo.nyamũ mbĩngĩ no ĩtembee.
translation: Wanyama wametengenezwa kwa seli nyingi. Wao hula vitu na kuvimeng'enyea ndani. Wanyama wengi wanaweza kusonga.

text: Nyamu syoka nisyo syi iliko (ateo ti nyamu syonthe; ikuyu, kwa ngelekany'o, iyingwa kiliko).
translation: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Nyamu syoka nisyo syi iliko (ateo ti nyamu syonthe; ikuyu, kwa ngelekany'o, iyingwa kiliko).
translation: Ni wanyama tu walio na bongo (ingawa hata si wanyama wote walio nazo; kwa mfano, viwavi wa baharini hawana bongo).

text: Nyamu syonekaa kila vandu iulu wanthi. Syinzaa ku nthi, ikathambia ku maukangani, na ikauluka kuu matuni.
translation: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Nyamu syonekaa kila vandu iulu wanthi. Syinzaa ku nthi, ikathambia ku maukangani, na ikauluka kuu matuni.
translation: Wanyama hupatikana duniani kote. Wanachimba ardhini, wanaogelea kwenye bahari, na wanaruka angani.

text: Cell' ni kalembeta kala kanini vyu ka vata mwiini wa kindu ki thayu.
translation: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Cell' ni kalembeta kala kanini vyu ka vata mwiini wa kindu ki thayu.
translation: Seli ni sehemu ndogo ya kimuundo na ya kazi ya viumbe (vitu) hai.

text: Seli yumanite na ndeto ya Latin cella ila iminiaa kalumu kanini.
translation: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Seli yumanite na ndeto ya Latin cella ila iminiaa kalumu kanini.
translation: Seli linatokana na neno cella la Kilatini ambalo humaanisha chumba kidogo.

text: Wasyaisya syindu syi thayu nthi wa kaindo ka unenevy'a syindu ukoona kana iseuvitw'e na ithyululu kana tulungu tuini.
translation: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Wasyaisya syindu syi thayu nthi wa kaindo ka unenevy'a syindu ukoona kana iseuvitw'e na ithyululu kana tulungu tuini.
translation: Ukitazama vitu vyenye uhai chini ya hadubini, utaona kwamba vimeudwa kwa miraba au mipira midogo.

text: Robert Hooke, mundu wa mbailongyi kuma uungelesa, niwoonie tuindo tunini twianene ngali syonthe ngunikoni aitumia kindu kya utethesya kwona tuindo tunini.
translation: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Robert Hooke, mundu wa mbailongyi kuma uungelesa, niwoonie tuindo tunini twianene ngali syonthe ngunikoni aitumia kindu kya utethesya kwona tuindo tunini.
translation: Robert Hooke, mtaalamu wa biolojia kutoka Uingereza, aliona miraba midogo kwenye kizibo kwa darubini.

text: Syailyi ta lumu. Nĩwe waĩ mundu wa mbee kwona seli ngwũ.
translation: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Syailyi ta lumu. Nĩwe waĩ mundu wa mbee kwona seli ngwũ.
translation: Zilionekana kama vyumba. Alikuwa mtu wa kwanza kuona seli zilizokufa.

text: Elements na compounds no syume kuma kwa muthemba umwe kuthi uungi vate kusenzya.
translation: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Elements na compounds no syume kuma kwa muthemba umwe kuthi uungi vate kusenzya.
translation: Elementi na misombo zinaweza kusonga kutoka hali moja hadi nyingine na zikose kubadilika.

text: Nitrogen ta ngasi mbato yio syindu o imwe ta Nitrogen sya muvai wa kiw'u. Muvai wa kiw'u undu withwaa uilye ni muvuthu ateo molecules syithwaa syi undumwe.
translation: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Nitrogen ta ngasi mbato yio syindu o imwe ta Nitrogen sya muvai wa kiw'u. Muvai wa kiw'u undu withwaa uilye ni muvuthu ateo molecules syithwaa syi undumwe.
translation: Nitrojeni kama gesi bado ina sifa sawa na nitrojeni oevu. Hali oevu nzito kiasi lakini molekyuli bado ni sawa.

text: Kiwu ni ngelekany'o ingi. Kiwu kyonthe kiseuvitw'e ni twindu twa aindrongen na atomu imwe ya nzeve yo veva na nthini.
translation: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Kiwu ni ngelekany'o ingi. Kiwu kyonthe kiseuvitw'e ni twindu twa aindrongen na atomu imwe ya nzeve yo veva na nthini.
translation: Maji ni mfano mwingine. Msombo maji umeundwa kwa atomu mbili za hidrojeni na atomu moja ya oksijeni.

text: yithiawa na umbo umwe wa nthini yithw'e ni nzeve, kiw'u, kana ivia.
translation: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: yithiawa na umbo umwe wa nthini yithw'e ni nzeve, kiw'u, kana ivia.
translation: Ina muundo sawa wa kimolekyuli iwe ni gesi, kioevu, au mango.

text: O na kwithw'a mumbo wayo ula twonaa no uvinduke, umbo wa kemikoo nduvindukaa.
translation: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: O na kwithw'a mumbo wayo ula twonaa no uvinduke, umbo wa kemikoo nduvindukaa.
translation: Ingawa hali yake ya mwili inaweza kubadilika, hali yake ya kikemikali inabaki ile ile.

text: Mavinda ni kindu kithiawa kila vandu tui, na kikwataa syindu syonthe ila twikaa, indu ni kyumu kueleeka.
translation: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Mavinda ni kindu kithiawa kila vandu tui, na kikwataa syindu syonthe ila twikaa, indu ni kyumu kueleeka.
translation: Wakati ni kitu ambacho kinatuzingira, na huathiri kila kitu tunachofanya, lakini ni ngumu kuelewa.

text: Ivinda ni isometwe ni asomi ma ndini, ui, na saenzi myaka makili maingi.
translation: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Ivinda ni isometwe ni asomi ma ndini, ui, na saenzi myaka makili maingi.
translation: Wakati umesomwa na wasomi wa kidini, kifalsafa, na kisayansi kwa maelfu ya miaka.

text: Ivinda ni tuyikusiiya ta ilingu sya maundu makethiwa mithenya yukite, kuvitia kwa mithenya ila tui ooyu muvaka mithenya mivitu.
translation: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Ivinda ni tuyikusiiya ta ilingu sya maundu makethiwa mithenya yukite, kuvitia kwa mithenya ila tui ooyu muvaka mithenya mivitu.
translation: Sisi hupata saa kama msururu wa matukio unaopita kutoka wakati ujao kupitia wakati uliopo hadi kwenye wakati uliopita.

text: Ivinda onayo no nzia tutumiia kusyaanisya (uasa) wa maundu meethiwa.
translation: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Ivinda onayo no nzia tutumiia kusyaanisya (uasa) wa maundu meethiwa.
translation: Saa pia ni jinsi tunavyolinganisha kipindi (urefu) cha matukio.

text: No umake kuvita kwa ivinda we mweene na kuisya kwisyokeleela kwa ivinda ya kithyululu ivinda ua kithyululu ni kindu kikikaa ingi na ingi.
translation: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: No umake kuvita kwa ivinda we mweene na kuisya kwisyokeleela kwa ivinda ya kithyululu ivinda ua kithyululu ni kindu kikikaa ingi na ingi.
translation: Unaweza kuweka alama ya upitaji wa saa wewe mwenyewe kwa kuangalia marudio ya tukio la kimzunguko. Tukio la kimzunguko ni kitu ambacho hutukia tena na tena mara nyingi.

text: Matuku aa kompyuta itumiawa kuvindua visa na vindio.
translation: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Matuku aa kompyuta itumiawa kuvindua visa na vindio.

text: Visa sya kwĩloela sya vata mũno no siseuvĩw'e kombyũtanĩ, na mũthemba ũũ wa ũseũvya visa nĩwongelekete ũtũmĩwa televiseninĩ na vitiunĩ.
translation: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Visa sya kwĩloela sya vata mũno no siseuvĩw'e kombyũtanĩ, na mũthemba ũũ wa ũseũvya visa nĩwongelekete ũtũmĩwa televiseninĩ na vitiunĩ.
translation: Michoro ya kisasa inaweza kujengwa kwenye kompyuta, na aina hii ya uhuishaji inazidi kutumiwa kwenye runinga na filamu.

text: Mavinda maingi wathi useuvaw'a na kompyuta ngomau kwa kuseuvya na kuvulany'a mawasya.
translation: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Mavinda maingi wathi useuvaw'a na kompyuta ngomau kwa kuseuvya na kuvulany'a mawasya.
translation: Muziki kwa kawaida hurekodiwa kutumia kompyuta tata ili kuchakata na kuchanganya sauti pamoja.

text: Kwa kilungu kiasa myakani ya 1900 na ya 2000, nikwaikiiite jana andu ma mbee kwikala New Zealand ni Maoiri ala asyimaa masuni manene metawa moas.
translation: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Kwa kilungu kiasa myakani ya 1900 na ya 2000, nikwaikiiite jana andu ma mbee kwikala New Zealand ni Maoiri ala asyimaa masuni manene metawa moas.
translation: Kwa muda mrefu wakati wa karne za kumi na tisa na ishirini, iliaminika wakazi wa kwanza wa Nyuzilandi walikuwa watu wa Maori, waliowinda ndege wakubwa walioitwa moa.

text: Ngewa ila yaasya kana yisilya ya andu ma Maori mathamie kuma Polynesia kwa nzia nene na moosa New Zealand kuma Moriori na mambiia uimi wa ngwatanio ya njamii.
translation: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Ngewa ila yaasya kana yisilya ya andu ma Maori mathamie kuma Polynesia kwa nzia nene na moosa New Zealand kuma Moriori na mambiia uimi wa ngwatanio ya njamii.
translation: Basi nadharia ikaanzisha wazo kwamba watu wa Maori walihama kutoka Polynesia katika Kundi Kubwa na kuchukua Nyuzilandi kutoka kwa Moriori, na kuanzisha jamii ya kilimo.

text: Uu wiovo, ukusi mweu wionany'a kana Moriori mai nguluvu nene ya Maori ala mathamie kuma New Zealand kuthi ithimani sya Chatham, maseuvitye kithio kyoo kikivathukany'o na ki muuo.
translation: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Uu wiovo, ukusi mweu wionany'a kana Moriori mai nguluvu nene ya Maori ala mathamie kuma New Zealand kuthi ithimani sya Chatham, maseuvitye kithio kyoo kikivathukany'o na ki muuo.
translation: Hata hivyo, ushahidi mpya unadokeza kwamba Moriori walikuwa kundi la Maori wa bara waliohama kutoka Nyuzilandi hadi Visiwa vya Chatham, na wakakuza utamaduni wao wenyewe wa kipekee na wenye amani.

text: Kwai mbai ingi ithamani ii sya Chathamyitawa Maori ila yaumite New Zealand.
translation: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Kwai mbai ingi ithamani ii sya Chathamyitawa Maori ila yaumite New Zealand.
translation: Kulikuwa pia na makabila mengine kwenye visiwa vya Chatham, ambao walikuwa Maori waliohamia Nyuzilandi.

text: Meeyitie Moriori kwai makau o kauta na mwisowe, muvai wa Moriori wavetangwa vyu.
