text: Andu ala makonanitw'e kwa myaka kauta matutetheeisye na kumanya mavinya na wendi witu o vamwe na kuasesi mawetu na mauvaluku maitu.
translation: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Andu ala makonanitw'e kwa myaka kauta matutetheeisye na kumanya mavinya na wendi witu o vamwe na kuasesi mawetu na mauvaluku maitu.
translation: Watu waliohusika kwa miongo kadhaa walitusaidia kuthamini uwezo na shauku zetu huku tukitathmini shida na hata kutofaulu kwa uwazi.

text: Yila twethukiisye andu mainengane ngewa syoo ene, sya misyi yoo, na sya mawiani moo, ni twakwatie mwanya wa ukunikila kwa unthini mithenya mivituku na andu amwe ala makiitie kwa useo kana uthuku syithio sya I kambuni.
translation: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Yila twethukiisye andu mainengane ngewa syoo ene, sya misyi yoo, na sya mawiani moo, ni twakwatie mwanya wa ukunikila kwa unthini mithenya mivituku na andu amwe ala makiitie kwa useo kana uthuku syithio sya I kambuni.
translation: Wakati wa kusikiliza watu wakishirikisha hadithi za kibinafsi, kifamilia au kishirika, tulipata ufahamu wa kale wenye thamani na baadhi ya watu ambao waliathiri utamaduni wa shirika kwa njia nzuri au mbaya.

text: O ila uelewa ni umo wa mundu manya ti undu umwe na kumanya kithio kyake, nitumaa mundu amanya vala ui kwa umo wa mundu wa kambuni.
translation: While understanding one's history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: O ila uelewa ni umo wa mundu manya ti undu umwe na kumanya kithio kyake, nitumaa mundu amanya vala ui kwa umo wa mundu wa kambuni.
translation: Wakati kuelewa historia ya mtu hakumaanishi kuelewa utamaduni, angalau huwasaidia watu kupata hisia za mahali waliko katika historia ya shirika.

text: Nthini wa kuthima mauseo na kuendeea na kumanya mauvaliku, andu na ala methiawa vau oonthe nimamanyaa o kwa uito myolooto, wia na syindu ila isukumaa kampuni.
translation: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Nthini wa kuthima mauseo na kuendeea na kumanya mauvaliku, andu na ala methiawa vau oonthe nimamanyaa o kwa uito myolooto, wia na syindu ila isukumaa kampuni.
translation: Wakati wa kutathmini mafanikio na kufahamu kutofaulu, watu binafsi na watu wote wanaoshiriki hugundua kwa kina zaidi maadili, misheni na nguvu za uendeshaji za shirika.

text: Ivindani yii, tuililikana maita kauta mavitu ma tavia ya uviasala na maendeeo mayo ni mateetheisye andu kwitikilana na mitalatala myeu na nzia nzau ya ikanisa yaku.
translation: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Ivindani yii, tuililikana maita kauta mavitu ma tavia ya uviasala na maendeeo mayo ni mateetheisye andu kwitikilana na mitalatala myeu na nzia nzau ya ikanisa yaku.
translation: Kwa wakati huu, kukumbuka matukio ya awali ya tabia za ujasiriamali na mafanikio yaliyofuatia kulisaidia watu kuwa wazi kwa mabadiliko mapya na mwelekeo mpya wa kanisa la kienyeji.

text: Ngewa imwe ta isu sya maendeeo nisyaolile mawia ma kusenzya, o ila ingi syaendee kusenzya ivinda yukite.
translation: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Ngewa imwe ta isu sya maendeeo nisyaolile mawia ma kusenzya, o ila ingi syaendee kusenzya ivinda yukite.
translation: Hadithi kama hizi za mafanikio zilipunguza hofu ya mabadiliko, huku zikiunda mielekeo chanya kuhusu mabadiliko wakati ujao.

text: Kusuania kuvyanene nikuminaa mathina ala makwatanasya mesilya kivathukany'o nikenda ukwate usungio.
translation: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Kusuania kuvyanene nikuminaa mathina ala makwatanasya mesilya kivathukany'o nikenda ukwate usungio.
translation: Mifumo inayobadilika ya fikira ni mbinu za utatuzi wa shida ambazo zinaunganisha maoni au nyanja tofauti ili kupata suluhisho.

text: Woni wa ĩsũanĩa ta yĩĩ nĩ mĩtũkĩ, kĩlĩĩko na ũseo vyũ, o na kwona ũw'o, kũtũmĩa nthĩa ila syĩkw'o, kwosanya maũvoo.
translation: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Woni wa ĩsũanĩa ta yĩĩ nĩ mĩtũkĩ, kĩlĩĩko na ũseo vyũ, o na kwona ũw'o, kũtũmĩa nthĩa ila syĩkw'o, kwosanya maũvoo.
translation: Angazio la mtazamo huu ni kasi, mantiki na usahihi, pia utambuzi wa ukweli, kutumia tena mbinu zilizopo, kukusanya taarifa.

text: Kindũ kya vata vyũ yisilyani yii ni: Ve ũsũngio umwe wa w'o. Wiisililya mausungio eli, uw'o kana ũvungũ.
translation: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Kindũ kya vata vyũ yisilyani yii ni: Ve ũsũngio umwe wa w'o. Wiisililya mausungio eli, uw'o kana ũvungũ.
translation: Kipengele muhimu zaidi cha mtazamo huu ni: kuna jibu moja tu sahihi. Unafikiria majibu mawili tu, yaani sahihi au kosa.

text: Kusoania kwa nzia iĩ nikuthanĩtwe na saenzi na nzĩa ingĩ sya kawaita.
translation: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Kusoania kwa nzia iĩ nikuthanĩtwe na saenzi na nzĩa ingĩ sya kawaita.
translation: Aina hii ya fikira inahusishwa na taratibu fulani za kisayansi au kawaida.

text: Andu masuaniaa uu methwaa me sawa, methwaa matonya ulilikana patani, kumina mathina na kuthukuma kwa mitiani ya maundu ma saenzi.
translation: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Andu masuaniaa uu methwaa me sawa, methwaa matonya ulilikana patani, kumina mathina na kuthukuma kwa mitiani ya maundu ma saenzi.
translation: Watu wenye aina hii ya kufikiria wana mawazo ya kimantiki, wanaweza kukariri miundo, kutatua shida na kufanya majaribio ya kisayansi.

text: Andu nĩmo mena kĩnengo kya mwanya kya kũsoma akili sya iingi.
translation: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Andu nĩmo mena kĩnengo kya mwanya kya kũsoma akili sya iingi.
translation: Kwa umbali wanadamu ndio spishi yenye talanta zaidi katika kusoma akili za wengine.

text: Kiu ni kwonany'a kana twina utonyi wa kumanya undu andu mekwona, mavangite kwika, kuaikiia, kumanya kana kwendeew'a.
translation: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Kiu ni kwonany'a kana twina utonyi wa kumanya undu andu mekwona, mavangite kwika, kuaikiia, kumanya kana kwendeew'a.
translation: Hilo linamaanisha tunaweza kutabiri kile binadamu wengine wanachohisi, kukusudia, kuamini, kujua au kutamani kwa ufanisi.

text: Kati wa mautonyi aa, kuelewa wendi wa andu angi ni kindu ki vata. Itumaa twithwa tutonya kumina syindu syivinya sya maundu ma kwika.
translation: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Kati wa mautonyi aa, kuelewa wendi wa andu angi ni kindu ki vata. Itumaa twithwa tutonya kumina syindu syivinya sya maundu ma kwika.
translation: Katika uwezo huu, kuelewa nia ya wengine ni muhimu. Huturuhusu kutatua uwezekano wa utata katika vitendo halisi vya kimwili.

text: Kwa mũvyano, ũkona mũndũ ndatũla ndĩlĩsya ya ngalĩ, wasya akwete kuya ngalĩ yeene.
translation: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger's car.

text: Kwa mũvyano, ũkona mũndũ ndatũla ndĩlĩsya ya ngalĩ, wasya akwete kuya ngalĩ yeene.
translation: Kwa mfano, ikiwa ungeona mtu akivunja dirisha la gari, labda ungedhani alikuwa anajaribu kuiba gari la mtu usiyemjua.

text: Nukwenda usilĩlwa kĩvathũkany'o ketha niwaaisye mbungũo sya ngalĩ yake na nĩyo watataa kũvũnzya alike.
translation: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Nukwenda usilĩlwa kĩvathũkany'o ketha niwaaisye mbungũo sya ngalĩ yake na nĩyo watataa kũvũnzya alike.
translation: Angehitaji kuhukumiwa tofauti ikiwa angepoteza funguo za gari lake na lilikuwa gari lake mwenyewe ambalo alikuwa akijaribu.

text: MRI yina mũsingĩ wa Fisikisi witawa nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), ula wamanyikanie myakani ya 1930 ni Felix Bloch (aithukuma yunivasiti ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kuma yunivasiti ya Harvard).
translation: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: MRI yina mũsingĩ wa Fisikisi witawa nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), ula wamanyikanie myakani ya 1930 ni Felix Bloch (aithukuma yunivasiti ya Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kuma yunivasiti ya Harvard).
translation: MRI ni ya msingi wa fizikia inayoitwa nyuklia mwangwi wa sumaku (NMR), ambayo iligunduliwa katika 1930s na Felix Bloch (anayefanya kazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Stanford) na Edward Purcell (kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Harvard).

text: Nthini wa chanelini kiu, makumbo ma sivaki na ma redio matumaa atumu syambiisya kumya singinoo sya letio.
translation: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Nthini wa chanelini kiu, makumbo ma sivaki na ma redio matumaa atumu syambiisya kumya singinoo sya letio.
translation: Katika tasnifu hii, uga wa sumaku na wimbiredio husababisha atomi kutoa ishara ndogo za redio.

text: Mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, ndakitali wa uiiti, na musomi wa saenzi, ni wa vumbuie mwambiliilyo wa kutumie mashini ya kukuna visa ta muio wa kuthima nthini wa uiiti.
translation: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, ndakitali wa uiiti, na musomi wa saenzi, ni wa vumbuie mwambiliilyo wa kutumie mashini ya kukuna visa ta muio wa kuthima nthini wa uiiti.
translation: Katika mwaka wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, daktari wa kimatibabu na mtafiti wa kisayansi, aligundua msingi wa kutumia picha za mwangwi wa sumaku kama kifaa cha utambuzi wa kimatibabu.

text: Mwaka ina itina niw'o valua wanenganiwe, ula niw'o wai wambee nthi yonthe kunenganwe muveani wa MRI.
translation: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Mwaka ina itina niw'o valua wanenganiwe, ula niw'o wai wambee nthi yonthe kunenganwe muveani wa MRI.
translation: Miaka minne baadaye leseni ilitolewa, ambayo ilikuwa leseni ya kwanza ulimwenguni iliyotolewa katika sehemu ya MRI

text: Mwakanĩ wa 1977, dakitalĩ Damadian nĩwamĩnĩebkũseũvya MRI skana ya mbee ya mwĩĩ wonthe ĩla wa mĩtĩe "indomitable"
translation: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first "whole-body" MRI scanner, which he called the "Indomitable".

text: Mwakanĩ wa 1977, dakitalĩ Damadian nĩwamĩnĩebkũseũvya MRI skana ya mbee ya mwĩĩ wonthe ĩla wa mĩtĩe "indomitable"
translation: Mwaka wa 1977, Dak. Damadian alikamilisha ujenzi wa mdaki wa MRI wa mwili wote ambao aliuita "kisicho epukika".

text: Uneeni ũla wa kũmanĩsya nũnenganaa mũndũ mwanya wa kwĩsilya na ĩndĩ kwĩka.
translation: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Uneeni ũla wa kũmanĩsya nũnenganaa mũndũ mwanya wa kwĩsilya na ĩndĩ kwĩka.
translation: Mawasiliano mengi ya kisolandanifu huchochea muda wa kutafakari na kuitikia wengine.

text: Ni inengaa amanyiwa utonyi wa kuthukuma undu matonya na undu miao ikumavikia.
translation: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Ni inengaa amanyiwa utonyi wa kuthukuma undu matonya na undu miao ikumavikia.
translation: Huwaruhusu wanafunzi uwezo wa kufanya kazi kwa mwendo wao wenyewe na kudhibiti mwendo wa taarifa za mafundisho.

text: Onaĩngĩ, vemasaa manini ma kũkũna wĩa ũtemũtalĩle masaa. (bremer, 1998)
translation: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Onaĩngĩ, vemasaa manini ma kũkũna wĩa ũtemũtalĩle masaa. (bremer, 1998)
translation: Isitoshe, kuna vizuizi vichache vya saa na uwezekano wa saa huru za kufanya kazi. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Ũtũmĩĩ wa mitandao ũnenga asomĩ mwanya wa kũkwata kĩsomo mavĩnda onthe.
translation: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Ũtũmĩĩ wa mitandao ũnenga asomĩ mwanya wa kũkwata kĩsomo mavĩnda onthe.
translation: Matumizi ya intaneti na Wavuti wa Ulimwengu Wote unaruhusu wanafunzi kupata habari kila wakati.

text: Asomi no manengane maukulyo kwi aalimu ivinda o yonthe kwi muthenya na sikeeteela usungio wa mituki, vandu va kweteela mbika ivinda yingi ya kwonana uthyu-kwa-uthyu.
translation: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Asomi no manengane maukulyo kwi aalimu ivinda o yonthe kwi muthenya na sikeeteela usungio wa mituki, vandu va kweteela mbika ivinda yingi ya kwonana uthyu-kwa-uthyu.
translation: Wanafunzi wanaweza pia kupeleka maswali kwa waalimu wakati wowote wa siku na wanatarajia majibu ya haraka, badala ya kungojea mkutano wa uso-kwa-uso utakaofuata.

text: Nzĩa ya kũsoma ya matũkũ aa nĩnenganaa mwanya wa kũelewa kũma mĩtũo ya tene. Vaĩ nzĩa ĩmwe nzeo ya kũsoma.
translation: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Nzĩa ya kũsoma ya matũkũ aa nĩnenganaa mwanya wa kũelewa kũma mĩtũo ya tene. Vaĩ nzĩa ĩmwe nzeo ya kũsoma.
translation: Njia ya usasa ya kujifunza hutoa uhuru kutoka kwa kanuni mahsusi. Hakuna njia moja nzuri ya kujifunza.

text: Ũw'o, vaiĩ kĩndũ kĩseo o na kĩmwe kya kusoma. Kũsoma kwĩthĩawa nthini wa ũtuika na katĩ katĩ wa mũmanyiw'a na umanyi ula ũkunengwa.
translation: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Ũw'o, vaiĩ kĩndũ kĩseo o na kĩmwe kya kusoma. Kũsoma kwĩthĩawa nthini wa ũtuika na katĩ katĩ wa mũmanyiw'a na umanyi ula ũkunengwa.
translation: Kwa kweli, hakuna jambo hata moja zuri la kujifunza. Kujifunza hufanyika katika uzoefu kati ya mwanafunzi na maarifa yanayowasilishwa.

text: Maũndũ ala twonete ma mĩtũkĩ monthe ma ĩka-we-mwene na ũvĩtũkya wa ũvoo, shoo sya televiseni ila syambatene na kwĩmanyĩthya syonany'a ũndũ ũũ.
translation: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Maũndũ ala twonete ma mĩtũkĩ monthe ma ĩka-we-mwene na ũvĩtũkya wa ũvoo, shoo sya televiseni ila syambatene na kwĩmanyĩthya syonany'a ũndũ ũũ.
translation: Uzoefu wetu wa sasa wa fanya-mwenyewe na uwasilishaji wa taarifa, vipindi vya televisheni vyenye msingi wa kujifunza, vinaonyesha pointi hii.

text: Aingĩ maitũ twĩthĩaa twĩloele ilungu televiseninĩ ila itatũtavasya ĩũlũ wa nzĩa kana kĩndũ kĩĩsĩle kĩla tũtakeesa ũkwatanĩa nakyo kana kũtũmĩa ũmanyi ũsu.
translation: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Aingĩ maitũ twĩthĩaa twĩloele ilungu televiseninĩ ila itatũtavasya ĩũlũ wa nzĩa kana kĩndũ kĩĩsĩle kĩla tũtakeesa ũkwatanĩa nakyo kana kũtũmĩa ũmanyi ũsu.
translation: Kwa hivyo wengi wetu hujipata tukitazama kipindi cha runinga ambacho hutujulisha kuhusu mchakato au uzoefu ambao hatutawahi kushiriki au kutumia maarifa hayo.

text: Tuikaseovithya ngali yitu ĩngĩ, kwaka nthongo nza wa nyumba kwĩtũ, kũthĩ Perũ kũsĩsya myako ya ĩvĩnda ya tene, kana kũseũvya ĩngĩ nyũmba ya mũtũĩ wĩtũ.
translation: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Tuikaseovithya ngali yitu ĩngĩ, kwaka nthongo nza wa nyumba kwĩtũ, kũthĩ Perũ kũsĩsya myako ya ĩvĩnda ya tene, kana kũseũvya ĩngĩ nyũmba ya mũtũĩ wĩtũ.
translation: Hatutawahi kukarabati gari lote, kujenga chemchemi katika ua letu la nyuma, kusafiri Peru kukagua magofu ya kale, au kubuni upya nyumba ya jirani.

text: Nimuvea kwa waya ula wisile ukangani ukakwatany'a Yulovu na setilaiti, Greenland yu nikwatanitw'e nesa yina kilungu kya 93 yiulu wa yiana mena Intaneti.
translation: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Nimuvea kwa waya ula wisile ukangani ukakwatany'a Yulovu na setilaiti, Greenland yu nikwatanitw'e nesa yina kilungu kya 93 yiulu wa yiana mena Intaneti.
translation: Shukrani kwa viungo vya kebo za nyuzi za kioo chini ya bahari katika Uropa na satelaiti pana yenye bendi za masafa mapana, Greenland imeunganishwa vizuri na asilimia 93 ya watu wana ufikiaji wa intaneti.

text: Oteli kana ala mauthoketye (kethwa wiikala kwa nyumba ya uthokw'a kana yaku mweene) ni muno kwithwa na wifi kana kombyuta ikwatanitw'e na indaneti, na mautuo oonthe mena mukaawa wina indaneti kana kundu kungi kwa wanda kwina wifi.
translation: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Oteli kana ala mauthoketye (kethwa wiikala kwa nyumba ya uthokw'a kana yaku mweene) ni muno kwithwa na wifi kana kombyuta ikwatanitw'e na indaneti, na mautuo oonthe mena mukaawa wina indaneti kana kundu kungi kwa wanda kwina wifi.
translation: Hoteli au wenyeji wako (ikiwa unakaa katika nyumba ya wageni au nyumba ya kibinafsi) ina uwezekano wa kuwa na WiFi au kompyuta iliyounganishwa kwenye intaneti, na makao yote yana duka la huduma za intaneti au mahali fulani palipo na WiFi ya umma.

text: O ta undũ vawetetwe vau ulu, ona vala ndeto "Eskimo" yithaa yitikilitwe United States ni yosawa ta isitwa ithuku ni andu mate ma United States Mũno mũno ma Canada.
translation: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: O ta undũ vawetetwe vau ulu, ona vala ndeto "Eskimo" yithaa yitikilitwe United States ni yosawa ta isitwa ithuku ni andu mate ma United States Mũno mũno ma Canada.
translation: Kama ilivyosemwa hapo juu, ijapokuwa neno "Eskimo" limebaki kukubalika Marekani, linachukuliwa kuwa la dharau na wengi watu wengi wa Aktika wasiokuwa wa Marekani, haswa katika Canada.

text: Na withwe uyiw'a ndeto itumiawa ni ekali ma Greenlandic, andu ma kuma nza nimaila eka umitumia.
translation: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Na withwe uyiw'a ndeto itumiawa ni ekali ma Greenlandic, andu ma kuma nza nimaila eka umitumia.
translation: Wakati unaweza kusikia neno hilo likitumiwa na Wenyeji wa Grinilandi, wageni wanapaswa kuepuka kulitumia.

text: Eene ma Greenland meyĩtaa Inuit me kananda na Kalaalleq (kwa wingĩ), Greenlander, kũu Greenland.
translation: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Eene ma Greenland meyĩtaa Inuit me kananda na Kalaalleq (kwa wingĩ), Greenlander, kũu Greenland.
translation: Wenyeji wa Greenland hujiita Inuit huko Canada na Kalaalleq (kwa wingi Kalaalit), Greenlander, katika Greenland.

text: Meko ma ũng'endilĩ, na mawendĩ mathũkũ kũla kwĩ aenĩ ndĩsĩkanĩwe kũũ Greenland. Ona kũũ mĩsyĩnĩ kũyĩthaa na "kũndũ kũthũkũ".
translation: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Meko ma ũng'endilĩ, na mawendĩ mathũkũ kũla kwĩ aenĩ ndĩsĩkanĩwe kũũ Greenland. Ona kũũ mĩsyĩnĩ kũyĩthaa na "kũndũ kũthũkũ".
translation: Uhalifu, na uhasidi kwa wageni kwa jumla, haujulikani katika Grinlandi. Hata katika miji, hakuna "maeneo mabaya".

text: Mbevo itonya kwithiwa no my'o muisyo munene utonya ukomana na mundu ula uteyumbanitye.
translation: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Mbevo itonya kwithiwa no my'o muisyo munene utonya ukomana na mundu ula uteyumbanitye.
translation: Hali ya hewa ya baridi labda ndiyo hatari tu ambayo wasiyojiandaa watakuta.

text: Watembea Greenland ivindani ya mbevo (uililikana kana o undu uthi Iulu, now'o kukwithiwa kuthithu), ni undu wa vata kuka na ngua sya muutia mbianu.
translation: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Watembea Greenland ivindani ya mbevo (uililikana kana o undu uthi Iulu, now'o kukwithiwa kuthithu), ni undu wa vata kuka na ngua sya muutia mbianu.
translation: Ikiwa utatembelea mji wa Greenland wakati wa msimu wa baridi (ukizingatia kuwa jinsi unavyokwenda kaskazini ndivyo inavyozidi kuwa baridi), ni muhimu kuleta mavazi ya kutosha ya joto.

text: Mĩthenya mĩasa ya ĩvinda ya sua noyĩete mathĩna ta kũkwata too mwĩanũ na mathĩna mamwĩĩ makũnanĩtwe na kũkosa too.
translation: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Mĩthenya mĩasa ya ĩvinda ya sua noyĩete mathĩna ta kũkwata too mwĩanũ na mathĩna mamwĩĩ makũnanĩtwe na kũkosa too.
translation: Siku ndefu sana katika msimu wa kiangazi zinaweza kupelekea shida za kupata usingizi wa kutosha na shida za kiafya zinazohusika.

text: Ivindani ya syua, ithwa wi metho o na tumuu twa Nordic. O na kau tuyietae uwau wonthe, no tuthatye muno.
translation: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Ivindani ya syua, ithwa wi metho o na tumuu twa Nordic. O na kau tuyietae uwau wonthe, no tuthatye muno.
translation: Wakati wa kiangazi, pia jihadhari na mbu wa Skandinavia. Ingawa hawaenezi magonjwa, wanaweza kukera.

text: O ila ekonomi ya Francisco ukonanaw'a na kwendeesya atalii ma kilasi kya nthi yonthe, ekonomi yayo ni inyaiiku.
translation: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: O ila ekonomi ya Francisco ukonanaw'a na kwendeesya atalii ma kilasi kya nthi yonthe, ekonomi yayo ni inyaiiku.
translation: Huku uchumi wa San Francisco ukiunganishwa nayo kuwa kivutio cha watalii cha kimataifa, uchumi wake ni mseto.

text: Uandĩkanĩ ũla mũnene wĩthĩa maũndũ ala ma andũ mesĩ wĩa, selikalĩnĩ, mbesanĩ, ũtandĩthya, na ũtaliinĩ.
translation: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Uandĩkanĩ ũla mũnene wĩthĩa maũndũ ala ma andũ mesĩ wĩa, selikalĩnĩ, mbesanĩ, ũtandĩthya, na ũtaliinĩ.
translation: Sekta kubwa zaidi za ajira ni huduma za kitaalamu, serikali, fedha, biashara, na utalii.

text: Wonany'o uu wa kauta wathini, sinemani, literature na kithio kitumiawa muno kutetheetye misyi minene kumanyika nthi yonthe.
translation: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Wonany'o uu wa kauta wathini, sinemani, literature na kithio kitumiawa muno kutetheetye misyi minene kumanyika nthi yonthe.
translation: Kuonyeshwa kwake mara kwa mara katika muziki, filamu, fasihi na utamaduni maarufu kumesaidia kuufanya mji huo na minara yake ijulikane ulimwenguni kote.

text: San Francisco ninenevetye muvea wa utalii na maoteli, mikaawa, na kundu kwo komania kukali.
translation: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco ninenevetye muvea wa utalii na maoteli, mikaawa, na kundu kwo komania kukali.
translation: San Francisko imekuza miundombinu kubwa ya watalii ambayo ni hoteli mikahawa, na vifaa vingi, vya kongamano vya hali ya juu.

text: San Francisco no yo imwe ya kundu kuseo vyu nthini isu nundu wa maliu angi ma Asia: ma Korea, Thai, India, na Japan.
translation: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: San Francisco no yo imwe ya kundu kuseo vyu nthini isu nundu wa maliu angi ma Asia: ma Korea, Thai, India, na Japan.
translation: San Francisco pia ni mojawapo ya mahali bora nchini kwa vyakula vya Kiasia: Korea, Thai, India, na Japani.

text: kũtembea kuthi Walt Disney kwonanasya kyalo kya vandũ vatheũ nthĩnĩ wa mĩsyĩ mĩngĩ Amelika.
translation: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: kũtembea kuthi Walt Disney kwonanasya kyalo kya vandũ vatheũ nthĩnĩ wa mĩsyĩ mĩngĩ Amelika.
translation: Kusafiri kuenda Ulimwengu wa Walt Disney inawakilisha hija kuu kwa familia nyingi za Amerika.

text: Kutembea "kúla kúmwe" kwithwaa vamwe na kuuluka na ndeke kuthi kiwanzani kinene kya ndeke kya Orlando, ukakwatany'a na oteli wa Disney ula withwaa vau, ukekala vau kyumwa kimwe na uisyoka musyi.
translation: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Kutembea "kúla kúmwe" kwithwaa vamwe na kuuluka na ndeke kuthi kiwanzani kinene kya ndeke kya Orlando, ukakwatany'a na oteli wa Disney ula withwaa vau, ukekala vau kyumwa kimwe na uisyoka musyi.
translation: Ziara ya "kawaida" inajumuisha kutua kwenye Uwanja wa kimataifa wa ndege wa Orlando, kusafiri kwa basi hadi kwenye hoteli ya Disney, kukaa karibu wiki bila kutoka kwa miliki za Disney, na kurudi nyumbani.

text: Ve ivathukany'o itekithimo itonya ithwa syivo, ateo uu utwikaa kana niw'o andu aingi maminiaa ila mekuneenea yiulu wa "kuthi Disney World".
translation: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Ve ivathukany'o itekithimo itonya ithwa syivo, ateo uu utwikaa kana niw'o andu aingi maminiaa ila mekuneenea yiulu wa "kuthi Disney World".
translation: Kuna tofauti zisizo na kikomo zinazopatikana, lakini hili linabaki kuwa jambo ambalo watu wengi humaanisha wanaposema wanaenda Ulimwengu wa Disney"."

text: Tikiti mbingi ithoetw'e kwisila indanetini sya athoosya ta eBay kana Craiglist syithiawa tikiti sya mithenya mingi sya utwila kuna vandu vamwe kuthi vangi.
translation: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Tikiti mbingi ithoetw'e kwisila indanetini sya athoosya ta eBay kana Craiglist syithiawa tikiti sya mithenya mingi sya utwila kuna vandu vamwe kuthi vangi.
translation: Tiketi nyingi zinazouzwa mtandaoni kupitia tovuti za minada kama eBay au Craiglist ni zilizotumika kidogo za siku nyingi za kutembelea mbuga nyingi.

text: Onakaũ ũũ nũndũ wa kĩla ĩvĩnda nĩ mũvatane nĩ dĩsney. Tĩkĩtĩ syasyo ĩkũĩaw'a.
translation: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Onakaũ ũũ nũndũ wa kĩla ĩvĩnda nĩ mũvatane nĩ dĩsney. Tĩkĩtĩ syasyo ĩkũĩaw'a.
translation: Ingawa hii ni shughuli ya kawaida sana, imekatazwa na Disney: tiketi haziwezi kuhamishwa.

text: Kwĩkala kambĩnĩ nthĩ wa Grand Canyon kwendaa valũa wa nthĩ ya ĩtina.
translation: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Kwĩkala kambĩnĩ nthĩ wa Grand Canyon kwendaa valũa wa nthĩ ya ĩtina.
translation: Ukitaji kambi wowote chini ya ukingo katika Grand Canyon unahitaji kibali cha sehemu za mashambani.

text: Valua ni nini ila syiusuvia canyon, na syithwaa ikwatikana muthenya wa mbee wa mwei, myei ina mbee wa mwei wa kuambiia.
translation: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Valua ni nini ila syiusuvia canyon, na syithwaa ikwatikana muthenya wa mbee wa mwei, myei ina mbee wa mwei wa kuambiia.
translation: Vibali hupunguzwa kulinda korongo na hupatikana katika siku ya kwanza ya mwezi, mienzi nne kabla ya mwezi kuanza.

text: Kwooũ, lũũsa wa kũsyoka nthĩ kwambĩĩa matũkũ ona meva noyĩthe yĩkwatĩkana kwambĩĩa 1 mwai wa mbee.
translation: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Kwooũ, lũũsa wa kũsyoka nthĩ kwambĩĩa matũkũ ona meva noyĩthe yĩkwatĩkana kwambĩĩa 1 mwai wa mbee.
translation: Kwa hivyo, idhini ya kurudi nchini kwa tarehe yoyote ya kuanza mwezi Mei inapatikana mnamo tarehe 1 Januari.

text: Myanya ya kũndũ kwisikie mũno ta Bright Angel Campground ila ivakene na Phantom Ranch ni yusuua mthenya wa mbee andũ maambia kuivia myanya.
translation: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Myanya ya kũndũ kwisikie mũno ta Bright Angel Campground ila ivakene na Phantom Ranch ni yusuua mthenya wa mbee andũ maambia kuivia myanya.
translation: Nafasi katika maeneo maarufu zaidi, kama vile Bright Angel Campground karibu na Phantom Ranch, kwa jumla hujaa kwa maombi yanayopokewa siku ya kwanza yanapofunguliwa kwa uhifadhi.

text: Ve mavalua manini matiele maiitwe kwa ala ma kuthi ma mauu na kwa ala meuka ma mbee, kwa nzia ya ula wavika wa mbee niwe ukunengwa.
translation: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ve mavalua manini matiele maiitwe kwa ala ma kuthi ma mauu na kwa ala meuka ma mbee, kwa nzia ya ula wavika wa mbee niwe ukunengwa.
translation: Kuna idadi ndogo ya vibali zilizohifadhiwa kwa maombi ya papo hapo zinazopatikana kwa hali ya fika kwanza, hudumiwa kwanza.

text: Kulika Avilika ya itheo na ngali ni nzia nzeo ya kwona wanake wa kisio kyu na kuvika kula kwi nzia sya ndambuka kula atalii matavika muno.
translation: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Kulika Avilika ya itheo na ngali ni nzia nzeo ya kwona wanake wa kisio kyu na kuvika kula kwi nzia sya ndambuka kula atalii matavika muno.
translation: Kuingia Afrika Kusini kwa gari ni njia ya ajabu ya kuona uzuri wote wa eneo vilevile kufika mahali kusiko katika njia za kawaida za watalii.

text: Undu uu nowikwe kwa ngali ya kawaita uvangite nesa ateo 4x4 vendaa na kundu kwingi kuendeka na ndia nthanthau sya 4x4.
translation: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Undu uu nowikwe kwa ngali ya kawaita uvangite nesa ateo 4x4 vendaa na kundu kwingi kuendeka na ndia nthanthau sya 4x4.
translation: Hii inaweza kufanywa kwenye gari la kawaida kwa mipango makini lakini inapendekezwa sana gari la 4 kwa 4 na sehemu nyingi zinaweza kufikika tu kwa gari la 4 kwa 4 lenye magurudumu mapana.

text: Ikia kilikoni kana kuvanga ateo Avilika ya itheoni ni ndumu na nthi ila mutui ti ndumu.
translation: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Ikia kilikoni kana kuvanga ateo Avilika ya itheoni ni ndumu na nthi ila mutui ti ndumu.
translation: Zingatia wakati wa kupanga kwamba ingawa Kaskazini mwa Afrika ni imara si nchi zote jirani zilizo imara.

text: Syĩndũ ila syendekanaa nĩ kaa mũndũ anewe mathangũ ma ũlika nthĩ ĩngĩ na mbesa sya'ũmaĩvĩa syĩthĩawa kĩvathũkanyo kwĩanana na nthĩ ĩla ĩkũĩnengane na kwĩanana na nthĩ ĩla uumĩte.
translation: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Syĩndũ ila syendekanaa nĩ kaa mũndũ anewe mathangũ ma ũlika nthĩ ĩngĩ na mbesa sya'ũmaĩvĩa syĩthĩawa kĩvathũkanyo kwĩanana na nthĩ ĩla ĩkũĩnengane na kwĩanana na nthĩ ĩla uumĩte.
translation: Mahitaji na gharama ya visa hutofautiana toka nchi hadi nchi na huathiriwa na nchini unakotoka.

text: Kĩla nthĩ nĩyĩthaa na mĩao yayo mbene ĩla yĩwetete nĩkyaũ kyaĩle kwĩtha ngalĩnĩ kya mĩtũkĩ.
translation: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Kĩla nthĩ nĩyĩthaa na mĩao yayo mbene ĩla yĩwetete nĩkyaũ kyaĩle kwĩtha ngalĩnĩ kya mĩtũkĩ.
translation: Kila nchi pia ina sheria za kipekee zinazotaja ni vifaa vipi vya dharura unavyohitaji kuwa navyo garini mwako.

text: Tauni ya Victoria Falls ngaliko ya westani ilembetani ya Zimbabwe kukilanilya muvaka kuma Livingstone, Zambia, na vakuvi na Botswana.
translation: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Tauni ya Victoria Falls ngaliko ya westani ilembetani ya Zimbabwe kukilanilya muvaka kuma Livingstone, Zambia, na vakuvi na Botswana.
translation: Victoria Falls ni mji ulioko katika sehemu ya magharibi mwa Zimbabwe, kuvuka mpaka kutoka Livingstone, ya Zambia, na karibu na Botswana.

text: Soko usu wi vakuvi na muvaluko usu wa kiw'u, na ni ukusyo munene, indi kikusyo kii kya atalii kinenganae myanya mingi kwa andu ala mekwenda kusisya vamwe na ala meumantha syindu nzau.
translation: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Soko usu wi vakuvi na muvaluko usu wa kiw'u, na ni ukusyo munene, indi kikusyo kii kya atalii kinenganae myanya mingi kwa andu ala mekwenda kusisya vamwe na ala meumantha syindu nzau.
translation: Jiji liko mara moja karibu na maporomoko ya maji ambayo ndiyo kivutio kikuu, lakini sehemu hii maarufu ya watalii huwatolea wanaotafuta kusisimka na kutembea maeneo mbali mbali fursa ya kukaa kwa muda mrefu.

text: Ivindani ya mbua (mwei wa ikumi na umwe nginya wakatatu) kiwu kiithwa ki kingi na ndulumo syiithwa syi sya kwendeesya.
translation: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ivindani ya mbua (mwei wa ikumi na umwe nginya wakatatu) kiwu kiithwa ki kingi na ndulumo syiithwa syi sya kwendeesya.
translation: Katika msimu wa mvua (Novemba hadi Machi), kiasi cha maji kitakuwa cha juu na maporomoko ya maji yatakuwa ya fujo sana.

text: Wi muikithye kuthitha wakilanilya kiao kana watembea utee wa kula kiwu kiiyikya.
translation: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Wi muikithye kuthitha wakilanilya kiao kana watembea utee wa kula kiwu kiiyikya.
translation: Umehakikishiwa kupata unyevunyevu ukiweza kuvuka daraja ama kutembea kando ya njia zinazozunguka karibu na Maporomoko.

text: Ona oou, ni kwoondũ ndwiona nesa kula kiwũ kĩkwĩnyĩkya nũndũ ni kĩngi.
translation: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Ona oou, ni kwoondũ ndwiona nesa kula kiwũ kĩkwĩnyĩkya nũndũ ni kĩngi.
translation: Kwa upande mwingine, ni kwa sababu kiwango cha maji hususan ni kikubwa sana hivi kwamba mtazamo wako wa Maporomoko halisi ya Maji utazuiliwa – na maji yote!

text: Kavuli ka Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 no itonye ithwa noko kavuli ke nguma kiimani kiu, sini ya kumanya ya Howard ya 1922 ya Cartel ya mathiko mavange nesa ma.
translation: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kavuli ka Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 no itonye ithwa noko kavuli ke nguma kiimani kiu, sini ya kumanya ya Howard ya 1922 ya Cartel ya mathiko mavange nesa ma.
translation: Kaburi la Tutankhamun (KV62). Huenda KV62 ndilo kaburi maarufu zaidi katika Bonde, eneo la ugunduzi wa Howard Carter wa mazishi salama ya kifalme ya mfalme mchanga mnamo 1922.

text: Walingany'a na tũvũlĩ twa ndongoĩ sya ũsũmbĩ, o na kaũ, kavũlĩ ka Tũtankhamũn vaĩ aja ya kũkatembelea, nũndũ nĩ kanĩĩnĩ na tĩ kanake ta tũvũlĩ tũla tũngĩ.
translation: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Walingany'a na tũvũlĩ twa ndongoĩ sya ũsũmbĩ, o na kaũ, kavũlĩ ka Tũtankhamũn vaĩ aja ya kũkatembelea, nũndũ nĩ kanĩĩnĩ na tĩ kanake ta tũvũlĩ tũla tũngĩ.
translation: Ikilinganishwa na makaburi mengine mengi ya kifalme, hata hivyo, kaburi la Tutankhamun halistahili sana kutembelewa, ni dogo sana na lina mapambo machache.

text: Ula ukwenda kwona undu kimba kii kyanangitwe ila andu meenda kukiumya isandukuni ndeona nundu no mutwe na ituo syonekee.
translation: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Ula ukwenda kwona undu kimba kii kyanangitwe ila andu meenda kukiumya isandukuni ndeona nundu no mutwe na ituo syonekee.
translation: Mtu yeyote aliye na shauku ya kuona ushahidi wa uharibifu uliofanyiwa maiti ya kale wakati wa kujaribu kuitoa kutoka kwa jeneza atasikitika kuwa ni kichwa na mabega tu zinazoonekana

text: Mothwii asu manee ma kavuli kau maivo ingi, indi nimavetetwe makatwawa isumbani ya kusuvia syindu sya tene ku misili.
translation: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Mothwii asu manee ma kavuli kau maivo ingi, indi nimavetetwe makatwawa isumbani ya kusuvia syindu sya tene ku misili.
translation: Utajiri mwingi wa kaburi haupo tena ndani yake, ila umepelekwa katika Jumba la Makumbusho la Misri huko Kairo.

text: Aeni mena ivinda inini nimo methwa me vaseo kutumia ivinda yoo me vandu vangi.
translation: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Aeni mena ivinda inini nimo methwa me vaseo kutumia ivinda yoo me vandu vangi.
translation: Ni bora wageni wasiokuwa na muda mrefu kutumia muda wao mahali pengine.

text: Phnom Krom ila yi kilomita 12 ngaliko ya itheo ya umilo wa sua ya Siem Reap. Ikalu yii yi iulu wa kiima yaakiwe mwiso wa myaka ya 900 ivinda ya Musumbi Yasovarman.
translation: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Phnom Krom ila yi kilomita 12 ngaliko ya itheo ya umilo wa sua ya Siem Reap. Ikalu yii yi iulu wa kiima yaakiwe mwiso wa myaka ya 900 ivinda ya Musumbi Yasovarman.
translation: Phnom Krom, kilomita 12 kusini magharibi mwa Siem Reap. Hekalu hili la kilimani lilijengwa mwishoni mwa karne ya 9, wakati wa utawala wa Mfalme Yasovarman.

text: Nzeve ii ya kimako ya ikalu na kwona iulu wa iia ya Tonle Sap nitumaa kulisa kiima kwithwa kwi na useo wakw'o.
translation: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Nzeve ii ya kimako ya ikalu na kwona iulu wa iia ya Tonle Sap nitumaa kulisa kiima kwithwa kwi na useo wakw'o.
translation: Mazingira yenye huzuni ya hekalu na mwonekano wa ziwa la Tonle Sap ulifanya ukweaji kilima kuwa wa maana.

text: Kũtembea kuthi vandu vau nokũkwatanĩw'e nesa vyũ na kyalo kya ĩtalũ kya kũthi ĩianĩ.
translation: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Kũtembea kuthi vandu vau nokũkwatanĩw'e nesa vyũ na kyalo kya ĩtalũ kya kũthi ĩianĩ.
translation: Ziara katika eneo hilo inaweza kujumuishwa kwa urahisi na safari ya ziwa katika boti.

text: Pass ya Angkor niyendekaa nikenda ulike ikaluni kwoou ndukolwe ni kuka na pasipoti yaku ila uelekele Tonle Sap.
translation: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Pass ya Angkor niyendekaa nikenda ulike ikaluni kwoou ndukolwe ni kuka na pasipoti yaku ila uelekele Tonle Sap.
translation: Kibali cha Angkor kinahitajika ili kuingia katika hekalu kwa hivyo usisahau kubeba pasipoti yako unapoelekea Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalemu niw'o musyi munene wa Isilaeli, o na kau nthi ingi mbingi na Ngwatanio ya Nthi ndimy'osaa taw'o musyi munene wa Isilaeli.
translation: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Yerusalemu niw'o musyi munene wa Isilaeli, o na kau nthi ingi mbingi na Ngwatanio ya Nthi ndimy'osaa taw'o musyi munene wa Isilaeli.
translation: Yerusalemu ni mji mkuu na mkubwa zaidi wa Israeli, ijapokuwa nchi nyingine nyingi na Umoja wa Mataifa haziutambui kama mji mkuu wa Israeli.

text: Musyi munene wa tene kuu iĩmani sya Judea withwa na istoli yi muyo ikwete kuma myaka makili mithelu.
translation: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Musyi munene wa tene kuu iĩmani sya Judea withwa na istoli yi muyo ikwete kuma myaka makili mithelu.
translation: Mji wa kale katika Vilima vya Judea una historia ya kusisimua ya maelfu ya miaka.

text: Musyi usu munene ni muthesye nundu wa ndni ila sya uthaitha Ngai umwe - Ya Ayuti, Kikilisito na Kiisilamu, na ithiaa ta kati kati ya maundu ma ki veva, ndini, na syithio.
translation: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Musyi usu munene ni muthesye nundu wa ndni ila sya uthaitha Ngai umwe - Ya Ayuti, Kikilisito na Kiisilamu, na ithiaa ta kati kati ya maundu ma ki veva, ndini, na syithio.
translation: Mji ni mtakatifu kwa dini tatu zinazomwamini Mungu mmoja - Dini ya Kiyahudi, Ukristo na Uislamu, na hutumika kama kituo cha kiroho, kidini, na kitamaduni.

text: Nũndũ wa ũ vata wa kĩ ndĩni wa mũsyĩ ũsu mũnene, na mũno mũno kũndũ kwingĩ kwa kwĩloela nthĩnĩ wa ngalĩko ngũũ ya mũsyĩ ũsu, Yelũsalemu nĩ ĩmwe katĩ wa kũndũ kwa kwendwa nĩ atalii Ĩsilaeli.
translation: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Nũndũ wa ũ vata wa kĩ ndĩni wa mũsyĩ ũsu mũnene, na mũno mũno kũndũ kwingĩ kwa kwĩloela nthĩnĩ wa ngalĩko ngũũ ya mũsyĩ ũsu, Yelũsalemu nĩ ĩmwe katĩ wa kũndũ kwa kwendwa nĩ atalii Ĩsilaeli.
translation: Kwa sababu ya umuhimu wa kidini wa mji huo, na hususan sehemu nyingi za maeneo ya Mji wa Zamani, Yerusalemu ni mojawapo ya sehemu kuu zinazowavutia watalii nchini Israeli.

text: Yelusaleme yi kundu kwingi kwa isitolia, kwa kwinza na kwa kithio, vamwe na isese sya utandithya ithengeanie vamwe na sya kwendeesya, kundu kwa kuiia, na kundu kwa kwitanithya.
translation: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Yelusaleme yi kundu kwingi kwa isitolia, kwa kwinza na kwa kithio, vamwe na isese sya utandithya ithengeanie vamwe na sya kwendeesya, kundu kwa kuiia, na kundu kwa kwitanithya.
translation: Yerusalemu ina sehemu nyingi za kihistoria, akiolojia na kitamaduni, pamoja na vituo vya ununuzi, mahoteli na migahawa mahariri na iliyojaa.

text: Ecuador yienda eene nthi ma Cuba matumiwe valua mbee wa matanalika Ecuador kwisila iwanza sya ndeke sya nthi yonthe kana kwitikilithwa kwa voindi.
translation: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Ecuador yienda eene nthi ma Cuba matumiwe valua mbee wa matanalika Ecuador kwisila iwanza sya ndeke sya nthi yonthe kana kwitikilithwa kwa voindi.
translation: Ekuado inahitaji kwamba raia wa Cuba wapate barua ya mwaliko kabla ya kuingia Ekuado kupitia viwanja vya ndege vya kimataifa ama vituo vya uandikishaji kwenye mipaka.

text: Valua uu niwaile kwitikilw'a ni muvea ma maundu manza ma Ecuador, na uyiatiia miao kauta.
translation: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Valua uu niwaile kwitikilw'a ni muvea ma maundu manza ma Ecuador, na uyiatiia miao kauta.
translation: Barua hii ni lazima ihalalishwe na Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Kiekwado, na itimize mahitaji fulani.

text: Maundu aa methwaa maseuvitw'e ni kenda withie kuthama ni laisi kati ka nthi syeli.
translation: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Maundu aa methwaa maseuvitw'e ni kenda withie kuthama ni laisi kati ka nthi syeli.
translation: Mahitaji haya yameandaliwa ili kutoa uhamiaji ulioandaliwa kati ya nchi zote mbili.

text: Eene nthi ma Cuba ala mena kaati sya ngilini maile uthokea uvisi wa Ecuador nikenda mavetangwe kwa iseeso yii.
translation: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Eene nthi ma Cuba ala mena kaati sya ngilini maile uthokea uvisi wa Ecuador nikenda mavetangwe kwa iseeso yii.
translation: Wananchi wa Kuba ambao wana kadi ya kijani ya Marekani, wanaweza kutembelea ubalozi wa Ekuado ili kusamehewa hitaji hili.

text: Pasipoti yitu no nginya yithwe yi mbitikilithye kwa mwei thanthatu kuvika matuku maku ma kutembea. Ndambuka ya kuthi na mbee niyendekaa kwonany'a ivinda ila ukwikala undu yiasavite.
translation: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Pasipoti yitu no nginya yithwe yi mbitikilithye kwa mwei thanthatu kuvika matuku maku ma kutembea. Ndambuka ya kuthi na mbee niyendekaa kwonany'a ivinda ila ukwikala undu yiasavite.
translation: Pasipoti yako lazima iwe halali kwa angalau miezi 6 zaidi ya tarehe zako za kusafiri. Tikiti ya safari ya kwenda na kurudi/kuendelea inahitajika ili kudhibitisha urefu wa kukaa kwako.

text: Savali sya andũ aingi ni mbesa nini, kwooũ ketha wi weka kana wina mũnyanyaũ, tata ũmanthe andũ angi mũseovye kikũndi kya andũ ana kana thanthatũ ni kenda mũive mbesa nini.
translation: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Savali sya andũ aingi ni mbesa nini, kwooũ ketha wi weka kana wina mũnyanyaũ, tata ũmanthe andũ angi mũseovye kikũndi kya andũ ana kana thanthatũ ni kenda mũive mbesa nini.
translation: Ziara huwa bei nafuu kwa vikundi vikubwa, kwa hivyo kama uko peke yako au na rafiki mmoja tu, jaribu kukutana na watu wengine na kuunda kikundi cha watu wanne hadi sita kwa bei bora kwa mtu mmoja.

text: O va ilye uu, undu ndwaile ema ukuthiny'a, nundu mavinda maingi atalii nimakuanaw'a nikenda maususye ngali.
translation: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: O va ilye uu, undu ndwaile ema ukuthiny'a, nundu mavinda maingi atalii nimakuanaw'a nikenda maususye ngali.
translation: Hata hivyo, kwa kweli hii haifai kukosa kukupa wasiwasi, kwa sababu mara nyingi watalii huchanganywachanganywa ili kuyajaza magari.

text: yĩĩlye mũno ta nzĩa ya kũkenga andũ kũĩkĩĩa kana maĩlũ kũĩva mũnango.
translation: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: yĩĩlye mũno ta nzĩa ya kũkenga andũ kũĩkĩĩa kana maĩlũ kũĩva mũnango.
translation: Inaonekana kweli kuwa njia zaidi ya kuwadanganya watu kuamini wanapaswa kulipa zaidi

text: Yi kuu matuni ngali ya yiuluni ya Machu Picchu ni kiima kii kivauuku muno, kaingi kyumilaa visani sya matialy'o asu.
translation: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Yi kuu matuni ngali ya yiuluni ya Machu Picchu ni kiima kii kivauuku muno, kaingi kyumilaa visani sya matialy'o asu.
translation: Juu ya mwisho wa kaskazini mwa Machu Picchu ni mlima ulio na mwinuko, mara nyingi ni uwanja wa nyuma wa picha nyingi za magofu.

text: Ĩilye ta yaũkĩsya kuma vau nthĩ, na nĩ mwambato mũũngamu na mũmũ mũno, ĩndĩ andũ ala me mĩĩ ĩtaĩ mathĩna no matonye ũlĩsa nthĩnĩ wa ndatĩka ta 45.
translation: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Ĩilye ta yaũkĩsya kuma vau nthĩ, na nĩ mwambato mũũngamu na mũmũ mũno, ĩndĩ andũ ala me mĩĩ ĩtaĩ mathĩna no matonye ũlĩsa nthĩnĩ wa ndatĩka ta 45.
translation: Inaonekana kutisha kutoka chini, na ni mwinuko mkali na mgumu, lakini watu wanaokusudiwa kuwa na hali nzuri ya mwili wanapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kuupanda kwa dakika kama 45.

text: Sĩtevu sya mavia niseũvĩtw'e vakũvĩ kĩla kasĩlanĩ, na kũla kũtheeũ kwĩna kũndũ kwa kwĩkwatĩla kũseũvĩtw'e na waya wa kyũma.
translation: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Sĩtevu sya mavia niseũvĩtw'e vakũvĩ kĩla kasĩlanĩ, na kũla kũtheeũ kwĩna kũndũ kwa kwĩkwatĩla kũseũvĩtw'e na waya wa kyũma.
translation: Hatua za mawe zimewekwa kando ya idadi kubwa ya vijia, na katika sehemu za mteremko nyaya za chuma hutoa reli za kushikiliwa inayounga mikono.

text: Usu wi o vo, eteela kuemwa ni kuveva, isuvie isio syi itheeo muno muno ila syina kimeu nundu no kwithwe na muisyo mituki.
translation: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Usu wi o vo, eteela kuemwa ni kuveva, isuvie isio syi itheeo muno muno ila syina kimeu nundu no kwithwe na muisyo mituki.
translation: Hilo likiwa limesemwa, tarajia kuishiwa na pumzi, na kuwa mwangalifu katika sehemu zenye mwinuko mno, haswa wakati wa unyevunyevu, kwa sababu inaweza kuwa hatari haraka.

text: Ve ngunga nini vakuvĩ na ĩũlũ ĩla no mbika yĩsĩlwe katĩ katĩ wamy'o, yĩ nthĩ mũno na ya ũvivilwa vyũ.
translation: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Ve ngunga nini vakuvĩ na ĩũlũ ĩla no mbika yĩsĩlwe katĩ katĩ wamy'o, yĩ nthĩ mũno na ya ũvivilwa vyũ.
translation: Kuna pango ndogo karibu na juu ambalo lazima lipitwe, liko chini kabisa na la kubana sana.

text: Kwona kundu na nyamu sya kithekani sya Galapagos kwikawa nesa italuni, o ta undu Charles Darwin wekie mwakani wa 1835.
translation: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Kwona kundu na nyamu sya kithekani sya Galapagos kwikawa nesa italuni, o ta undu Charles Darwin wekie mwakani wa 1835.
translation: Kuona mandhari na wanyamapori wa Galapagos hufanywa vizuri kwa boti, kama vile Charles Darwin alivyofanya mnamo 1835.

text: Masiwa mavitite 60 nimesilaa nzia ya kiwuni ya Galapagos ila yi unene wa kuma akua 8 nginya 100.
translation: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Masiwa mavitite 60 nimesilaa nzia ya kiwuni ya Galapagos ila yi unene wa kuma akua 8 nginya 100.
translation: Zaidi ya meli 60 za kifahari husafiri kwenye maji ya Galapagos - zikiwa zenye saizi ya abiria 8 hadi 100.

text: andu aingi mayivaa uthei woo tene tene matuko matanamba uvika (nundu masiwa methaa mausuite ivinda ya mbesa).
translation: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: andu aingi mayivaa uthei woo tene tene matuko matanamba uvika (nundu masiwa methaa mausuite ivinda ya mbesa).
translation: Watu wengi huhifadhi nafasi zao mapema sana (kwani kwa kawaida boti hizo hujaa wakati wa msimu wenye shughuli nyingi).

text: Sisya kana muungamii ula ukuiva kwisila kwake ni mundu ueleetwe na kusomea maundu ma Galapagos wina umanyi museo wa meli syi kivathukany'o.
translation: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Sisya kana muungamii ula ukuiva kwisila kwake ni mundu ueleetwe na kusomea maundu ma Galapagos wina umanyi museo wa meli syi kivathukany'o.
translation: Hakikisha kwamba wakala unayetumia kupata uhifadhi ni mtaalamu wa Galapagos aliye na maarifa mengi ya aina tofauti tofauti za meli.

text: Ũu wikiithya kana wendi waku fulani na/kana unyivu niweananithw'a na isiwa ila yimaile.
translation: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Ũu wikiithya kana wendi waku fulani na/kana unyivu niweananithw'a na isiwa ila yimaile.
translation: Hii itahakikisha kwamba masilahi na/au vizuizi vyako vinalingana na meli inayowafaa zaidi.

text: Mbee ya Spanish mavike twi sengyali ya 16, ngaliko ya iulu ya Chile yai ungu wa utongoi wa Inca o ila eene nthi ma Araucanian (Mapuche) matuie kati kati na ngaliko ya iulu ya Chile.
translation: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mbee ya Spanish mavike twi sengyali ya 16, ngaliko ya iulu ya Chile yai ungu wa utongoi wa Inca o ila eene nthi ma Araucanian (Mapuche) matuie kati kati na ngaliko ya iulu ya Chile.
translation: Kabla ya Wahispania kuwasili katika karne ya 16, Chile kaskazini ilikuwa chini ya utawala wa Inca huku wenyeji Waarauka (Mapuche) wakiishi Chile ya kati na kaskazini.

text: Mapũche maĩ amwe katĩ wa ĩkũndĩ ĩla nĩnĩ sya Amelika syeyĩũngamĩe, ĩla syitalikitwe ũnenĩnĩ wa Spanish muvaka ila chĩle yakwatie wĩyathĩ.
translation: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Mapũche maĩ amwe katĩ wa ĩkũndĩ ĩla nĩnĩ sya Amelika syeyĩũngamĩe, ĩla syitalikitwe ũnenĩnĩ wa Spanish muvaka ila chĩle yakwatie wĩyathĩ.
translation: Mapuche pia walikuwa mojawapo ya vikundi huru asilia vya Marekani, ambavyo havikuzama kabisa katika sheria ya Kihispania hadi baada ya uhuru wa Chile.

text: Ona kutw'ika Chile yatangaasie kwisumbika mwaka wa 1810 katikati wa makau ma Napoleon ala matiie Spain itena silikali nene ikuthukuma myaka kauta, usindi wi kavaa iulu wa asungu ma Spain ndwaa ithiwa nginya 1818.
translation: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Ona kutw'ika Chile yatangaasie kwisumbika mwaka wa 1810 katikati wa makau ma Napoleon ala matiie Spain itena silikali nene ikuthukuma myaka kauta, usindi wi kavaa iulu wa asungu ma Spain ndwaa ithiwa nginya 1818.
translation: Ingawa Chile ilitangaza uhuru mnamo 1810 (katikati mwa vita vya Kinapoleoni ambavyo viliacha Uspanya bila serikali kuu thabiti kwa miaka kadhaa), ushindi kamili dhidi ya Uspanya haukufikiwa hadi 1818.

text: Republic ya Dominican (spanish: republica Dominicana) ni nthi ya caribbean ila yitiawa nusu umuloni wa sua na kithama kya hispaniola, kila kithiiwa vamwe na Haiti.
translation: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Republic ya Dominican (spanish: republica Dominicana) ni nthi ya caribbean ila yitiawa nusu umuloni wa sua na kithama kya hispaniola, kila kithiiwa vamwe na Haiti.
translation: Jamhuri ya Dominika (Kihispania: Republica Dominicana) ni nchi ya Karibi ambayo imechukua nusu ya kisiwa cha Hispaniola, ambacho inashirikisha na Haiti.

text: Eka o nthangathĩ ila syĩ ndee wa ũkanga na syiima, nthi isũ ni mũsyi wa ndua ila nguu muno vyu ya Europe nthini wa Amelicas, ila yu ni kilungu kimwi kya Domingo.
translation: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Eka o nthangathĩ ila syĩ ndee wa ũkanga na syiima, nthi isũ ni mũsyi wa ndua ila nguu muno vyu ya Europe nthini wa Amelicas, ila yu ni kilungu kimwi kya Domingo.
translation: Kando na pwani zenye mchanga mweupe na mandhari ya milima, nchi hiyo ni nyumbani mwa mji wa zamani zaidi wa Kiingereza katika Amerika, ukiwa sasa sehemu ya Santo Domingo.

text: Kithama kyu kyambite ikalwa ni Tainos na Caribes. Namo Caribes mai andu maneenaa kithyomo kya Arawaka ala mavikite vandu 10,000 BCE.
translation: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Kithama kyu kyambite ikalwa ni Tainos na Caribes. Namo Caribes mai andu maneenaa kithyomo kya Arawaka ala mavikite vandu 10,000 BCE.
translation: Wenyeji wa kwanza wa kisiwa walikuwa Wataino na Wakaribi. Wakaribi walikuwa watu wenye kuongea lugha ya Arakwan waliokuwa wamefika takribani mwaka wa 10,000 BCE.

text: Myaka minini itina wa akunikili kuma Europe kuvika, utalo wa andu ma Tainos ni woleketwe muno ni andu ma Spain ala mamakĩlilye vinya.
translation: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Myaka minini itina wa akunikili kuma Europe kuvika, utalo wa andu ma Tainos ni woleketwe muno ni andu ma Spain ala mamakĩlilye vinya.
translation: Kwa kipindi cha miaka michache mifupi kufuatia kuwasili kwa wavumbuzi wa Ulaya, idadi ya watu ya Tainos ilikuwa imepunguzwa sana na washindi wa Kihispania.

text: Kwianana na Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indians) kati wa 1492 na 1498 ala mavivukiie Spanish mooaie andu ta 100,000 ma muvai wa Tainos.
translation: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Kwianana na Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indians) kati wa 1492 na 1498 ala mavivukiie Spanish mooaie andu ta 100,000 ma muvai wa Tainos.
translation: Kulingana na Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) kati ya 1492 na 1498 washindi wa Kispanya waliwaua takribani Wataino 100,000.

text: Jardin de la Union. Yanya yii yaakiwe ta atrium ya wiw'ano wa sengyali ya 17, o vala Templo de San Diego niw'o mwako ula utiítwe.
translation: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Jardin de la Union. Yanya yii yaakiwe ta atrium ya wiw'ano wa sengyali ya 17, o vala Templo de San Diego niw'o mwako ula utiítwe.
translation: Jardin de la Union. Nafasi hii ilijengwa kama nyumba ya watawa ya karne ya 17, ambapo Templo de San Diego ndilo jengo pekee lililopo sasa.

text: Yũ nĩyo ĩtũmĩkaa ta mwako wa katĩ, na vethaa ve maũndũ maingĩ maendee vo, mũthenya na ũtũkũ.
translation: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Yũ nĩyo ĩtũmĩkaa ta mwako wa katĩ, na vethaa ve maũndũ maingĩ maendee vo, mũthenya na ũtũkũ.
translation: Sasa inafanya kazi kama magulio ya kati, na daima ina mambo mengi yanayoendelea, mchana na usiku.

text: Ve mikaawa mingi ithyuukite muunda usu, na muthenya na maiyoo nikwithiawa mathau ma mbathi na angi ta asu nthini wa vandu va uthumua vau nza.
translation: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Ve mikaawa mingi ithyuukite muunda usu, na muthenya na maiyoo nikwithiawa mathau ma mbathi na angi ta asu nthini wa vandu va uthumua vau nza.
translation: Kuna mikahawa kadhaa inayozunguka bustani, na katika nyakati za adhuhuri na jioni maonyesho ya bure hufanywa huko katika gazebo iliyo katikati.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the kĩss). Mĩamba ĩlĩ ĩtĩlanĩtwe nĩ kĩthĩmo kya 69cm nĩw'o mũsyĩ mũkũũ wa wendo.
translation: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the kĩss). Mĩamba ĩlĩ ĩtĩlanĩtwe nĩ kĩthĩmo kya 69cm nĩw'o mũsyĩ mũkũũ wa wendo.
translation: Callejon del Beso (Kichochoro cha busu). Roshani mbili zilizotengwa na sentimita 69 tu ni nyumba ya shujaa mkongwe wa mapenzi.

text: Umanengete o mbesa nini syana imwe siutavya I ngewa.
translation: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Umanengete o mbesa nini syana imwe siutavya I ngewa.
