text: kĩthũkũma kya Bowen nĩvaendawa mũno kwa syalo sya mũthenya kana wĩkendĩ nũndũ nĩkwĩthaa kũtwaa masĩwa, kũtembea, ndũka, kũndũ kwa kũthũmũa na ĩngĩ mbĩngĩ.
translation: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: kĩthũkũma kya Bowen nĩvaendawa mũno kwa syalo sya mũthenya kana wĩkendĩ nũndũ nĩkwĩthaa kũtwaa masĩwa, kũtembea, ndũka, kũndũ kwa kũthũmũa na ĩngĩ mbĩngĩ.
translation: Kisiwa cha Bowen ni maarufu kwa safari ya mchana ama safari ya wikendi na inatoa safari za kayaki, matembezi, maduka, migahawa, na nyinginezo.

text: Njamii nzeo yi Howe Sound o wavita Vancouver, na no umikwate kwisila taxi sya kuvanga ila ukuma kithama kya Granville kuu nza wa taoni ya Vancouver.
translation: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Njamii nzeo yi Howe Sound o wavita Vancouver, na no umikwate kwisila taxi sya kuvanga ila ukuma kithama kya Granville kuu nza wa taoni ya Vancouver.
translation: Jamii hii halisi iko katika Howe Sound nje ya Vancouver, na inafikiwa kwa urahisi kupitia teksi za majini zilizoratibiwa zinazoondoka Kisiwa cha Granville katika Vancouver ya chini.

text: Kwa ala mendete maseso ma nza no matembee o mbola ukangani uelekele kula kumililaa yayaya.
translation: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Kwa ala mendete maseso ma nza no matembee o mbola ukangani uelekele kula kumililaa yayaya.
translation: Kwa wale ambao hufurahia shughuli za nje, matembezi kwenye korido toka Baharini hadi Angani ni muhimu.

text: (Kũtwaa ngalĩ ĩsaa nyĩmwe na nũsũ kũma Vancouver) n kwa mbesa mbĩngĩ lakĩnĩ n vesĩkĩe nũndũ wa mathaũ ma mwaka wa 2010 ma ĩvĩndanĩ ya ũthĩthũ.
translation: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: (Kũtwaa ngalĩ ĩsaa nyĩmwe na nũsũ kũma Vancouver) n kwa mbesa mbĩngĩ lakĩnĩ n vesĩkĩe nũndũ wa mathaũ ma mwaka wa 2010 ma ĩvĩndanĩ ya ũthĩthũ.
translation: Whistler (mwendo wa saa 1.5 kutoka Vancouver) ni pa bei ghali lakini panajulikana kwa sababu ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi ya 2010.

text: Siũũka ĩanĩ North America ivinda ya uthithũ na uilisa syima na isulũlũ ivinda ya sua.
translation: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Siũũka ĩanĩ North America ivinda ya uthithũ na uilisa syima na isulũlũ ivinda ya sua.
translation: Katika msimu wa baridi, furahia baadhi ya utelezaji mzuri wa Marekani Kaskazini na katika msimu wa joto jaribu uendeshaji baiskeli halisi milimani.

text: Valua syailwe ni kulisaviwa tene. Wailwe ni kwithwa na valua ni kenda wikale wiyoo wonthe vaa Sirena.
translation: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Valua syailwe ni kulisaviwa tene. Wailwe ni kwithwa na valua ni kenda wikale wiyoo wonthe vaa Sirena.
translation: Ni lazima vibali vihifadhiwe mapema. Lazima uwe na kibali ili kukaa usiku kucha.

text: Sirena nivo vandũ va asyĩmi voka vanenganae kũndũ kwa ũkoma na lĩu mũvyũ ĩũlũ wa kambĩ. La Leona, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos sinenganae o kambĩ vataĩ lĩu.
translation: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Sirena nivo vandũ va asyĩmi voka vanenganae kũndũ kwa ũkoma na lĩu mũvyũ ĩũlũ wa kambĩ. La Leona, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos sinenganae o kambĩ vataĩ lĩu.
translation: Sirena ndicho kituo pekee cha walinzi ambacho hutoa malazi ya bweni na vyakula moto pamoja na kambi. La Leona, San Pedrillo, na Los Patos hutoa kambi bila huduma ya chakula.

text: Ni vatonyeka ukakwata valua imwe kwa imwe kuma Ranger Station kuu Puerto Jimenez, ateo mayitikilaa kaati.
translation: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Ni vatonyeka ukakwata valua imwe kwa imwe kuma Ranger Station kuu Puerto Jimenez, ateo mayitikilaa kaati.
translation: Inawezekana kupata vibali vya mbuga moja kwa moja kutoka kwa Kituo cha Walinzi katika Puerto Jimerez, lakini hawakubali kadi za deni.

text: Wia wa kupark (MINAE) ndunenganae mwanya wa parking nthini wa ivinda yiasa ya mwei umwe mbeangeni ivinda ya kuvika.
translation: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Wia wa kupark (MINAE) ndunenganae mwanya wa parking nthini wa ivinda yiasa ya mwei umwe mbeangeni ivinda ya kuvika.
translation: Huduma ya Mbuga (MINAE) haitoi vibali vya zaidi ya mwezi mmoja kabla ya kutarajiwa kwa kuwasili.

text: CafeNet El Sol niyithwaa na kumbuku kwa tene na mbesa sya Amelika ndola 30, kana ndola ikumi kwa muthenya umwe; ve livoti mbeange ithanguni yoo.
translation: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: CafeNet El Sol niyithwaa na kumbuku kwa tene na mbesa sya Amelika ndola 30, kana ndola ikumi kwa muthenya umwe; ve livoti mbeange ithanguni yoo.
translation: CafeNet El Sol hutoa huduma ya kuhifadhi kwa ada ya dola 30 za Kimarekani na pasi za siku moja kwa dola 10 za kimarekani; maelezo kwenye ukurasa wao wa Corcovado.

text: Cook Island ni nthi yi kati kati wa kiw'u ina ngwatanio na New Zealand, yi nthini wa Polynesia, kati kati wa itheo ya Pacific ocean.
translation: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Cook Island ni nthi yi kati kati wa kiw'u ina ngwatanio na New Zealand, yi nthini wa Polynesia, kati kati wa itheo ya Pacific ocean.
translation: Visiwa vya Cook ni nchi ya kisiwa katika ushirika huru na Nyuzilandi, iliyoko Polynesia, katikati mwa Bahari la Pasifiki ya Kusini.

text: Ni archipelago vala ve ithama 15 syaanikite kuvita milioni 2.2 km2 mbaalini.
translation: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ni archipelago vala ve ithama 15 syaanikite kuvita milioni 2.2 km2 mbaalini.
translation: Ni funguvisiwa lililo na visiwa 15 vilivyoenea zaidi ya mraba wa kilometa milioni 2.2 ya bahari.

text: Syina ivinda yimwe ya masaa ta Hawaii, nthi isu syi kati kati wa kiw'u mavinda angi isuaniawa ta "Hawaii nthi y'uungu".
translation: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Syina ivinda yimwe ya masaa ta Hawaii, nthi isu syi kati kati wa kiw'u mavinda angi isuaniawa ta "Hawaii nthi y'uungu".
translation: Vikiwa katika eneo la saa sawa na Hawaii, wakati mwingine visiwa hivyo hufikiriwa kuwa "Hawaii ya chini kwa chini".

text: Ateo nĩ nini, ililikanasya atalii amwe akũũ kuma Hawaii mbeangenĩ wa nthĩ vate mĩkaawa mĩnene ya atalii na maendeeo angĩ.
translation: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Ateo nĩ nini, ililikanasya atalii amwe akũũ kuma Hawaii mbeangenĩ wa nthĩ vate mĩkaawa mĩnene ya atalii na maendeeo angĩ.
translation: Ingawa kidogo, huwakumbusha baadhi ya wageni wakongwe wa Hawaii wakati kabla ya utaifa bila mikahawa yote mikubwa ya watalii na maendeleo mengine.

text: Ithama sya Cook iyingwa mĩsyĩ mĩnene ateo syĩna ithama 15 kĩvathũkany'o. ĩla nene nĩ Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
translation: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ithama sya Cook iyingwa mĩsyĩ mĩnene ateo syĩna ithama 15 kĩvathũkany'o. ĩla nene nĩ Rarotonga na Aitutaki.
translation: Visiwa vya Cook havina miji yoyoyte lakini vinajumuisha visiwa 15 tofauti. Vikuu kati yazo ni Rarotonga na Aitutaki.

text: Kwa nthĩ ila syendee nesa ũmũnthĩ, kuseuvya kitanda kya deluxe na lĩũ wa kwakya kũtwĩkĩthĩtw'e muthemba wa ati.
translation: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kwa nthĩ ila syendee nesa ũmũnthĩ, kuseuvya kitanda kya deluxe na lĩũ wa kwakya kũtwĩkĩthĩtw'e muthemba wa ati.
translation: Katika nchi zilizoendelea leo, kuandaa kitanda cha deluksi na kiamshakinywa imeimarishwa kwa aina fulani ya kisanaa.

text: Mwiso muthyani, B&Bs isindanaa nundu wa syindu ili: kukomani na mbrekifasti.
translation: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Mwiso muthyani, B&Bs isindanaa nundu wa syindu ili: kukomani na mbrekifasti.
translation: Mwishowe, ni wazi kwamba B&Bs hushindana haswa kwenye vitu viwili vikuu: matandiko na kiamsha kinywa.

text: O kwou, twi vandu vaseo uu mundu niwaile umantha syindu sya itanda ila sya mbesa mbingi, vatonyeka ivula ya utuma na moko kana kitanda kya tene.
translation: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: O kwou, twi vandu vaseo uu mundu niwaile umantha syindu sya itanda ila sya mbesa mbingi, vatonyeka ivula ya utuma na moko kana kitanda kya tene.
translation: Ipasavyo, katika bora zaidi ya vituo hivyo mtu anafaa kupata matandiko ya kistarehe zaidi, pengine firasha iliyotengenezwa kwa mkono au kitanda cha kizamani.

text: Kyauya kya kwakya no kithiwe na maliu ma ivindani ma vandu vau kana liu uuitwe nesa ni ula ukethetw'e.
translation: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Kyauya kya kwakya no kithiwe na maliu ma ivindani ma vandu vau kana liu uuitwe nesa ni ula ukethetw'e.
translation: Kiamsha kinywa kinaweza kujumuisha faraha za misimuwa kutoka katika eneo au mlo maalum ya mwenyeji.

text: Mwako ũu no ta wa nyũmba ngũu yiseovetwe ya nzia sya tene, nthi ni iseovetwe na yina vandũ va kũthambia.
translation: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Mwako ũu no ta wa nyũmba ngũu yiseovetwe ya nzia sya tene, nthi ni iseovetwe na yina vandũ va kũthambia.
translation: Kikao kinaweza kuwa kwenye jumba nzee la kihistoria lililo na vyombo vya kale, uwanja wenye nyasi zilizokatwa vizuri na bwawa la kuogelea.

text: kũlĩka ngalĩnĩ yakũ na kũthĩ kyalonĩ kĩasa kũnengaa mwĩndũ mwĩw'ĩle mũseo.
translation: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: kũlĩka ngalĩnĩ yakũ na kũthĩ kyalonĩ kĩasa kũnengaa mwĩndũ mwĩw'ĩle mũseo.
translation: Kuingia kwenye gari lako na kuelekea kwa safari ya mbali ya barabara kuna mvutio wa ndani kwa urahisi wake.

text: Kivathukany'o na ngali nene, niikwatya niwisene na undu wailitwe ni kutwaa ngali yaku nini na niwisi unyivu wayo.
translation: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kivathukany'o na ngali nene, niikwatya niwisene na undu wailitwe ni kutwaa ngali yaku nini na niwisi unyivu wayo.
translation: Tofauti na magari makubwa, labda tayari unajua kuendesha gari lako na unajua mapungufu yake.

text: Kwaka maeema malini ya mweene kana tauni ya saisi o na wiva nokutume andu malyaiilya kindu kite maana.
translation: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kwaka maeema malini ya mweene kana tauni ya saisi o na wiva nokutume andu malyaiilya kindu kite maana.
translation: Kuweka hema kwenye mali ya kibinafsi au katika mji wa saizi yoyote kunaweza kuvutia watu wasiofaa.

text: Kwa ũkuvĩ, kũtũmĩa ngalĩ yaku nĩ nthĩa nzeo mũno ya kũthi ndembea sya lelũnĩ ĩndĩ kaingĩ ti nthĩa ya kũthi ũthũmũo wa kambinĩ.
translation: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kwa ũkuvĩ, kũtũmĩa ngalĩ yaku nĩ nthĩa nzeo mũno ya kũthi ndembea sya lelũnĩ ĩndĩ kaingĩ ti nthĩa ya kũthi ũthũmũo wa kambinĩ.
translation: Kwa kifupi, kutumia gari lako ni njia mwafaka ya safari za barabarani lakini nadra kwa gari lenyewe kuwa njia ya "kupiga kambi".

text: Kũtũa ũtũmĩĩte ngalĩ nĩkũtonyeka ketha wĩna ngalĩ nene, Sedan kana Station Wagon yĩna ĩvĩla syĩtonya kũkomwa.
translation: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Kũtũa ũtũmĩĩte ngalĩ nĩkũtonyeka ketha wĩna ngalĩ nene, Sedan kana Station Wagon yĩna ĩvĩla syĩtonya kũkomwa.
translation: Kupiga kambi kwenye gari kunawezekana kama una minivani, SUV, Sedan au Stesheni Wagon lenye viti ambavyo vinaweza kulazwa.

text: Mikaawa imwe yithiawa na kindu yosete kuma golden age ya nzia sya ngali sya mwaki na mivia ya ukanga; mbee wa kau wa keli wa nthi yonthe, myakani ya maana ikumi na kenda kana mwambililyoni wa miongo ili.
translation: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Mikaawa imwe yithiawa na kindu yosete kuma golden age ya nzia sya ngali sya mwaki na mivia ya ukanga; mbee wa kau wa keli wa nthi yonthe, myakani ya maana ikumi na kenda kana mwambililyoni wa miongo ili.
translation: Baadhi ya hoteli zina urithi kutoka kwenye zama za usitawi za reli za mvuke na meli kubwa kubwa za abiria; kabla ya Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, katika karne za 19 au 20 mapema.

text: Maoteli aa mai vala athui na ala mai nguma ma umunthi methwa mekalaa, na maina liu wa wioo museo na maisa ma wioo maseo.
translation: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Maoteli aa mai vala athui na ala mai nguma ma umunthi methwa mekalaa, na maina liu wa wioo museo na maisa ma wioo maseo.
translation: Hizi ni hoteli ambazo watu tajiri na maarufu enzi zile wangeishi, na mara nyingi walikula na kujitumbuiza.

text: Syinduũ sya tene, kuema itha na syindũ sya mithenya ino na kũkua nikukonanwa namo.
translation: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Syinduũ sya tene, kuema itha na syindũ sya mithenya ino na kũkua nikukonanwa namo.
translation: Zana hizo za kale, ukosefu wa huduma za kisasa, na uzee fulani wenye neema pia ni sehemu ya tabia zao.

text: Ona vala ni ma andũ mbene, mala kauta asũmbĩ ma nthi ingĩ na anene angĩ ma nthi ingĩ nimekalaa kuũ mooka ndambũka.
translation: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Ona vala ni ma andũ mbene, mala kauta asũmbĩ ma nthi ingĩ na anene angĩ ma nthi ingĩ nimekalaa kuũ mooka ndambũka.
translation: Japo huwa zinamilikiwa kibinafsi, wakati mwingine huwa zinatumiwa kuwapokea marais wanaozuru, pamoja na waheshimiwa wengine.

text: Mutembei wina ilovia nesa no aamue kutembea nthi yonthe na ndeke, anoetw'e ni kwikala maotelini aa on the.
translation: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Mutembei wina ilovia nesa no aamue kutembea nthi yonthe na ndeke, anoetw'e ni kwikala maotelini aa on the.
translation: Msafiri aliye na vitita vya pesa huenda akafikiria safari ya ndege kuzunguka ulimwengu, inayositishwasitishwa kwa kukaa katika nyingi ya hoteli hizi.

text: ikundi ya kukuany'a utethyo ni ngwatanio ila ikwatanasya atalii na andu maku misyi ila maendete kutembelea.
translation: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: ikundi ya kukuany'a utethyo ni ngwatanio ila ikwatanasya atalii na andu maku misyi ila maendete kutembelea.
translation: Kubadilishana mitandao ya ukarimu ndio shirika linalounganisha wasafiri na wenyeji kwenye miji wanayoizuru.

text: kũlĩka mũtandaonĩ ũsũ kwendaa ũsyũsye mathangũ mũtandaonĩ, anakaũ ve ĩngĩ yeenda kũĩkĩĩthwya.
translation: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: kũlĩka mũtandaonĩ ũsũ kwendaa ũsyũsye mathangũ mũtandaonĩ, anakaũ ve ĩngĩ yeenda kũĩkĩĩthwya.
translation: Kujiunga na mtandao kama huo kwa kawaida kunahitaji tu kujaza fomu ya mtandaoni; hata hivyo mitandao mingine itatoa ama kuhitaji uhakiki zaidi.

text: List ya ala mauthokya yithwaa inenganitwe kwisila kwa kuprint na/kana kiseeveni, saa ingi nundu wa kwendekethw'a ni atembei ala angi.
translation: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: List ya ala mauthokya yithwaa inenganitwe kwisila kwa kuprint na/kana kiseeveni, saa ingi nundu wa kwendekethw'a ni atembei ala angi.
translation: Orodha ya wenyeji wanaopatikana hutolewa kwa kuchapishwa kwenye nakala na/au mitandaoni, wakati mwingine pamoja na marejeleo na hakiki kutoka kwa wasafiri wengine.

text: Kwikala musyini wa mundu wa nthi ya ntha kwa thooa munini kwambiisw'e mwei wa mbee mwaka wa 2004 itina wa museuny'a wa syindu sya nthini sya kombyuta Casey Fenton ukwata ndeke ya kuivia kyalo kwa thooa wa nthi kuthi Iceland indi ndai na vandu va kwikala.
translation: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Kwikala musyini wa mundu wa nthi ya ntha kwa thooa munini kwambiisw'e mwei wa mbee mwaka wa 2004 itina wa museuny'a wa syindu sya nthini sya kombyuta Casey Fenton ukwata ndeke ya kuivia kyalo kwa thooa wa nthi kuthi Iceland indi ndai na vandu va kwikala.
translation: Kulala kwenye nyumba za watu kwa muda kulianzishwa mnamo Januari 2004 baada ya mtengenezaji wa programu za kompyuta Casey Fenton kupata safari ya ndege ya bei nafuu kuelekea Aislandi lakini hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa.

text: Atumiye amanyiwa imeili ma yunivasiti ya kisio na akwata namba mbingi sya andu meyumitye kumunenga vandu va kwikala mana.
translation: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Atumiye amanyiwa imeili ma yunivasiti ya kisio na akwata namba mbingi sya andu meyumitye kumunenga vandu va kwikala mana.
translation: Akawatumia wanafunzi wa chuo kikuu chaa ndani barua pepe na akapata matoleo mengi sana ya malazi ya bure.

text: Kundũ kũu kwa kũkoma kwithaa na andũ ma mũika - ta ma myaka ta mbao - indi no withie atalii akũuangu ku.
translation: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Kundũ kũu kwa kũkoma kwithaa na andũ ma mũika - ta ma myaka ta mbao - indi no withie atalii akũuangu ku.
translation: Hosteli hushughulikia vijana kimsingi - mgeni wa kawaida ana miaka ishirini hivi - lakini mara nyingi unaweza kuwapata wasafiri wazee huko pia.

text: Vamĩlĩ syĩ syana ti mboneki mũno, ĩndĩ nyumba imwe sya ũkoma nĩmetĩkĩlasya tũsũmbanĩ twoo meoka.
translation: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Vamĩlĩ syĩ syana ti mboneki mũno, ĩndĩ nyumba imwe sya ũkoma nĩmetĩkĩlasya tũsũmbanĩ twoo meoka.
translation: Familia zilizo na watoto si jambo la kawaida, lakini baadhi ya hosteli huwaruhusu katika vyumba vya kibinafsi.

text: Beijĩng mũsyĩ wa China nĩ vo vakethĩwa ve mathaũ ma Olympik ma ĩvĩnda ya mbevo mwakanĩ wa 2022, ala makaũtwĩkĩtha mũsyĩ wa mbee wa kwĩthĩwa wĩna mathaũ ma Olympik ma ĩvĩndanĩ ya sũa n ĩvindanĩ ya mbevo.
translation: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijĩng mũsyĩ wa China nĩ vo vakethĩwa ve mathaũ ma Olympik ma ĩvĩnda ya mbevo mwakanĩ wa 2022, ala makaũtwĩkĩtha mũsyĩ wa mbee wa kwĩthĩwa wĩna mathaũ ma Olympik ma ĩvĩndanĩ ya sũa n ĩvindanĩ ya mbevo.
translation: Mji wa Beijing nchini Uchina utakuwa mji mwenyeji wa mashindano ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi mwaka wa 2022, ambayo itaifanya Beijing kuwa mji wa kwanza kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki ya majira ya joto na baridi.

text: Beijing nĩyo ĩkũũngamĩa syathĩ sya kũvĩnga na kũvĩngũa na mathaũ ma nthĩnĩ wa nyũmba ma ĩa.
translation: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Beijing nĩyo ĩkũũngamĩa syathĩ sya kũvĩnga na kũvĩngũa na mathaũ ma nthĩnĩ wa nyũmba ma ĩa.
translation: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za kufungua na kufunga na matukio ya ndani kwenye barafu.

text: Mathau angi ma kusiuuka makeethwa kuu Taizicheng ngaliko ya usiuuka kuu Zhangjiakou, ta kilomita 220 (maili 140) kuma Mbeijini.
translation: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Mathau angi ma kusiuuka makeethwa kuu Taizicheng ngaliko ya usiuuka kuu Zhangjiakou, ta kilomita 220 (maili 140) kuma Mbeijini.
translation: Matukio mengine ya kuteleza kwenye theluji yatakuwa katika eneo la Taizicheng katika Zhangjiakou, takribani kilomita 220 (maili 140) kutoka Beijing.

text: Makalũ maingĩ methwaa na mboka ya mwaka kwambĩĩya mwei wa ĩkũmĩ na ũmwe na ĩithela mwei wa katano katĩkatĩ, kĩla kĩsenzasya kwĩanana na kalenda ka mwaka ka kĩla ĩkalũ.
translation: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Makalũ maingĩ methwaa na mboka ya mwaka kwambĩĩya mwei wa ĩkũmĩ na ũmwe na ĩithela mwei wa katano katĩkatĩ, kĩla kĩsenzasya kwĩanana na kalenda ka mwaka ka kĩla ĩkalũ.
translation: Hekalu nyingi zina sikukuu ya Kila mwaka kuanzia mwishoni mwa Novemba hadi katikati mwa Mei, ambayo hufautiana kulingana na kalenda ya mwaka ya kila hekalu.

text: Sĩkũkũ mbingĩ ila syĩkawa nĩ kanĩsa syĩnthaa syĩ sya kũtanĩa maũlĩlĩkanyo ma kanĩsa kana kũnengana kyeo kanĩsanĩ o kana maũndĩ a ngĩ manene makonanĩtye kanĩsa.
translation: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Sĩkũkũ mbingĩ ila syĩkawa nĩ kanĩsa syĩnthaa syĩ sya kũtanĩa maũlĩlĩkanyo ma kanĩsa kana kũnengana kyeo kanĩsanĩ o kana maũndĩ a ngĩ manene makonanĩtye kanĩsa.
translation: Sherehe nyingi za Hekaluni zinaadhimishwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa kwa mungu anayeongoza au tukio lolote jingine kuu linalohusiana na hekalu.

text: Mathau ma ithembo ya Kerala mendeesya muno uyiloela, vethwaa na nzou syiatianie mbanakavye, wini wa ithembo na mathau angi.
translation: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Mathau ma ithembo ya Kerala mendeesya muno uyiloela, vethwaa na nzou syiatianie mbanakavye, wini wa ithembo na mathau angi.
translation: Tamasha za hekalu za Kerala ni za kufurahisha sana kuona, kwa msafara wa mara kwa mara wa ndovu waliopambwa, bendi za hekalu na tamasha nyinginezo.

text: Wonany'o wa nthi yonthe (wisikie ta World Exposition, kana kwa laisi Expo) ni iseso inene ya ati na saenzi ya nthi yonthe.
translation: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Wonany'o wa nthi yonthe (wisikie ta World Exposition, kana kwa laisi Expo) ni iseso inene ya ati na saenzi ya nthi yonthe.
translation: Maonyesho ya Dunia (kwa kawaida yanajulikana kama World Exposition, au Expo tu) ni tamasha kubwa ya kimataifa ya sanaa na sayansi.

text: nthĩ ĩla syĩna ũsolĩ na masomo ma kwonany'a mĩkalĩle namaũndũ mavĩtũkũ ĩtũmĩaa ĩwanza sya nthĩ.
translation: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: nthĩ ĩla syĩna ũsolĩ na masomo ma kwonany'a mĩkalĩle namaũndũ mavĩtũkũ ĩtũmĩaa ĩwanza sya nthĩ.
translation: Nchi zinazoshiriki huwasilisha maonyesho ya kisanaa na kielimu katika kumbi za kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya kidunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.

text: International Horticultural Expoitions ni syathe ila syonanasya malaa, miunda ya kusomea ulu wa miti na syindu ingi ila syiilenie na miti.
translation: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: International Horticultural Expoitions ni syathe ila syonanasya malaa, miunda ya kusomea ulu wa miti na syindu ingi ila syiilenie na miti.
translation: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Maua ni matukio maalum ambayo huonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za mimea na kitu chochote kingine kinachohusisha mimea.

text: O na ketha andu maasyaa no sitiwe kila mwaka (ketha syi nthi syi kivathukany'o) indi mekoni ni kuvathukanyo.
translation: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: O na ketha andu maasyaa no sitiwe kila mwaka (ketha syi nthi syi kivathukany'o) indi mekoni ni kuvathukanyo.
translation: Ingawa katika nadharia zinaweza kutokea kila mwaka (mradi zako katika nchi tofauti), kwa mazoezi hazipo.

text: Maũndũ aa mekala vandũ va myei ĩtatũ na thanthatũ, namethiawa kũndũ kwĩna mwanya utanyiva heka 50.
translation: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Maũndũ aa mekala vandũ va myei ĩtatũ na thanthatũ, namethiawa kũndũ kwĩna mwanya utanyiva heka 50.
translation: Matukio hayo huwa kwa miezi mitatu hadi miezi sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo yasiyopungua hekta 50.

text: Ve mithemba mingi kivathukany'o ya sinema ila itumiitwe myaka mingi mithelu. Ta ya milimita 35 (36 kwa milimita 24 nengativu) niyo itumiawa muno.
translation: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Ve mithemba mingi kivathukany'o ya sinema ila itumiitwe myaka mingi mithelu. Ta ya milimita 35 (36 kwa milimita 24 nengativu) niyo itumiawa muno.
translation: Kuna aina nyingi za filamu ambazo zimetumika kwa miaka. Filamu ya milimita 35 (kanda hasi ya milimita 36 kwa milimita 24) ni ya kawaida zaidi.

text: Nĩ laisi kũkwata ĩngĩ kwa vaatĩ wamĩna ĩla wĩ nayo, na yĩthaa na kwolĩtĩ ĩtĩanĩe vanini na DSLR ĩla yĩ vo kwa saa ii.
translation: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Nĩ laisi kũkwata ĩngĩ kwa vaatĩ wamĩna ĩla wĩ nayo, na yĩthaa na kwolĩtĩ ĩtĩanĩe vanini na DSLR ĩla yĩ vo kwa saa ii.
translation: Kwa kawaida inaweza kujazwa tena kwa urahisi kiasi ikiisha, na hutoa ubora wa mwonekano unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule wa DSLR ya sasa.

text: Kamela imwe sya sinema ya fomati ya kati kati itumiaa fomati ya sendimita 6 kwa 6, ianene nda na negative ya milimita 56 kwa 56.
translation: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Kamela imwe sya sinema ya fomati ya kati kati itumiaa fomati ya sendimita 6 kwa 6, ianene nda na negative ya milimita 56 kwa 56.
translation: Kamera ingine za muundo wa kati zinatumia muundo wa 6 kwa 6, kwa usahihi 56 kwa 56 hasi.

text: Ino inenganae visa ntheu kundu kuna kwa ila ya nekativu ya milimita 35 ila ni 3136 sikwea kwa 864.
translation: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ino inenganae visa ntheu kundu kuna kwa ila ya nekativu ya milimita 35 ila ni 3136 sikwea kwa 864.
translation: Hii hutoa ubora wa mwonekano karibu mara nne ya ule wa picha hasi ya milimita 35 (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).

text: Nyamu sya kitheka nisyo kati wa syindu imwe syivinya kwa mukuni wa visa, na syendaa vaati nzeo, umiisyo, utuika na miio miseo.
translation: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Nyamu sya kitheka nisyo kati wa syindu imwe syivinya kwa mukuni wa visa, na syendaa vaati nzeo, umiisyo, utuika na miio miseo.
translation: Wanyama pori ni miongoni mwa michoro yenye changamoto zaidi kwa mpiga picha, na inahitaji mchanganyiko wa bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vizuri.

text: Visa sya nyamu sya kitheka nivuthiiw'e, indi ta visa ila ingi, visa yithiawa yi lato ndeto ngili.
translation: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Visa sya nyamu sya kitheka nivuthiiw'e, indi ta visa ila ingi, visa yithiawa yi lato ndeto ngili.
translation: Upigaji picha za wanyamapori mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa urahisi, lakini kama upigaji picha kwa ujumla, picha ina thamani ya maneno elfu.

text: Ukuni wa visa wa nyamu sya kithekani kwendaa lenzi ndaasa, ona vala syindũ sya ikundi sya tũsũni kana tusamũ tũnini twendaa lenzi ingi.
translation: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Ukuni wa visa wa nyamu sya kithekani kwendaa lenzi ndaasa, ona vala syindũ sya ikundi sya tũsũni kana tusamũ tũnini twendaa lenzi ingi.
translation: Mara nyingi upigaji picha za wanyamapori huhitaji lenzi ndefu, ingawa vitu kama kundi la ndege au kiumbe mdogo huhitaji lenzi nyingine.

text: Nyamu mbingi sya kuka syiyonekanaa muno na andu ni mavatitwe kuikuna visa sya kusevya mbesa nasyo.
translation: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Nyamu mbingi sya kuka syiyonekanaa muno na andu ni mavatitwe kuikuna visa sya kusevya mbesa nasyo.
translation: Ni vigumu kupata wanyama wengi wa kigeni, na mbuga wakati mwingine huwa na sheria zinazohusu upigaji picha kwa ajili za kibiashara.

text: Nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ nosyĩthe syĩna w'ĩa kana syĩna ũngendu. Mawĩ'thyũlũlũko nomethe me mathĩthũ, mavyũ kana memathũkũ.
translation: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ nosyĩthe syĩna w'ĩa kana syĩna ũngendu. Mawĩ'thyũlũlũko nomethe me mathĩthũ, mavyũ kana memathũkũ.
translation: Wanyamapori wanaweza kuwa wenye aibu au wakali. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au makali kwa vinginevyo.

text: Kwi ithyomo mbee wa 5,000 iulu wa nthi ve ithyomo mbee wa 20 iuneenwa ni andu mililion 50 kana ainge mbee wa asu.
translation: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Kwi ithyomo mbee wa 5,000 iulu wa nthi ve ithyomo mbee wa 20 iuneenwa ni andu mililion 50 kana ainge mbee wa asu.
translation: Ulimwengu una zaidi ya lugha 5,000, zikiwemo zaidi ya ishirini zilizo na wazungumzaji zaidi ya milioni 50.

text: Ndeto siandikitwe maita maingi syithiawa syi mituki kuelewa mbee wa ndeto sya kuneena, o ingi. Uu maita maingi niw'o uw'o wa masanduku ma valua, ala kaingi methiawa vinya kumatamuka nesa.
translation: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Ndeto siandikitwe maita maingi syithiawa syi mituki kuelewa mbee wa ndeto sya kuneena, o ingi. Uu maita maingi niw'o uw'o wa masanduku ma valua, ala kaingi methiawa vinya kumatamuka nesa.
translation: Maneno yaliyoandikwa mara nyingi huwa rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyotamkwa, pia. Hii huwa hususan ni kweli kwa anwani, ambazo aghalabu huwa vigumu kutamkwa kwa busara.

text: Nthi syonthe vyu mbingi ni syisi Kisungu nesa, na o na kwa mbingaingi no wikwaty'e umanyi muthime - muno muno anduni ma myaka nini.
translation: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Nthi syonthe vyu mbingi ni syisi Kisungu nesa, na o na kwa mbingaingi no wikwaty'e umanyi muthime - muno muno anduni ma myaka nini.
translation: Mataifa mengi mazima huzungumza Kiingereza kwa ufasaha kabisa, na kwa hata mengine mengi unaweza kutarajia ufahamu mdogo - hasa miongoni mwa watu wenye umri mdogo.

text: Sũanĩa, ethĩwa nĩũkwenda, mũ Mancu, mũ Bostoni, mũ Jamaica na mũ Sydneysider mailye mesanĩ kĩthyũlũlũ maiya ky'aũya kya ma'ĩyoo Toronto.
translation: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Sũanĩa, ethĩwa nĩũkwenda, mũ Mancu, mũ Bostoni, mũ Jamaica na mũ Sydneysider mailye mesanĩ kĩthyũlũlũ maiya ky'aũya kya ma'ĩyoo Toronto.
translation: Fikiria, ukitaka, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, na Msydney wakiwa wameketi wamezunguka meza wakila chajio mkahawani katika Toronto.

text: maendee kwilegal mo mbene na ngewa kuma misyi minene ya kwoo, maitavanya na luka ya kwoo na argoti ya uvonge.
translation: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: maendee kwilegal mo mbene na ngewa kuma misyi minene ya kwoo, maitavanya na luka ya kwoo na argoti ya uvonge.
translation: Wanaburudishana na hadithi kutoka kwa mitaa ya manyumbani kwao, inayosemwa katika lafudhi zao tofauti na lugha ya kienyeji isiyo rasmi.

text: Kuthooa liu ndukani nene vyu ni yo ithiawa nzia laisi vyu ya kuvuuna. Vatee my'anya ya kũua, ũnyuvi o na vamwe na uu withiawa usiiwe ni liu ula wi mũue.
translation: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Kuthooa liu ndukani nene vyu ni yo ithiawa nzia laisi vyu ya kuvuuna. Vatee my'anya ya kũua, ũnyuvi o na vamwe na uu withiawa usiiwe ni liu ula wi mũue.
translation: Kwa kawaida, kununua chakula katika supamaketi ndiyo njia ya bei rahisi kabisa ya kujilisha. Bila fursa za kupika, machaguo hata hivyo yamepunguzwa kwa chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari.

text: Suvamaketi nisyiendee ukwata mbau nundu wa kuua liu woo. O na ingi nisyithwaa na maasini ya kuvyuvya liu.
translation: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Suvamaketi nisyiendee ukwata mbau nundu wa kuua liu woo. O na ingi nisyithwaa na maasini ya kuvyuvya liu.
translation: Maduka makubwa yanazidi kupata seehemu ya chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari. Baadhi ya maduka makuu hutoa tanuri ya miale ya kupasha chakula joto.

text: Nthini wa nthi imwe kana nduka nene syi kivathukany'o nivethiawa vainyiva mukaawa umwe wi nthini, muno muno utai ta wi vata muno na wa thooa munini.
translation: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Nthini wa nthi imwe kana nduka nene syi kivathukany'o nivethiawa vainyiva mukaawa umwe wi nthini, muno muno utai ta wi vata muno na wa thooa munini.
translation: Katika baadhi ya nchi au aina za maduka kuna angalau mkahawa kwenye eneo, mara nyingi usio wa kirasmi na wenye bei nafuu.

text: Umĩthya na ũikua mathangũ maku ma kũĩvwa kũkethĩwa na mbanga kana thĩna vamwe na namba ĩla mũũngamĩi waku ũtonya ũkwatĩkana nam'yo.
translation: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Umĩthya na ũikua mathangũ maku ma kũĩvwa kũkethĩwa na mbanga kana thĩna vamwe na namba ĩla mũũngamĩi waku ũtonya ũkwatĩkana nam'yo.
translation: Tengeneza na ubebe nakala za hati ya bima na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya mtoa huduma wako wa bima.

text: Mailite kwonia ula ukũivia e-mail na namba ya simu ni kenda matawe/ metikilwe na menyielesye.
translation: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Mailite kwonia ula ukũivia e-mail na namba ya simu ni kenda matawe/ metikilwe na menyielesye.
translation: Wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe na nambari za simu za kimataifa za mtoa bima kwa ushauri/idhini na kufanya madai.

text: Ithiwa na kopi ingi miioni yaku na mutandaoni (itumie kwa isanduku yaku ya valua, kana yiyitwe nthini wa "matu").
translation: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ithiwa na kopi ingi miioni yaku na mutandaoni (itumie kwa isanduku yaku ya valua, kana yiyitwe nthini wa "matu").
translation: Kuwa na nakala nyingine katika mzigo wako na mtandaoni (baruapepe iliyo na kiambatisho kwako mwenyewe, au kuhifahiwa kwenye "wingu").

text: ketha kũtembea na kompyũta nĩnĩ sya kwoko, kũĩya mũvywano nthĩnĩ wa mwanyanĩ wa yo wakũĩya syĩndũ (nĩlĩkwatĩkana vate mũtandao).
translation: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: ketha kũtembea na kompyũta nĩnĩ sya kwoko, kũĩya mũvywano nthĩnĩ wa mwanyanĩ wa yo wakũĩya syĩndũ (nĩlĩkwatĩkana vate mũtandao).
translation: Kama unafasiri na kipakatilishi au kibao, hifadhi nakala kwenye kadi kasima yake(unayoweza kufikia bila mtandao)

text: O na ingi nengane mathangu ma wiw'ano na namba sya utumia ukuvikia kwi ala mwi kyaloni nao na andu ma musyi kana nduu ila ikwenda utethya.
translation: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: O na ingi nengane mathangu ma wiw'ano na namba sya utumia ukuvikia kwi ala mwi kyaloni nao na andu ma musyi kana nduu ila ikwenda utethya.
translation: Pia toa nakala za sera/mkataba kwa wenzi wa kusafiri na jamaa au marafiki nyumbani walio tayari kusaidia.

text: Ng'ondi ni nyamu sya kau indi ni syisiaa ila kwina thina.
translation: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ng'ondi ni nyamu sya kau indi ni syisiaa ila kwina thina.
translation: Kongoni (pia wanajulikana kama elk) hawana fujo kiasili, lakini watajitetea ikiwa watakisia kuna hatari.

text: Ĩla andũ matekwona ndaatai nene ta ite nthũku, nomatonye ũthi vakuvĩ namy'o na kwĩlikya mbanganĩ.
translation: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Ĩla andũ matekwona ndaatai nene ta ite nthũku, nomatonye ũthi vakuvĩ namy'o na kwĩlikya mbanganĩ.
translation: Wakati watu hawaoni kongoni kama anayeweza kuwa hatari, huenda wakamsogea karibu sana na kujiweka hatarini.

text: kũnywa mbũkĩ wĩna kĩthĩmo. Mbũkĩ ĩthũa kĩla mũndũ kĩvathũkang'anyo, na wĩsĩ kĩthĩmo chakũ nĩ kĩtũmĩ kĩnene.
translation: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: kũnywa mbũkĩ wĩna kĩthĩmo. Mbũkĩ ĩthũa kĩla mũndũ kĩvathũkang'anyo, na wĩsĩ kĩthĩmo chakũ nĩ kĩtũmĩ kĩnene.
translation: Kunywa vinywaji vyenye pombe kwa kiasi tu. Pombe inaathiri kila mtu kwa njia tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.

text: Mundu anywa uki muno no utonya kwanangika mbio, akatwika kilalinda kana akakwa.Mbanga ii niyongelekaa ila msundu anya uki ula utemvitukithye kunyuwa.
translation: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Mundu anywa uki muno no utonya kwanangika mbio, akatwika kilalinda kana akakwa.Mbanga ii niyongelekaa ila msundu anya uki ula utemvitukithye kunyuwa.
translation: Matukio ya kiafya ya muda mrefu kutokana na kunywa kupita kiasi yanaweza kujumuisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Kuwepo kwa hatari huongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa kiharamu.

text: Mbuki ila ngune muungu nitonya kwithiwa syina syindu syi muisyo ta methanoo, ila itumaa metho maa kana kikwu ona yi nini.
translation: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Mbuki ila ngune muungu nitonya kwithiwa syina syindu syi muisyo ta methanoo, ila itumaa metho maa kana kikwu ona yi nini.
translation: Mivinyo isiyo halali inaweza kuwa na uchafu mwingi hatari pamoja na methanoli, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.

text: Miwani no yithwe na thoowa munini nthi sya nza munomuno nthi syi ukwati munini kula ivalua syievawa thowa munini.
translation: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Miwani no yithwe na thoowa munini nthi sya nza munomuno nthi syi ukwati munini kula ivalua syievawa thowa munini.
translation: Miwani inaweza kuwa bei rahisi katika nchi ya kigeni, haswa katika nchi za mapato ya chini ambapo gharama za kazi ziko chini.

text: Suania kwusiiw'a metho musyi, muno muno ethiwa aivi ma ngalama nimamiongelete vo, na kuete vala uandikiwe ndawa vaseuviw'e kundu kungi.
translation: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Suania kwusiiw'a metho musyi, muno muno ethiwa aivi ma ngalama nimamiongelete vo, na kuete vala uandikiwe ndawa vaseuviw'e kundu kungi.
translation: Fikiria kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, haswa ikiwa bima inaugharamia, na kuleta agizo nawe ili lifailiwe mahali pengine.

text: Vulemu sya thooa munene na masyitwa me nguma ila sikwatikanaa kundu ta kuu no syithiwe na mathina eli; imwe no syithiwe ila itee vata, na ila sya w'o syumitw'e nthi sya nza no syithiwe na thooa munene kwi sya musyi.
translation: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Vulemu sya thooa munene na masyitwa me nguma ila sikwatikanaa kundu ta kuu no syithiwe na mathina eli; imwe no syithiwe ila itee vata, na ila sya w'o syumitw'e nthi sya nza no syithiwe na thooa munene kwi sya musyi.
translation: Fremu za kifahari za kampuni tajika ambazo hupatikana katika maeneo kama haya zina shida mbili; baadhi huenda zikawa ni nakala zisizo na leseni, na zile halisi zilizoletwa ndani huenda zikawa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.

text: Kahawa ni imwe kati ya syindũ ika itesewa mũno iũlu wa nthi na withie mithemba mbingi kisioni kya mũsyi.
translation: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Kahawa ni imwe kati ya syindũ ika itesewa mũno iũlu wa nthi na withie mithemba mbingi kisioni kya mũsyi.
translation: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa sana duniani, na labda unaweza kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.

text: O na vamwe na uu, kwi nthia mbingi muno sya unywa kaawa nthi yonthe ila syi vata kutatithya.
translation: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: O na vamwe na uu, kwi nthia mbingi muno sya unywa kaawa nthi yonthe ila syi vata kutatithya.
translation: Walakini, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa ulimwenguni kote ambazo zinafaa kushuhudiwa.

text: kutuva iimani kwithiawa no kusiuuka nginya kyunguni kya ndia, ila yitiawa yi mbumu kana yusie kiw'u.
translation: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: kutuva iimani kwithiawa no kusiuuka nginya kyunguni kya ndia, ila yitiawa yi mbumu kana yusie kiw'u.
translation: Kuingia kwenye korongo (au: canyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya korongo, ambayo imekauka au imejawa na maji.

text: Kutwaa isiwa kwithwaa kukwatene na maundu ma kuthambia, kulisa iima na kutulila -- indi yendaa o mauvundisyo manini ma mwii kuyambiisya (weananithya na kulisa mavia, kwithika kana kusiuuka, kwa ngelekany'o).
translation: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Kutwaa isiwa kwithwaa kukwatene na maundu ma kuthambia, kulisa iima na kutulila -- indi yendaa o mauvundisyo manini ma mwii kuyambiisya (weananithya na kulisa mavia, kwithika kana kusiuuka, kwa ngelekany'o).
translation: Mchezo wa korongo huchanganya vipengele kutoka kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini unahitaji mafunzo kiasi au hali nzuri ya kimwili ili kuanza (ukilinganishwa na kupanda mwamba, upigaji mbizi wa scuba au kuteleza milimani, kwa mfano).

text: Kuthi mauu ivinda iasa kwithiawa ni vamwe na kuthi mauu nthini wa ithyululuko ila syumbitwe ni Ngai, muno muno syithiawa nziani sya kutembea.
translation: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Kuthi mauu ivinda iasa kwithiawa ni vamwe na kuthi mauu nthini wa ithyululuko ila syumbitwe ni Ngai, muno muno syithiawa nziani sya kutembea.
translation: Matembezi ni shughuli ya nje ambayo huwa na kutembea katika mazingira asili, mara nyingi katika njia za matembezi.

text: Kũtembea mũthenya kwaĩ vamwe na kũthĩ ĩlũngũ ngũvĩ kũte maĩlĩ na ĩngĩ ndaasa ĩla sya ĩtonya kũtembewa kwa mũthenya.
translation: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kũtembea mũthenya kwaĩ vamwe na kũthĩ ĩlũngũ ngũvĩ kũte maĩlĩ na ĩngĩ ndaasa ĩla sya ĩtonya kũtembewa kwa mũthenya.
translation: Matembezi ya mchana huhusisha umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali zaidi ambao unaweza kufikiwa kwa siku moja.

text: Kwa kũtembea kũũkũa mũthenya ũmwe na kwisila nzia itena mathĩna maĩngĩ kwĩ laisi kwĩ yũmbanya, na mũndũ yeyote wĩna ũĩma wa mwĩĩ no atanĩe savalĩ ĩsũ.
translation: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Kwa kũtembea kũũkũa mũthenya ũmwe na kwisila nzia itena mathĩna maĩngĩ kwĩ laisi kwĩ yũmbanya, na mũndũ yeyote wĩna ũĩma wa mwĩĩ no atanĩe savalĩ ĩsũ.
translation: Kwa matembezi ya mchana kando ya njia rahisi maandalizi kidogo yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote aliye na usawa wastani wa kimwili anaweza kufurahia.

text: Vamili syina syana nini nikwenda ivinda yingi ya kwiyumbany'a, ateo kuu nza ni laisi o na wina syana na syana itavikííe kuthi sukulu.
translation: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Vamili syina syana nini nikwenda ivinda yingi ya kwiyumbany'a, ateo kuu nza ni laisi o na wina syana na syana itavikííe kuthi sukulu.
translation: Huenda familia zilizo na watoto wadogo zikahitaji matayarisho mengi, lakini siku moja nje inawezekana kwa urahisi hata kukiwa na watoto wachanga na wale walio karibu kwenda shuleni.

text: Nthi yonthe kwina kambuni 200 ila siusikanaa na kũsemba. Ila mbingi ni syiinyungamitye.
translation: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Nthi yonthe kwina kambuni 200 ila siusikanaa na kũsemba. Ila mbingi ni syiinyungamitye.
translation: Kimataifa, kuna mashirika karibu 200 ya ziara za mbio. Nyingi kati yazo hufanya kazi kwa uhuru.

text: Go Running Tours ila yoosie kivila cha Global Running Tours ni ithũkũmaa na atetheesya ma kũsemba ĩlembetanĩ inya.
translation: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Go Running Tours ila yoosie kivila cha Global Running Tours ni ithũkũmaa na atetheesya ma kũsemba ĩlembetanĩ inya.
translation: Mrithi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours huunganisha makundi mengi ya kutoa huduma ya ukimbiaji na utazamaji kwenye mabara manne.

text: Running Tours Barcelona ila yambiliilye Barcelona na Running Copenhagen ya Copenhagen ni yakomanie na Running Tours Prague ya Prague na ingi.
translation: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Running Tours Barcelona ila yambiliilye Barcelona na Running Copenhagen ya Copenhagen ni yakomanie na Running Tours Prague ya Prague na ingi.
translation: Kwa mizizi ya Running Tours huko Barcelona na Copenhagen's Running kwa Copenhagen, ilijumuishwa haraka na Running Tours huko Prague na wengineo.

text: Ve syĩndũ mbingĩ mũno waĩlĩlwe nĩ kũsyaĩsya mbee na ĩvindanĩ ya kũthi kyalo vandũ.
translation: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ve syĩndũ mbingĩ mũno waĩlĩlwe nĩ kũsyaĩsya mbee na ĩvindanĩ ya kũthi kyalo vandũ.
translation: Kuna mambo mengi sana unayofaa kutilia maanani kabla na wakati wa kusafiri mahali.

text: Ila wathi kyaloni, iyumbanye kwithia maundu matai undu methiawa "kũya mũsyĩ". Tavia, mĩao, lĩu, mũtũumĩĩle wa lelũ, kũndũ kwa ũkoma, iwango, ithyomo na ingĩ mbingĩ kwa kĩwango kĩana ũna syĩthĩwa kĩvathĩkany'o na vala wĩkalaa.
translation: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ila wathi kyaloni, iyumbanye kwithia maundu matai undu methiawa "kũya mũsyĩ". Tavia, mĩao, lĩu, mũtũumĩĩle wa lelũ, kũndũ kwa ũkoma, iwango, ithyomo na ingĩ mbingĩ kwa kĩwango kĩana ũna syĩthĩwa kĩvathĩkany'o na vala wĩkalaa.
translation: Unaposafiri, tarajia mambo yasiwe kama yalivyo "nyumbani". Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, mahali pa kulala, viwango, lugha na kadhalika zitatofautiana kwa kiwango fulani na mahali unapoishi.

text: Kii ni kindu waile kwikala ulilikene, ni kana wivetane na kuumia, kana wasye musamo na undu maundu mekawa ku.
translation: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Kii ni kindu waile kwikala ulilikene, ni kana wivetane na kuumia, kana wasye musamo na undu maundu mekawa ku.
translation: Hili ni jambo ambalo unahitaji kukumbuka kila wakati, ili kuepuka kukata tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za kawaida za kufanya mambo.

text: Ala matetheasya andu maithi syaloni methiitwe kw'o kuma myaka maana ya 19. Mutetheesya ethiawa museo kwa kyalo kivitukite syindu ila mundu wonete vau mbeeni ki syumbe, syithio, ithyomo kana nthi ila ngya.
translation: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Ala matetheasya andu maithi syaloni methiitwe kw'o kuma myaka maana ya 19. Mutetheesya ethiawa museo kwa kyalo kivitukite syindu ila mundu wonete vau mbeeni ki syumbe, syithio, ithyomo kana nthi ila ngya.
translation: Mawakala wa usafiri wamekuwapo tangu karne ya 19. Kwa kawaida wakala wa usafiri huwa chaguo zuri kwa safari ambayo ni zaidi ya uzoefu wa awali wa msafiri wa maumbile, utamaduni, lugha au nchi za mapato madogo.

text: Onavale mivea mbingi ni yi kwenda kwitikila myanya ya kawaita aingi mamo wia woo munene ni mithemba ya ndambuka, masavu ma utumii wa mbesa kana kundu kungi kwa utembea.
translation: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Onavale mivea mbingi ni yi kwenda kwitikila myanya ya kawaita aingi mamo wia woo munene ni mithemba ya ndambuka, masavu ma utumii wa mbesa kana kundu kungi kwa utembea.
translation: Ingawa mashirika mengi ya uwakala yako tayari kufanya uhifadhi mwingi wa kawaida, mawakala wengi hushughulika na aina maalum za usafiri, masafa ya bajeti au mahali pa kwenda.

text: Nuseo kutumia engyendi ula umbukiaa ndambuka syiilye syaku.
translation: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Nuseo kutumia engyendi ula umbukiaa ndambuka syiilye syaku.
translation: Inaweza kuwa afadhali kutumia wakala ambaye huhifadhi safari sawa na yako kila wakati.

text: Sisya ndambuka ila mbuloka ukukunia maleve, yithiwe ni mitandaoni kana ndilisyani ya nduka.
translation: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Sisya ndambuka ila mbuloka ukukunia maleve, yithiwe ni mitandaoni kana ndilisyani ya nduka.
translation: Angalia ni safari zipi ambazo wakala anapendekeza, iwe kwenye tovuti au kwenye dirisha la duka.

text: Ketha nukwenda kwona nthĩ yonthe kwa ũlaisi, kĩtũmĩ, mĩkalĩle kana masĩndano, ve nzĩa ĩla sya kwĩka oũ.
translation: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Ketha nukwenda kwona nthĩ yonthe kwa ũlaisi, kĩtũmĩ, mĩkalĩle kana masĩndano, ve nzĩa ĩla sya kwĩka oũ.
translation: Ikiwa unataka kuuona ulimwengu kwa urahisi, kwa umuhimu, mtindo wa maisha au chamgamoto, kuna baadhi ya njia za kufanya hivyo.

text: Maanĩtw'e kelĩ: ũthũkũme ũendeeye na kyalo kana ũsisye wone kana noũole matumisi maku. Ũvoo ũũ wĩneenea yĩũlũ wa ĩĩ ya ĩtina.
translation: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Maanĩtw'e kelĩ: ũthũkũme ũendeeye na kyalo kana ũsisye wone kana noũole matumisi maku. Ũvoo ũũ wĩneenea yĩũlũ wa ĩĩ ya ĩtina.
translation: Kimsingi wao huwa katika vikundi viwili: fanya kazi ukiwa safarini ama jaribu upunguze gharama zako. Nakala hii inaangazia wa mwisho.

text: Kwa ala mekwiwa matiana na kũanĩwa, ĩvinda na kũtatĩthya kũola ũtũmĩi ũthee nginya nzilo, onai kiwango kinini kya mbangyeti ya kũtambũka.
translation: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Kwa ala mekwiwa matiana na kũanĩwa, ĩvinda na kũtatĩthya kũola ũtũmĩi ũthee nginya nzilo, onai kiwango kinini kya mbangyeti ya kũtambũka.
translation: Kwa wale walio tayari kuacha starehe, muda na utabiri ili kupunguza garama hadi sufuri, angalia usafiri wa bajeti ndogo.

text: Utao uu wosaa ta kute ung'ei kati ka ala me savaliini, maitesaa syindu nthuku, maivoyaa na maitumia ala angĩ nai ni kenda matetheke.
translation: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Utao uu wosaa ta kute ung'ei kati ka ala me savaliini, maitesaa syindu nthuku, maivoyaa na maitumia ala angĩ nai ni kenda matetheke.
translation: Ushauri huo unachukulia kuwa wasafiri hawaibi, hawana uingiliaji, hawashiriki katika soko haramu, hawaombi, au kunyonya watu wengine kwa faida yao.

text: Uvisi wa kũisya andũ ala mathamaa nĩkyo kyaĩ kya mbee andũ mekusyoka ndekenĩ, isiwa kana ngalĩnĩ ingi.
translation: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Uvisi wa kũisya andũ ala mathamaa nĩkyo kyaĩ kya mbee andũ mekusyoka ndekenĩ, isiwa kana ngalĩnĩ ingi.
translation: Kituo cha kukaguliwa kwa wahamiaji kwa kawaida ndipo mahali pa kwanza kusimama unaposhuka kwenye ndege, meli ama gari jingine.

text: Andũ nimasiasywa ila me ngalĩn sya mwakĩ ila sikilanialya mĩvaka na no nginya mundu ethe na kĩvandĩ ailisa ngalĩ isũ.
translation: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Andũ nimasiasywa ila me ngalĩn sya mwakĩ ila sikilanialya mĩvaka na no nginya mundu ethe na kĩvandĩ ailisa ngalĩ isũ.
translation: Katika baadhi ya garimoshi zinazovuka mipaka ukaguzi hufanywa terni likiwa kwenye mwendo na hivyo unapaswa kuwa na kitambulisho halali unapopanda mojawapo ya treni hizo.

text: Makanga ma ngali sya mwaki ila siendaa utuku mosanasya mavalua ma ndambuka tene ni kenda ndukanangiwe too.
translation: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Makanga ma ngali sya mwaki ila siendaa utuku mosanasya mavalua ma ndambuka tene ni kenda ndukanangiwe too.
translation: Kwenye treni za kulala usiku, pasipoti zinaweza kukusanywa na kondakta ili usingizi wako usitatizwe.

text: Kwĩyandĩkĩthya nĩ wendekethyo wa kwosa vĩsa. Nthĩ ĩmwe, nongĩnya wĩyĩandĩkĩthye wĩyandĩkĩthya vala wĩkalaa kwa anene ma kĩsio.
translation: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Kwĩyandĩkĩthya nĩ wendekethyo wa kwosa vĩsa. Nthĩ ĩmwe, nongĩnya wĩyĩandĩkĩthye wĩyandĩkĩthya vala wĩkalaa kwa anene ma kĩsio.
translation: Usajili ni hitaji la ziada kwa mchakato wa visa. Katika baadhi ya nchi, ni lazima usajili uwepo wako na anwani ya unakokaa na mamlaka ya ndani.

text: Uu nowende kususya foomu wina muusikali wa kisio kiu kana uthi kwa uvisi wa nthama.
translation: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Uu nowende kususya foomu wina muusikali wa kisio kiu kana uthi kwa uvisi wa nthama.
translation: Hii huenda ikahitaji kujaza fomu na polisi wa ndani au ziara katika ofisi za uhamiaji.

text: Nthini wa nthi mbingi syi miao ta isu, mikaawa ya nthi isu nimyo yandikithasya (lilikana ukulya).
translation: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Nthini wa nthi mbingi syi miao ta isu, mikaawa ya nthi isu nimyo yandikithasya (lilikana ukulya).
translation: Katika nchi nyingi zilizo na sheria kama hiyo, hoteli za ndani zitashughulikia usajili (hakikisha umeuliza).

text: Kundu kungi, no kwa la mekwikala nza wa kundu kwa ukoma kwa atalii meenda kwiyandikithya. O vailye uu uu nutumaa miao yisiwe nesa, kwoou manya kwi tene.
translation: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register. However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Kundu kungi, no kwa la mekwikala nza wa kundu kwa ukoma kwa atalii meenda kwiyandikithya. O vailye uu uu nutumaa miao yisiwe nesa, kwoou manya kwi tene.
translation: Katika kesi nyingine, wale tu wanoishi nje ya makazi ya watlii wanafaa kujiandikisha. Lakini, hii inafanya sheria kuwa fiche, kwa hivyo jua mapema.

text: Architecture ukonanitw'e na ndisaini na mwako wa myako. Mundu ula uthukumaa wia uu evala ukuthukuma ethwaa eilye ta mutalii we mweene.
translation: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Architecture ukonanitw'e na ndisaini na mwako wa myako. Mundu ula uthukumaa wia uu evala ukuthukuma ethwaa eilye ta mutalii we mweene.
translation: Majenzi yanahusika na ubunifu na ujenzi wa majengo. Mara nyingi majenzi ya mahali ni kivutio cha watalii kivyake.

text: Nyumba mbingi ni mbanake muno kya kwiloelwaa na kuisya kuma nyumba ndaasa kuma ndilisyani yikiitwe clevery ni wanake mwingi.
translation: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Nyumba mbingi ni mbanake muno kya kwiloelwaa na kuisya kuma nyumba ndaasa kuma ndilisyani yikiitwe clevery ni wanake mwingi.
translation: Majengo mengi ni mazuri sana kutazama na mtazamo kutoka kwa jengo refu au kutoka kwa dirisha lililowekwa kwa ujanja unaweza kuwa uzuri wa ajabu.

text: Masomo ma myako kwa kilungu kinene nimavulanaa na masomo angi ta kuvangithya misyi minene, masomo ma iao na malelu, mavisa ma wanake, mivango ya nthini ya nyumba na wanake wa nza wa nyumba.
translation: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Masomo ma myako kwa kilungu kinene nimavulanaa na masomo angi ta kuvangithya misyi minene, masomo ma iao na malelu, mavisa ma wanake, mivango ya nthini ya nyumba na wanake wa nza wa nyumba.
translation: Majenzi huingiliana sana na nyanja nyingine zikiwemo mipango ya mji, uhandisi wa umma, sanaa za mapambo, ubunifu wa ndani na ubunifu wa mandhari.

text: Nikwithiwa pueblos mbingi syi naku nthini, ndwisa ukwata ivinda yikavaa ya maisha ma utuku utaendete Albuquerque kana Santa Fe.
translation: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Nikwithiwa pueblos mbingi syi naku nthini, ndwisa ukwata ivinda yikavaa ya maisha ma utuku utaendete Albuquerque kana Santa Fe.
translation: Kwa kuzingatia umbali wa wapueblo wengi, hutaweza kupata maisha ya usiku ya maana bila kusafiri kwenda Albakuku au Santa Fe.

text: O na vamwe na uu, vakuvi kundu kwa uthauka mathau ma usinda mbesa kw'onthe kuu kuandikitwe vaa iulu nikunenganae syindu sya unyw'a na mbingi syasyo sietae utaniuthyo wa masyitwa me nguma (mbeeni vyu ila nene sithyulukite ukuvini wa Albuquerque na Santa Fe).
translation: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: O na vamwe na uu, vakuvi kundu kwa uthauka mathau ma usinda mbesa kw'onthe kuu kuandikitwe vaa iulu nikunenganae syindu sya unyw'a na mbingi syasyo sietae utaniuthyo wa masyitwa me nguma (mbeeni vyu ila nene sithyulukite ukuvini wa Albuquerque na Santa Fe).
translation: Walakini, karibu kasino zote zilizoorodheshwa hapo juu hutoa vinywaji, na kadhaa huleta chapa tajika za burudani (kimsingi zile kubwa zinazozingira Albukuku na Santa Fe moja kwa moja).

text: Isuvie: Mbaa sya misyi minini vaa siyithiangaa kundu kuseo kwa mueni wa nza wa musyi kuthumuila.
translation: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Isuvie: Mbaa sya misyi minini vaa siyithiangaa kundu kuseo kwa mueni wa nza wa musyi kuthumuila.
translation: Jihadhari: Baa za mji mdogo hapa sio mahali pazuri kwa mgeni wa nje ya nchi kutangamana.

text: Kindu kimwi, northern New Mexico yina thina wa alevi kutwaa ngali na ukwatii wa ndeleva inyuite wi yulu nundu wa ilavu nini kũ taoni.
translation: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Kindu kimwi, northern New Mexico yina thina wa alevi kutwaa ngali na ukwatii wa ndeleva inyuite wi yulu nundu wa ilavu nini kũ taoni.
translation: Kwa jambo moja, kaskazini mwa New Meksiko mna shida kubwa ya uendeshaji gari kwa ulevi, na idadi kubwa ya madereva walevi iko karibu sana na baa za miji midogo.

text: Murals ite vata kana scribble syisikie ta grafiti.
translation: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Murals ite vata kana scribble syisikie ta grafiti.
translation: Michoro ya kuta au maandishi yasiyotakikana yanajulikana kama grafiti.

text: Liu wa Hangi uwiawa yiimani ivyu yi muthangani.
translation: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Liu wa Hangi uwiawa yiimani ivyu yi muthangani.

text: Yiima yithwaa yikiitwe uvyuvu ni mavia methwaa mavivitw'e ni mwaki, kana kundu kungi uvyuvu wa ngyiothamo ula utumaa muthanga withwa wi muvyu.

text: Hangi mũno mũno ĩtũmĩkaa kũua lĩu wa kĩtene wa ũvĩvy'a waũya wĩyoo.

text: MetroRaĩl yĩna ĩlasĩ ĩle sya ngalĩ sya mwakĩ ĩla ĩtũmĩa sĩtĩma nthĩnĩ na nza ya Cape Town: Metroplũs (ĩla ongĩ yitawa kĩlasĩ kya mbee) na Metro (oĩla ĩngĩ yitawa kĩlasĩ kya katatũ).
translation: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroRaĩl yĩna ĩlasĩ ĩle sya ngalĩ sya mwakĩ ĩla ĩtũmĩa sĩtĩma nthĩnĩ na nza ya Cape Town: Metroplũs (ĩla ongĩ yitawa kĩlasĩ kya mbee) na Metro (oĩla ĩngĩ yitawa kĩlasĩ kya katatũ).
translation: MetroRail ina daraja mbili katika treni za abiria ndani na karibu na Cape Town: MetroPlus (pia huitwa Daraja la Kwanza) na Metro (huitwa Daraja la Tatu).

text: Metroplus yi kavaa na yii andu aingi indi ndivi yake yi iulu va nini, ona vala no munini kute tikiti sya kawaita sya metro Europe.
translation: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Metroplus yi kavaa na yii andu aingi indi ndivi yake yi iulu va nini, ona vala no munini kute tikiti sya kawaita sya metro Europe.
translation: MetroPlus ina starehe zaidi na haina msongamano lakini ni ya bei ghali kiasi, ingawa bado ni ya bei ya chini kuliko tiketi za kawaida za reli huko Uropa.

text: Kila ngali ya mwaki yi makumbi ma Metroplus na Metro. Makumbi ma Metroplus methiawa mwiso wa ngali ya mwaki vakuvi na Cape Town.
translation: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Kila ngali ya mwaki yi makumbi ma Metroplus na Metro. Makumbi ma Metroplus methiawa mwiso wa ngali ya mwaki vakuvi na Cape Town.
translation: Kila treni ina kochi za MetroPlus na Metro; kila wakati kochi za MetroPlus huwa katika upande wa treni ulioko karibu na Cape Town.

text: Kukuia angi - Ndukaatate muvuko waku ueke uwona, muno muno ila uukilanilya mivaka ya nthi yonthe.

translation: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

translation: Kwa wale wasioelewa lugha ya kimatibabu, jina maambukuzi na kuambukizwa yana maana tofauti.

text: Uwau wa kutamba na mituki ni ula uetawe ni tusamu twa kuete mowau, tumwe ta vailasi, mbakitilia, kuvu kana valasaiti ingi.
translation: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Uwau wa kutamba na mituki ni ula uetawe ni tusamu twa kuete mowau, tumwe ta vailasi, mbakitilia, kuvu kana valasaiti ingi.
translation: Ugonjwa wenye maambukizi ni ule unaosababishwa na pathojeni, kama vile kirusi, bakteria, kuvu au vimelea wengine.

text: Uwau uu ni ula ukwatanawa kwa kwitha vandu pamwe na mundu muwau.

translation: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Myaka 20 mithelu, kiwango kya nzia sya kwikala na kana nesa kuu Uptown Charlotte niyongelekete.
