translation: Katika miaka 20 iliyopita, kiasi machaguo yenye kuwapendeza watoto huko Uptown Charlotte yamekuwa yakiongezeka.

text: Ngali sya ukui situumiika muno ni familia nthini wa Charlotte, onaketha nitonya utumika mavinda angi.
translation: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ngali sya ukui situumiika muno ni familia nthini wa Charlotte, onaketha nitonya utumika mavinda angi.
translation: Kwa jumla teksi hutumiwa na familia katika Charlotte, ingawa zinaweza kutumika kiasi katika hali fulani.

text: Nĩvethaa na wongelekũ wa mbĩvya kwondũ wa kwĩtha na akũwa mbee wa elĩ, kwooũ kĩĩ nokĩthe kĩmbesa mbĩngĩ kũvita ũndũ vaĩle.
translation: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Nĩvethaa na wongelekũ wa mbĩvya kwondũ wa kwĩtha na akũwa mbee wa elĩ, kwooũ kĩĩ nokĩthe kĩmbesa mbĩngĩ kũvita ũndũ vaĩle.
translation: Kuna kuongeza fedha za ziada kwa kuwa na abiria zaidi ya 2, kwa hivyo chaguo hili linaweza kuwa ghali kuliko inavyohitajika.

text: Antarctica nivo vandu vathithu vyu nthi yonthe, na ithyuukite kitui kya Itheo.
translation: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Antarctica nivo vandu vathithu vyu nthi yonthe, na ithyuukite kitui kya Itheo.
translation: Antaktika ndio mahali baridi zaidi Duniani na huzunguka Nguzo la Kusini.

text: Ndembea sya ki utalii syi thooa muno, syendaa kwithiwa sawa mwiini, sitonya o kwikika ivinda ya syua Nwei wa Ikumi na umwe kuthi mwei wa ikumi na ili, na kwa uasa sitonya o kwithiwa Peninsula.
translation: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ndembea sya ki utalii syi thooa muno, syendaa kwithiwa sawa mwiini, sitonya o kwikika ivinda ya syua Nwei wa Ikumi na umwe kuthi mwei wa ikumi na ili, na kwa uasa sitonya o kwithiwa Peninsula.
translation: Ziara za watalii ni za gharama kubwa, zinahitaji usawa wa kimwili, zinaweza kufanyika tu katika msimu wa joto wa Novemba-Februari, na kwa njia kubwa zinafanyika tu Peninsula, Visiwani na Bahari ya Ross.

text: Makili kauta ma athukumi nimekalaa vaa yila kuvyu ituo ta ndasani kauta isioni iia; no anini mekalaa vaa ila kuthithu.
translation: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Makili kauta ma athukumi nimekalaa vaa yila kuvyu ituo ta ndasani kauta isioni iia; no anini mekalaa vaa ila kuthithu.
translation: Maelfu machache ya wafanyakazi huishi hapa wakati wa kiangazi kwenye dazeni nne za makazi aghalabu katika maeneo hayo; idadi ndogo hukaa wakati wa msimu wa baridi.

text: Inland Antarctica ni uinyi wi weka ula wina ĩa ya kilomita 2-3.
translation: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Inland Antarctica ni uinyi wi weka ula wina ĩa ya kilomita 2-3.
translation: Bara la Antaktiki ni jangwa la ukiwa lililofunikwa na kilomita 2-3 za barafu.

text: Andũ ma kũtongeasya savalĩ sya nzeve saa ĩmwe nĩmatembea mĩthanganĩ, nĩngenda malĩse ĩĩma kana, ĩla yĩthaa na kĩwanza kĩnene.
translation: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Andũ ma kũtongeasya savalĩ sya nzeve saa ĩmwe nĩmatembea mĩthanganĩ, nĩngenda malĩse ĩĩma kana, ĩla yĩthaa na kĩwanza kĩnene.
translation: Safari za anga za mara kwa mara za wataalam huenda bara, kwa upandaji milima au kufikia Nchani, ambayo ina msingi mkubwa.

text: Laini wa ngaliko ya itheo wisile (kana lelu munene) ni wa kilomita 1600 kuma McMurdo kuu Ross Sea kuthi lainini.
translation: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Laini wa ngaliko ya itheo wisile (kana lelu munene) ni wa kilomita 1600 kuma McMurdo kuu Ross Sea kuthi lainini.
translation: Njia ya Ncha ya Kusini (au Barabara Kuu) ni njia yenye urefu wa kilomita 1600 kutoka Kituo cha McMurdo katika Bahari ya Ross hadi kwenye ncha.

text: Ni ia ikwatene yina crevasses na imakitwe ni ivevelo. Ikuwa ni matinga vulani makua mauta na mali ingi.
translation: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Ni ia ikwatene yina crevasses na imakitwe ni ivevelo. Ikuwa ni matinga vulani makua mauta na mali ingi.
translation: Ni theluji iliyoshikanishwa na mianya kuzibwa ndani na kuwekwa alama ya bendera. Inaweza kusafiriwa tu na matrekta maalum, magari ya kukokota kwenye theluji yenye mafuta na vifaa.

text: Ii ti mbuthu muno kwoou nzia ni nginya iiname kwa kilungu kiasa kithyululuni kya iima sya Transantarctic ni kaa ivike weuni.
translation: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ii ti mbuthu muno kwoou nzia ni nginya iiname kwa kilungu kiasa kithyululuni kya iima sya Transantarctic ni kaa ivike weuni.
translation: Hizi si nyepesi sana kwa hivyo inabidi treni kuchukua mzunguko mrefu katika Milima ya Transantarctic ili kuja kwenye tambarare.

text: Kitumi kila kinene kya mbanga ivindani ya mbua ni malelu meusiiuuka, tusila twa kwisila (kutembeela) na muno muno matambya.
translation: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Kitumi kila kinene kya mbanga ivindani ya mbua ni malelu meusiiuuka, tusila twa kwisila (kutembeela) na muno muno matambya.
translation: Sababu ya kawaida zaidi ya ajali katika msimu wa baridi ni barabara, lami (vijia vya kando) na hasa ngazi zenye utelezi.

text: Nthĩ vyũ, nĩwendaa siatũ syĩna nginya-nthĩ mbaĩlu. Siatũ sya ĩvindanĩ ya syũa syĩthĩawa syũ ndendeu mũno ĩũlũ wa mbalavu na ĩa, o na mbuti imwe sya ĩvindanĩ ya ũthithu ti mbĩanu.
translation: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Nthĩ vyũ, nĩwendaa siatũ syĩna nginya-nthĩ mbaĩlu. Siatũ sya ĩvindanĩ ya syũa syĩthĩawa syũ ndendeu mũno ĩũlũ wa mbalavu na ĩa, o na mbuti imwe sya ĩvindanĩ ya ũthithu ti mbĩanu.
translation: Kwa kiwango cha chini, unahitaji viatu vilivyo na nyayo zinazofaa. Viatu vya kiangazi kwa kawaida huwa telezi sana katika barafu na theluji, hata buti za baridi zina upungufu.

text: Vatani yaile ithwa yi ndiku kiasi, 5mm (1/5 inzi) kana mbingi, na I ngua yi mbuthu kiasi ila kuthithu.
translation: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Vatani yaile ithwa yi ndiku kiasi, 5mm (1/5 inzi) kana mbingi, na I ngua yi mbuthu kiasi ila kuthithu.
translation: Ruwaza hiyo inapaswa kuwa na kina kirefu, milimita 5 (inchi 1/5) au zaidi, na nyenzo laini za kutosha katika hali ya baridi.

text: Mbuti imwe syithwaa na misumaa na ingi syongelawa misumaa nundu wa kusiuuka, ni nzeo kwa iatu na mbuti mbingi, kwa itiinyo na solo.
translation: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Mbuti imwe syithwaa na misumaa na ingi syongelawa misumaa nundu wa kusiuuka, ni nzeo kwa iatu na mbuti mbingi, kwa itiinyo na solo.
translation: Baadhi ya buti zina hazama na kuna zana za nyongeza zilizo na hazama kwa hali telezi, zinazofaa kwa viatu na buti nyingi, kwa kisigino au kisigino na wayo.

text: Itiinyo syaile ithwa ite ndũlu na syi nthanthau. Kithangathi, nglaveli kana munyu (calcium chloride) nunyaiikaw'a leluni kana tusilani nikenda vai kethwe na kusiiuka.
translation: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Itiinyo syaile ithwa ite ndũlu na syi nthanthau. Kithangathi, nglaveli kana munyu (calcium chloride) nunyaiikaw'a leluni kana tusilani nikenda vai kethwe na kusiiuka.
translation: Viatu vya juu vinafaa kua chini na pana.Mchanga, kokoto au chumvi (Kloridi kalsiamu) mara nyingi hupatikana zimetawanyika kwenye barabara na njia ili kuboresha msuguano.

text: Ilungu sya ia ti undu ute wa kawaita; ivauuko nene ikuaa ia yianiie, na yila yingi yiithea kuu nthi ta ilungu isu.
translation: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Ilungu sya ia ti undu ute wa kawaita; ivauuko nene ikuaa ia yianiie, na yila yingi yiithea kuu nthi ta ilungu isu.
translation: Maporomoko ya theluji si uhitilafiani wa kawaida; mteremko mkali unaweza kushikilia theluji kiwango fulani, na viwango vya ziada vitashuka kama maporomoko ya theluji.

text: Thĩna nĩ kana ĩa yĩthaa yĩ ĩkwatanũ, nana yendaa kũthĩngĩthwa nĩ kana yĩtĩke, na ĩa yĩmwe ĩyĩtĩka yo mbene no yĩtũme yĩngĩ ĩyĩtĩka.
translation: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Thĩna nĩ kana ĩa yĩthaa yĩ ĩkwatanũ, nana yendaa kũthĩngĩthwa nĩ kana yĩtĩke, na ĩa yĩmwe ĩyĩtĩka yo mbene no yĩtũme yĩngĩ ĩyĩtĩka.
translation: Tatizo ni kwamba theluji ni danganyifu, kwa hivyo inahitaji kuanzishwa ili iteremke, na kuteremka kwa theluji kidogo huenda kukawa tukio la kuanzisha iliyobaki.

text: Saa ingi undu ula wambiiasya ni ila sua yeekia muutia muumbi, saa ingi ni muumbi kwitika, saa ingi syindu ingi sya nature, muno mundu.
translation: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Saa ingi undu ula wambiiasya ni ila sua yeekia muutia muumbi, saa ingi ni muumbi kwitika, saa ingi syindu ingi sya nature, muno mundu.
translation: Wakati mwingine tukio asilia linalochochea ni jua kupasha joto theluji, wakati mwingine kuanguka zaidi kwa theluji, wakati mwingine matukio ya asili, mara nyingi binadamu.

text: Kĩuutani ni kilinge cha nzeve nyina vinya mũnini ila ikusasya nzeve nthini na iũlu.
translation: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Kĩuutani ni kilinge cha nzeve nyina vinya mũnini ila ikusasya nzeve nthini na iũlu.
translation: Tufani ni safuwima inayozunguka iliyo na presha ya chini sana ya hewa, ambayo hufyonza hewa ya karibu ndani na juu.

text: Syithwaa na kivese ki iulu (muno maili 100-200 kwa isaa) na iyukilya syindu ngito kuthi kiseeveni, ikuitwe ta undu kilingi kikuaa.
translation: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Syithwaa na kivese ki iulu (muno maili 100-200 kwa isaa) na iyukilya syindu ngito kuthi kiseeveni, ikuitwe ta undu kilingi kikuaa.
translation: Wanafanyiza upepo (mara nyingi maili 100-200 kwa saa) na kuinua vitu vizito hewani, kubeba kama vile chemchela.

text: Syambiia ta ilinge syitheete na syiitwika ĩuutani syakwata nthi.
translation: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Syambiia ta ilinge syitheete na syiitwika ĩuutani syakwata nthi.
translation: Huanza kama faneli zinazoshuka kutoka kwenye mawingu ya dhoruba, na yakawa tufani yanapogusa ardhi."

text: Andũ ala manenganaa VPN (mitandao ya ũneenĩ kwa kĩmbĩthĩ) nĩ nzĩa nzeo ya kũmanya ngewa ila sya siasa ivithawa andũ na tavia ya kũsiĩa maũneenĩ ma mũtandao kũlĩngana na kĩsio.
translation: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Andũ ala manenganaa VPN (mitandao ya ũneenĩ kwa kĩmbĩthĩ) nĩ nzĩa nzeo ya kũmanya ngewa ila sya siasa ivithawa andũ na tavia ya kũsiĩa maũneenĩ ma mũtandao kũlĩngana na kĩsio.
translation: Watoaji wa VPN (mtandao pepe wa kibinafsi) ya kibinafsi ni njia bora ya kukwepa uzuiaji wa kisiasa na uchujaji wa kibiashara wa IP kulingana na eneo.

text: Syi kiwango kiyiulu kwi kompyuta muvai wa prokisi: Nitumaa ingi mauvoo asu ngali syi kivathyukany'o, ti http yoka.
translation: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Syi kiwango kiyiulu kwi kompyuta muvai wa prokisi: Nitumaa ingi mauvoo asu ngali syi kivathyukany'o, ti http yoka.
translation: Ni bora kuliko wakala wa tovuti kwa sababu kadhaa: Huelekeza upya trafiki yote ya intaneti, si http pekee.

text: Kawaita nimanenganaa kilungi kinene na wia museo. Syithwaa syina vasiwati ukethia vai kukunikilwa.
translation: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Kawaita nimanenganaa kilungi kinene na wia museo. Syithwaa syina vasiwati ukethia vai kukunikilwa.
translation: Kwa kawaida huwa wanatoa upana wa bendi wa juu na huduma bora zaidi. Wamesimbwa kwa hivyo ni vigumu kuwapeleleza.

text: Kambuni sya mauvoo kaingi ni'ikenganaa iulu wa kieleelo kya uu, makasya kana ni "kisiia kuyw'a kwauvoo."
translation: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Kambuni sya mauvoo kaingi ni'ikenganaa iulu wa kieleelo kya uu, makasya kana ni "kisiia kuyw'a kwauvoo."
translation: Kampuni za midia daima hudanganya kuhusu madhumuni ya hili, zikidai kwamba ni kwa "kuzuia uharamu".

text: Na w'o, ndini syiina kindu kwa kuyiia kutekwitikilithye ni miao; kuyiia o va nini kwa disk nuithwa wi sawa kwa kila kindu vala kila oringyinoo kisawa.
translation: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Na w'o, ndini syiina kindu kwa kuyiia kutekwitikilithye ni miao; kuyiia o va nini kwa disk nuithwa wi sawa kwa kila kindu vala kila oringyinoo kisawa.
translation: Kwa kweli, misimbo ya mikoa hazina athari kabisa kwa unakilishaji haramu; nakala ndogo ndogo za diski zitacheza tu vizuri kwenye kifaa chochote kinachocheza nakala halisi.

text: Kielelo kinene ni kunenga kambani isu vinya munenange iulu wa ndunyu syoo; monthe no iulu wa kuthyuua mbesa.
translation: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Kielelo kinene ni kunenga kambani isu vinya munenange iulu wa ndunyu syoo; monthe no iulu wa kuthyuua mbesa.
translation: Lengo halisi ni kuzipatia kampuni hizo udhibiti zaidi wa masoko yake; yote ni kuhusu kutengeneza pesa.

text: Nundu kukuna simu kwithwaa kukwatanithitw'e na indaneti, vai vata wa kutumia simu ya kambuni vala wikalaa kana vala uutembea.
translation: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Nundu kukuna simu kwithwaa kukwatanithitw'e na indaneti, vai vata wa kutumia simu ya kambuni vala wikalaa kana vala uutembea.
translation: Kwa sababu simu hupitishwa kwenye intaneti, huhitaji kutumia kampuni ya simu iliyo mahali unakoishi au unakosafiri.

text: Vai mwao wa kumanya utalo wa nadu kuma kisioni ki ukwikala; no ukwate satellite internet kithekani kwa nguku, Alaska na uisakua namba ila ui wi Arizona ya sua.
translation: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Vai mwao wa kumanya utalo wa nadu kuma kisioni ki ukwikala; no ukwate satellite internet kithekani kwa nguku, Alaska na uisakua namba ila ui wi Arizona ya sua.
translation: Pia hakuna sharti kwamba upate nambari ya kienyeji kutoka kwa jamii unakoishi; unaweza kupata unganisho la mtandao wa satelaiti kwenye porini ya Chicken, Alaska na uchague nambari inayodai uko katika Arizona yenye jua.

text: Mavinda maingi, wailwe ni kuua namba ya nthi yonthe utee ila itumaa simu sya PSTN syukunia we simu. Vala namba isu yumite nivo vethwaa ve kivathukany'o undu andu meukukunia.
translation: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Mavinda maingi, wailwe ni kuua namba ya nthi yonthe utee ila itumaa simu sya PSTN syukunia we simu. Vala namba isu yumite nivo vethwaa ve kivathukany'o undu andu meukukunia.
translation: Mara nyingi, unafaa kununua kando nambari ya kimataifa ambayo inakubali simu za PSTN kukupigia. Mahali nambari hiyo imetoka huleta tofauti kwa watu wanaokupigia.

text: Apps sya kualyula kwa ivinda ya kiiki- applications ila syithwaa itonya kwalyula segmendi nima ya ndeto kuma kithyomo kimwe kuthi kíngí.
translation: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Apps sya kualyula kwa ivinda ya kiiki- applications ila syithwaa itonya kwalyula segmendi nima ya ndeto kuma kithyomo kimwe kuthi kíngí.
translation: Programu za utafsiri wa matini kwa wakati halisi – programu-tumizi ambazo zina uwezo wa kutafsiri sehemu nzima za matini kutoka lugha moja kwa nyingine kiotomatiki.

text: Ĩmwe sya mboya nthĩnĩ wa kĩlungu kĩĩ ona no syalyule maandĩko ma ithyomo sya nthi sya nza kuthi syonany'o kana syindu ingĩ kwa maũndũnĩ ma w'o ila mutumii wolootelya simu yake kwi syindu isu.
translation: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Ĩmwe sya mboya nthĩnĩ wa kĩlungu kĩĩ ona no syalyule maandĩko ma ithyomo sya nthi sya nza kuthi syonany'o kana syindu ingĩ kwa maũndũnĩ ma w'o ila mutumii wolootelya simu yake kwi syindu isu.
translation: Baadhi ya programu-tumizi katika kategoria hii zinaweza hata kutafsiri matini ya lugha za kigeni kwenye vibao vya ishara au vitu vingine katika dunia halisi wakati mtumiaji anapoelekeza simu maizi kwenye vitu hivyo.

text: Ingyini sya kualyula nisiendee nesa kwanza, nayu syithwaa na kualyula kwa w'o (na kusany'a kute kwingi), ateo kumwe ni kusuviiku, nundu saa ingi nosyithwe ite sya uw'o.
translation: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Ingyini sya kualyula nisiendee nesa kwanza, nayu syithwaa na kualyula kwa w'o (na kusany'a kute kwingi), ateo kumwe ni kusuviiku, nundu saa ingi nosyithwe ite sya uw'o.
translation: Injini za utafsiri zimeimarika sana, na sasa mara nyingi hutoa tafsiri inayokaribia usahihi (na kawaida huwa si upuzi), lakini umakini unahitajika, kwani zinaweza kuwa zimekosea kabisa.

text: Apps imwe ila syi nguma kwa ngaliko ii ni Google Translate, ila itumaa utumia kualyula ona ute mutandaoni ila wa ndaoloondi ndata ya kithyomo.
translation: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Apps imwe ila syi nguma kwa ngaliko ii ni Google Translate, ila itumaa utumia kualyula ona ute mutandaoni ila wa ndaoloondi ndata ya kithyomo.
translation: Mojawapo ya programu maarufu sana katika kategoria hii ni Google Translate, ambayo huruhusu utafsiri nje ya mtandao baada ya kupakua data ya lugha inayotakikana.

text: Kũtũmĩa ũtethyo wa ũmanya nzĩa wa GPS nthĩnĩ wa simu yaku no yĩthĩwe no my'o nzĩa mbũthũ na nzeo ya ũmanya nzĩa yĩla wĩ nza wa nthĩ yaku.
translation: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Kũtũmĩa ũtethyo wa ũmanya nzĩa wa GPS nthĩnĩ wa simu yaku no yĩthĩwe no my'o nzĩa mbũthũ na nzeo ya ũmanya nzĩa yĩla wĩ nza wa nthĩ yaku.
translation: Kutumia programu za kuabiri za GPS kwenye rununu yako kunaweza kuwa njia rahisi na bora ya kuabiri ukiwa nje ya nchi yako.

text: Nikusuvia mbesa kwa kuthooa mavu nzau kwi GPS, kana kamaasini ka GPS kekoka kana kukomboa imwe kuma kwa kampuni sya ngali.
translation: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Nikusuvia mbesa kwa kuthooa mavu nzau kwi GPS, kana kamaasini ka GPS kekoka kana kukomboa imwe kuma kwa kampuni sya ngali.
translation: Inaweza kuokoa pesa badala ya kununua ramani mpya za GPS, au kifaa cha GPS kinachojisimamia au kukodisha kimoja kutoka kwa kampuni ya kukodisha magari.

text: Kethwa ndwina ndata kwa simu yaku, kana ila yi vaasa, muthukumile nutonya ithwa ute museo kana utevo.
translation: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kethwa ndwina ndata kwa simu yaku, kana ila yi vaasa, muthukumile nutonya ithwa ute museo kana utevo.
translation: Ikiwa huna muunganisho wa data kwa simu yako, au ikiwa mbali na masafa, utendakazi wake utakwazika au hautakuwepo.

text: Kila nduka yi konani yithiawa na namba mbingi ya kulanithya ya kaati sya simu sya kuivia ila itonya kutumiwa ni simu sya jamii kana ila sya kawaita.
translation: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Kila nduka yi konani yithiawa na namba mbingi ya kulanithya ya kaati sya simu sya kuivia ila itonya kutumiwa ni simu sya jamii kana ila sya kawaita.
translation: Kila duka la karibu limejawa na aina nyingi za kukanganya za kadi za simu za kulipia kabla ambazo zinaweza kutumika katika simu za kulipia au simu za kawaida.

text: Kwaĩngĩ, kaadĩ mbĩngĩ syĩtha sye nzeo kwa kwitana kĩla vandũ, ĩmwe nĩ nengana kotĩ mũseo wa kũkũna sĩmũ ĩkũndĩ ĩmwe sya nthĩ.
translation: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Kwaĩngĩ, kaadĩ mbĩngĩ syĩtha sye nzeo kwa kwitana kĩla vandũ, ĩmwe nĩ nengana kotĩ mũseo wa kũkũna sĩmũ ĩkũndĩ ĩmwe sya nthĩ.
translation: Huku kadi nyingi zikiwa nzuri kwa kupiga simu kila mahali, nyingine ni maalumu kwa kutoa gharama za chini za kupiga simu kwa vikundi mahususi vya mataifa.

text: Ni kenda kukwata tethyo uu mundu nu kunaa simu namba ite ndivi ila itonya kukunwa ni simu mbingi.
translation: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Ni kenda kukwata tethyo uu mundu nu kunaa simu namba ite ndivi ila itonya kukunwa ni simu mbingi.
translation: Ufikiaji wa huduma hizi mara nyingi ni kupitia nambari ya simu isiyolipishwa ambayo inaweza kupigwa kutoka simu nyingi bila malipo.

text: Miao ila iatiiawa kukuna visa sya kawaita ingi noyo iatiiawa kwosya vitio, navatonyeka ona muno.
translation: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Miao ila iatiiawa kukuna visa sya kawaita ingi noyo iatiiawa kwosya vitio, navatonyeka ona muno.
translation: Kanuni kuhusu upigaji picha za kawaida pia hutumika kwa kurekodi video, pengine hata zaidi.

text: Kethwa kukuna visa ya kindu kuyitikilithitw'e, ndwaile indi o na usuania kwosa vindio ya kyo.
translation: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Kethwa kukuna visa ya kindu kuyitikilithitw'e, ndwaile indi o na usuania kwosa vindio ya kyo.
translation: Ikiwa kupiga picha ya kitu tu hakuruhusiwi, basi hupaswi hata kufikiria kurekodi video yake.

text: Ketha wĩtũmĩa tũteka twa kwosa vĩsa sĩsya tene syĩndũ ĩla syĩtĩkĩlĩtwe na na valũa ũla wĩkwendeka.
translation: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ketha wĩtũmĩa tũteka twa kwosa vĩsa sĩsya tene syĩndũ ĩla syĩtĩkĩlĩtwe na na valũa ũla wĩkwendeka.
translation: Ikiwa unatumia ndege-roboti, angalia mapema ni nini unachoruhusiwa kuchukua filamu yake na ni vibali au leseni gani za ziada zinazohitajika.

text: Kutwaa kamela ya drone vakuvi na kiwanza kya ndeke kana iulu wa nguthu ya andu ni ivindiisya ithuku, o na ethiwa ti kutula miao vala wikalaa.
translation: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Kutwaa kamela ya drone vakuvi na kiwanza kya ndeke kana iulu wa nguthu ya andu ni ivindiisya ithuku, o na ethiwa ti kutula miao vala wikalaa.
translation: Kurusha kidege-roboti karibu na uwanja wa ndege juu ya umati wa watu ni wazo mbaya karibu kila wakati, hata kama si haramu katika eneo lako.

text: Matuku aa kũthi ndambũka na ndeke kũimbukiawa muno kwisila kwa I ndeke vate kulianilya ndivi yasyo.
translation: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Matuku aa kũthi ndambũka na ndeke kũimbukiawa muno kwisila kwa I ndeke vate kulianilya ndivi yasyo.
translation: Siku hizi usafiri wa ndege huhifadhiwa moja kwa moja mara chache kupitia kampuni ya ndege bila kwanza kutafuta na kulinganisha bei.

text: Saa ingi o ndeke isu imwe niyithwaa na mathooa kivathukany'o kundu kwingi na nuseo ukamba umantha kwa mutandao woo wa ndeke utanamba umbuku.
translation: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Saa ingi o ndeke isu imwe niyithwaa na mathooa kivathukany'o kundu kwingi na nuseo ukamba umantha kwa mutandao woo wa ndeke utanamba umbuku.
translation: Wakati mwingine safari moja inaweza kuwa na bei zinazotofautiana sana katika wajumuishaji tofauti na ina faida kulinganisha matokeo ya utafutaji na pia kuangalia tovuti ya kampuni ya ndege yenyewe kabla ya kuhifadhi.

text: O na kau no withiwe utena vata wa valua wa kwitikilya kulika nthi imwe ta mutalii kana ki viasala, kuthi kuu ta musomi wa nthi sya nza kwendaa kwikala munango kwi kuthi ta mutalii wa kawaita.
translation: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: O na kau no withiwe utena vata wa valua wa kwitikilya kulika nthi imwe ta mutalii kana ki viasala, kuthi kuu ta musomi wa nthi sya nza kwendaa kwikala munango kwi kuthi ta mutalii wa kawaita.
translation: Wakati huenda usihitaji visa kwa ziara fupi katika nchi fulani kama mtalii au kwa biashara, kwenda huko kama mwanafunzi wa kimataifa kwa jumla kunahitaji kukaa kwa muda mrefu kuliko kwenda huko kama mtalii wa kawaida tu.

text: Kwa vamwe, kwĩkala nthĩ ya ũenĩnĩ kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasanga yĩenda wose vĩsa tene.
translation: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Kwa vamwe, kwĩkala nthĩ ya ũenĩnĩ kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasanga yĩenda wose vĩsa tene.
translation: Kwa ujumla, kukaa kwenye nchi ya kigeni kwa muda mrefu zaidi kunahitaji upate visa mapema.

text: Visa sya asomi syithwaa na miao kivathukany'o na nzia ya kuaplai kivathukany'o na atalii ma kawaita kana visa sya viasala.
translation: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Visa sya asomi syithwaa na miao kivathukany'o na nzia ya kuaplai kivathukany'o na atalii ma kawaita kana visa sya viasala.
translation: Kwa jumla visa za wanafunzi huwa na mahitaji na utaratibu wa maombi tofauti na visa za kawaida za kitalii au kibiashara.

text: Nthi mbingi, ũkethiwa ũyendeka withe na valua kuma sukulu ula wasomeaa na ingi ũikiithyo kana ukatonya kuiyungamia mwaka waku wa mbee wi sukulu.
translation: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Nthi mbingi, ũkethiwa ũyendeka withe na valua kuma sukulu ula wasomeaa na ingi ũikiithyo kana ukatonya kuiyungamia mwaka waku wa mbee wi sukulu.
translation: Kwa nchi nyingi, utahitaji barua ya ofa kutoka kwa taasisi ambayo unataka kusomea, na pia ushahidi wa pesa za kujisaidia kwa angalau mwaka wa kwanza wa kozi yako.

text: Kũlya sukuluni, o na kĩsese kya kũthi na kũlika nthĩ sya nza ĩũlũ wa nthĩ ĩla ũkwenda kũsomea nũndũ wa ũmanya syĩndũ ila sikwendekana.
translation: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Kũlya sukuluni, o na kĩsese kya kũthi na kũlika nthĩ sya nza ĩũlũ wa nthĩ ĩla ũkwenda kũsomea nũndũ wa ũmanya syĩndũ ila sikwendekana.
translation: Angalia katika taasisi, vilevile idara ya uhamiaji ya nchi ambako unahitaji kusomea kwa mahitaji ya kina.

text: Anilesi withwe wi ndivlomati, kuthukuma nthi sya nza ve mini ukausuasya koti kwianana na nthi ila ukwikala.
translation: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Anilesi withwe wi ndivlomati, kuthukuma nthi sya nza ve mini ukausuasya koti kwianana na nthi ila ukwikala.
translation: Isipokuwa kama wewe ni mwanadiplomasia, kufanya kazi ughaibuni kwa jumla humaanisha kwamba utalazimika kufaili ushuru wa mapato nchini uliko.

text: Koti wa ukwati withwaa wi kivathukany'o kwa nthi kivathukany'o, na rate sya koti na vala ivikite syikivathukany'o vyu kuma nthi kuthi ingi.
translation: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Koti wa ukwati withwaa wi kivathukany'o kwa nthi kivathukany'o, na rate sya koti na vala ivikite syikivathukany'o vyu kuma nthi kuthi ingi.
translation: Ushuru wa mapato huundwa kwa njia tofauti katika nchi tofauti, na viwango na vikundi vya ushuru hutofautiana pakubwa toka nchi moja hadi nyingine.

text: Nthi imwe sya silikali nini, ta United States na Canada, koti wa ukwati utilawa ni silikali nene na silikali ya isioni kwoou uthiaa wi undu umwe.
translation: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Nthi imwe sya silikali nini, ta United States na Canada, koti wa ukwati utilawa ni silikali nene na silikali ya isioni kwoou uthiaa wi undu umwe.
translation: Katika baadhi ya nchi za shirikisho, kama vile Marekani na Kanada, ushuru wa mapato hutozwa katika ngazi ya shirikisho na pia ngazi ya ndani, kwa hivyo viwango na vikundi vinaweza kutofautiana toka eneo hadi eneo.

text: Ona vala kuisywa kwa kuthama kuyithaa kana o mutalatala ila wavika nthi yaku ya kusyawa, kusuvia syithio nimatonya kwitha me vinya.
translation: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Ona vala kuisywa kwa kuthama kuyithaa kana o mutalatala ila wavika nthi yaku ya kusyawa, kusuvia syithio nimatonya kwitha me vinya.
translation: Wakati kuangaliwa kwa uhamiaji kawaida haupo au ni urasmi ukifika katika nchi yako, udhibiti wa forodha unaweza kuwa shida.

text: Ikiithya kana niwisi kila utonya na kila utatonya na uiweta kila kindu utavita kwa maundu ma miao.
translation: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ikiithya kana niwisi kila utonya na kila utatonya na uiweta kila kindu utavita kwa maundu ma miao.
translation: Hakikisha unajua kile unachoweza na hauwezi kuleta kisha kutangaza kitu chochote juu ya mipaka ya kisheria.

text: Nzia ya laisi ya kulika viasala uu wa kuandika mauvoo ma kutembea ni kandike utonyi waku nthini wa website yisikie ya kutembea.
translation: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Nzia ya laisi ya kulika viasala uu wa kuandika mauvoo ma kutembea ni kandike utonyi waku nthini wa website yisikie ya kutembea.
translation: Njia ilio rahisi kuanza biashara ya uandishi wa usafiri ni kuonyeshana ujuzi wako kwenye tovuti ya blogu ya usafiri iliyo imara.

text: Wamina kwithiwa wimwianie kwa kuandika na kumya makosa nthini wa mutandao, itina, no useuvye mutandao waku.
translation: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Wamina kwithiwa wimwianie kwa kuandika na kumya makosa nthini wa mutandao, itina, no useuvye mutandao waku.
translation: Unaporidhika na umbizo na uhariri kwenye wavuti, basi baadaye, labda utaunda tovuti yako mwenyewe.

text: Kwiyumya utetheesye yila wi savalini ni nzia imwe ya kuete uvinduku indi ti kwa kunengane kwi kw'oka.
translation: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Kwiyumya utetheesye yila wi savalini ni nzia imwe ya kuete uvinduku indi ti kwa kunengane kwi kw'oka.
translation: Kujitolea wakati wa kusafiri ni njia nzuri ya kuleta mabadiliko lakini si kuhusu utoaji tu.

text: Kwikala na kwiyumwa kutethya wia ute ndivi nthi sya nza ni nzia nzeo ya kumanya syithio ingi, kukomana na andu eu, kwimanya, kuelewa miolooto na kunya syindu nzau.
translation: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Kwikala na kwiyumwa kutethya wia ute ndivi nthi sya nza ni nzia nzeo ya kumanya syithio ingi, kukomana na andu eu, kwimanya, kuelewa miolooto na kunya syindu nzau.
translation: Kuishi na kujitolea katika nchi ya kigeni ni njia bora ya kupata kujua utamaduni mpya, kukutana na watu wapya, kujifunza juu yako mwenyewe, kupata hisia za mtazamo na hata kupata ujuzi mpya.

text: Nĩ ũseo kũnenevya mũvango wa mbesa nĩkana athũkũmĩ ma kwĩ yũmya mathũkũme kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasa nũndũ nĩmethaa manengetwe vandũ va ũkoma na leũ na nanĩnĩ maĩvawa mũsaala mũnĩnĩ.
translation: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Nĩ ũseo kũnenevya mũvango wa mbesa nĩkana athũkũmĩ ma kwĩ yũmya mathũkũme kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasa nũndũ nĩmethaa manengetwe vandũ va ũkoma na leũ na nanĩnĩ maĩvawa mũsaala mũnĩnĩ.
translation: Pia inaweza kuwa njia bora ya kupanua bajeti ili kuwezesha kukaa mahali kwa muda mrefu kwani kazi nyingi za kujitolea hutoa vyumba na malazi na baadhi hulipa mshahara kidogo.

text: Ing'endilĩ sya ũkanganĩni syatumiaa nzia sya kiwuni sya Russia kuvika Black Sea na Caspian Sea. Nzia ii imwe no syitumiwe. Syisya kana ve syindu siendeka ni kenda mundu akilanilye ila syi vinya kukwata.
translation: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Ing'endilĩ sya ũkanganĩni syatumiaa nzia sya kiwuni sya Russia kuvika Black Sea na Caspian Sea. Nzia ii imwe no syitumiwe. Syisya kana ve syindu siendeka ni kenda mundu akilanilye ila syi vinya kukwata.
translation: Maharamia wa Skandinavia walitumia njia za majini za Kirusi kufika kwenye Bahari Nyeusi na Bahari ya Kaspi. Sehemu za njia hizo bado zinaweza kutumika. Angalia uwezekano wa kuhitaji vibali maalum, ambavyo huenda ikawa vigumu kuvipata.

text: Mutau wa white Sea-Baltic Canal ukwatanitye ukanga wa Arctic na ula wa Baltic, kwisila silanga wa Onega, Ladoga na ula wa Saint Petersburg, kaingi kwisila mbusi na maia.
translation: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Mutau wa white Sea-Baltic Canal ukwatanitye ukanga wa Arctic na ula wa Baltic, kwisila silanga wa Onega, Ladoga na ula wa Saint Petersburg, kaingi kwisila mbusi na maia.
translation: Mfereji kati ya Bahari Nyeupe na Baltic huunganisha Bahari kuu ya Atiki na Bahari ya Baltic, kupitia Ziwa Onega, Ziwa Ladoga na Saint Petersburg, mara nyingi kwa mito na maziwa.

text: Iia ya Onega no yikwatanitw'e na Volga, kwoou kuma ukangani wa Caspia kwisila Russia no kutonyeke.
translation: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Iia ya Onega no yikwatanitw'e na Volga, kwoou kuma ukangani wa Caspia kwisila Russia no kutonyeke.
translation: Ziwa Onega limeunganishwa na Volga, kwa hivyo bado inawezekana kusafiri kutoka Bahari Caspian kupitia Urusi.

text: Ikiiya kana wavika vala masiwa syingamaa nukwona kila kindu. Ni ukomana na andu angi maendaa na masiwa na ni mekuutavya kila kindu.
translation: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Ikiiya kana wavika vala masiwa syingamaa nukwona kila kindu. Ni ukomana na andu angi maendaa na masiwa na ni mekuutavya kila kindu.
translation: Kuwa na uhakika ya kwamba unapofika bandarini, kila kitu kitakuwa dhahiri. Utapatana na waombajilifti wa machua wengine na watashiriki habari nawewe.

text: Kwa ukuvi wiithwa uyamba mathangũ meonany'a ũtethyo wakũ, wĩsĩlĩte utee wa ũkanga, wĩthĩane na andũ ale meĩthambya masĩwa na ala matwaa masĩwa.
translation: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Kwa ukuvi wiithwa uyamba mathangũ meonany'a ũtethyo wakũ, wĩsĩlĩte utee wa ũkanga, wĩthĩane na andũ ale meĩthambya masĩwa na ala matwaa masĩwa.
translation: Kimsingi utakuwa unaweka matangazo kuhusu msaada wako, kutembea katika gati, kuongelesha watu wanaosafisha mashua zao, kujaribu kuwasiliana na mabaharia kwenye baa, na kadhalika.

text: Kwa tata kũneena na andũ aĩngĩ vyũ ĩndĩ vatonyeka. ĩtina wa ĩvĩnda ĩnĩnĩ kĩla mũndũ nũkũũmanya na aĩkũtavya ĩsĩwa yĩla yĩkũmantha mũndũ.
translation: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Kwa tata kũneena na andũ aĩngĩ vyũ ĩndĩ vatonyeka. ĩtina wa ĩvĩnda ĩnĩnĩ kĩla mũndũ nũkũũmanya na aĩkũtavya ĩsĩwa yĩla yĩkũmantha mũndũ.
translation: Jaribu kuongea na watu wengi iwezekanavyo. Baada ya muda mfupi kila mtu atakujua na watakutolea vidokezo kuhusu ni boti ipi inayotafuta mtu.

text: Waile kusakua kambuni wa ndeke ila ukaulukaa nasyo muno muno kwa ui.
translation: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Waile kusakua kambuni wa ndeke ila ukaulukaa nasyo muno muno kwa ui.
translation: Unafaa kuchagua kampuni ya Usafiri wa Mara Nyingi katika muungano kwa makini.

text: O na vala nowone ta wailu kukomana na ndeke ila utumia kuuluka muno, waile umanya kana moseo ala manenganawa methwaa me kivathukany'o na kundu kwingi kwa flyers kwithwaa na ulau ungu wa ndeke ingi o ngwatanioni imwe.
translation: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: O na vala nowone ta wailu kukomana na ndeke ila utumia kuuluka muno, waile umanya kana moseo ala manenganawa methwaa me kivathukany'o na kundu kwingi kwa flyers kwithwaa na ulau ungu wa ndeke ingi o ngwatanioni imwe.
translation: Ingawa unaweza kudhani ni bora zaidi kujiunga na kampuni ya ndege unayotumia zaidi, unapaswa kujua kuwa marupurupu yanayotolewa mara nyingi ni tofauti na pointi za usafiri wa mara kwa mara huenda zikawa karimu zaidi chini ya kampuni tofauti katika muungano mmoja.

text: Ndeke ta sya Emirates, Etihad, Qatar na Turkish ninenevetye wia woo muno nginya Avilika, na nisiendaa nginya siti ingi nene sya nthi ingi syina ndivi nzeo kuvita ndeke sya European.
translation: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Ndeke ta sya Emirates, Etihad, Qatar na Turkish ninenevetye wia woo muno nginya Avilika, na nisiendaa nginya siti ingi nene sya nthi ingi syina ndivi nzeo kuvita ndeke sya European.
translation: Kampuni za ndege kama vile Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways na Turkish Airlines zimepanua huduma zao pakubwa katika Afrika, na hutoa miunganisho kwenye miji mingi muhimu ya Afrika kwa bei bora kuliko kampuni nyingine za Uingereza.

text: Kambũni ya ndeke ya Turkey yũlũkasya ndeke kũthi kũũndũ 39 nthĩnĩ wa nthĩ 30 sya Avĩlĩka kwĩ mwakanĩ wa 2014.
translation: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Kambũni ya ndeke ya Turkey yũlũkasya ndeke kũthi kũũndũ 39 nthĩnĩ wa nthĩ 30 sya Avĩlĩka kwĩ mwakanĩ wa 2014.
translation: Shirika la ndege la Uturuki hupaa angani kwenda kwa vituo 39 katika nchi 30 za Kiafrika kuanzia mwaka wa 2014.

text: Ketha wĩna masaa angĩ ma kũtembea, sĩanĩsya tĩkĩtĩ wa kũtembea afrĩca na wa nthĩ yonthe.
translation: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Ketha wĩna masaa angĩ ma kũtembea, sĩanĩsya tĩkĩtĩ wa kũtembea afrĩca na wa nthĩ yonthe.
translation: Ikiwa unao wakati wa ziada wa kusafiri, angalia uone jinsi ankarakifani yako ya jumla ya nauli kwenda Afrika inalingana na nauli ya kuuzunguka ulimwengu.

text: Ndukolwe ni kwongeleela ngalama ila yongeleka ya visas, koti wa kukusya, ukua wa nthi, etc. kwa kundu kw'oonthe nza wa Avilika.
translation: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ndukolwe ni kwongeleela ngalama ila yongeleka ya visas, koti wa kukusya, ukua wa nthi, etc. kwa kundu kw'oonthe nza wa Avilika.
translation: Usisahau kuongeza gharama za ziada za visa za ziada, ushuru wa kuondoka, usafiri kwenye ardhi, n.k., kwa sehemu hizo zote nje ya Afrika.

text: Kethwa nukwenda kuuluka nthi yonthe ukomany'e ngaliko ya itheo ya Hemisphere, kusakua ndeke na kundu kula uuthi ni kunini nundu wa unyivu wa nzia sya transoceanic.
translation: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Kethwa nukwenda kuuluka nthi yonthe ukomany'e ngaliko ya itheo ya Hemisphere, kusakua ndeke na kundu kula uuthi ni kunini nundu wa unyivu wa nzia sya transoceanic.
translation: Ikiwa unataka kusafiri kuzunguka ulimwengu katika Kizio cha Kusini, machaguo ya ndege na mahali si mengi kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa ndege zinazosafiri kuvuka bahari.

text: Vai ngwatanio ya ndeke sya ukui yithiawa iikwata ikililo isu itatu sya ukanga ila syi ilembetani ya itheo ya ndunia na SkyTeam ona ndikwataa kimwe kati wa ikililo isu.
translation: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Vai ngwatanio ya ndeke sya ukui yithiawa iikwata ikililo isu itatu sya ukanga ila syi ilembetani ya itheo ya ndunia na SkyTeam ona ndikwataa kimwe kati wa ikililo isu.
translation: Hakuna muungano wa ndege unaohudumia vivukio vyote vitatu vya bahari katika Ulimwengu wa Kusini (na hakuna kivukio ambacho SkyTeam inahudumia).

text: Ona uu wiovo, Star Aliance iungamia kila kindu ateo kwambililya Santiago de Chile nginya Tahiti, ila italikaa ta ya LATAM OneWorld flight.
translation: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Ona uu wiovo, Star Aliance iungamia kila kindu ateo kwambililya Santiago de Chile nginya Tahiti, ila italikaa ta ya LATAM OneWorld flight.
translation: Hata hivyo, Star Alliance hushughulikia kila kitu isipokuwa South Pacific ya mashariki kutoka Santiago de Chile kwenda Tahiti, ambayo ni safari ya LATAM Oneworld.

text: Ndeke ino tiyo twikwetye yiyoka kethwa nukwenda ukila Pacific ya itheo na kosti ya kwoko kwa aka ya itheo wa Amelika. (ona vaa itheo)
translation: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ndeke ino tiyo twikwetye yiyoka kethwa nukwenda ukila Pacific ya itheo na kosti ya kwoko kwa aka ya itheo wa Amelika. (ona vaa itheo)
translation: Safari hii ya ndege siyo chaguo la pekee kama unataka kuruka Pasifiki Kusini na pwani ya magharibi ya Marekani Kusini. (tazama chini)

text: Twi 1994, andu ma kilio kya Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh kisio kya Azerbaijan nimambiisye kau na Azeris.
translation: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Twi 1994, andu ma kilio kya Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh kisio kya Azerbaijan nimambiisye kau na Azeris.
translation: Mnamo 1994, eneo la Azabaijan lililo la Nagorno-Karabakh kikabila lilifanya vita dhidi ya Azeris.

text: Tukwetwe mbau ni andu ma Armeria, nthi ingi niyaakiwe. Ateo vai nthi ndyaaseuvw'a - o na ti Armenia - ila yimesi ovisiali.
translation: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Tukwetwe mbau ni andu ma Armeria, nthi ingi niyaakiwe. Ateo vai nthi ndyaaseuvw'a - o na ti Armenia - ila yimesi ovisiali.
translation: Kwa kuungwa mkono na Armenia, jamhuri mpya iliundwa. Hata hivyo, hakuna nchi thabiti - si hata Armenia - huitambua kirasmi.

text: Ngaananio sya kueta muuo iulu wa kisio kiu syiendee kusiiya wiw'ano kati wa Armenia na Azerbaijan.
translation: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Ngaananio sya kueta muuo iulu wa kisio kiu syiendee kusiiya wiw'ano kati wa Armenia na Azerbaijan.
translation: Hoja za kidiplomasia dhidi ya eneo hilo zinaendelea kutatiza uhusiano kati ya Armenia na Azerbaian.

text: Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) ni kavalo kisikie mũno cha myaka ya 1700 kila kithiiukite Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
translation: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) ni kavalo kisikie mũno cha myaka ya 1700 kila kithiiukite Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
translation: Wilaya ya Canal (Kiholanzi: Grachtengordel) ni wilaya maarufu ya karne ya 17 inayozunguka Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.

text: Kĩsese kyonthe kĩseũvĩtw'e ta vandũ va vata mũno va UNESCO nthĩ yonthe nũndũ wa vata wavo wa mwanya kĩ syĩthĩo na syĩndu na maũndũ ma tene, na thooa wa mĩũnda yaky'o nĩyo ĩmwe katĩ kwa ĩla yĩ ĩũlu vyũ nthĩ ĩsu yonthe.
translation: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Kĩsese kyonthe kĩseũvĩtw'e ta vandũ va vata mũno va UNESCO nthĩ yonthe nũndũ wa vata wavo wa mwanya kĩ syĩthĩo na syĩndu na maũndũ ma tene, na thooa wa mĩũnda yaky'o nĩyo ĩmwe katĩ kwa ĩla yĩ ĩũlu vyũ nthĩ ĩsu yonthe.
translation: Wilaya nzima imeteuliwa kama Pahali pa Urithi wa Shirika la Umoja wa Mataifa la Elimu, Sayansi na Utamaduni kwa thamani yake ya kipekee ya kitamaduni na kihistoria, na thamani yake ya mali ni kati ya zile za juu zaidi ya nchi.

text: Cinque Terre, ila iminia itheka itatu, yithwaa na mautui ma isoa nini itano sya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso ila syi nthini wa ngaliko ya Liguria ya Itali.
translation: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Cinque Terre, ila iminia itheka itatu, yithwaa na mautui ma isoa nini itano sya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso ila syi nthini wa ngaliko ya Liguria ya Itali.
translation: Cinque Terre, yaani Ardhi Tano, ina vijiji vitano vya kipwani vya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza na Monterosso vilivyo katika eneo la Kiitaliano la Liguria.

text: Nĩmbaandĩke nthĩnĩ wa ũtalo wa syĩndũ ila sinengae nthĩ yonthe ndaĩa wa UNESCO.
translation: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Nĩmbaandĩke nthĩnĩ wa ũtalo wa syĩndũ ila sinengae nthĩ yonthe ndaĩa wa UNESCO.
translation: Wameorodheshwa katika Orodha ya Urithi wa Dunia ya UNESCO.

text: Sengyali kauta, andu nimakite mbeinzi mesuvie, ivangalukini nene ing'ethanisye na kundu kutulu ila ila itakulanasya na ukanga.
translation: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Sengyali kauta, andu nimakite mbeinzi mesuvie, ivangalukini nene ing'ethanisye na kundu kutulu ila ila itakulanasya na ukanga.
translation: Kwa karne nyingi, watu walijenga matuta kwa umakini katika mandhari yenye mawemawe na mwinuko hadi kwenye majabali yaliyo juu ya bahari.

text: Ũndũ ũmwe ũla ũendesyaa nĩ kũkosekana kwa maendeeo. Nzĩa sya kũthĩ na maaũ, ngalĩ sya mwakĩ na meli nĩnĩ nyoĩtonya kũtũmĩwa kũtembea kũma ũtũĩ ũmwe kũthĩ ũngĩ.
translation: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Ũndũ ũmwe ũla ũendesyaa nĩ kũkosekana kwa maendeeo. Nzĩa sya kũthĩ na maaũ, ngalĩ sya mwakĩ na meli nĩnĩ nyoĩtonya kũtũmĩwa kũtembea kũma ũtũĩ ũmwe kũthĩ ũngĩ.
translation: Sehemu ya haiba yake ni ukosefu wa maendeleo ya shirika yanayoonekana. Njia, treni na maboti huunganisha vijiji, na magari hayawezi kuvifikia kutoka nje.

text: Mivai ya Kiivalanza kila kineenawa Belgium na Switzerland syi kivathukany'o kiniini na Kiivalanza kila kineenawa ku Uvalanza, indi nivw'anene o muno ukethia no mwiw'ane.
translation: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Mivai ya Kiivalanza kila kineenawa Belgium na Switzerland syi kivathukany'o kiniini na Kiivalanza kila kineenawa ku Uvalanza, indi nivw'anene o muno ukethia no mwiw'ane.
translation: Aina za Kifaransa zinazozungumzwa katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinatofautiana kidogo na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, ingawa zinalingana kiasi cha kueleweka baina yazo.

text: kĩndũ kyũ mwene, mũtambo wa ũandĩkĩ wa namba wa French-tũneenee Belgĩũm na Swĩtzerland wĩna kĩvathũkanyo na french ĩla ĩneenawa France, na mũtamũkĩle wa ndeto ĩmwe wĩna kĩvathũkany'o.
translation: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: kĩndũ kyũ mwene, mũtambo wa ũandĩkĩ wa namba wa French-tũneenee Belgĩũm na Swĩtzerland wĩna kĩvathũkanyo na french ĩla ĩneenawa France, na mũtamũkĩle wa ndeto ĩmwe wĩna kĩvathũkany'o.
translation: Hasa, mfumo wa hesabu katika Ubelgiji na Uswizi zinazozungumza Kifaransa una mambo yasiyo ya kawaida ambayo ni tofauti na Kifaransa kinachozungumzwa Ufaransa, na matamshi ya maneno kadhaa ni tofauti kidogo.

text: O na uu, ene nthi ma Belgian onthe ala manenaa kifrengyi na Sweiss methwa masomie Kifrengyi sukulu, kwoou methwa meikuelewa ona watumia Kifrengyi kya namba.
translation: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: O na uu, ene nthi ma Belgian onthe ala manenaa kifrengyi na Sweiss methwa masomie Kifrengyi sukulu, kwoou methwa meikuelewa ona watumia Kifrengyi kya namba.
translation: Walakini, Wabelgiji wote waliozungumza Kifaransa na Kiswisi walijifunza Kifaransa shuleni, kwa hivyo wangeweza kukuelewa hata ukitumia mfumo wa nambari wa Kifaransa.

text: Kukethanisya nzeveni ni kwisikie nthi mbingi ta nzia ya unyanya.
translation: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Kukethanisya nzeveni ni kwisikie nthi mbingi ta nzia ya unyanya.
translation: Katika sehemu nyingi za dunia, kupunga mkono ni ishara ya kirafiki, kuashiria "hujambo."

text: O na vailye uu, kũya nthĩ ya Malaysĩa, kwa andũ moo ala mekalaa mĩsyĩ imaanisasya "ũka vaa" o ũndũ ũmwe na kyaa kya kũsũna kyolootete mwĩĩ wakũ, nzĩa ĩla ĩtũmĩkaa nthĩ sya ũmĩlĩlonĩ wa sũa, na yaĩlĩte kũtũmĩka kwa nzĩa oĩsũ yĩ yoka.
translation: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: O na vailye uu, kũya nthĩ ya Malaysĩa, kwa andũ moo ala mekalaa mĩsyĩ imaanisasya "ũka vaa" o ũndũ ũmwe na kyaa kya kũsũna kyolootete mwĩĩ wakũ, nzĩa ĩla ĩtũmĩkaa nthĩ sya ũmĩlĩlonĩ wa sũa, na yaĩlĩte kũtũmĩka kwa nzĩa oĩsũ yĩ yoka.
translation: Walakini, huko Malaysia, angalau kati ya Malay katika maeneo ya vijijini, inamaanisha "kuja huku," sawa na kidole cha kwanza kilichoelekezwa kuelekea kwenye mwili, ishara ambayo hutumiwa katika nchi fulani za Magharibi, na inapaswa kutumiwa tu kwa sababu hiyo.

text: O ta oũ, mũndũ wa kũma Britain aitembea Spain no olanĩlw'e akona mũndũ ũmũkĩlĩlye kwoko aĩmwĩa ethe na savalĩ nzeo kitaa kya kw'oko kĩsyaĩtye mũndũ ũsũ ũmũkĩlĩlye kw'oko (vandũ va kĩsyaĩtye ũla ũkũkĩlĩlw'a) ta ũkũmwĩa nĩ asyoke.
translation: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: O ta oũ, mũndũ wa kũma Britain aitembea Spain no olanĩlw'e akona mũndũ ũmũkĩlĩlye kwoko aĩmwĩa ethe na savalĩ nzeo kitaa kya kw'oko kĩsyaĩtye mũndũ ũsũ ũmũkĩlĩlye kw'oko (vandũ va kĩsyaĩtye ũla ũkũkĩlĩlw'a) ta ũkũmwĩa nĩ asyoke.
translation: Vivyo hivyo, msafiri wa Uingereza huko Uhispania anaweza kukosea kuagana kwaheri kwa kupepa kuhusisha viguzo akikabilia mpepapi (badala ya mtu anayepepewa) kama ishara ya kurudi.

text: Ithyomo ila sya kũseũv'wa syĩthĩwa vo kwoondũ wa kũtetheesya andũ ala methaa na thĩna wa kũneenanya kũelewana.
translation: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Ithyomo ila sya kũseũv'wa syĩthĩwa vo kwoondũ wa kũtetheesya andũ ala methaa na thĩna wa kũneenanya kũelewana.
translation: Lugha saidizi ni lugha bandia au za kubuniwa zinazoundwa kwa lengo la kusaidia mawasiliano kati ya watu ambao vinginevyo wangepata shida ya kuwasiliana.

text: Nĩ mbaany'e kuma Lingua Francas, ila ni ithyomo sya kũsyawa kana ĩla syĩ thaũ nĩ syeethĩĩwe syĩĩtũmĩwa kwa kĩtũmĩ kana kĩthyĩmo kya ũnene katĩ katĩ wa aneeni ma ithyomo ĩngĩ.
translation: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Nĩ mbaany'e kuma Lingua Francas, ila ni ithyomo sya kũsyawa kana ĩla syĩ thaũ nĩ syeethĩĩwe syĩĩtũmĩwa kwa kĩtũmĩ kana kĩthyĩmo kya ũnene katĩ katĩ wa aneeni ma ithyomo ĩngĩ.
translation: Wao ni tofauti na lingua Francas, ambayo ni lugha asilia au ya kikaboni ambazo huwa maarufu kwa sababu moja au nyingine kama njia ya mawasiliano kati ya wasemaji wa lugha nyingine.

text: Maũvyũvũnĩ ma mũthenya, atembeĩ nĩmethĩanaa na ĩmeũ ĩla ĩmolanĩalya na kĩw'ũ. (kana syĩndũ ĩngĩ).
translation: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Maũvyũvũnĩ ma mũthenya, atembeĩ nĩmethĩanaa na ĩmeũ ĩla ĩmolanĩalya na kĩw'ũ. (kana syĩndũ ĩngĩ).
translation: Katika joto la siku, wasafiri wanaweza kuona mazigazi ambayo hutoa dhana ya maji (au vitu vingine).

text: II nosyithwe syi muisyo kethwa mutalii nokwatiia maundu ma kwelelukya, anangite vinya wa mwanya na kiwu kila kitiele.
translation: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: II nosyithwe syi muisyo kethwa mutalii nokwatiia maundu ma kwelelukya, anangite vinya wa mwanya na kiwu kila kitiele.
translation: Hizi zinaweza kuwa hatari ikiwa msafiri atafuata mazigazi, kupoteza nishati ya thamani na maji iliyobaki.

text: Ona ndesati ila mbyu vyu nithithaa muno wiyoo. Uwau wa mbevo ni muthuku muno utena ngua sya muutia.
translation: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ona ndesati ila mbyu vyu nithithaa muno wiyoo. Uwau wa mbevo ni muthuku muno utena ngua sya muutia.
translation: Hata jangwa lililo na joto zaidi linaweza likawa baridi sana usiku. Hipothemia ni hatari halisi bila mavazi ya joto.

text: Ĩvindanĩ ya syũa, mũno mũno, nũkwenda ithiwa wĩsuvianiite na ũmuu ethĩwa nũkwĩsĩla kĩthekanĩ kya mbua.
translation: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Ĩvindanĩ ya syũa, mũno mũno, nũkwenda ithiwa wĩsuvianiite na ũmuu ethĩwa nũkwĩsĩla kĩthekanĩ kya mbua.
translation: Katika kiangazi, hasa, utahitaji kujihadhari na mbu ukiamua kutembea katika msitu wa mvua.

text: Unethwa utwaite ngali wisile kithekani ki miti mithungu, o vanini uvinguite miomo ila uulika nthini wa ngali nundu utoetye umuu ulikany'e naku ngalini.
translation: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Unethwa utwaite ngali wisile kithekani ki miti mithungu, o vanini uvinguite miomo ila uulika nthini wa ngali nundu utoetye umuu ulikany'e naku ngalini.
translation: Hata ikiwa unaendesha kupitia msitu wa mvua wa kitropiki ndogo, sekunde chache milango ikiwa wazi unapoingia kwenye gari ni muda unaotosha kwa mbu kuingia na wewe garini.

text: Ikua ya nyunyi sya yayaya, kana kwa isyitwa ya ndaia avian influenza, itonya ukwata nyunyi vamwe na nyamu ila syongasya.
translation: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Ikua ya nyunyi sya yayaya, kana kwa isyitwa ya ndaia avian influenza, itonya ukwata nyunyi vamwe na nyamu ila syongasya.
translation: Homa ya ndege inaweza kuambukiza ndege na pia mamalia.

text: Nthĩ wa makwani ngili ĩmwe ma'awetwa andunĩ, ĩndĩ amwe kwamo nĩ maetie kĩkw'ũ.
translation: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Nthĩ wa makwani ngili ĩmwe ma'awetwa andunĩ, ĩndĩ amwe kwamo nĩ maetie kĩkw'ũ.
translation: Kesi chache chini ya elfu zimewahi kuripotiwa kwa wanadamu, lakini baadhi yazo zilipelekea kifo.

text: Mbingi ikwatite andu ala mathukumanaa na ndithya sya nguku, indi ve o muisyo kwa andu ala mendete kwiloela nyunyi.
translation: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Mbingi ikwatite andu ala mathukumanaa na ndithya sya nguku, indi ve o muisyo kwa andu ala mendete kwiloela nyunyi.
translation: Mengi yamehusisha watu ambao hufanya kazi na kuku, lakini pia kuna hatari kiasi kwa watazama ndege.

text: Nthĩ ya Norway nĩ ũndũ wa kawaita kwĩtha na tũlũsĩ na malĩko ala mokaa makaũngana na nthĩ ndĩndĩmalũ.
translation: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Nthĩ ya Norway nĩ ũndũ wa kawaita kwĩtha na tũlũsĩ na malĩko ala mokaa makaũngana na nthĩ ndĩndĩmalũ.
translation: Kawaida kwa Norwei kuwa na vilango-bahari vyenye miinuko mikali na mabonde ambayo ghafla hugeuka kuwa kilima kirefu tambarare ambacho ni bapa, kwa kadiri fulani.

text: Kundũ kũu kutũlu kwitawa "vidde" kwonania vandũ vathanthaũ, vandũ vate miti, vatakwatene.
translation: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Kundũ kũu kutũlu kwitawa "vidde" kwonania vandũ vathanthaũ, vandũ vate miti, vatakwatene.
translation: Nyanda hizi za juu mara nyingi huitwa "vidde" kumaanisha nafasi pana, wazi isiyo na miti, eneo lisilo na mipaka.

text: Kuuya Rogaland na Agder ikothete kwitwa "hei" ila iungamiaa kitheka kitaingwa miti kaingi kithiawa kyusuitwe ni tumalaa.
translation: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Kuuya Rogaland na Agder ikothete kwitwa "hei" ila iungamiaa kitheka kitaingwa miti kaingi kithiawa kyusuitwe ni tumalaa.
translation: Katika Rogaland na Agder kwa kawaida huitwa "hei" kumaanisha ardhi iliyotengwa isiyo na miti na mara nyingi hufunikwa na mimea ya vichakani.

text: Ia ikamu iyithwaa yiilumu, ateo nĩyitheea ĩĩmanĩ. Kĩ kĩetae myalĩka na syanda ĩla ĩtonya kũkwatanywa na ĩao sya ĩa.
translation: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Ta undu umwe na andu mena utuika, e na nzika sya uwau wa sukali kana nouvow'e, aiweta kana maundu aa maina musingi kwa andu ala mena muthemba wa mbee wa sukali.
translation: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.

text: Ta undu umwe na andu mena utuika, e na nzika sya uwau wa sukali kana nouvow'e, aiweta kana maundu aa maina musingi kwa andu ala mena muthemba wa mbee wa sukali.
translation: Kama wataalam wengine, ana shaka kuhusu kama ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akagundua kuwa matokeo haya hayana umuhimu kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugojwa wa kisukari wa aina 1.

text: Wakwambĩlĩlya, mwandĩkĩ Sara Danius, wa komitii ya kunengana mithinzio ya maundu ma uandiki, nĩwatangaasiie andũ kwĩsĩla kameme ka Sveriges kana mayaĩ matonya kũmũvikĩa Bob Dylan imwe kwa imwe yĩũlũ wa kũsinda mũthĩnzĩo wa maundu ma uandiki wa 2016, makola ikia vitii wa kũmũvikia.
translation: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.

text: Wakwambĩlĩlya, mwandĩkĩ Sara Danius, wa komitii ya kunengana mithinzio ya maundu ma uandiki, nĩwatangaasiie andũ kwĩsĩla kameme ka Sveriges kana mayaĩ matonya kũmũvikĩa Bob Dylan imwe kwa imwe yĩũlũ wa kũsinda mũthĩnzĩo wa maundu ma uandiki wa 2016, makola ikia vitii wa kũmũvikia.
translation: Mnamo Jumatatu, Sara Danius, katibu wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel ya Fasihi katika Chuo cha Uswidi, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa kipindi cha redio kwenye Sveriges Radio katika Uswidi kwamba kamati hiyo, kwa kutoweza kumfikia Bob Dylan moja kwa moja kuhusu ushindi wa Tuzo la Nobel la Fasihi 2016, iliacha juhudi zake za kujaribu kumfikia.

text: Danius aaĩsye, "Oyu vaĩ ũndũ twĩkwĩka. Nĩnakũnĩa siumu na natũma maũtũmanĩ kwa anyanyae make mavakũvĩ na nakwata maũsũngĩo ma kwendeesya. Kwa saa ĩĩ kĩũ nĩ kĩanĩte".
translation: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."

text: Danius aaĩsye, "Oyu vaĩ ũndũ twĩkwĩka. Nĩnakũnĩa siumu na natũma maũtũmanĩ kwa anyanyae make mavakũvĩ na nakwata maũsũngĩo ma kwendeesya. Kwa saa ĩĩ kĩũ nĩ kĩanĩte".
translation: Danius alisema, "Sasa hivi hatufanyi chochote. Nimepiga simu na kutuma barua pepe kwa mshirika wake wa karibu na kupata majibu ya kirafiki sana. Kwa sasa, hakika hiyo imetosha."

text: Ona vala singano umwe wi ungu wa ukunikili wionany'a utonya kuola ikw'u kumana na Ebola, nginya yu, vai ndawa inesa kwonanw'a mbailu kwa kuiita uwau ula wikw'o.

text: Ndawa imwe ya kukitana na mowau, Zmapp, mbeeni yai inoonany'a watho ngali isu, indi masomo moonanasya kana vaita wayo kwa kusiiia ikw'u wai munii mbee wondu yatalikanaa.

text: Ndawa imwe ya kukitana na mowau, Zmapp, mbeeni yai inoonany'a watho ngali isu, indi masomo moonanasya kana vaita wayo kwa kusiiia ikw'u wai munii mbee wondu yatalikanaa.
translation: Kinywaji kimoja cha kingamwili, ZMapp, hapo awali kilionyesha ahadi uwanjani, lakini tafiti rasmi zilionyesha kilikuwa na faida kidogo kuliko ilivyotafutwa katika kuzuia kifo.

text: Itata ya PALM, Zmapp yatumiawa tayo ya kusiia, vei mini saendisti maitumiaa ta ya kuthima na kwiananithya uiiti ingi itatu nayo.
translation: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.

text: Itata ya PALM, Zmapp yatumiawa tayo ya kusiia, vei mini saendisti maitumiaa ta ya kuthima na kwiananithya uiiti ingi itatu nayo.
translation: Katika jaribio la PALM, Zmapp ilitumika kama kidhibiti, kumaanisha wanasayansi waliitumia kama msingi na kulinganisha matibabu mengine matatu nayo.

text: Mathau ma kwaka mii ma Amelika nimakwatililaa valua wa kamitii ya mathau ma Olympic ma Amelika na nimetikilaa vata munene wa musyi wa Olympic kunenga kw'oko ithyluluko nzeo kwa asembi maitu monthe.
translation: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.

text: Mathau ma kwaka mii ma Amelika nimakwatililaa valua wa kamitii ya mathau ma Olympic ma Amelika na nimetikilaa vata munene wa musyi wa Olympic kunenga kw'oko ithyluluko nzeo kwa asembi maitu monthe.
translation: USA Gymnastics hukubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na hukubali hitaji kuu la familia ya Olimpiki la kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.

text: twĩtĩkĩlana na ũnenĩ wa USOC's kana mawendĩ ma asembĩ na ĩlavũ, na mathaũ, no matetheew'e nesanga kwa kũeendeea na mbee na maũvĩndũkũ me kĩtũmĩ nthĩnĩ wa ĩkũndĩ, vandũ va kũvalaanĩka.
translation: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.

text: twĩtĩkĩlana na ũnenĩ wa USOC's kana mawendĩ ma asembĩ na ĩlavũ, na mathaũ, no matetheew'e nesanga kwa kũeendeea na mbee na maũvĩndũkũ me kĩtũmĩ nthĩnĩ wa ĩkũndĩ, vandũ va kũvalaanĩka.
translation: Tunakubaliana na taarifa ya USOC kwamba masilahi ya wanariadha na vilabu vyetu, na spoti yao, huenda yakashughulikiwa vyema kwa kusonga mbele na mabadiliko ya maana ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya kughairi vyeti.

text: Ngyimu sya USA nikwataa mbau ukunikili wa kivyake ula utonya kuete kyeni undu utumii muthuku wingivite ueleetw'e na ukumbau ni ala mavitie ma Larry Nassar withwa waendie uteumanyikana kwa ivinda iasa na iendekethasya mavalyuku ala mailu.
translation: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.

text: Ngyimu sya USA nikwataa mbau ukunikili wa kivyake ula utonya kuete kyeni undu utumii muthuku wingivite ueleetw'e na ukumbau ni ala mavitie ma Larry Nassar withwa waendie uteumanyikana kwa ivinda iasa na iendekethasya mavalyuku ala mailu.
translation: USA Gymnastics inaunga mkono uchunguzi huru ambao labda utafafanua jinsi unyanyasaji wa kiwango kama vile ulivyoelezewa kwa ujasiri sana na manusura wa Larry Nassar ungekosa kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu hivyo na inakumbatia mabadiliko muhimu na ya kufaa.

text: Mathau ma ngyimu ma Amelika na USOC mena wendi o umwe - kutw'ikithya ithau ya ngyimu, na ala angi, kwithiwa mena miisyo minini undu vatonyeka na kuatiia ndoto syoo me kundu kusuuviku, mawithyululukoni maseo na ma kuthuthya.
translation: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.

text: Mathau ma ngyimu ma Amelika na USOC mena wendi o umwe - kutw'ikithya ithau ya ngyimu, na ala angi, kwithiwa mena miisyo minini undu vatonyeka na kuatiia ndoto syoo me kundu kusuuviku, mawithyululukoni maseo na ma kuthuthya.
translation: USA Gymnastics na USOC zina lengo moja — kuifanya spoti ya sarakasi, na nyingine, salama iwezekanavyo ili wanariadha wafuate ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, chanya na ya kuwezesha.

text: Usakuanini wa 1976 ai mutai wa Carter iulu wa ngwatanio sya nthi syanza, na atongoesya ta mutai munene wa ikundi ya muuo wa nthi, ayosa mwanya wa Henry Kissinger.

text: Ta NSA ni watetheisye Carter syinduni sya nthi yonthe, ta undu ula Camp David aisye mwaka wa 1978; kuseuvya unyanya wa US na China myaka ya mwiso ya 1970; Iranian Revolution ila yatumie Iran ivingiwa, 1979 na Soviet kulika Afghanistan 1979.

text: Ta NSA ni watetheisye Carter syinduni sya nthi yonthe, ta undu ula Camp David aisye mwaka wa 1978; kuseuvya unyanya wa US na China myaka ya mwiso ya 1970; Iranian Revolution ila yatumie Iran ivingiwa, 1979 na Soviet kulika Afghanistan 1979.
