text: Ii yionania tu kana ndainosa imwe swai na mawia, ngewa syisikie mũno indi ni syinenganaa uvoo mavindi makũu ma ndainosa matonania kwa ngelekany'o langi na undũ mavangitwe.
translation: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.

text: Ii yionania tu kana ndainosa imwe swai na mawia, ngewa syisikie mũno indi ni syinenganaa uvoo mavindi makũu ma ndainosa matonania kwa ngelekany'o langi na undũ mavangitwe.
translation: Hii haithibitishi tu kuwa baadhi ya dinosaria walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imezagaa, bali pia inatoa maelezo ambayo kijumla visukuku haviwezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa pande-tatu.

text: Andu ma sayanzi maisye nyamu ii yai na kithui kya muthanga iulu na mbuluku kana ya langi wa caratenoid ngaliko ya ungu.
translation: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.

text: Andu ma sayanzi maisye nyamu ii yai na kithui kya muthanga iulu na mbuluku kana ya langi wa caratenoid ngaliko ya ungu.
translation: . Wanasayansi wanasema manyoya ya mnyama huyu yalikuwa ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu upande wa juu na hafifu au rangi ya karotini upande wa chini.

text: Kukwata woni usu onaw'o nuetae kuvinduka kwa mawia nyunyini.
translation: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.

text: Kukwata woni usu onaw'o nuetae kuvinduka kwa mawia nyunyini.
translation: Utambuzi huo pia unatoa ufahamu wa mageuko ya manyoya katika ndege.

text: Nundu mawia ma ndainosa mayithwaa mena utee mwianu nesa, witawa rachis, ateo nisyithwaa na syindu ingi sya mawia-barbs na barbules-akunikili maeleiwe muno muno kana rachis yai kwiana kwa itina kwa syindu ingi.
translation: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.

text: Nundu mawia ma ndainosa mayithwaa mena utee mwianu nesa, witawa rachis, ateo nisyithwaa na syindu ingi sya mawia-barbs na barbules-akunikili maeleiwe muno muno kana rachis yai kwiana kwa itina kwa syindu ingi.
translation: Kwa sababu manyoya ya dinosau hayana chimbuko uliyostawishwa vizuri, inayoitwa rachi, lakini huwa na sifa zingine za manyoya — barbu na barbule — watafiti waligundua rachi labda ni maendeleo ya baadaye ya uvumbuzi kuliko sifa hizi nyingine.

text: Undu mawia mavangitwe wai wonany'o kana mayaatumiwa ndekeni ateo matumiiwe kwa kusiania na uvyuvu kana kwona. Akunikili mendekethisye atii, o na kutwika kii ni kisithe kya ndainosa o nini, I samboo yiunany'a kindu kingi na ti kaswii kenthi.
translation: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.

text: Undu mawia mavangitwe wai wonany'o kana mayaatumiwa ndekeni ateo matumiiwe kwa kusiania na uvyuvu kana kwona. Akunikili mendekethisye atii, o na kutwika kii ni kisithe kya ndainosa o nini, I samboo yiunany'a kindu kingi na ti kaswii kenthi.
translation: Muundo wa manyoya unaonyesha kwamba hayakutumika katika kupeperuka bali yalitumiwa kudhibiti joto au uonyesho. Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, ingawa huu ni mkia wa dinosauri mchanga, sampuli inaonyesha manyoya ya utu uzima na si manyoya laini ya ndani ya kifaranga.

text: Asomĩ maĩsye kana, onakaũ kĩĩ nĩ kĩsĩthe kya ĩng'ala ĩnĩnĩ mũvwano ũũ woonanasya mawĩa ma kĩndũ kĩnene lakĩnĩ tĩ kaswĩĩ.
translation: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.

text: Asomĩ maĩsye kana, onakaũ kĩĩ nĩ kĩsĩthe kya ĩng'ala ĩnĩnĩ mũvwano ũũ woonanasya mawĩa ma kĩndũ kĩnene lakĩnĩ tĩ kaswĩĩ.
translation: Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, hata kama huu ni mkia wa dinosau mdogo, sampuli hiyo inaonyesha manyoya ya ukubwa na si manyoya ya kifaranga mdogo.

text: Bomu ila ituikiw'e kituoni kinene kya askali ku Gaziantep, turkey iyoo kwakya yuwaie askali eli na yaũmisya andu mbee wa wa miongo ili.
translation: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.

text: Bomu ila ituikiw'e kituoni kinene kya askali ku Gaziantep, turkey iyoo kwakya yuwaie askali eli na yaũmisya andu mbee wa wa miongo ili.
translation: Bomu la gari lililolipuliwa katika hedikota ya polisi katika Gaziantep, Uturuki jana asubuhi liliwaua maafisa wawili wa polisi na kuwajeruhi watu wengine zaidi ya ishirini.

text: Uvisi wa ngavana waisye kati wa asu ikumi na keenda maumiite mai maovisaa ma volisi.
translation: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.

text: Uvisi wa ngavana waisye kati wa asu ikumi na keenda maumiite mai maovisaa ma volisi.
translation: Ofisi ya Gavana ilisema kumi na tisa wa wale waliojeruhiwa walikuwa maafisa wa polisi.

text: Askali measya meona musikali wa Daesh (ISIL) niwe wa mavithukiie.
translation: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.

text: Askali measya meona musikali wa Daesh (ISIL) niwe wa mavithukiie.
translation: Polisi walisema wanashuku wanaodaiwa kuwa wanamgambo wa Daesh (ISIL) kwa kuhusika na shambulio hilo.

text: Ni meethie sua yithũkũmaa ta ndata ila ingi. Wia wa ndata syonthe utongoeawa ni kyeni kyoo, kuthiuuka kwoo na vai kindu kingi.
translation: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.

text: Ni meethie sua yithũkũmaa ta ndata ila ingi. Wia wa ndata syonthe utongoeawa ni kyeni kyoo, kuthiuuka kwoo na vai kindu kingi.
translation: Walipata kuwa Jua lilifanya kazi kwa kanuni msingi sawa na za nyota nyingine: Shuguli za nyota zote kwenye mfumo zilipatikana kuendeshwa na mng'ao wao, mzunguko wao na hakuna jingine.

text: Ũtwekũ na kũthĩũũkya nĩ kũtũmĩawa kũmanya namba ya star's Rossby, ĩla yĩeleasya ũndũ kĩw'ũ kya nthakame kĩtembeaa.
translation: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.

text: Ũtwekũ na kũthĩũũkya nĩ kũtũmĩawa kũmanya namba ya star's Rossby, ĩla yĩeleasya ũndũ kĩw'ũ kya nthakame kĩtembeaa.
translation: Mng'ao na mzunguko hutumika pamoja ili kuamua namba ya Rossby ya nyota, ambayo inahusiana na mtiririko wa utegili.

text: O undu Rossby namba ininivite, now'o ndata yithwaa itakwatene o undumwe na kutungwa kwa mangineti.
translation: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.

text: O undu Rossby namba ininivite, now'o ndata yithwaa itakwatene o undumwe na kutungwa kwa mangineti.
translation: Jinsi idadi ya Rossby inavyokuwa ndogo, ndivyo nyota zinapungua kuwa wa utendaji kwa kuzingatia mabadiliko ya sumaku.

text: Kyalonĩ kyake, Iwasaki alikile thĩĩnaanĩ maita maingĩ mũno.
translation: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.

text: Kyalonĩ kyake, Iwasaki alikile thĩĩnaanĩ maita maingĩ mũno.
translation: Wakati wa safari yake, Iwasaki alikumbwa na matata mara nyingi.

text: Niwaveniwe ni ing'ei sya kiw'uni, avithukiwa ni ngiti ya mung'ethya ku Tibet, atoloka akiite kutw'awa ku Nepal na akwatiwa India.
translation: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.

text: Niwaveniwe ni ing'ei sya kiw'uni, avithukiwa ni ngiti ya mung'ethya ku Tibet, atoloka akiite kutw'awa ku Nepal na akwatiwa India.
translation: Aliporwa na maharamia, akashambuliwa huko Tibeti na mbwa mwenye kichaa, akakwepa ndoa katika Nepali na akakamatwa huko India.

text: Kiwango cha 802.11n ni kuthukumaa mitamboni ya 2.4Ghz na 5.0Ghz.
translation: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.

text: Kiwango cha 802.11n ni kuthukumaa mitamboni ya 2.4Ghz na 5.0Ghz.
translation: Kiwango cha 802.11n hufanya kazi katika masafa ya gigahezi 2.4 na gigahezi 5.0.

text: Kii ni kiumitonyethya ithi itina na itumike vamwe na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g ketha kisese kina radio ili.
translation: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.

text: Kii ni kiumitonyethya ithi itina na itumike vamwe na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g ketha kisese kina radio ili.
translation: Hii itaiwezesha kutangamana kwa nyuma na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, mradi tu kituo cha ardhini kina redio mbili.

text: Mĩtũkĩ ya 802.11n ĩthĩwa mĩtũkangĩ ĩisianĩw'a na ĩla ya mĩvĩtũkie yĩna umĩlyo wa ĩũlũ vyũ wa 600Mbit kwa kĩla sekendi.
translation: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.

text: Mĩtũkĩ ya 802.11n ĩthĩwa mĩtũkangĩ ĩisianĩw'a na ĩla ya mĩvĩtũkie yĩna umĩlyo wa ĩũlũ vyũ wa 600Mbit kwa kĩla sekendi.
translation: Kasi za 802.11n ni haraka sana kuliko zile za watangulizi wake zikiwa upeo wa kinadharia wa kiwango cha juu cha 600Mbit/s.

text: Duvall, ula utwaitwe e na syana ili nima, ndaatia undu munene kwa Miller, vala ngewa isu yaumitw'e.
translation: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.

text: Duvall, ula utwaitwe e na syana ili nima, ndaatia undu munene kwa Miller, vala ngewa isu yaumitw'e.
translation: Duvall, ambaye ameolewa na ana watoto waliokomaa, hakuacha hisia kubwa kwa Miller, ambayehadithi ilimhusu.

text: Ila Miller weeiwe aneene aisye "Mike aneenaa muno ivinda ya kuthukisya… ni neeyumbanasya kwoou ndyaaiwa kila wasyaa".
translation: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."

text: Ila Miller weeiwe aneene aisye "Mike aneenaa muno ivinda ya kuthukisya… ni neeyumbanasya kwoou ndyaaiwa kila wasyaa".
translation: Alipoambiwa atoe maoni, Miller alisema, "Mike huongea sana wakati wa kesi…nilikuwa najitayarisha kwa hivyo sikuwa ninasikia kwa kweli alichokuwa akisema."

text: "Twiikia vitii tuole nzeve ya Kamboni ndaiokisaiti ila ilekaw'a kwa ilungu ya ukwati kwa kilungu kimwanya kuvikia 2020 kuma 2005", Hu nnunawetie.
translation: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.

text: "Twiikia vitii tuole nzeve ya Kamboni ndaiokisaiti ila ilekaw'a kwa ilungu ya ukwati kwa kilungu kimwanya kuvikia 2020 kuma 2005", Hu nnunawetie.
translation: "Tutajaribu kupunguza utoaji wa dayoksidi ya kaboni kwa kila kipimo cha GDP kwa kiwango muhimu kufikia 2020 kutoka kiwango cha 2005", Hu alisema.

text: Ndanaa seti namba kwa kutila kuu, ayasya syiseuvya kwianana na undu ekonomi ya Kyaina yumya.
translation: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.

text: Ndanaa seti namba kwa kutila kuu, ayasya syiseuvya kwianana na undu ekonomi ya Kyaina yumya.
translation: Hakuweka kiwango cha kukatwa, akisema itafanywa kulingana na pato la kiuchumi la China.

text: Hu nunataie nthi ila siendee na kuendeea "syivetane na nzia nguu ya kuthokoany'a mbee nikana ithesye itina".
translation: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."

text: Hu nunataie nthi ila siendee na kuendeea "syivetane na nzia nguu ya kuthokoany'a mbee nikana ithesye itina".
translation: Hu aliimiza nchi zinazokua "kuepuka njia ya kitambo ya kuchafua kwanza na kusafisha baadaye.''

text: Aongelie kana "o na vamwe na ũu, maikeewe mathũkũme mawĩa mavĩtũkĩte vala mavikĩte kĩ kwĩana, vinya na ũtonyi woo.
translation: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."

text: Aongelie kana "o na vamwe na ũu, maikeewe mathũkũme mawĩa mavĩtũkĩte vala mavikĩte kĩ kwĩana, vinya na ũtonyi woo.
translation: Aliongeza kwamba "hawapaswi, hata hivyo, kuombwa kuchukua wajibu ambao ni zaidi ya hatua yao ya ukuaji, uwajibikaji na uwezo."

text: Kĩkũndĩ kya asomĩ kya ĩraq kyonanĩsye mawonanyo moo saa 12.00 GMT ũmũnthĩ.
translation: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.

text: Kĩkũndĩ kya asomĩ kya ĩraq kyonanĩsye mawonanyo moo saa 12.00 GMT ũmũnthĩ.
translation: Kikundi cha Wasomi wa Iraq kiliwasilisha ripoti yao saa 12 GMT leo.

text: Yumasya ukany'o kana vaingwa mundu o na umwe utonya kwosa itambya kwa nthi ya iraq ivindani yii yiekane na kau, kwongeleka kwa ithokoo kana kusyokea ithokoo.
translation: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.

text: Yumasya ukany'o kana vaingwa mundu o na umwe utonya kwosa itambya kwa nthi ya iraq ivindani yii yiekane na kau, kwongeleka kwa ithokoo kana kusyokea ithokoo.
translation: Inatoa ilani kwamba hakuna yeyote anayeweza kutoa hakikisho kwamba mpango wowote wa hatua katika Iraki wakati huu utakomesha vita vya kimadhehebu, vurugu inayozidi, au mwelekeo kwenye machafuko.

text: Ripoti isu yavinguka na wendi wa debati ivinguitwe na formationi ya wendi wa United States kula kwa mawoni moo kula kwi umuloni wa sua.
translation: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.

text: Ripoti isu yavinguka na wendi wa debati ivinguitwe na formationi ya wendi wa United States kula kwa mawoni moo kula kwi umuloni wa sua.
translation: Ripoti hiyo inaanza kwa ombi la mjadala wazi na kuundwa kwa maafikiano katika Marekani kuhusu sera kuhusu Mashariki ya Kati.

text: Lipoti ii ni ya vata muno nundu wa miao ya selikali kwa Iraq na yienda kusenzwa.
translation: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.

text: Lipoti ii ni ya vata muno nundu wa miao ya selikali kwa Iraq na yienda kusenzwa.
translation: Ripoti hiyo inashutumu vikali karibu kila kipengele cha sera ya sasa ya Mtendaji kuhusu Iraki na inahimiza ubadilishaji wa mwelekeo mara moja.

text: Kundu kya mbee kati ya mitalala ila malanitye ni kana mupango mweu wa ngwatanio ya nthi syi kivathukany'o ni waile kwikiwa mwaka utanamba kuthela kusiia uvuthukii wa mivaka ya Iraq na kutungiania unyanya na atui make.
translation: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq's borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.

text: Kundu kya mbee kati ya mitalala ila malanitye ni kana mupango mweu wa ngwatanio ya nthi syi kivathukany'o ni waile kwikiwa mwaka utanamba kuthela kusiia uvuthukii wa mivaka ya Iraq na kutungiania unyanya na atui make.
translation: Kwanza kati ya mapendekezo yake 78 ni kwamba mpango mpya wa kidiplomasia unapaswa kuchukuliwa kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka huu ili kuweka katika hali ya usalama mipaka ya Iraq dhidi ya uingiliaji wa maadui na kuanzisha tena uhusiano wa kidiplomasia na majirani zake.

text: Seneta wa oyu ula ni kiveti cha musumbi wa Argentina Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ni watangasie kana nũkwenda kivila kya ũsumbi iyoo yiawioo La Plata, taoni yi kilomita 50 (maili 31) kuma Buenos Aires.
translation: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.

text: Seneta wa oyu ula ni kiveti cha musumbi wa Argentina Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ni watangasie kana nũkwenda kivila kya ũsumbi iyoo yiawioo La Plata, taoni yi kilomita 50 (maili 31) kuma Buenos Aires.
translation: Seneta wa sasa na Mke wa Rais wa Ajentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner alitangaza uwaniaji wake wa urais jana jioni katika La Plata, mji ulio kilomita 50 (maili 31) kutoka Buenos Aires.

text: Mundu muka Kirchner atangasie muvango wake wa kuungama kunyuvwa ta muungamii wa nthi e nyumbani ya Argentine Theatre, o vandũ vala watumĩie kwambĩĩsya kambeni syake sya seneti sya mwaka wa 2005 ta ũmwe wa aũngamii ma andũ ma kĩsio kya Buenos Aires.
translation: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.

text: Mundu muka Kirchner atangasie muvango wake wa kuungama kunyuvwa ta muungamii wa nthi e nyumbani ya Argentine Theatre, o vandũ vala watumĩie kwambĩĩsya kambeni syake sya seneti sya mwaka wa 2005 ta ũmwe wa aũngamii ma andũ ma kĩsio kya Buenos Aires.
translation: Bi. Kirchner alitangaza nia yake ya kuwania urais katika Ukumbi wa Ajentina, mahali pale pale alipotumia kuanzisha kampeni yake ya Seneti mnamo 2005 kama memba wa ujumbe wa wilaya ya Buenos Aires.

text: Kukulany'a kuu kwambiisw'e ni kuemanwa iulu wa kutumiwa kwa utethyo na kwaka ingi ivindani ya Hurricane Katrina; Kula andu amwe omu ki mbesa metite ki mathekanya "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translation: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."

text: Kukulany'a kuu kwambiisw'e ni kuemanwa iulu wa kutumiwa kwa utethyo na kwaka ingi ivindani ya Hurricane Katrina; Kula andu amwe omu ki mbesa metite ki mathekanya "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translation: Mjadala ulianzishwa na mzozo juu ya kutumia zaidi kwa msaada na ujenzi upya katika Kimbunga Katrina; ambacho wahafidhina wa fedha wabebandika kwa ucheshi "Mpango wa Bushwa New Orleans."

text: Iseso ya kusisya kana uw'o ni watwaiiiw'e nthini wa kunengane mawia kwa andu me nthini wa silikali niyiendee.
translation: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.

text: Iseso ya kusisya kana uw'o ni watwaiiiw'e nthini wa kunengane mawia kwa andu me nthini wa silikali niyiendee.
translation: Ukosoaji huru wa juhudi za ujenzi upya umezingatia utoaji wa kandarasi za ujenzi upya kwa wajuzi wanaodhaniwa wa Washington.

text: Andu mbee wa milioni inya maendie mathiko meku Rome.
translation: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.

text: Andu mbee wa milioni inya maendie mathiko meku Rome.
translation: Watu zaidi ya milioni nne walienda Roma kuhudhuria mazishi.

text: Namba ya andu ala meiikw'o yii mbingi nginya wethia vaitonyeka kila mundu kulika nthini wa mathiko asu mei ku St. Peter's Square.
translation: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.

text: Namba ya andu ala meiikw'o yii mbingi nginya wethia vaitonyeka kila mundu kulika nthini wa mathiko asu mei ku St. Peter's Square.
translation: Idadi ya watu waliokuwepo ilikuwa kubwa sana kwamba haikuwezekana kwa kila mtu kupata kuingia kwenye mazishi katika uwanja wa St. Peter.

text: Tĩvĩĩ nene nĩsyekĩĩwe kũndũ kĩvathũkany'o Rome nĩkana andũ meloele kyathi kiu.
translation: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.

text: Tĩvĩĩ nene nĩsyekĩĩwe kũndũ kĩvathũkany'o Rome nĩkana andũ meloele kyathi kiu.
translation: Skrini kadhaa kubwa za televisheni ziliangikwa mahali mbalimbali jijini Roma ili kuwezesha watu kutazama sherehe hiyo.

text: Misyini minene ya Italy na ndunia yonthe, muno muno ku Poland, myako ta isu niyaakiwe, ila yoonekie ni nguthu nene ya andu.
translation: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.

text: Misyini minene ya Italy na ndunia yonthe, muno muno ku Poland, myako ta isu niyaakiwe, ila yoonekie ni nguthu nene ya andu.
translation: Katika miji mingine mingi ya Italia na ulimwengu kwa ujumla, haswa katika Polandi, mipangilio sawa ilifanywa, ambayo ilionekana na idadi kubwa ya watu.

text: Andĩkĩ ma ĩsĩtolĩ nĩmaũmanĩsye mĩao ya FBI ĩla yatĩĩanaa na meko ma ũngendĩlĩ ala me laĩsI, mũno mũno kũywa kwa mĩtokaa, mena kĩeleelo kya kwĩyendeesya na maũseo.
translation: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.

text: Andĩkĩ ma ĩsĩtolĩ nĩmaũmanĩsye mĩao ya FBI ĩla yatĩĩanaa na meko ma ũngendĩlĩ ala me laĩsI, mũno mũno kũywa kwa mĩtokaa, mena kĩeleelo kya kwĩyendeesya na maũseo.
translation: Wanahistoria wameshutumu sera za zamani za FBI kwa kuangazia rasilimali kwenye kesi ambazo ni rahisi kutatua, hasa kesi za magari yaliyoibwa, kwa madhumuni ya kuongeza kiwango cha mafanikio cha wakala.

text: Selikali ni yaambiisye kũmya mbesa sya mũvango ũu wa wathe mwakani wa mbesa wa 2005 na yendekithya kana FBI yumye athukumi 10 ma kũukitana na mavisa ma ũlaalai ma andũ aima.
translation: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.

text: Selikali ni yaambiisye kũmya mbesa sya mũvango ũu wa wathe mwakani wa mbesa wa 2005 na yendekithya kana FBI yumye athukumi 10 ma kũukitana na mavisa ma ũlaalai ma andũ aima.
translation: Bunge lilianza kufadhili kikundi chenye nia chafu katika mwaka wa kifedha wa 2005 na kuaini kuwa FBI lazima itoe makachero kumi kwa ponografia ya watu wazima.

text: Robin Uthappa asindĩe na makĩsi me ĩũlũ vyũ, masemba 70 kwa mĩvĩla 41 akũnĩte 11 inya na thanthatũ 2.
translation: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.

text: Robin Uthappa asindĩe na makĩsi me ĩũlũ vyũ, masemba 70 kwa mĩvĩla 41 akũnĩte 11 inya na thanthatũ 2.
translation: Robin Uthappa alifanya alama za juu za fursa, pointi 70 katika mipira 41 kwa kufikia nne 11 na sita 2.

text: Athauki ma katikati ma cricket, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid ni mathauakie nesa na maseovya ngwatanio ya hundred-run.
translation: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.

text: Athauki ma katikati ma cricket, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid ni mathauakie nesa na maseovya ngwatanio ya hundred-run.
translation: Wachezaji wa kati wa kriketi, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, walicheza vizuri na kushirikiana katika masafa mia moja.

text: Ateo, ĩtina wa kwaasya kamũlango ka mũũngamĩi India yasembie o mavinda 36 na yaasya tũmĩlango 7 kũminũkĩlya mathaũ asu.
translation: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.

text: Ateo, ĩtina wa kwaasya kamũlango ka mũũngamĩi India yasembie o mavinda 36 na yaasya tũmĩlango 7 kũminũkĩlya mathaũ asu.
translation: Lakini, baada ya kupoteza wiketi ya kapteni India ilifanya pointi 36 na kupoteza wiketi 7 kumaliza fursa.

text: Mũnene wa Amelika George W. Bush aavikie Singapore kĩokonĩ kya Novemba 16, aambĩĩsya ndembea ya kyumwa kĩima ya Asia.
translation: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.

text: Mũnene wa Amelika George W. Bush aavikie Singapore kĩokonĩ kya Novemba 16, aambĩĩsya ndembea ya kyumwa kĩima ya Asia.
translation: Rais wa Marekani George W. Bush alifika Singapori asubuhi ya Novemba 16, hivyo kuanza ziara ya Asia ya wiki moja.

text: Akethisw'e ni munini wa munene wa selikali wa Singapore Wong Kan Seng na manenea iulu wa viasala na amaitha ma kau mena munene wa selikali wa Singapore Lee Hsien Loong.
translation: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.

text: Akethisw'e ni munini wa munene wa selikali wa Singapore Wong Kan Seng na manenea iulu wa viasala na amaitha ma kau mena munene wa selikali wa Singapore Lee Hsien Loong.
translation: Alisalimiwa na Naibu Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Wong Kan Seng na wakajadili masuala ya biashara na ughaidi na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Lee Hsien Loong.

text: Itina wa kyumwa kya wasyo kwa ukuni wa kula wi kati, Bush eeie wanda yiulu wa kuseuvya utandithya kuu Asia.
translation: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.

text: Itina wa kyumwa kya wasyo kwa ukuni wa kula wi kati, Bush eeie wanda yiulu wa kuseuvya utandithya kuu Asia.
translation: Baada ya wiki ya kushindwa katika uchaguzi wa nusu muhula, Bush aliambia hadhira kuhusu upanuzi wa biashara katika Asia.

text: Minista munene Stephen Harper niweetikila kutuma "Clean Air Act" ya silikali kwa komitii yoonthe ya kyama ni kenda maliviu, mbee wa isomo ya keli, itina wa umbano wa wakeli ula wai wa ndatika 25 vala ndongoi Jack Layton wai PMO.
translation: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.

text: Minista munene Stephen Harper niweetikila kutuma "Clean Air Act" ya silikali kwa komitii yoonthe ya kyama ni kenda maliviu, mbee wa isomo ya keli, itina wa umbano wa wakeli ula wai wa ndatika 25 vala ndongoi Jack Layton wai PMO.
translation: Waziri Mkuu Stephen Harper amekubali kutuma 'Mkataba wa Hewa Safi' wa serikali kwa kamati ya vyama vyote kwa ukaguzi, kabla ya kusomwa kwake kwa mara ya pili, baada ya mkutano wa Jumanne wa dakika 25 na kiongozi wa NDP Jack Layton kwenye PMO.

text: Layton nĩweetĩĩtye ũalyũko wa mĩĩao ya ila itũthyũũkĩte ya conservatives ĩvindanĩ ya ũmbano na mũnene wa silikalĩ, ayĩĩtya "wandĩko mweũ na wa nthĩnĩ vyũ" wa mĩao ĩsu ya syĩndũ itũthyũũkĩte ya kyama kya Conservative.
translation: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.

text: Layton nĩweetĩĩtye ũalyũko wa mĩĩao ya ila itũthyũũkĩte ya conservatives ĩvindanĩ ya ũmbano na mũnene wa silikalĩ, ayĩĩtya "wandĩko mweũ na wa nthĩnĩ vyũ" wa mĩao ĩsu ya syĩndũ itũthyũũkĩte ya kyama kya Conservative.
translation: Layton alikuwa ameomba mabadiliko ya mswada wa kimazingira wa wahafidhina wakati wa mkutano na PM, akiomba "uandishi upya wa undani na mkamilifu" wa mswada wa kimazingira wa chama cha Wahafidhina.

text: Kuma ila silikali ya Federal yambiie kunengane ilovia sya sivitali wa Mersey kuu Devonport, Tasmania, silikali na ayumbe amwe nimatulie makosa kiko kii ta undu wa kwiyonany'a nundu wa usakuani wa mwei wa ikumi na umwe.
translation: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.

text: Kuma ila silikali ya Federal yambiie kunengane ilovia sya sivitali wa Mersey kuu Devonport, Tasmania, silikali na ayumbe amwe nimatulie makosa kiko kii ta undu wa kwiyonany'a nundu wa usakuani wa mwei wa ikumi na umwe.
translation: Tangu Serikali ya Shirikisho ilipoingilia kati kuhusu ufadhili wa hospitali ya Mersey katika Davenport, Tasmania, serikali ya jimbo na baadhi ya wabunge wa shirikisho wameshutumu kitendo hiki kama sarakasi kabla ya uchaguzi wa kishirika utakaofanyika mnamo Novemba.

text: Indi Mũnene wa nthi, John Howard ni waasya kana kiko kii ni cha kusũvia syindũ sya sivitali ino kũmana na kwanangwa ni selikali ya Tasman kwa kũnengane AUD$ milioni 45 sya kwongeleela.
translation: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.

text: Indi Mũnene wa nthi, John Howard ni waasya kana kiko kii ni cha kusũvia syindũ sya sivitali ino kũmana na kwanangwa ni selikali ya Tasman kwa kũnengane AUD$ milioni 45 sya kwongeleela.
translation: Lakini Waziri Mkuu John Howard alisema kitendo hicho kilikuwa tu cha kulinda majengo ya hospitali kutokana na kushushwa hadhi na serikali ya Tasmania, kwa kutoa dola milioni 45 za Australia.

text: Kwianana na mauvoo ala mamituki, namba sya ukanga syonany'a tsunami undu yambiie. Vai o tsunami yaandikitwe vakuvi na Pago pago na Niue.
translation: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.

text: Kwianana na mauvoo ala mamituki, namba sya ukanga syonany'a tsunami undu yambiie. Vai o tsunami yaandikitwe vakuvi na Pago pago na Niue.
translation: Kulingana na taarifa za hivi punde, vipimo vya kiwango cha bahari vilionyesha tufani ilizalishwa. Kulikuwa na baadhi ya shughuli dhahiri za tufani zilizorekodiwa karibu na Pago Pago na Niue.

text: Vai wanango munene kana mauumisye malivotiwa kuu Tonga, ateo sitima nunaie o vanini, kila kyasiie athukumi ma Tonga kukwata warning ya tsunami kuma kwa PTWC.
translation: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.

text: Vai wanango munene kana mauumisye malivotiwa kuu Tonga, ateo sitima nunaie o vanini, kila kyasiie athukumi ma Tonga kukwata warning ya tsunami kuma kwa PTWC.
translation: Hakuna madhara makubwa au majeraha yaliyoripotiwa huko Tonga, lakini nguvu za umeme zilipotea kwa muda, hali ambayo iliripotiwa kuzuia mamlaka ya Tongan kupokea onyo la tsunami lililotolewa na PTWC.

text: Sukulu ikumi na inya ku Hawaii ila syi utee wa ukanga kana kuthengeania naw'o ninavingiwe syonthe kwi Wakatatu ona kwithiwa mokany'o asu ma nai manavetangwa.
translation: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.

text: Sukulu ikumi na inya ku Hawaii ila syi utee wa ukanga kana kuthengeania naw'o ninavingiwe syonthe kwi Wakatatu ona kwithiwa mokany'o asu ma nai manavetangwa.
translation: Shule kumi na nne katika Hawaii zilizoko au zilizo karibu na mipaka ya pwani zilifungwa siku nzima Jumatano licha ya tahadhari kuondolewa.

text: Plesitend wa ngwatanio ya Amelika George W. Bush niwathokisye itangaso.
translation: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.

text: Plesitend wa ngwatanio ya Amelika George W. Bush niwathokisye itangaso.
translation: Rais wa marekani George W. Bush alikaribisha tangazo hilo.

text: Muneeni wa Bush, Gordon Johndroe ni weetie kwivita kwa North Korea "itambya inene ya kumwa miio ya kau ila itaile Korea".
translation: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."

text: Muneeni wa Bush, Gordon Johndroe ni weetie kwivita kwa North Korea "itambya inene ya kumwa miio ya kau ila itaile Korea".
translation: Msemaji wa Bush Gordon Johndroe alitaja ahadi ya Korea Kaskazini kama "hatua kuu kuelekea lengo la kufikia uondoaji wa kuaminika wa silaha za kinyuklia katika rasi ya Kikorea."

text: Kiuutani kya ikumi kutw'iiwa isyita kwianana na musimu wa iuutani sya Atlantic, Subtropical Storm Jerry, kyumanie ukangani wa Atlantic umunthi.
translation: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

text: Kiuutani kya ikumi kutw'iiwa isyita kwianana na musimu wa iuutani sya Atlantic, Subtropical Storm Jerry, kyumanie ukangani wa Atlantic umunthi.
translation: Dhoruba ya kumi iliyopewa jina ya msimu wa Kimbunga cha Atlantiki, Dhoruba ya Nusutropiki ya Jerry, iliundwa katika Bahari ya Atlantiki leo.

text: National Hurricane Center (NHC) yasya kuvikia vu Jerry ndatonya kulikya nthi muisyoni.
translation: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.

text: National Hurricane Center (NHC) yasya kuvikia vu Jerry ndatonya kulikya nthi muisyoni.
translation: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Vimbunga (NHC) kinasema kwamba wakati huu, Jerry hakitoi tishio kwa ardhi.

text: Ma injinia ma Amelika maumisye woni kana inzi thanthatũ sya mbua nosyanange isiĩi ila syaĩ mbanangĩku vau mbeenĩ.
translation: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.

text: Ma injinia ma Amelika maumisye woni kana inzi thanthatũ sya mbua nosyanange isiĩi ila syaĩ mbanangĩku vau mbeenĩ.
translation: Corps of Engineers cha Marekani kilikadiria kwamba inchi 6 za mvua huenda zikabomoa matuta ambayo yaliharibiwa awali.

text: Woti wa kenda, ũla waĩ na kĩw'ũ kĩvĩtũku kya wingĩ wa vuti mĩongo ĩlĩ ĩvindanĩ ya Hurricane Katrina, o yu wĩna kĩw'ũ kĩvĩtũkũte mwĩyovonĩ tondũ kĩtheeo kya ũsĩ kĩla kĩ vakuvĩ nĩ kyoomoliwe.
translation: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.

text: Woti wa kenda, ũla waĩ na kĩw'ũ kĩvĩtũku kya wingĩ wa vuti mĩongo ĩlĩ ĩvindanĩ ya Hurricane Katrina, o yu wĩna kĩw'ũ kĩvĩtũkũte mwĩyovonĩ tondũ kĩtheeo kya ũsĩ kĩla kĩ vakuvĩ nĩ kyoomoliwe.
translation: Wadi ya Tisa, ambayo ilishuhudia mafuriko ya hadi futi 20 kwa kimo wakati wa Kimbunga Katrina, sasa iko kwenye maji yanayofikia kiunoni kwani tuta lililokuwa karibu lilifurika.

text: Kiwu nikitikite vau muthangani kwa vandu veana fiti 100 kwa uthanthau.
translation: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.

text: Kiwu nikitikite vau muthangani kwa vandu veana fiti 100 kwa uthanthau.
translation: Maji yanamwagika juu ya tuta katika sehemu ya futi 100 upana.

text: mũtongoĩ wa andũ Adam Cuerden nĩwoonanĩsye woo wake kũmana na kũvũtwa kũũ ĩla waneenĩe na wĩkĩnews mweĩ mũvĩtũkũ.
translation: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.

text: mũtongoĩ wa andũ Adam Cuerden nĩwoonanĩsye woo wake kũmana na kũvũtwa kũũ ĩla waneenĩe na wĩkĩnews mweĩ mũvĩtũkũ.
translation: Msimamizi wa Commons Adam Cuerden alielezea kufadhaika kwake kuhusu ufutaji huo alipoongea na Wikinews mwezi uliopita.

text: "Wales niwatukengie kuma mwambiio. Mbee, kutyonethya ii ni kitumi kya makoani. Keli, kwa kutwonethya niwatwithukiisye, nuseo vyu kuvutwa."
translation: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."

text: "Wales niwatukengie kuma mwambiio. Mbee, kutyonethya ii ni kitumi kya makoani. Keli, kwa kutwonethya niwatwithukiisye, nuseo vyu kuvutwa."
translation: "Yeye [Wales] kimsingi alindanganya tangu mwanzo. Kwanza kwa kufanya kama hii ni kwa sababu za kisheria. Pili, kwa kujifanya alikuwa anatusikiliza, hadi saana yake ifutwe."

text: Mathĩna ma ndũa matũmĩe kwĩyũmya kũkitana na maũndũ ma ũvũkũ mitandaonĩ ĩla yĩna andũ mĩlĩonĩ mbĩngĩ ĩla yĩ na mwanya wa kwonanya.
translation: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.

text: Mathĩna ma ndũa matũmĩe kwĩyũmya kũkitana na maũndũ ma ũvũkũ mitandaonĩ ĩla yĩna andũ mĩlĩonĩ mbĩngĩ ĩla yĩ na mwanya wa kwonanya.
translation: Hasira ya jamii imesababisha juhudi za sasa za kutayarisha sera kuhusu kadiri ya ngono kwa wavuti ambayo inakaribisha mamilioni ya vyombo vya habari vilivyo na leseni wazi.

text: Wia ula uminitwe kwikw'a mwingi waw'o wai wa mesilya, indi mutalatala usu waimuandike kwikany'a ta nguthu ya ndata ya Sagittarius.
translation: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.

text: Wia ula uminitwe kwikw'a mwingi waw'o wai wa mesilya, indi mutalatala usu waimuandike kwikany'a ta nguthu ya ndata ya Sagittarius.
translation: Kazi iliyofanywa ilikuwa hasa ya nadharia, lakini programu ilitengenezwa ili kuiga mitazamo iliyofanywa ya galaksi ya Mshale.

text: Undu ula timu yamanthaa wai utonya kwambiiw'a ni mavinya kati wa undu wi kivindu wa galaxy na undu wa Milky Way's.
translation: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.

text: Undu ula timu yamanthaa wai utonya kwambiiw'a ni mavinya kati wa undu wi kivindu wa galaxy na undu wa Milky Way's.
translation: Athari ambayo timu ilikuwa ikitafuta ingesababishwa na nguvu za mawimbi baina ya dutu nyeusi za galaksia na dutu nyeusi za Kilimia.

text: O taũndũ mwaĩ wĩthaa ũkũsĩtye nthĩ, na kũete makũmbo, now'o nzĩa ya ndata yĩthaa ĩkũsĩtye ndata sya Sagĩttarĩũs.
translation: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

text: O taũndũ mwaĩ wĩthaa ũkũsĩtye nthĩ, na kũete makũmbo, now'o nzĩa ya ndata yĩthaa ĩkũsĩtye ndata sya Sagĩttarĩũs.
translation: Kama vile mwezi unavuta nguvu duniani, na kusababisha mawimbi, vivyo hivyo ndivyo Njia ya Kimaziwa hutia nguvu kwenye giligili la alama ya Mshale.

text: Masayandisti nimamina uweta kana kindu kyu kiu nikithuaa kiu kingi kiu kwa nzia imwe undu kindu kikaa.
translation: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.

text: Masayandisti nimamina uweta kana kindu kyu kiu nikithuaa kiu kingi kiu kwa nzia imwe undu kindu kikaa.
translation: Wanasayansi waliweza kuhitimisha kuwa udusi mweusi unaathiri udusi mwingine mweusi kwa njia ile ile ya kawaida.

text: Ngewa ii yiasya syindu mbingi nduku yayayani syi ikumboni na iseovitwe ni ilembeta nini.
translation: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.

text: Ngewa ii yiasya syindu mbingi nduku yayayani syi ikumboni na iseovitwe ni ilembeta nini.
translation: Nadharia hii inasema kuwa dutu nyingi yenye giza inayozingira galaksi iko karibu na galaksi kwa aina ya mwangaza, na inatengenezwa kwa chembechembe nyingi ndogo.

text: Livoti sya televisheni syonany'a syũki mweũ ũyuma masinini ĩsu.
translation: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.

text: Livoti sya televisheni syonany'a syũki mweũ ũyuma masinini ĩsu.
translation: Ripoti kwenye televisheni zinaonyesha moshi mweupe unaotoka kwenye mmea huo.

text: Ita sya ku nisiendee na kukany'a ekali ala me vakuvi na mutambo usu mekali nyumbani matekumaala, mavosye vani sya nzeve na maikany'e kiw'u kya miveleki.
translation: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.

text: Ita sya ku nisiendee na kukany'a ekali ala me vakuvi na mutambo usu mekali nyumbani matekumaala, mavosye vani sya nzeve na maikany'e kiw'u kya miveleki.
translation: Mamlaka ya ndani inaonya wakaaji walio karibu na mmea huo kukaa ndani, kuzima viyoyozi na kutokunywa maji ya bomba.

text: Kulingana na muvea wa nuclear wa Japani, radioactive caesium na iodine nikwatikanie kambunini isu.
translation: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.

text: Kulingana na muvea wa nuclear wa Japani, radioactive caesium na iodine nikwatikanie kambunini isu.
translation: Kulingana na shirika la nyuklia la Japan, mionzi, cesiamu na iodini zimetambuliwa kiwandani.

text: Ũtongoi wĩasya ũũ nĩ wonany'o kana mĩtũngĩ ĩla yĩna maũta ma ũranĩũm vandũnĩ vau notayavũthũkie na yambĩĩa kwita.
translation: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.

text: Ũtongoi wĩasya ũũ nĩ wonany'o kana mĩtũngĩ ĩla yĩna maũta ma ũranĩũm vandũnĩ vau notayavũthũkie na yambĩĩa kwita.
translation: Serikali inabashiri kuwa hii inaonyesha kuwa vyombo vinayokuwa na Urani kwenye tovuti vinaweza kuwa vimetoboka na vinavuja.

text: Dr. Tony Moll niwaseovisye Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberclosis (XDR-TB) kisioni kya Kwazulu-Natal kila ki Avilika ya Itheo.
translation: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.

text: Dr. Tony Moll niwaseovisye Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberclosis (XDR-TB) kisioni kya Kwazulu-Natal kila ki Avilika ya Itheo.
translation: Dk. Tony Moll aligundua Kifua Kikuu Kinachokinza Dawa Kabisa (XDR-TB) katika eneo la KwaZulu-Natal, Afrika Kusini.

text: Maũneenany'anĩ, aaisye kũsenzanya kũu kweũ "kwaĩnamathĩna maĩngĩ na makũtelemya nũndũ kiwango kya kĩkw'ũ kyai yiulu".
translation: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."

text: Maũneenany'anĩ, aaisye kũsenzanya kũu kweũ "kwaĩnamathĩna maĩngĩ na makũtelemya nũndũ kiwango kya kĩkw'ũ kyai yiulu".
translation: Katika mahojiano, alisema aina mpya ilikuwa "ya kusumbua sana na ya kutisha kwa sababu ya kiwango cha juu cha kufariki."

text: Awau angi no methiwe makwatisw'e uwau usu me sivitali, Dr. Moll niw'o ukusuania, mainyiva andu eli mai athukumi ma sivitali.
translation: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.

text: Awau angi no methiwe makwatisw'e uwau usu me sivitali, Dr. Moll niw'o ukusuania, mainyiva andu eli mai athukumi ma sivitali.
translation: Huenda baadhi ya wagonjwa waliambukizwa mdudu huyo hospitalini, kama anavyofikiria Dkt. Moll, na angalau wawili walikuwa wafanyakazi hospitalini.

text: Nthini wa ivinda ya mwaka umwe, mundu muwau no akwatye andu ta 10 nginya 15 ala me vakuvi.
translation: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.

text: Nthini wa ivinda ya mwaka umwe, mundu muwau no akwatye andu ta 10 nginya 15 ala me vakuvi.
translation: Katika mwaka mmoja, mtu aliyeambukizwa huenda akaambukiza wato 10-15 wa karibu.

text: Ona oou, kilungu cha XDR-TB kikundini kiu kyonthe kya andũ ala mena TB ni kinini: andũ 6,000 kwa andũ 330,000 ala awaũ South Africa.
translation: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.

translation: Hakuna ilani ya tsunami iliyotolewa, na kulingana na uwakala wa jeofizikia wa Jakarta, hakuna ilani ya tsunami itakayotolewa kwani mtetemeko haukufikia ukubwa unaohitajika wa 6.5.

text: Moonekanaa me anou mũno ĩthaunĩ yĩla mathaũkaa na eĩtu-a-inya, Avilika ya ĩtheo o na vailye ta ũu nĩmaendeeie o nesa o ĩthau yĩendee na mbee.

text: Nzia syoo nzeo sya kwisiia, mituo ya ukwata muvila na kuthukuma ta timu ni watumie metha na kivathukany'o na angi na nimoonekanaa nimo meusinda.

text: Nzia syoo nzeo sya kwisiia, mituo ya ukwata muvila na kuthukuma ta timu ni watumie metha na kivathukany'o na angi na nimoonekanaa nimo meusinda.

text: Athukumi ma silikali ya ndua ya Amsterdam na nyũmba ya kwonany'a syĩndũ sya tene ya Anne Frank measya kana muti usu wina uwau wa fungus na niulikya andu muisyoni wa ki uima wa mwii na mongela kana ndwi ila utavaluka.
translation: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.

text: Athukumi ma silikali ya ndua ya Amsterdam na nyũmba ya kwonany'a syĩndũ sya tene ya Anne Frank measya kana muti usu wina uwau wa fungus na niulikya andu muisyoni wa ki uima wa mwii na mongela kana ndwi ila utavaluka.
translation: Maafisa wa mji wa Amsterdam na Makavazi ya Anne Frank wanasema kwamba mti huo umeambukizwa kuvu na unatoa hatari kwa afya ya jamii kwani walisema kwamba ulikuwa katika hatari ya karibu ya kuanguka.

text: Yavangiitwe kutilwa Wakeli, indi yateetheiwe itina wa ũsililo wa koti wa emangyenzi.

text: Kundu kwa kulililya kwa ngunga isu syonthe, ila syeetawa "Iiitu Muonza Masyaaniw'e", syaina ta mita 250 ila ni kati wa fiti 328 nginya fiti 820 kwa uthanthau.
translation: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.

text: Kundu kwa kulililya kwa ngunga isu syonthe, ila syeetawa "Iiitu Muonza Masyaaniw'e", syaina ta mita 250 ila ni kati wa fiti 328 nginya fiti 820 kwa uthanthau.
translation: Milango yote ya pango, iliyopewa jina "Dada Saba", ina kipenyo cha angalau mita 100 hadi 250 (futi 328 hadi 820).

text: Visa isu sionany'a kana uvinduku wa uvyuvu wa muthenya na utuku wionan'ya isu ni ngunga.
translation: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.

text: Visa isu sionany'a kana uvinduku wa uvyuvu wa muthenya na utuku wionan'ya isu ni ngunga.
translation: Picha za miale isiyoonekana zinaonyesha kwamba utofauti wa joto kati ya usiku na mchana unaonyesha kwamba huenda ni mapango.

text: Ni nthithu kwi mawithyululuko muthenya na muutia wiyoo.
translation: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.

text: Ni nthithu kwi mawithyululuko muthenya na muutia wiyoo.
translation: "Ni baridi kuliko maeneo ya karibu katika mchana na ni ya joto zaidi katika usiku.

text: "Tavia yoo ya uvuyũ ti steady ta ngunga nene nthi ila syikalakya uvuyũ steady, lakini syi consistent na maima maneno muthangani", aisye Glen Cushing wa United States Geological Survey (USGS) timu ya Astrogeology na kyuo kya Northern Arizona kila ki Flagstaff, Arizona.
translation: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.

text: "Tavia yoo ya uvuyũ ti steady ta ngunga nene nthi ila syikalakya uvuyũ steady, lakini syi consistent na maima maneno muthangani", aisye Glen Cushing wa United States Geological Survey (USGS) timu ya Astrogeology na kyuo kya Northern Arizona kila ki Flagstaff, Arizona.
translation: Tabia yazo ya kijoto si thabiti kama mapango makubwa katika Dunia ambayo mara nyingi hudumisha halijoto sawa kwa kadiri fulani, lakini inapatana nazo kuwa mashimo marefu ardhini," alisema Glen Cushing wa Timu ya Falakiolojia ya Utafiti wa Jiolojia wa Marekani (USGS) na wa Chuo Kikuu cha Arizona Kaskazini kilichoko Flagstaff, Arizona.

text: Kũya, France ũkũnĩ wa kũla kũma tene wĩthaa wĩ ĩtina wa ĩvĩnda : akũnĩ makũla makũnĩ kasũmbanĩ ũmwe kwo mwe na mayĩkĩa ĩthangũ valũanĩ monanĩtye ũla makũnĩa.
translation: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.

text: Kũya, France ũkũnĩ wa kũla kũma tene wĩthaa wĩ ĩtina wa ĩvĩnda : akũnĩ makũla makũnĩ kasũmbanĩ ũmwe kwo mwe na mayĩkĩa ĩthangũ valũanĩ monanĩtye ũla makũnĩa.
translation: Huko Ufaransa, upigaji kura tangu jadi umekuwa uzoefu wa teknolojia ambayo haijaimarika: wapigaji kura hujitenga kwenye kibanda, kisha wanaweka karatasi iliyochapishwa mapema kuonyesha mgombea wao wa uchaguzi katika bahasha.

text: Itina wa maovisaa kukusia kivandi kya mukuni wa kula, mukuni wa kula nikwikia vaasya usu isandukuni ya kukuna kula na ayikia saii ivuku ya akuni ma kula.
translation: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.

text: Itina wa maovisaa kukusia kivandi kya mukuni wa kula, mukuni wa kula nikwikia vaasya usu isandukuni ya kukuna kula na ayikia saii ivuku ya akuni ma kula.
translation: Baada ya maafisa kuthibitisha utambulisho wa mpigaji kura, mpigaji kura hutumbukiza bahasha kwenye sanduku la kura na kusaini orodha ya kupiga kura.

text: Mwiao wa usakuani wa France niwatiiawa ikoanini yii.
translation: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.

text: Mwiao wa usakuani wa France niwatiiawa ikoanini yii.
translation: Sheria ya uchaguzi ya Ufaransa badala yake hupanga kesi hiyo kwenye msimbo. Madhubuti.

text: Kuma 1988, mikeve ya kula yailwe ithwa yi ya kioo nikenda akuni ma kula na asyaiisya maikiithye vai mavaasya mevo ila iseso yikwambiia na vai vaasya syikwongelwa ateo ila italitwe tayali ni andu ma kutala metikilithitw'e.
translation: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.

text: Kuma 1988, mikeve ya kula yailwe ithwa yi ya kioo nikenda akuni ma kula na asyaiisya maikiithye vai mavaasya mevo ila iseso yikwambiia na vai vaasya syikwongelwa ateo ila italitwe tayali ni andu ma kutala metikilithitw'e.
translation: Tangu 1988, ni lazima masanduku ya kura yawe maangavu ili wapigaji kura na wachunguzi waweze kushuhudia kwamba hakuna bahasha zinazoongezwa isipokuwa zile za wapigaji kura waliohesabiwa na kuidhinishwa.

text: Ala maũtetea ivĩla sya kũũngamĩa nomatũme andũ ma ũmaũngamĩa kũsyaĩsya kĩla kĩlungu kya wĩa ũsu. Maĩyoo, kula italawa nĩ andũ ma kwĩyumya masiĩswe mũno, meatĩĩe mĩvango ntheu.
translation: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.

text: Ala maũtetea ivĩla sya kũũngamĩa nomatũme andũ ma ũmaũngamĩa kũsyaĩsya kĩla kĩlungu kya wĩa ũsu. Maĩyoo, kula italawa nĩ andũ ma kwĩyumya masiĩswe mũno, meatĩĩe mĩvango ntheu.
translation: Wagombeaji wanaweza kutuma wawakilishi kushuhudia kila sehemu ya mchakato. Jioni, kura huhesabiwa na watu waliojitolea chini ya usimamizi mkubwa, kwa kufuata utaratibu maalum.

text: Kombyũta ya ASUS Eee, ĩla yambĩĩw'e nthĩ yonthe nũndũ wa ũsiĩa wanangĩku wa mbesa na ũtũmĩki, nĩyo yaneeneiwe mũno nthĩnĩ wa mwei wa makombyũta wa Taipei mwaka wa 2007.

translation: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.

text: Ekali kaũta ma Bishkek nimatũlile mũti atetĩ kũma ngaliko ya nthi kwa kutula miao.

text: Ũsũngĩo wa mũthia wai usindi wa voindi ĩmwe, 21 na 20, wavikya muthia ũsindi wa All Blacks wa maita 15 kĩatĩanĩsyo.
translation: Alama ya mwisho ilikuwa ushindi wa nukta moja, 21 hadi 20, na kumaliza mfuo wa ushindi wa michezo wa Weusi Wote.

text: Kwa Springboks, yathela na ithau ya kwasya katano kiatianisyo.
translation: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.

text: Kwa Springboks, yathela na ithau ya kwasya katano kiatianisyo.
translation: Kwa Springboksi, iliishia kuwa mfuo wa kupoteza mechi-tano

text: Yai ithau ya muthya ya All Blacks, na ala mai masindite kikombe kiu syumwa ili mbitu.
translation: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.

text: Yai ithau ya muthya ya All Blacks, na ala mai masindite kikombe kiu syumwa ili mbitu.
translation: Ilikuwa mechi ya mwisho kwa All Blacks, ambao tayari walikuwa wameshinda kombe wiki mbili zilizopita.

text: Isindano ya muthya yiithwa vandu vetawa Ellis Park kuu Johannesburg kyumwa kyukite, ila Springboks methauka na Australia.
translation: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.

text: Isindano ya muthya yiithwa vandu vetawa Ellis Park kuu Johannesburg kyumwa kyukite, ila Springboks methauka na Australia.
translation: Mechi ya mwisho ya msururu itafanyika katika Ellis Park mjini Johannesburg wiki ijayo, wakati Springboks watakapocheza dhidi ya Australia.

text: Kuthingitha kwa nthi kwa kiasi kuthingithisye uthuiloni wa sua wa Montana saa 10:08 wioo wa kwambiliilya.
translation: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.

text: Kuthingitha kwa nthi kwa kiasi kuthingithisye uthuiloni wa sua wa Montana saa 10:08 wioo wa kwambiliilya.
translation: Mtetemeko wastani wa ardhi ulitikisa Montana magharibi saa 4 na dakika 8 usiku wa Jumatatu.

text: Vaii livoti sya mituki sy wanangiku sikwatikanite ni kisiio kya umanthi wa syindu sya nthi wa Amelika (USGS) na kisiio kyamy'o kya kwosanya mauvoo ma kuthingitha kwa nthi.
translation: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.

text: Vaii livoti sya mituki sy wanangiku sikwatikanite ni kisiio kya umanthi wa syindu sya nthi wa Amelika (USGS) na kisiio kyamy'o kya kwosanya mauvoo ma kuthingitha kwa nthi.
translation: Hakuna ripoti za sasa zilizopokewa na Utafiti wa Jiolojia wa Marekani (USGS) na Kituo chake cha Kitaifa cha Taarifa za Mitetemeko ya Ardhi.

text: Kĩthingitho kĩu kya nthĩ kyaĩ nthĩnĩ wa kĩlomita mĩongo ĩlĩ (maĩli ĩkumi na itano) ngalĩko ya ĩũlũĩ-ũĩlũ ya ũmothonĩ wa Dillon, vakuvĩ kĩlomita mĩongo thanthatũ na itano (maĩli mĩongo ĩna) ĩtheo wa Butte.
translation: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.

text: Kĩthingitho kĩu kya nthĩ kyaĩ nthĩnĩ wa kĩlomita mĩongo ĩlĩ (maĩli ĩkumi na itano) ngalĩko ya ĩũlũĩ-ũĩlũ ya ũmothonĩ wa Dillon, vakuvĩ kĩlomita mĩongo thanthatũ na itano (maĩli mĩongo ĩna) ĩtheo wa Butte.
translation: Kitovu cha mtetemeko huo kilikuwa takriban kilomita 20 (maili 15) kaskazini mwa kaskazini mashariki mwa Dillon, na takriban kilomita 65 (maili 40) kusini mwa Butte.

text: Uwau wa ikua ya nyaunyi sya yayaya ni muisyo muthuku kwa andu, H5N1, niyekiithwa yina uwau muthuku vyu wa ivaata ya kitheka, inamanyikie wakwambiliilya, kuu marshland vakuvi na Lyon umiloni wa sua wa France.
translation: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.

text: Uwau wa ikua ya nyaunyi sya yayaya ni muisyo muthuku kwa andu, H5N1, niyekiithwa yina uwau muthuku vyu wa ivaata ya kitheka, inamanyikie wakwambiliilya, kuu marshland vakuvi na Lyon umiloni wa sua wa France.
translation: Aina ya homa ya ndege iliyo hatari kwa binadamu, H5N1, imethibitishwa kuambukiza bata mwitu aliyekufa, aliyepatikana Jumatatu, katika kinamasi karibu na Lyon mashariki mwa Ufaransa.

text: France niyo nthi ya muonza nthini wa ngwatanio ya Europe kuumia nundu wa uwau ũũ, vatiie Australia, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece na itali.
translation: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.

text: France niyo nthi ya muonza nthini wa ngwatanio ya Europe kuumia nundu wa uwau ũũ, vatiie Australia, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece na itali.
translation: Ufaransa ni nchi ya saba katika Jumuiya ya Ulaya kukabiliwa na virusi hivi; kufuatia Austria, Ujerumani, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Ugiriki na Italia.

text: Makesi matesikie nesa ma H5N1 kuu Croatia na denmark meikala matemaikiithye.
translation: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.

text: Makesi matesikie nesa ma H5N1 kuu Croatia na denmark meikala matemaikiithye.
translation: Matukio yanayoshukiwa ya H5N1 katika Kroatia na Denmaki hayajathibitishwa.

text: Nimasikatie Ngai "nundũ wa ikw'ũ mbingi, wanango na wia kati ya mamilioni na mamilioni ma andũ."
translation: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."

text: Nimasikatie Ngai "nundũ wa ikw'ũ mbingi, wanango na wia kati ya mamilioni na mamilioni ma andũ."
translation: Ghambers alikuwa amemshtaki Mungu kwa "vifo, uharibifu na ugaidi uilioenea, wa mamilioni ya mamilioni ya wakaazi wa Dunia."

text: Chambers, mũleani na Ngai, easya kana ĩkũani yake nĩ "ĩthũku" na "mũndũ o wonthe no asikate mũndũ o wonthe."
translation: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."

text: Chambers, mũleani na Ngai, easya kana ĩkũani yake nĩ "ĩthũku" na "mũndũ o wonthe no asikate mũndũ o wonthe."
translation: Chambers, anayeamini kuwa kuwepo kwa Mungu hakujulikani, anasema kuwa kesi yake ni ya "kijinga" na "mtu yeyote anaweza kumshtaki yeyote."

text: Ngewa ila yanenganiwe nthini wa French Opera, ni Camille Saint-Saens, ni ya muthauki "ula mutuile wake uamuitwe ni wendo wa ndawa sya umila na Japan.
translation: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."

text: Ngewa ila yanenganiwe nthini wa French Opera, ni Camille Saint-Saens, ni ya muthauki "ula mutuile wake uamuitwe ni wendo wa ndawa sya umila na Japan.
translation: Hadithi iliyotolewa kwenye mchezo wa kifaransa wa kuigiza wa opera na Camille Saint-Saens ni wa msanii "ambaye maisha yake yanaamuriwa na upendo wa madawa na Japani.

text: Nundu wa uu, athauki manyusaa vangi nimavika stengyi, na thieta yo mweene ni kwendekethya andu malikane namo.
translation: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.

text: Nundu wa uu, athauki manyusaa vangi nimavika stengyi, na thieta yo mweene ni kwendekethya andu malikane namo.
translation: Kama matokeo, watendaji huvuta misokoto ya bangi kwenye jukwaa, na ukumbi wenyewe unawahimiza hadhira kushiriki.

text: Ula unai sivika Newt Gingrich, ngavana wa Texas Rick Perry, na mundu muka wa kongresi Michele Bachmann manaminie me namba inya, itano, na thanthatu, maatianie ou.
translation: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.

text: Ula unai sivika Newt Gingrich, ngavana wa Texas Rick Perry, na mundu muka wa kongresi Michele Bachmann manaminie me namba inya, itano, na thanthatu, maatianie ou.
translation: Spika wa awali Newt Gingrich, gavana wa Texas Rick Perry na Mbunge Michelle Bachmann walimaliza katika nafasi za nne, tano, na sita mtawalia.

text: Gingrich nitataiie Santorum ila mausungio maumie indi maina ndeto mbai kwa Romney ala mamaneneaa nai ivinda ya kwitya kula.
translation: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.

text: Gingrich nitataiie Santorum ila mausungio maumie indi maina ndeto mbai kwa Romney ala mamaneneaa nai ivinda ya kwitya kula.
translation: Baada ya matokeo kuingia, Gingrich alimpongeza Santorum, lakini alikuwa na maneno makali kwa Romney, ambaye matangazo hasi ya kampeni yalipeperushwa kwa niaba yake dhidi ya Gingrich.

text: Perry avangie "nukusyoka Teaxas kuasesi mosungio ma caucus ma miyoo, athiane kethwa ve nzia yakwa ya kuthi nambee", ateo itina aisye nokwikala isembani yiu na eimina mwei wa mbee matuku 21 kuu sukulu wa musingi wa Carolina ya itheo.
translation: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.

text: Perry avangie "nukusyoka Teaxas kuasesi mosungio ma caucus ma miyoo, athiane kethwa ve nzia yakwa ya kuthi nambee", ateo itina aisye nokwikala isembani yiu na eimina mwei wa mbee matuku 21 kuu sukulu wa musingi wa Carolina ya itheo.
translation: Perry alisema, "Nitarudi Texas ili kutathmini matokeo ya mkutano wa usiku wa leo, kuamua kama kuna njia yangu ya kusonga mbele katika mbio hizi", lakini baadaye akasema kwamba angebaki kwenye mbio na kushindana katika uchaguzi wa msingi wa Carolina Kusini mnamo Januari 21.

text: Bachmann, ũla nĩwe wasindie kula sya Ames Straw mwai wa Nyanya, atw'ie kũmina kambeni syake.
translation: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.

text: Bachmann, ũla nĩwe wasindie kula sya Ames Straw mwai wa Nyanya, atw'ie kũmina kambeni syake.
translation: Bachmann, aliyeshinda Kura ya maoni ya Ames Straw mnamo Agosti, aliamua kukomesha kampeni yake.

text: Mũkũni wa visa akuiwe atwawa nyumba ya uiiti munene ya Ronald Reagan UCLA vala mwisowe wakwie.
translation: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.

text: Mũkũni wa visa akuiwe atwawa nyumba ya uiiti munene ya Ronald Reagan UCLA vala mwisowe wakwie.
translation: Mpigaji picha alichukuliwa hadi Kituo cha Matibabu cha Ronald Reagan, ambako baadaye alifariki.

text: Mauvoo maisye ai na myaka 20 kindu. Bieber aineena aisye "Ndyai vo na ndyakonetwe na mbanga ii, mesilya na mboya yi na musyi wa ula unaaisye."
translation: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."

text: Mauvoo maisye ai na myaka 20 kindu. Bieber aineena aisye "Ndyai vo na ndyakonetwe na mbanga ii, mesilya na mboya yi na musyi wa ula unaaisye."
translation: Aliripotiwa kuwa katika miaka yake ya 20. Katika taarifa, Bierber alisema "Ingawa sikuwako au kuhusika na ajali hii mbaya moja kwa moja, mawazo na maombi yangu yako kwa familia ya muathiriwa."

text: Mũtandao wa maũtandĩthya TMZ ũeleawa kana mũkũnĩ wa vĩsa aũngamĩsye ngalĩ yake ngalĩko ĩngĩ ya Sepũlveda Boũlevard na atata kwosa vĩsa sya asĩkalĩ mayĩũngama matanamba kũkĩla nzĩa na kũendeea, kwa mĩtũkĩ lelũnĩ mũnene wa Carlĩfonĩa asĩkalĩ ala maĩlelũnĩ maũngamĩe na na mamũlasĩmĩthya kũsyoka mala elĩ.
translation: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.

text: Mũtandao wa maũtandĩthya TMZ ũeleawa kana mũkũnĩ wa vĩsa aũngamĩsye ngalĩ yake ngalĩko ĩngĩ ya Sepũlveda Boũlevard na atata kwosa vĩsa sya asĩkalĩ mayĩũngama matanamba kũkĩla nzĩa na kũendeea, kwa mĩtũkĩ lelũnĩ mũnene wa Carlĩfonĩa asĩkalĩ ala maĩlelũnĩ maũngamĩe na na mamũlasĩmĩthya kũsyoka mala elĩ.
translation: Tovuti ya habari za burudani TMZ inaelewa mpiga picha alisimamisha gari katika upande mwingine wa Sepulveda Boulevard na akajaribu kupiga picha za kizuizi cha polisi kabla ya kuvuka barabara na kuendelea, akamfanya afisa wa polisi wa California Highway Patrol aliyekuwa akiendesha kizuizi kumwamrisha kurudi katika upande mwingine, mara mbili.

text: Kumanwa na askali, deleva wa ngali ila yakongie mukuni wa visa ve vinya muno we kwikiwa mbini.
translation: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.

text: Kumanwa na askali, deleva wa ngali ila yakongie mukuni wa visa ve vinya muno we kwikiwa mbini.
translation: Kwa mujibu wa polisi, dereva wa gari lililomgonga mpigaji picha huenda akakabiliwa na mashtaka ya jinai.

text: Ve matuvĩ ĩkumi na nyanya kila mũthenya, nthi kaũta nĩ syĩemetwe ni kwosa ĩtuvĩ ona yĩmwe.
translation: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.

text: Ve matuvĩ ĩkumi na nyanya kila mũthenya, nthi kaũta nĩ syĩemetwe ni kwosa ĩtuvĩ ona yĩmwe.
translation: Huku medali kumi na nane zikipatikana kwa siku, baadhi ya nchi zimekosa kufikia jukwaa la medali.

text: Ni vamwe na Netherlands, na Anna Jochemsen mamina namba keenda ithauni ya aka kilasini kya Super-G iyoo, na Finland yina Katja Saarinen aminite e namba ikumi o ithauni yiu.
translation: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.

text: Ni vamwe na Netherlands, na Anna Jochemsen mamina namba keenda ithauni ya aka kilasini kya Super-G iyoo, na Finland yina Katja Saarinen aminite e namba ikumi o ithauni yiu.
translation: Ni pamoja na Uholanzi, huku Anna Jochemsen akimaliza wa tisa katika kitengo cha kusimama cha wanawake kwenye Super-G jana, na Ufini huku Katja Saarinen akimaliza wa kumi katika tukio hilo hilo.

text: Mitchell Gourley wa Australia aminie e namba ikumi na umwe nthini wa ithau ya kuungama kwa aume ya Super-G. Musindani wa Czech Oldrich Jelinek aminie e namba ikumi na thanthatu nthini wa ithau ya kwikala nthi ya aume ya Super-G.
translation: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.

text: Mitchell Gourley wa Australia aminie e namba ikumi na umwe nthini wa ithau ya kuungama kwa aume ya Super-G. Musindani wa Czech Oldrich Jelinek aminie e namba ikumi na thanthatu nthini wa ithau ya kwikala nthi ya aume ya Super-G.
translation: Mitchell Gourley wa Australia alimaliza wa kumi na mmoja katika kitengo cha kusimama cha wanaume cha Super-G. Mshindani wa Cheki Oldrich Jelinek alimaliza wa kumi na sita katika kitengo cha kuketi cha wanaume cha Super-G.

text: Arly Velasquez wa Mexico aminie e wa ikumi na itano ithauni ya aume ya Super-G. Ula wa New Zealand Adam Hall aminie e wa keenda ithauni yiu ya aume ya Super-G.
translation: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.

text: Arly Velasquez wa Mexico aminie e wa ikumi na itano ithauni ya aume ya Super-G. Ula wa New Zealand Adam Hall aminie e wa keenda ithauni yiu ya aume ya Super-G.
translation: Arly Velasquez wa Meksiko alimaliza kwa nafasi ya kumi na tano katika seti ya Super-G ya wanaume. Ukumbi wa Adam wa Zilandi Mpya lilimaliza wa tisa katika msimamo wa Super-G wa wanaume.

text: Musembi wa kilalinda munduume wa Poland Maciej Krezel na ula umwonasya nzia Anna Ogarzynska manamiinie me ikumi na itatu mathauni ma Super-G. Jong Seork Park wa Korea ya nthi ya Itheo anaminie e wa miongo ili na inya nthini wa mathau ma kwikala ma aume ma Super-G.
translation: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.

text: Musembi wa kilalinda munduume wa Poland Maciej Krezel na ula umwonasya nzia Anna Ogarzynska manamiinie me ikumi na itatu mathauni ma Super-G. Jong Seork Park wa Korea ya nthi ya Itheo anaminie e wa miongo ili na inya nthini wa mathau ma kwikala ma aume ma Super-G.
translation: Mtelezaji wa theluji asiyeona vizuri kutoka Poland Maciej Krezel na mwelekezi wake Anna Ogarzynska walimaliza wa kumi na tatu katika Super-G. Jong Seork Park kutoka Korea Kusini alimaliza wa ishirini na nne katika kikundi cha wanaume cha kuketi cha Super-G.

text: Andu ma kuete muuo ma UN, ala mavikie Haiti itina wa kuthingitha kwa nthi 2010, metulwa muti nundu wa kunyaiikya uwau ula wambiie vakuvi na kambi ya kikosi kyoo.
translation: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.

text: Andu ma kuete muuo ma UN, ala mavikie Haiti itina wa kuthingitha kwa nthi 2010, metulwa muti nundu wa kunyaiikya uwau ula wambiie vakuvi na kambi ya kikosi kyoo.
translation: Walinda amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa, ambao waliwasili Haiti baada ya mtetemeko wa ardhi wa 2010, wanalaumiwa kwa ueneaji wa ugonjwa huo ulioanza karibu na kambi ya kikosi hicho.

text: Kwianana na kusikatwa, kiko kuma kambu ya UN kuyaikuthesye nesa, kwatuma kwithwa na mbakitelia ilika kalusini kala kakwatanite na usi wa Artibonite, ula numwe wa mbusi ila nene kuu Haiti.
translation: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.

text: Kwianana na kusikatwa, kiko kuma kambu ya UN kuyaikuthesye nesa, kwatuma kwithwa na mbakitelia ilika kalusini kala kakwatanite na usi wa Artibonite, ula numwe wa mbusi ila nene kuu Haiti.
translation: Kulingana na shtaka hilo, uchafu kutoka kwenye kambi ya Umoja wa Mataifa haukutakaswa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha bakteria kuingia kwenye tawi la Mto Artibonite, mojawapo ya mito mikubwa sana ya Haiti.

text: Mbee wa kuvika kwa jeshi, Haiti ndyambite kwona mathina makonanity'e na uwau usu kuma myaka ya 1800.
translation: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.

text: Mbee wa kuvika kwa jeshi, Haiti ndyambite kwona mathina makonanity'e na uwau usu kuma myaka ya 1800.
translation: Kabla ya kufika kwa vikosi, Haiti haikuwa imekumbana na shida zinazohusiana na magonjwa tangu miaka ya 1800.

text: Muvia wa Haiti wa miao na uthasyo wa mawoni niutumiie usomi wa wa kwiyungamia ula unonanisye jeshi ya Nepalese ya kuete muuo ikwatanite na Ngwatanio ya Nthi inaetie uwau usu Haiti iteumanya.
translation: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.

text: Muvia wa Haiti wa miao na uthasyo wa mawoni niutumiie usomi wa wa kwiyungamia ula unonanisye jeshi ya Nepalese ya kuete muuo ikwatanite na Ngwatanio ya Nthi inaetie uwau usu Haiti iteumanya.
translation: Taasisi ya Haki na Demokrasia ya Haiti imerejelea utafiti huru ambao unapendekeza kwamba kikosi cha kulinda amani cha Kinepali cha Umoja wa Mataifa kilileta ugonjwa huo Haiti bila kujua.

text: Musomi uwau uu wa UN etawa Danielle Lantagane aisye uwau uu waetiwe ni asũvĩi ma mũuo.
translation: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.

text: Musomi uwau uu wa UN etawa Danielle Lantagane aisye uwau uu waetiwe ni asũvĩi ma mũuo.
translation: Danielle Lantagne, mtaalamu wa UN kuhusu ugonjwa huo, alisema kuna uwezekano mkurupuko huo ulisababishwa na walinda amani.

text: Hamilton nĩwaĩkĩĩthĩsye kana sĩvitalĩ wa yũnĩvasĩtĩ ya Howard nĩyoosĩe mũwaũ ũũ ekwa kondisyoni nzeo.
translation: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.

text: Hamilton nĩwaĩkĩĩthĩsye kana sĩvitalĩ wa yũnĩvasĩtĩ ya Howard nĩyoosĩe mũwaũ ũũ ekwa kondisyoni nzeo.
translation: Hamilton alithibitisha kwamba Chuo cha Howard kilimpokea mgonjwa akiwa katika hali thabiti.

text: Mũwaũ ũu ai Nigeria kũla andũ amwe mawaite Ebola.
translation: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.

text: Mũwaũ ũu ai Nigeria kũla andũ amwe mawaite Ebola.
translation: Mgonjwa alikuwa Nijeria, ambako baadhi ya matukio ya virusi vya Ebola yametokea.

text: Sivitalĩ nĩyatĩĩya mawalany'o kũsianĩa na kukwatany'a ũwau, mbaka kuvathukany'a awau kuma kwa ala angi ni kinda kusiĩa kukwatya angi ũwau.
translation: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.

text: Sivitalĩ nĩyatĩĩya mawalany'o kũsianĩa na kukwatany'a ũwau, mbaka kuvathukany'a awau kuma kwa ala angi ni kinda kusiĩa kukwatya angi ũwau.
translation: Hospitali imefuata itifaki ya kudhibiti maambukizi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutenga mgonjwa kutoka kwa wengine ili kuzuia uwezekano wa kuwaambukiza wengine.

text: Mbee wa Simpsons Simon atanamba uthukuma ivindini syi kivathukanyo kwa ivila syi kivathukanyo.
translation: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.

text: Mbee wa Simpsons Simon atanamba uthukuma ivindini syi kivathukanyo kwa ivila syi kivathukanyo.
translation: Kabla ya The Simpsons Simon alikuwa amefanyia kazi maonyesho kadhaa katika nafasi mbalimbali.

text: Myakani isu ya 1980 na kindu, ni wathukumaa ivindi imwe ta Taxi, Cheers, na The Tracy Ullman Show.
translation: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.

text: Myakani isu ya 1980 na kindu, ni wathukumaa ivindi imwe ta Taxi, Cheers, na The Tracy Ullman Show.
translation: Katika miaka ya 1980 alishughulikia vipindi kama vile Taxi, Cheers, na Onyesho la Tracy Ullman.

text: Mwakanĩ wa 1989 nĩwateetheĩsye kũseũvya Sĩmpsons kwa ũmĩsyo na mathĩna, na aũngamĩa kũandĩka kĩkũndĩ kya mbee kya kũandĩka mawonan'o.
translation: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.

text: Mwakanĩ wa 1989 nĩwateetheĩsye kũseũvya Sĩmpsons kwa ũmĩsyo na mathĩna, na aũngamĩa kũandĩka kĩkũndĩ kya mbee kya kũandĩka mawonan'o.
translation: Mnamo 1989 alisaidia kuunda The Simpsons Pamoja na Brooks na Groening, na ndiye aliyehusika katika kuajiri timu ya kwanza ya uandishi ya kipindi.

text: O na itina wa kutia shoo twi 1993 niwekalile na isyitwa ya producer munene, na aendeea ukwata ndola kauta kĩla mũsimũ.
translation: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.

text: O na itina wa kutia shoo twi 1993 niwekalile na isyitwa ya producer munene, na aendeea ukwata ndola kauta kĩla mũsimũ.

text: Mbeeni Xinhua kila nikisese kya mauvoo ku China nikiwetie ta ve ndeke yii inakwata ni imaamai.

text: Livoti sya itina sya wetaa ndeke isu yakwatie itisya ya mbomu na yavinduwa yasyokethya Afghanistan, iivuila ku kandahar.
translation: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.

text: Livoti sya itina sya wetaa ndeke isu yakwatie itisya ya mbomu na yavinduwa yasyokethya Afghanistan, iivuila ku kandahar.
translation: Kisha ripoti za baadaye zilisema ndege ilipokea tishio la bomu na ikaelekezwa tena Afganistani, na kutua Kandahar.

text: Mbanga sya kĩsevenĩ nĩsyĩkĩkaa mũno nthĩ ya Iran, ĩla yĩthaa na ita ngũũ na ila syĩthaa itenzuvĩe ũndũ vaĩle kwoondũ wa kũendeesya maũndũ ma layaa na ita sya kaũ.
translation: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.

text: Mbanga sya kĩsevenĩ nĩsyĩkĩkaa mũno nthĩ ya Iran, ĩla yĩthaa na ita ngũũ na ila syĩthaa itenzuvĩe ũndũ vaĩle kwoondũ wa kũendeesya maũndũ ma layaa na ita sya kaũ.
translation: Ajali za hewani ni kawaida nchini Iran, ambayo ina ndege ambazo huhifadhiwa kihafifu kwa shughuli za kiraia na zile za kijeshi.

text: Kwikiiwa mivaka ni nthi sya nza kwioneny'e kana ndeke nzau siyamba utoowa.
translation: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.

text: Kwikiiwa mivaka ni nthi sya nza kwioneny'e kana ndeke nzau siyamba utoowa.
translation: Vikwazo vya kimataifa vimemaanisha kuwa ndege mpya haiwezi kununuliwa.

text: Mwambiioni wa kyumwani kii, ndeke ya asikali ivalukile yoaa andu atatu na yaumisya angi atatu.
translation: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.

text: Mwambiioni wa kyumwani kii, ndeke ya asikali ivalukile yoaa andu atatu na yaumisya angi atatu.
translation: Mapema wiki hii, helikopta ya polisi ilianguka na kuua watu watatu na kujeruhi wengine watatu.

text: Mwai mũthelu Iran inonie muisyo wamyo muthuku vyu wa nzeveni kwa myaka mingi yila ndeke inaavalukile iendete Armenia, yauaa andu 168 ala manai nthini.
translation: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.

text: Mwai mũthelu Iran inonie muisyo wamyo muthuku vyu wa nzeveni kwa myaka mingi yila ndeke inaavalukile iendete Armenia, yauaa andu 168 ala manai nthini.
translation: Mwezi uliopita Iran iliona janga la hewani baya zaidi kwa miaka wakati ndege iliyokuwa ikielekea Amenia ilianguka na kuwaua watu wote 168.

text: O mwai ũsu nowo ndeke yasembie yavita kiwanza kya ndeke vu Mashhad na yakonga ukuta, yoowaa andu ikumi na muonza.
translation: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.

text: O mwai ũsu nowo ndeke yasembie yavita kiwanza kya ndeke vu Mashhad na yakonga ukuta, yoowaa andu ikumi na muonza.
translation: Katika mwezi huo huo ndege nyingine ya abiria ilipita njia yake katika Mashhad na kugonga ukuta, ikawaua watu kumi na saba.

text: Undu wi vata woneenany'a wa wakana wa Tokyo Game Show, muusumbi wa Nintendo Satoru Iwata niwoonanisye ndisaini ya console yavinya ya kusyiia ya kambuni ya Nintendo.
translation: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.

text: Undu wi vata woneenany'a wa wakana wa Tokyo Game Show, muusumbi wa Nintendo Satoru Iwata niwoonanisye ndisaini ya console yavinya ya kusyiia ya kambuni ya Nintendo.
translation: Katika uwasilishaji mkuu wa Onyesho la Mchezo la Tokyo Alhamisi, Rais wa Nintendo Satoru Iwata alizindua muundo wa kidhibiti cha kiweko kipya cha kampuni hiyo cha Nintendo Revolution.

text: Kithyanene ta kaindo ka usenzya televiseni, kaindo kau ka utongoesya katumiaa twindu twili twa ukamanyithya syindu ingi vala syii twiitwe vakuvi na televiseni ya mutumii ni kana amiungamye yithiwe ta iina mauthyu atatu na ii kiseveni.
translation: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.

text: Kithyanene ta kaindo ka usenzya televiseni, kaindo kau ka utongoesya katumiaa twindu twili twa ukamanyithya syindu ingi vala syii twiitwe vakuvi na televiseni ya mutumii ni kana amiungamye yithiwe ta iina mauthyu atatu na ii kiseveni.
translation: Ifananayo na rimoti ya runinga, kidhibiti hutumia sensa mbili zilizowekwa karibu na runinga ya mtumiaji ili kupata nafasi yake katika sehemu ya pande tatu.

text: Uu wituma athauki methwa na utonyi wa kusiia meko na muendele mathauni ma vindio kwa kwisilya i kindu kiseeveni.
translation: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.

text: Uu wituma athauki methwa na utonyi wa kusiia meko na muendele mathauni ma vindio kwa kwisilya i kindu kiseeveni.
translation: Hii itawaruhusu wachezaji kudhibiti machaguo na misogeo katika michezo ya video kwa kusogeza kifaa hewani.

text: Giancarlo Fisichella aaisye utonyii wa kutwaa ngali yake na amina lilie datika nini itina wa kwambiia.

text: Munyanyae wake wa timu Fernando Alonso anatongoestye ithau ta yonthe, ateo yathelile o ila waungamie yiimani, na noethwa no undu wa ndia ya mbee ya kw'oko kwa aume yai mbikie nai.

text: Munyanyae wake wa timu Fernando Alonso anatongoestye ithau ta yonthe, ateo yathelile o ila waungamie yiimani, na noethwa no undu wa ndia ya mbee ya kw'oko kwa aume yai mbikie nai.
translation: Mwanatimu mwenzake Fernando Alonso alikuwa akiongoza kwa wingi wa mbio hizo, lakini aliumaliza mara tu baada ya kusimama kwa matengenezo, labda kwa sababu ya gurudumu la kulia la mbele kushonwa vibaya.

text: Michael Schumacher aminie ithau yake atatianite muno na Alonso, nundu wa kuungamw'a kwa wanango makauni maingi aendee na ithau.
