text: Michael Schumacher aminie ithau yake atatianite muno na Alonso, nundu wa kuungamw'a kwa wanango makauni maingi aendee na ithau.
translation: Michael Schumacher alimaliza mbio zake muda mfupi baada ya Alonso, kwa sababu ya uharibifu wa mfumo wa kusimamisha gari, uliosababishwa na mapambano kadhaa wakati wa mbio hizo.

text: "Nimwanake na ingi ainaa nesa muno", aisye uu kwianana na mauvoo ma umbano wa transcript.
translation: "She's very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.

text: "Nimwanake na ingi ainaa nesa muno", aisye uu kwianana na mauvoo ma umbano wa transcript.
translation: "Ni mrembo sana na huimba vizuri sana, pia", alisema kulingana na manukuu ya kongamano la habari.

text: Ninasongaw'a kila ivinda ila tukwiyumbanisya uu, kuma nthini ngooni yakwa.

translation: "Niliguzwa kila wakati tulipofanya mazoezi ya hii, kutoka ndani ya moyo wangu."

text: itina wa datika 3 nthini wa kyauya kya muthenya, kamela kakuitwe kaonanisye twindu twingi twa insulation form break kuma kwa itanki ya mauta.
translation: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.

text: Munene wa ndeke ukui wa uthi na usyoka wa NASA N. Wayne Hale Jr. aisye ivuyu yavalukie "itina wa ivinda yila twai na vata nayo."
translation: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."

text: Munene wa ndeke ukui wa uthi na usyoka wa NASA N. Wayne Hale Jr. aisye ivuyu yavalukie "itina wa ivinda yila twai na vata nayo."

text: Ndatika Itano nthini wa kyonan'yo kiseve kyambiisya ulika, ta ndatika imwe uu itinani, kiseve kyavikiisya kilomita 70 kĩla ĩsaa… na indi mbua yauka, indi yi nyumu na nene muno ikakuna kikonde kyaku ta singano, na indi mbalavu yavaluka kuma matuuni, andu mena w'ia na kua mbu na kusemba iulu wa ala angi.
translation: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.

text: Ndatika Itano nthini wa kyonan'yo kiseve kyambiisya ulika, ta ndatika imwe uu itinani, kiseve kyavikiisya kilomita 70 kĩla ĩsaa… na indi mbua yauka, indi yi nyumu na nene muno ikakuna kikonde kyaku ta singano, na indi mbalavu yavaluka kuma matuuni, andu mena w'ia na kua mbu na kusemba iulu wa ala angi.
translation: Dakika tano ndani ya onyesho upepo unaanza kuingia, takriban dakika moja baadaye, upepo unafikia kilomita 70 kwa saa…kisha mvua inakuja, lakini kwa nguvu na kubwa sana kiasi kwamba inapiga ngozi yako kama sindano, kisha mvua ya mawe ikaanguka toka angani, watu wakapata wasiwasi na kupiga mayowe na kukanyangana.

text: Armand Versace aisye, "ni naaisye mwiitu tusyaaniwe na mũnyanya na niende vũ vai iwete ili tusulũlũni, andũ amaimavita na kũmasukũma".
translation: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.

text: Armand Versace aisye, "ni naaisye mwiitu tusyaaniwe na mũnyanya na niende vũ vai iwete ili tusulũlũni, andũ amaimavita na kũmasukũma".
translation: Nilimpoteza dadangu na rafiki yake, na nikiwa njiani kulikuwa na watu wawili wenye ulemavu kwenye viti vya magurudumu, watu waliruka tu juu yao na kuwasukuma," Armand Versace alisema.

text: NHK ni yaisye kisese cha kuseovya mwaki wa sitima cha Kashiwazaki Kariwa ni chathukumaa ta kawaita.

translation: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.

text: Mbomu ĩmwe ilivukie nza wa ovisi wa ngavana munene.

text: Mbomu ĩmwe ilivukie nza wa ovisi wa ngavana munene.
translation: Bomu moja lililipuka nje ya ofisi ya gavana mkuu.

text: Mbomu iingi itatu nituikie vakuvi na myako ya silikali kwa ilungu ya masaa eli.
translation: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.

text: Mbomu iingi itatu nituikie vakuvi na myako ya silikali kwa ilungu ya masaa eli.
translation: Mabomu matatu zaidi yalilipuka karibu na majengo ya serikali katika kipindi cha saa tatu.

text: Livoti imwe syiweta namba ya ikw'u ila mbikiithye ta nyanya, na utalo wa kuikiika wiweta kana andu ta 30 ni manakwatie maukite; indi utalo woonthe ndunamba kumanyikana.
translation: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.

text: Livoti imwe syiweta namba ya ikw'u ila mbikiithye ta nyanya, na utalo wa kuikiika wiweta kana andu ta 30 ni manakwatie maukite; indi utalo woonthe ndunamba kumanyikana.
translation: Baadhi ya ripoti zilionyesha idadi rasmi ya vifo kuwa vinane, na ripoti rasmi zinathibitisha kulikuwa na majeruhi hadi 30; lakini idadi kamili bado hazijajulikana.

text: Asiti ili sya cyanuric na melamaini nineethiiwe sambooni sya maumau ma nyamu sya musyi ila syakwie itina wa uya liu muthuku wa nyamu isu.
translation: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.

text: Asiti ili sya cyanuric na melamaini nineethiiwe sambooni sya maumau ma nyamu sya musyi ila syakwie itina wa uya liu muthuku wa nyamu isu.
translation: Asidi sayanuri na melanini zilipatikana kwenye sampuli za mkojo kutoka kwa wanyamavipenzi waliokufa baada ya kula chakula kichafu cha wanyamavipenzi.

text: Kompaundi isu ili syakwatana iseuvasya tuvila tula tusiiaa uthukumi wa mbio, uu unawetiwe ni akunikili kuma kimanyisyoni kyu.
translation: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.

text: Kompaundi isu ili syakwatana iseuvasya tuvila tula tusiiaa uthukumi wa mbio, uu unawetiwe ni akunikili kuma kimanyisyoni kyu.
translation: Kampaundi hizo mbili humenyuka pamojakutengeneza fuwele ambazo zinaweza kuzuia kazi za figo, watafiti chuoni walisema.

text: Mumanthi wa maundu oonie twindu tumu tuseuvitw'e maumooni ma mbaka itina wa kwongela melamine na asindi ya cyanuric.
translation: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.

text: Mumanthi wa maundu oonie twindu tumu tuseuvitw'e maumooni ma mbaka itina wa kwongela melamine na asindi ya cyanuric.
translation: Watafiti waliona uwele zilizoundwa katika mkojo wa paka kwa kuongezewa melamine na asidi ya sianiuriki.

text: Syindu ila iseuvity'e Klisto ii syivyanene na isu syithiawa maumaoni ma nyamu ndwau ila waathithya kwa infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translation: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

text: Syindu ila iseuvity'e Klisto ii syivyanene na isu syithiawa maumaoni ma nyamu ndwau ila waathithya kwa infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translation: Mchanganyiko wa fuwele hizi unalingana na wa zile zinazopatikana kwenye mkojo wa wanyamavipenzi walioathiriwa ikilinganishwa kutumia uchunguzi wa miale isiyoonekana (FTIR).

text: Ndyisi kana waamba umanya, ateo mioo mingi kuma Amelika ya kati syavikie nthi ii vate kuiva koti.
translation: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.

text: Ndyisi kana waamba umanya, ateo mioo mingi kuma Amelika ya kati syavikie nthi ii vate kuiva koti.
translation: Sijui kama unatambua hili au la, lakini nyingi ya bidhaa kutoka Marekani ya Kati ziliingia humu nchini bila kulipiwa ushuru.

text: ona ilungu ya 80 iulu wa yiana ya miio yitu yatilawa koti syi kivathukany'o ku nthi sya kati sya America. Yu nituumwony'a.
translation: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.

text: ona ilungu ya 80 iulu wa yiana ya miio yitu yatilawa koti syi kivathukany'o ku nthi sya kati sya America. Yu nituumwony'a.
translation: Na bado asilimia themanini ya bidhaa zetu zilitozwa ushuru kupitia orodha za ushuru katika nchi za Marekani ya Kati.

text: Kĩĩũ kĩyaambelea nye; kĩyaambendeesya ona vanĩnĩ.
translation: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.

text: Kĩĩũ kĩyaambelea nye; kĩyaambendeesya ona vanĩnĩ.
translation: Hilo halikuonekana kuwa na maana kwangu; hakika halikuwa la haki.

text: Undu niyaa andu ni tukue undu tuukukua.
translation: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.

text: Undu niyaa andu ni tukue undu tuukukua.
translation: Ninachosema kwa watu ni kwamba nyinyi mtutendee jinsi tunavyowatendea.

text: Ngavana wa California Arnold Schwarzenegger niwekie sahii mwiao ula ukunite maluvuku kuta na kukomboethya kwa itau ya vitio yina kithokoo na kau kwa kyana nini.
translation: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

text: Ngavana wa California Arnold Schwarzenegger niwekie sahii mwiao ula ukunite maluvuku kuta na kukomboethya kwa itau ya vitio yina kithokoo na kau kwa kyana nini.
translation: Gavana wa California Arnold Schwarzenegger alisaini kuwa sheria mswada unaopiga marufuku uuzwaji au ukodishwaji wa michezo ya video yenye vurugu kwa wasiofikia utu uzima.

text: Mwiao huu wendaa mathaũ ma vindio ala mena kaũ kuandikwa pandũ penekee "18" na mateea mũndũ atavikitye myaka 18 ni maivaa vaini wa Ndola 1000 kwa kila ikosa.
translation: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.

text: Mwiao huu wendaa mathaũ ma vindio ala mena kaũ kuandikwa pandũ penekee "18" na mateea mũndũ atavikitye myaka 18 ni maivaa vaini wa Ndola 1000 kwa kila ikosa.
translation: Mswada huo unahitaji michezo ya video yenye vurugu inayouzwa katika jimbo la Kalifornia kuwa na lebo iliyoandikwa "18" na kufanya mauzo yake kwa watoto wadogo kuwa na adhabu ya faini ya dola 1000 kwa kila kosa.

text: Munene wa kumya utwi wa mavityo kwa wanda, Kier Starmer QC, aumisye livoti kwakya kuu aitangaasa utwi wa Huhne na Pryce.
translation: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.

text: Munene wa kumya utwi wa mavityo kwa wanda, Kier Starmer QC, aumisye livoti kwakya kuu aitangaasa utwi wa Huhne na Pryce.
translation: Kiongozi wa Mashtaka ya Umma, Wakili Kier Starmer, alitoa taarifa asubuhi ya leo akitangaza kushtakiwa kwa Huhne na Pryce.

text: Huhne ni weenyumisye uvisini na Ed Davey MP nu kwosa kivila kiu. Norman Lamb MP nu kwosa kivila kya unene wa viasala kila Davey ukuma.
translation: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.

text: Huhne ni weenyumisye uvisini na Ed Davey MP nu kwosa kivila kiu. Norman Lamb MP nu kwosa kivila kya unene wa viasala kila Davey ukuma.
translation: Huhne amejiuzulu na nafasi yake katika Baraza la Mawaziri itachukuliwa na mbunge Ed Davey. Mbunge Norman Lamb anatarajiwa kuchukua kazi ya Waziri wa Biashara inayoachwa na Davey.

text: Huhne na Pryce ni mandikiwe kuvika mbee wa asili ma makoani ma Westminster matuku 16 mwai wa keli.
translation: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.

text: Huhne na Pryce ni mandikiwe kuvika mbee wa asili ma makoani ma Westminster matuku 16 mwai wa keli.
translation: Huhne na Pryce wameratibiwa kutokea katika Mahakama ya Hakimu ya Westminster mnamo Februari 16.

text: Ala matiwa ni thayu ni Nicholas Alden, 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback atwie e ndeleva.
translation: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.

text: Ala matiwa ni thayu ni Nicholas Alden, 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback atwie e ndeleva.
translation: Vifo vilikuwa vya Nicholas Alden, 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback alikuwa dereva.

text: Edgar niwakwatie itau kwoko na ukambu na Kristoffer Schneider ni watiiwe aile kuthĩnzwa uthyu.
translation: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.

text: Edgar niwakwatie itau kwoko na ukambu na Kristoffer Schneider ni watiiwe aile kuthĩnzwa uthyu.
translation: Edgar Veguilla alipata majeraha ya mkono na taya huku Kristoffer Schneider akihitaji upasuaji wa kurekebisha uso wake.

text: Muio ya kau ya Uka niwaanagikie alootete mutwe wa mundu wa kana. Schneider ena mauumiu, nthong'o iitho yimwe, nimutiloiku chongo na uthyu ni useuvitwe na chuma.
translation: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.

text: Muio ya kau ya Uka niwaanagikie alootete mutwe wa mundu wa kana. Schneider ena mauumiu, nthong'o iitho yimwe, nimutiloiku chongo na uthyu ni useuvitwe na chuma.
translation: Silaha ya Uka ilikosa kufanya kazi huku ikilenga kichwa cha mwanamume wa tano. Schneider ana maumivu yanayoendelea, upofu katika jicho moja, hana sehemu ya fuvu na uso uliotengenezwa kwa titani.

text: Schneider nunaumisye ukusi wake kwisila vitio kuma ngome imwe ya USAF ku nthi isu yoo.
translation: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.

text: Schneider nunaumisye ukusi wake kwisila vitio kuma ngome imwe ya USAF ku nthi isu yoo.
translation: Schneider alitoa ushahidi kupitia kiungo cha video kutoka makazi ya Jeshi la Anga la Amerika katika nchi yake.

text: Carpanedo ni wasindanite mathau angi ma andu mbene mbee wa mathau ma Wakatatu.
translation: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.

text: Carpanedo ni wasindanite mathau angi ma andu mbene mbee wa mathau ma Wakatatu.
translation: Zaidi ya tukio la Jumatatu, Carpanedo alishindana katika mbio mbiliza kibinafsi katika Ubingwa.

text: Yake ya mbee yai Slalom, vala wamimeisye na ndaamina isembani yake ya mbee. 36 yiulu wa asindani 116 mai na mosungio amwe isembani yiu.
translation: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.

text: Yake ya mbee yai Slalom, vala wamimeisye na ndaamina isembani yake ya mbee. 36 yiulu wa asindani 116 mai na mosungio amwe isembani yiu.
translation: Yake ya kwanza ilikuwa Slalom, ambapo alipata Hakumaliza katika mbio zake za kwanza. 36 wa washindani 116 walikuwa na matokeo sawa katika mbio hizo.

text: Ĩsemba yake yĩngĩ, ya Giant Slalom, yatumie amina e wa ikumi kati ka kikundi kya aka kya kwikala ena ivinda yonthe ya usemba ya ndatika 4:41.30, ndatika 2:41.60 nthi wa ũla waminie e wa mbee Claudia Loesch wa Australia na ndatika 1:09.02 nthĩ wa ũla waĩ wa kenda kũmina Gyongyi Dani wa Hungary.
translation: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.

text: Ĩsemba yake yĩngĩ, ya Giant Slalom, yatumie amina e wa ikumi kati ka kikundi kya aka kya kwikala ena ivinda yonthe ya usemba ya ndatika 4:41.30, ndatika 2:41.60 nthi wa ũla waminie e wa mbee Claudia Loesch wa Australia na ndatika 1:09.02 nthĩ wa ũla waĩ wa kenda kũmina Gyongyi Dani wa Hungary.
translation: Alimaliza wa kumi katika mbio yake nyingine, Giant Slalom, kwenye kitengo cha kuketi cha wanawake kwa muda uliojumuishwa wa ukimbiaji wa 4:41.30, dakika 2:11.60 polepole kuliko aliyemaliza katika nafasi ya kwanza Mwaustralia Claudia Loesch na dakika 1:09.02 polepole kuliko aliyemaliza katika nafasi ya tisa Gyongyi Dani wa Hungaria.

text: Asembĩ ana ma mbalavuni ma kĩkũndĩ kya ĩvetĩ nĩmaemĩwe nĩ kũmĩna masemba moo, na 45 ĩũlũ wa 117 ma asembĩ onthe kũũ Giant Slalom nĩmaemĩe kũsĩndana mathaũnĩ.
translation: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.

text: Asembĩ ana ma mbalavuni ma kĩkũndĩ kya ĩvetĩ nĩmaemĩwe nĩ kũmĩna masemba moo, na 45 ĩũlũ wa 117 ma asembĩ onthe kũũ Giant Slalom nĩmaemĩe kũsĩndana mathaũnĩ.
translation: Wazungu wanne kwenye kundi la wanawake walishindwa kumaliza mbio zao, na 45 ya 117 walifeli na kushindwa kupata nafasi kwenye mbio hizo.

text: Asĩkalĩ ma Madhya Pradesh nĩmoosĩe kompyuta na sĩmũ ĩla syooyĩtwe.
translation: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.

text: Asĩkalĩ ma Madhya Pradesh nĩmoosĩe kompyuta na sĩmũ ĩla syooyĩtwe.
translation: Polisi wa Madhya Pradesh walikipata kipakatalishi na simu ya rununu iliyoibwa.

text: Munini wa Munene wa Askali, D K Arya aisye, "ni tũkwatite andu atano ala mavũkitye mundumuka ũu wa Switzerland na makwata simu na laptop yake".
translation: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".

text: Munini wa Munene wa Askali, D K Arya aisye, "ni tũkwatite andu atano ala mavũkitye mundumuka ũu wa Switzerland na makwata simu na laptop yake".
translation: Naibu Inspekta Jenerali D K Arya alisema, "tumewakamata watu watano waliomnajisi mwanamke huyo Mswisi na tukapata rununu na kompyuta ndogo yake."

text: Esililw'a mesikanie ta Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
translation: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.

text: Esililw'a mesikanie ta Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.
translation: Washtakiwa wanatajwa kamaBaba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar, na Vishnu Kanjar.

text: Munene wa polisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki aisye esililw'a manaumilile kotini mavw'ikite mothyu moo.
translation: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.

text: Munene wa polisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki aisye esililw'a manaumilile kotini mavw'ikite mothyu moo.
translation: Mkuu wa polisi Chandra Shekar Solanki alisema mshtakiwa alitokea mahakamani na uso uliofunikwa.

text: O na vala andu atatu mei nthini wa nyumba ila ngali imikongie, vai mundu unaumia.
translation: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.

text: O na vala andu atatu mei nthini wa nyumba ila ngali imikongie, vai mundu unaumia.
translation: Ingawa watu watatu walikuwa ndani ya nyumba wakati gari liliigonga, hakuna aliyejeruhiwa.

text: O na vamwe na uu, ndeleva niwakwatie mauumisye manene mutweni wake.
translation: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.

text: O na vamwe na uu, ndeleva niwakwatie mauumisye manene mutweni wake.
translation: Hata hivyo, dereva alipata majeraha mabaya kwenye kichwa.

text: Leluni vala mbanga isu yakitikie nivangiwe kwa kavinda oila andu ma mbee ma kuokoa maumasya ndeleva kgalini isu ndune ya Audi TT.
translation: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.

text: Leluni vala mbanga isu yakitikie nivangiwe kwa kavinda oila andu ma mbee ma kuokoa maumasya ndeleva kgalini isu ndune ya Audi TT.
translation: Barabara ambamo mgongano ulifanyika ilifungwa kwa muda wakati huduma za dharura walipokuwa wakiokoa dereva kutoka kwa Audi TT nyekundu.

text: Yambee aitiiwa sivitalini wa James Paget ku Great Yarmouth.
translation: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

text: Yambee aitiiwa sivitalini wa James Paget ku Great Yarmouth.
translation: Mwanzoni alikuwa amelazwa kwenye Hospitali ya James Paget katika Great Yarmouth.

text: Kwa undu usu niwesio uthamiiw'a sivitalini wa Addenbrooke kuu Cambridge.
translation: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

text: Kwa undu usu niwesio uthamiiw'a sivitalini wa Addenbrooke kuu Cambridge.
translation: Baadaye alihamishiwa Hospitalini Addenbrooke katika Cambridge.

text: Adekoya onayũ ethaa koti wa Edinburgh Sheriff asĩkatĩwe ĩvĩtyo ya kũũa kĩvĩsĩ kyake.
translation: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.

text: Adekoya onayũ ethaa koti wa Edinburgh Sheriff asĩkatĩwe ĩvĩtyo ya kũũa kĩvĩsĩ kyake.
translation: Tangu wakati huo Adekoya amekuwa katika Mahakama ya Edinburg Sheriff kwa mashtaka ya kumuua mwanaye.

text: Nĩ mũkwate eteele kusikatwa na ĩkwani kusilwa, ĩndĩ ũkũsĩ wonthe wa mũndũ wonie kĩla kyekĩkie nowanangĩke tondũ visa wake nĩwonanitw'e kĩla vandũ.
translation: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.

text: Nĩ mũkwate eteele kusikatwa na ĩkwani kusilwa, ĩndĩ ũkũsĩ wonthe wa mũndũ wonie kĩla kyekĩkie nowanangĩke tondũ visa wake nĩwonanitw'e kĩla vandũ.
translation: Yuko korokoroni akisubiri mashtaka na kesi, lakini ushahidi wowote wa walioshuhudia huenda ukaathirika vibaya kwa sababu picha yake imechapishwa sana mahali kwingi.

text: ĩĩ syĩkawa mũnomũno kũndũ kũngĩ ũK ĩndĩ tĩ ũsĩlĩlo Scottish ũla ũthũkũma kĩvathũkanyo na kotĩ syo syonete ũmĩthyo wa mavisa ta ũsĩlĩlo wa mbee.
translation: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.

text: ĩĩ syĩkawa mũnomũno kũndũ kũngĩ ũK ĩndĩ tĩ ũsĩlĩlo Scottish ũla ũthũkũma kĩvathũkanyo na kotĩ syo syonete ũmĩthyo wa mavisa ta ũsĩlĩlo wa mbee.
translation: Hii ni desturi kwingineko Uingereza lakini haki ya Kiskoti hufanya kazi kwa njia tofauti na mahakama zimeangalia uchapishaji wa picha kama wenye ubaguzi.

text: Profesa pamela Ferguson wa kimanyisyo kinene kya Dendee amanya "aandiki ma mauvoo mesile laini wi muisyo kethwa nimekutumbithya visa sya suspects."
translation: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."

text: Profesa pamela Ferguson wa kimanyisyo kinene kya Dendee amanya "aandiki ma mauvoo mesile laini wi muisyo kethwa nimekutumbithya visa sya suspects."
translation: Profesa Pamela Ferguson wa Chuo Kikuu cha Dundee anasema "wanahabari wanaonekana kujihatarisha kwa kuchapisha picha n.k. za watuhumiwa."

text: Crown Office, ila yithiawa iungamie kesi syonthe sya ngaliko ya usikatani, yonanisye kwa atangasi ma mauvoo kana ndina undu itonya kuweta vatonyeka nginya kyovo kyumw'e.
translation: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.

text: Crown Office, ila yithiawa iungamie kesi syonthe sya ngaliko ya usikatani, yonanisye kwa atangasi ma mauvoo kana ndina undu itonya kuweta vatonyeka nginya kyovo kyumw'e.
translation: Crown Office, ambayo husimamia mashtaka, imeashiria kwa wanahabari kwamba hakuna maoni ya ziada yatakayotolewa angalau hadi mashtaka yafanyike.

text: Iithangu, kwianana na undu yaumiw'e vatai mwanya, yikanenea uemano wa mivakani, ula Palestina ikwenda withiwe wianeenw'e na mivaka ya mbee wa kau wa Mideast wa mwaka wa 1967.
translation: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.

text: Iithangu, kwianana na undu yaumiw'e vatai mwanya, yikanenea uemano wa mivakani, ula Palestina ikwenda withiwe wianeenw'e na mivaka ya mbee wa kau wa Mideast wa mwaka wa 1967.
translation: Hati hiyo, kulingana na fununu, itarejelea mzozo wa mipaka, ambayo Palestina inataka iwe na msingi wa mipaka kabla ya Vita vya 1967 vya Mashariki ya Kati.

text: Syindu ingi ila syaneneewe syiwa ni vamwe na mwikalile wa mthenya ya mbeeni ya Yelusalemu ila ii ntheu kulakwi nthi syonthe syi ili na undu ula wakonetye Jordan Valley.
translation: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.

text: Syindu ingi ila syaneneewe syiwa ni vamwe na mwikalile wa mthenya ya mbeeni ya Yelusalemu ila ii ntheu kulakwi nthi syonthe syi ili na undu ula wakonetye Jordan Valley.
translation: Mada nyingine zilizoshughulikiwa inaripotiwa zinatia ndani hali ya baadaye ya Yerusalemu ambayo ni takatifu kwa mataifa yote mawili na suala la Bonde la Yordani.

text: Israel yienda kwithe na ita kyandani kwa myaka ikumi meetha na ngwatanio nayo PA niyitikilile kuma vau miaka itano yoka.
translation: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.

text: Israel yienda kwithe na ita kyandani kwa myaka ikumi meetha na ngwatanio nayo PA niyitikilile kuma vau miaka itano yoka.
translation: Israeli inadai kuendelezwa kwa uwepo wa kijeshi katika bonde hilo kwa miaka kumi pindi mkataba utakapotiwa saini huku PA ikikubali kuondoa uwepo huo kwa miaka mitano tu.

text: Aathi nthini wa iseso ya kutata maaile kusyaiisw'a kwa vakuvi ni asikali ma ita sya kusuvia mititu, iseso yiu yiisyaiiw'a na wailu wayo kuikiithwa.
translation: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.

text: Aathi nthini wa iseso ya kutata maaile kusyaiisw'a kwa vakuvi ni asikali ma ita sya kusuvia mititu, iseso yiu yiisyaiiw'a na wailu wayo kuikiithwa.
translation: Walenga shabaha katika jaribio la ziada la kudhibiti visumbufu walipaswa kusimamiwa na walinzi, kwani jaribio lingefuatiliwa na ufanisi wake kutathminiwa.

text: Mevamwe na NPWS na kĩkũndĩ kya kwonany'a mathaũ kya Aũstralĩa (NSW) ĩnc, andũ ala meyũmĩtye mavĩtĩe nĩmaandĩkĩwe nthĩnĩ wa mũvango wa ũmantha andũ ma kwonany'a mathaũ.
translation: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.

text: Mevamwe na NPWS na kĩkũndĩ kya kwonany'a mathaũ kya Aũstralĩa (NSW) ĩnc, andũ ala meyũmĩtye mavĩtĩe nĩmaandĩkĩwe nthĩnĩ wa mũvango wa ũmantha andũ ma kwonany'a mathaũ.
translation: Kwa kushirikiana na NPWS na Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, wajitoleaji waliohitimu waliandikishwa, chini ya mpango wa uwindaji wa Sporting Shooters Association.

text: Kwosana na Mick O'Flynn, Munene ula wakwatiie kivila cha Park Conservation and Heritage pamwe na NPWS, ala masakuiwe ivinda ya kuatha kwa mbee ni makwatie usuvii na miao ya kiimasomo.
translation: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.

text: Kwosana na Mick O'Flynn, Munene ula wakwatiie kivila cha Park Conservation and Heritage pamwe na NPWS, ala masakuiwe ivinda ya kuatha kwa mbee ni makwatie usuvii na miao ya kiimasomo.
translation: Kwa mujibu wa Mick O'Flynn, Kaimu Mkurugenzi wa Uhifadhi wa Mbuga na Urithi katika NPWS, walenga shabaha hao wanne walioteuliwa kwa operesheni ya kwanza ya upigaji risasi walipokea mafunzo na maagizo kamili ya usalama.

text: Martelly nĩweevitie nzamani nzaũ ya ũsakuani ya Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) ya andũ kenda iyoo.
translation: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.

text: Martelly nĩweevitie nzamani nzaũ ya ũsakuani ya Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) ya andũ kenda iyoo.
translation: Martelly aliapisha Baraza mpya la muda la Uchaguzi la (CEP) la wanachama tisa jana.

text: Nĩ CEP ya katano ya Martelly nthĩnĩ wa myaka ĩna.
translation: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.

text: Nĩ CEP ya katano ya Martelly nthĩnĩ wa myaka ĩna.
translation: Ni CEP ya tano ya Martelly katika miaka minne.

text: Mwei mũthelu kĩsese kya muungamii wa selikali ya nthi kinaumisye woni wa kũtia wia kwa CEP ta imwe ya matambya ma utwaa nthi kwa unyuvani mweu.
translation: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.

text: Mwei mũthelu kĩsese kya muungamii wa selikali ya nthi kinaumisye woni wa kũtia wia kwa CEP ta imwe ya matambya ma utwaa nthi kwa unyuvani mweu.
translation: Mwezi uliopita tume ya rais ilipendekeza kujiuzulu kwa CEP iliyotangulia kama sehemu ya kifurushi cha hatua za kusogeza nchi kuelekea uchaguzi mpya.

text: Komiseni yai usungio wa Martelly wa kunyaiikya utongoi uuleana na maandamano ala mambiie mwei wa ikumi.
translation: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.

text: Komiseni yai usungio wa Martelly wa kunyaiikya utongoi uuleana na maandamano ala mambiie mwei wa ikumi.
translation: Tume ilikuwa jibu la Martelly kwa maandamano yaliyoenea dhidi ya utawala ambayo yalianza mnamo Oktoba.

text: Maandamano ala methwaa saa ingi me na kau mambiiaw'a ni kukosa usakuani, amwe kuma 2011.
translation: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.

text: Maandamano ala methwaa saa ingi me na kau mambiiaw'a ni kukosa usakuani, amwe kuma 2011.
translation: Maandamano hayo ambayo wakati mwingine huwa jeuri yalianzishwa na ukosefu wa kuwa na uchaguzi, ambapo mwingine ulichelewa tangu 2011.

text: Makesi vakũvĩ 60 ma ũvyũvũ mwĩngĩ ma ĩPods nĩmalivotiiwe, ĩetete myaki thanthatũ ki na kũtia andũ ana mena maũvĩvye manini.
translation: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.

text: Makesi vakũvĩ 60 ma ũvyũvũ mwĩngĩ ma ĩPods nĩmalivotiiwe, ĩetete myaki thanthatũ ki na kũtia andũ ana mena maũvĩvye manini.
translation: Takriban matukio 60 ya iPod zenye kasoro kutoa joto jingi yameripotiwa, hivyo kusababisha jumla ya mioto sita na kuwaacha watu wanne na majeraha madogo ya kuchomeka.

text: Muvea wa ekonomi wa Japani, Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) waisye kana niyeesi mbanga 27 syikonanitw'e na kindu kiu.
translation: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.

text: Muvea wa ekonomi wa Japani, Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) waisye kana niyeesi mbanga 27 syikonanitw'e na kindu kiu.
translation: Wizara ya Uchumi, Biashara na Viwanda ya Japani (METI) ilisema ilijua ajali 27 zilizohusiana na vifaa hivyo.

text: Kyumwa kithelu, METI nimanatangaasie kana Apple niyamatavitye iulu wa wongeleku wa kesi 34 sya kuvyuva muno, na ila kambuni isu inasyetie "itena uito".
translation: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."

text: Kyumwa kithelu, METI nimanatangaasie kana Apple niyamatavitye iulu wa wongeleku wa kesi 34 sya kuvyuva muno, na ila kambuni isu inasyetie "itena uito".
translation: Wiki iliyopita, METI ilitangaza kwamba Apple ilikuwa imewaarifu kuhusu matukio 34 ya ziada ya utoaji wa joto jingi, ambayo kampuni hiyo ilisema "hayakuwa makubwa."

text: Muvea usu wasungiie kwa kumita livoti ya kuthamiisya ya Apple ta ya "kwilila kwaw'o".
translation: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."

text: Muvea usu wasungiie kwa kumita livoti ya kuthamiisya ya Apple ta ya "kwilila kwaw'o".
translation: Wizara hiyo ilijibu kwa kuita kuhairishwa kwa ripoti na Apple kuwa kwa "kusikitisha sana."

text: Kĩthingitho kya nthĩ kyakũnie Mariana saa ũmwe na Ndatĩka ĩkũmi na Kenda sya kwakya masaa ma nthĩ ĩsu (09:19 p.m. GMT Wakatano).
translation: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).

text: Kĩthingitho kya nthĩ kyakũnie Mariana saa ũmwe na Ndatĩka ĩkũmi na Kenda sya kwakya masaa ma nthĩ ĩsu (09:19 p.m. GMT Wakatano).
translation: Tetemeko la ardhi lilipiga Mariana saa 7 dakika 19 asubuhi wakati wa ndani (saa 9 dakika 19 usiku GMT Ijumaa).

text: Ovisi wa kĩkũndi kya kũtetheesya yĩla ve thĩna mũnene kya Northern Marianas kyaisye vaĩ wanangĩko waatavanywa nthĩ ĩsũ.
translation: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.

text: Ovisi wa kĩkũndi kya kũtetheesya yĩla ve thĩna mũnene kya Northern Marianas kyaisye vaĩ wanangĩko waatavanywa nthĩ ĩsũ.
translation: Ofisi ya udhibiti wa dharura ya Marianas Kaskazini ilisema kwamba hakuna madhara yaliyoripotiwa katika taifa.

text: Ona kituo kya kukany'a andu ila Tsunami yukite yinaisye kutyai manowanany'o ma kuneethiiwe kwi Tsunami.
translation: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.

text: Ona kituo kya kukany'a andu ila Tsunami yukite yinaisye kutyai manowanany'o ma kuneethiiwe kwi Tsunami.
translation: Pia, Kituo cha Onyo ya Tsunami cha Pasifiki kilisema kuwa hakukuwa na dalili ya Tsunami.

text: Ula wai musikali wa Filipino akwatite mateka mbasi sya atalii ma Hong Kong kuu Manila, musyi munene wa Philippines.
translation: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.

text: Ula wai musikali wa Filipino akwatite mateka mbasi sya atalii ma Hong Kong kuu Manila, musyi munene wa Philippines.
translation: Polisi wa kitambo wa Filipino amewateka nyara watalii wa Hong Kong kwa kuteka basi lao katika Manila, mji mkuu wa Ufilipino.

text: Rolando Mendoza nunatuikiisye atalii ivuti yake ya M16.
translation: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.

text: Rolando Mendoza nunatuikiisye atalii ivuti yake ya M16.
translation: Rolando Mendoza alifyatua bunduki yake ya M16 kwa watalii.

text: Amwe ma ala makwetwe mateka nimaovow'a na mainyiva thanthatu nimaikiithwa kithwa makw'a tayali.
translation: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.

text: Amwe ma ala makwetwe mateka nimaovow'a na mainyiva thanthatu nimaikiithwa kithwa makw'a tayali.
translation: Mateka kadhaa wamenusuriwa na angalau sita wamethibitishwa kufa kufikia sasa.

text: Ala manakwatitwe mateka thanthatu, me vamwe na syana na andu akuu, nimalekiw'e tene, nundu mai akuni ma visa ma Filipino.
translation: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.

text: Ala manakwatitwe mateka thanthatu, me vamwe na syana na andu akuu, nimalekiw'e tene, nundu mai akuni ma visa ma Filipino.
translation: Mateka sita, wakiwemo watoto na wazee, waliachiliwa mapema kama vile wapiga picha wa Ufilipino.

text: Ikiithya kw'oko kwaku ni kuleelu undu vatonyeka o mbato uendee uthauka noti isu nesa- na ingi ndukatate kwikala uisongya syaa syaku muno na vinya.
translation: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.

text: Ikiithya kw'oko kwaku ni kuleelu undu vatonyeka o mbato uendee uthauka noti isu nesa- na ingi ndukatate kwikala uisongya syaa syaku muno na vinya.
translation: Wapiga picha baadaye walichukua nafasi ya mwanamke mzee kwani alihitaji kwenda haja. Mendoza alivamiwa kwa risasi.

text: lĩggĩns atĩĩye maũndũ ma ĩthe na alĩka ũsomĩnĩ wa dawa.
translation: Liggins followed in his father's footsteps and entered a career in medicine.

text: lĩggĩns atĩĩye maũndũ ma ĩthe na alĩka ũsomĩnĩ wa dawa.
translation: Liggins alifuata nyayo za babake na kujiunga na kazi ya udaktari.

text: Afundiitw'e ta mwisikya na ambiie uthuma sivitalini wa iveti wa Auckland National twi 1959.
translation: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.

text: Afundiitw'e ta mwisikya na ambiie uthuma sivitalini wa iveti wa Auckland National twi 1959.
translation: Alijifunza kuwa mkunga na akaanza kufanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Wanawake ya Auckland mnamo 1959.

text: Yila wathukumaa sivitalini Liggins ambiisye kumantha uw'o iulu wa woo wa usyai wa ivinda itai iviku ivindani yila utai na wia mwingiwa kwika.
translation: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.

text: Yila wathukumaa sivitalini Liggins ambiisye kumantha uw'o iulu wa woo wa usyai wa ivinda itai iviku ivindani yila utai na wia mwingiwa kwika.
translation: Alipokuwa akifanya kazi hospitalini, Liggins alianza kuchunguza uchungu wa mapema wa uzazi katika muda wake wa ziada.

text: Ukunikili wake woonanisye kana keka hormone niyanenganiwe yithwa yakalaatile mavui ma kana kwiana kiwango kila kyaile.
translation: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.

text: Ukunikili wake woonanisye kana keka hormone niyanenganiwe yithwa yakalaatile mavui ma kana kwiana kiwango kila kyaile.
translation: Utafiti wake ulionyesha kwamba kama homoni ingetumiwa, ingeongeza kasi ya ukuaji wa mapafu ya mtoto.

text: Xinhua niyawetie kana akyungusi ma silikali nimakwatie "mbokisi nziu" ilĩ sya ndeke ila ilekotia wakatatu.
translation: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.

text: Xinhua niyawetie kana akyungusi ma silikali nimakwatie "mbokisi nziu" ilĩ sya ndeke ila ilekotia wakatatu.
translation: Xinhua aliripoti kwamba wachunguzi wa serikali walipata vifaa vya 'sanduku nyeusi' vya kurekodi matukio kwenye ndege siku ya Jumatano.

text: okiti angi onamo nimanenganie ndaia ya mwiso kwa Luna.
translation: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.

text: okiti angi onamo nimanenganie ndaia ya mwiso kwa Luna.
translation: Mabondia wenzake pia walimuombeleza Luna.

text: Tommy Dreamera aĩsye "lũna aĩ mũsũmbĩ wa mbee mũthũkũ. Mũnene wake wa mbee. Lũna akwĩe ũtũkũ wa mweĩ ĩlĩ.mwanake take.kĩvetĩ kĩlũmũ."
translation: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."

text: Tommy Dreamera aĩsye "lũna aĩ mũsũmbĩ wa mbee mũthũkũ. Mũnene wake wa mbee. Lũna akwĩe ũtũkũ wa mweĩ ĩlĩ.mwanake take.kĩvetĩ kĩlũmũ."
translation: Tommy Dreamer alisema, "Luna alikuwa Malkia wa kwanza wa Kukithiri. Meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna aliaga dunia mnamo usiku wa miezi miwili. Kipekee kama alivyo tu. Mwanamke hodari."

text: Dustin "Golddust" Runnels niwaneeneie yiulu wa "Luna ai musaanu takwa…onethwa e mbee…nimwendete na ningumumisi…niikwatya e vandu vaseo."
translation: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."

text: Dustin "Golddust" Runnels niwaneeneie yiulu wa "Luna ai musaanu takwa…onethwa e mbee…nimwendete na ningumumisi…niikwatya e vandu vaseo."
translation: Justin "Goldust" Runnels ametoa maoni kwamba "Luna alikuwa mdhaifu kama mimi … labda hata zaidi … umpende na utamkosa… kwa matumaini yupo mahali pazuri."

text: Yiulu wa andu 1,400 ala makunie kula mbee wa 2010, ala maleanaa na Australia yiitwika nthi yisumbikite namba yambatie na vaasendi ya 8 kuma 2008.
translation: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.

text: Yiulu wa andu 1,400 ala makunie kula mbee wa 2010, ala maleanaa na Australia yiitwika nthi yisumbikite namba yambatie na vaasendi ya 8 kuma 2008.
translation: Kwa watu 1,400 waliopiga kura ya maoni kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2010 wa shirikisho, wale wanaopinga Australia kuwa jamhuri waliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.

text: Julia Gillard nthini wa kambeini ya usakũani mũnene mwaka wa 2010 aisye kana niwaikĩie kana Australia ni yaile kwitha yiyũngamie itina wa ũsumbĩ wa Queen Elizabeth II chathela.
translation: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.

text: Julia Gillard nthini wa kambeini ya usakũani mũnene mwaka wa 2010 aisye kana niwaikĩie kana Australia ni yaile kwitha yiyũngamie itina wa ũsumbĩ wa Queen Elizabeth II chathela.
translation: Kaimu Waziri Mkuu Julia Gillard alidai wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa ushirika wa 2010 kwamba aliamini Australia inafaa kuwa jamhuri mwishoni mwa utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II.

text: Andũ mĩongo itatũ na ĩna yĩũlũ wa yĩana nĩmenda mũka mũsũmbĩ Elizabeth ĩĩ ethe e mũsũmbĩ wa mwĩso wa Australia.
translation: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.

text: Andũ mĩongo itatũ na ĩna yĩũlũ wa yĩana nĩmenda mũka mũsũmbĩ Elizabeth ĩĩ ethe e mũsũmbĩ wa mwĩso wa Australia.
translation: Asilimia 34 ya walio kwenye uchunguzi wanashiriki maoni haya, kumtaka Malkia Elizabeth wa II awe malikia wa mwisho wa Australia.

text: Kiwangoni kya iũlu kya ũtalo ũu, andu 29 kwa kila 100 ala mekiwe ukũnikili measya Australia yailite ũtwikithya nthi yiyungamie mitũki ila itonyeka na andũ 31 kwa kila 100 measya iyaile kutwika nthi yiyũngamie.
translation: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.

text: Kiwangoni kya iũlu kya ũtalo ũu, andu 29 kwa kila 100 ala mekiwe ukũnikili measya Australia yailite ũtwikithya nthi yiyungamie mitũki ila itonyeka na andũ 31 kwa kila 100 measya iyaile kutwika nthi yiyũngamie.
translation: Katika wingi wa kura, asilimia 29 ya wale waliofanyiwa utafiti wanaamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, huku asilimia 31 wakiamini Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.

text: Mũsindi wa thaavu wa Olympic aĩlĩle kũthambĩa nthĩnĩ wa mathaũ ma mita 100 na mita 200 itaĩ mawatho na masindano atatũ ma masemba nthĩnĩ wa mathaũ ma Commonwealth, ĩndĩ nũndũ wa mũnyungunyĩsyo wake waĩlu wake wa mwĩĩ yu nĩwĩthĩĩtwe na nzika.
translation: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.

text: Mũsindi wa thaavu wa Olympic aĩlĩle kũthambĩa nthĩnĩ wa mathaũ ma mita 100 na mita 200 itaĩ mawatho na masindano atatũ ma masemba nthĩnĩ wa mathaũ ma Commonwealth, ĩndĩ nũndũ wa mũnyungunyĩsyo wake waĩlu wake wa mwĩĩ yu nĩwĩthĩĩtwe na nzika.
translation: Aliyeshinda nishani ya dhahabu ya Olimpiki alikuwa amepangiwa kuogelea katika mtindo huru wa mita 100 na mita 200 na mbio tatu za kupokezana vijiti katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kwa sababu ya malalamiko yake uzima wake umekuwa na shaka.

text: Ethiitwe atekunywa ndawa sya kuola kyalya nundu nimbatane mathauni.
translation: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.

text: Ethiitwe atekunywa ndawa sya kuola kyalya nundu nimbatane mathauni.
translation: Hakuweza kunywa dawa zinazohitajika kutuliza maumivu yake kwani zimepigwa marufuku katika Michezo.

text: Curtis cooper, mwĩkĩ wa masavu na masomo ma kombyũta, sukulu mũnene wa Central Missouri, nĩwe wamanyĩe namba ĩla nene vyũ ĩtonya kũanĩka na ĩmwe na yo mbene yĩyoka mweĩ wa mbee matukũ 25.
translation: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.

text: Curtis cooper, mwĩkĩ wa masavu na masomo ma kombyũta, sukulu mũnene wa Central Missouri, nĩwe wamanyĩe namba ĩla nene vyũ ĩtonya kũanĩka na ĩmwe na yo mbene yĩyoka mweĩ wa mbee matukũ 25.
translation: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri, amegundua nambari tasa kubwa zaidi kufikia sasa mnamo Januari 25.

text: Andu kauta nimaikiithisye kwa kutumia hardware na software kivathukany'o mwambiioni wa mwei wa keli na inatangaasiwe wakeli.
translation: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.

text: Andu kauta nimaikiithisye kwa kutumia hardware na software kivathukany'o mwambiioni wa mwei wa keli na inatangaasiwe wakeli.
translation: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.

text: Comets noetha syumasya kiwu ikaete kuu nthi vamwe na tusamu tunini ina itonya useuvya protein na kuendeesya maisa.
translation: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.

text: Comets noetha syumasya kiwu ikaete kuu nthi vamwe na tusamu tunini ina itonya useuvya protein na kuendeesya maisa.
translation: Kuna uwezekano kwamba nyotamkia zilikuwa chanzo cha kusafirisha maji katika dunia, pamoja na vitu vilivyo na kaboni vinavyoweza kuunda protini na kusaidia uhai.

text: Anasayanzi nimendaa kuelewa undu nthi isoovawya, muno muno undu nthi yasoovie, nundu comets kya konganie na nthi ivinda ya tene.
translation: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.

text: Anasayanzi nimendaa kuelewa undu nthi isoovawya, muno muno undu nthi yasoovie, nundu comets kya konganie na nthi ivinda ya tene.
translation: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.

text: Cuomo, ula wina myaka 53 ambiiisye ũtongoi wake mwaka huu ũyambiisya na avitukithya mwiao wa kũtwaana kwa andu ma uko umwe (uume kana uka).
translation: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.

text: Cuomo, ula wina myaka 53 ambiiisye ũtongoi wake mwaka huu ũyambiisya na avitukithya mwiao wa kũtwaana kwa andu ma uko umwe (uume kana uka).
translation: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.

text: Ndeto isu itaĩ mbĩkĩĩthye asyĩtie "kĩneene na ũtumanu wa kĩ siasa".
translation: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".

text: Ndeto isu itaĩ mbĩkĩĩthye asyĩtie "kĩneene na ũtumanu wa kĩ siasa".
translation: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".

text: Nukwikwatiw'a kwithwa eyukitania kivila kya plesitendi twi 2016.
translation: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.

text: Nukwikwatiw'a kwithwa eyukitania kivila kya plesitendi twi 2016.
translation: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.

text: NextGen ni walany'o FAA ikwasya ni uketikithya ndeke kwisila nzia nguvi na kũsuvia mauta ma ndeke kila mwaka na kũtulia kũmya makaa (carbon).
translation: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.

text: NextGen ni walany'o FAA ikwasya ni uketikithya ndeke kwisila nzia nguvi na kũsuvia mauta ma ndeke kila mwaka na kũtulia kũmya makaa (carbon).
translation: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.

text: Itũmĩaa tekinolongyia ya iulu ila itai undu umwe na ila syai sya tenange sya uungu-wa-nthi kunenga mwanya ala masianya syalo sya nzeveni kwona ndeke nesa vyu na kunenga atwai ma ndeke uvoo mutheu vyu.
translation: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.

text: Itũmĩaa tekinolongyia ya iulu ila itai undu umwe na ila syai sya tenange sya uungu-wa-nthi kunenga mwanya ala masianya syalo sya nzeveni kwona ndeke nesa vyu na kunenga atwai ma ndeke uvoo mutheu vyu.
translation: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.

text: Vai ukui ungi wivo na ngali sya mwaki iyungama Wembley, na kuvaki ngali na kuvaki uithi ingi kuivo vanduni vau.
translation: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.

text: Vai ukui ungi wivo na ngali sya mwaki iyungama Wembley, na kuvaki ngali na kuvaki uithi ingi kuivo vanduni vau.
translation: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.

text: W'ia wa kwaa nzia sya kuthi kyalo waetie utonyekani kana ithau yikalasimika kuthaukiwa itina wa miomo mivinge vatai akwatiliili ma timu.
translation: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.

text: W'ia wa kwaa nzia sya kuthi kyalo waetie utonyekani kana ithau yikalasimika kuthaukiwa itina wa miomo mivinge vatai akwatiliili ma timu.
translation: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.

text: Isomo itumbithiw'e wakana ithanguni ya saenzi yoonanasya kuseuvya kungi kwa muvai wa nyunyi ya yayaya kuu kithamani kya Ecuador Galapagos.
translation: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.

text: Isomo itumbithiw'e wakana ithanguni ya saenzi yoonanasya kuseuvya kungi kwa muvai wa nyunyi ya yayaya kuu kithamani kya Ecuador Galapagos.
translation: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.

text: Asomĩ kũma univasĩtĩ ya princeton kũya United States na univasĩtĩ ya Uppsala nthi ya sweden nĩmawetĩe kana mĩthemba ĩngĩ nĩ ya ũmĩlĩle n maũsyoa elĩ, onavala yatwĩkĩkanĩe kana nĩsye kalĩlĩle mũno nũndũ wa kũvandĩthwa katĩkatĩ wa endamic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes na athamĩ ma cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translation: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.

text: Asomĩ kũma univasĩtĩ ya princeton kũya United States na univasĩtĩ ya Uppsala nthi ya sweden nĩmawetĩe kana mĩthemba ĩngĩ nĩ ya ũmĩlĩle n maũsyoa elĩ, onavala yatwĩkĩkanĩe kana nĩsye kalĩlĩle mũno nũndũ wa kũvandĩthwa katĩkatĩ wa endamic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes na athamĩ ma cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translation: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.

text: Thaavũ no ĩseũvwe myũmbĩle kĩvathũkangany'o. No ĩthiuukw'e ĩkatwĩka maũmbo manini.
translation: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.

text: Thaavũ no ĩseũvwe myũmbĩle kĩvathũkangany'o. No ĩthiuukw'e ĩkatwĩka maũmbo manini.
translation: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.

text: No ikusw'e ikesila wayani mutheke, ula utonya ukunzwa na ukombiiwa. No ikuniiwe kana ikakunzwa ta ivati.
translation: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.

text: No ikusw'e ikesila wayani mutheke, ula utonya ukunzwa na ukombiiwa. No ikuniiwe kana ikakunzwa ta ivati.
translation: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.

text: No íthekevywe vyu, na iyumbííwa kyumani kingi. No íthekevywe vyu ukethia saa ingi noitumiwe kwanakavya mavisa ala masoletwe na moko kwa mavuku metawa "illuminated manuscripts".
translation: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".

text: No íthekevywe vyu, na iyumbííwa kyumani kingi. No íthekevywe vyu ukethia saa ingi noitumiwe kwanakavya mavisa ala masoletwe na moko kwa mavuku metawa "illuminated manuscripts".
translation: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa "miswada iliyoangazwa".

text: Ino yitawa pH ya kemikoo. No useuvye indiketa utumiite njuisi ndune ya ikovisi.
translation: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.

text: Ino yitawa pH ya kemikoo. No useuvye indiketa utumiite njuisi ndune ya ikovisi.
translation: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.

text: Suvu wa ikovisi ni usenzasya langi kulingana na undu ndawa ii yina asindi kana "base".
translation: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.

text: Suvu wa ikovisi ni usenzasya langi kulingana na undu ndawa ii yina asindi kana "base".
translation: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.

text: pH levo yonanawo ni kiwango kya Hydrogen (H nthini wa pH) ions kwa kemikoo ila yiuthimwa.
translation: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.

text: pH levo yonanawo ni kiwango kya Hydrogen (H nthini wa pH) ions kwa kemikoo ila yiuthimwa.
translation: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.

text: Mbeleete sya nzeve ya Hydrogen ni protons ila electron syoo syoosiwe (atom sya Hydrogen syithaa na proton imwe na electron imwe).
translation: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).

text: Mbeleete sya nzeve ya Hydrogen ni protons ila electron syoo syoosiwe (atom sya Hydrogen syithaa na proton imwe na electron imwe).
translation: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).

text: Thiuukya mbota ii ili mbumu na itina uivilinga itwike muvila.
translation: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

text: Thiuukya mbota ii ili mbumu na itina uivilinga itwike muvila.
translation: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.

text: Kimeu kila ki mokoni maku nukiukitana na kikonde kya nza, ula uutuma wiw'a kyama na kuseuvya kindu ta ílúngúsa.
translation: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.

text: Kimeu kila ki mokoni maku nukiukitana na kikonde kya nza, ula uutuma wiw'a kyama na kuseuvya kindu ta ílúngúsa.
translation: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.

text: Mĩsyĩ mĩnene ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro yaĩna syoo sya ũkũna kĩla nyũmba, na ĩkakwatanywa na mĩvelekĩ mĩseo ya kũkũa ĩko.
translation: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.

text: Mĩsyĩ mĩnene ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro yaĩna syoo sya ũkũna kĩla nyũmba, na ĩkakwatanywa na mĩvelekĩ mĩseo ya kũkũa ĩko.
translation: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.

text: Matialy'o ma kula kwĩsĩlaa kĩko kya syoonĩ nĩmethĩĩwe nyumbanĩ sya mĩsyĩ ya Minoa ya Crete na Santorini kũya Ũkiliki.
translation: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

text: Matialy'o ma kula kwĩsĩlaa kĩko kya syoonĩ nĩmethĩĩwe nyumbanĩ sya mĩsyĩ ya Minoa ya Crete na Santorini kũya Ũkiliki.
translation: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.

text: Vai o syoo nthi ya tene ya Misili, Persia na kyeina. Kuiva kwa Roman, syoo saa ingi syai vandu va kuthambia vala aume na aka methwaa vamwe.
translation: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.

text: Vai o syoo nthi ya tene ya Misili, Persia na kyeina. Kuiva kwa Roman, syoo saa ingi syai vandu va kuthambia vala aume na aka methwaa vamwe.
translation: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.

text: Ila weeta mundu wi maili makili kauta vaasa naku, withwaa uitumia setilaiti.
translation: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

text: Ila weeta mundu wi maili makili kauta vaasa naku, withwaa uitumia setilaiti.
translation: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.

text: Kindũ kila kĩ yayayanĩ kwosaa kũkũnwa kwa simu na kĩimitũnga ĩtheo o saa ĩsũ.
translation: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.

text: Kindũ kila kĩ yayayanĩ kwosaa kũkũnwa kwa simu na kĩimitũnga ĩtheo o saa ĩsũ.
translation: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.

text: Setilaiti yatumiwe kiseeveni ni kyombo. Sayantisti matumia telescope kiseeveni nundu nzeve ya nthi niyanangaa kyeni kimwe na kwona nesa.
translation: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth's atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.

text: Setilaiti yatumiwe kiseeveni ni kyombo. Sayantisti matumia telescope kiseeveni nundu nzeve ya nthi niyanangaa kyeni kimwe na kwona nesa.
translation: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.

text: Veenda loketi nene yi utulu uvitite viti 100 nikenda wikie setilaiti kana teliskovu kiseeveni.
translation: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.

text: Veenda loketi nene yi utulu uvitite viti 100 nikenda wikie setilaiti kana teliskovu kiseeveni.
translation: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.

text: Ndia nisenzetye nthi yonthe kwa nzia mbailu. Undu munene ndia itutethetye ni kwisila kwithwa na ukui wi laisi na wa mitukí.
translation: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.

text: Ndia nisenzetye nthi yonthe kwa nzia mbailu. Undu munene ndia itutethetye ni kwisila kwithwa na ukui wi laisi na wa mitukí.
translation: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.

text: Nĩ ĩtũetee ngalĩ ya mwaki, ngali nini, na syĩndũ ingĩ mbingĩ sya ũkua andũ na mĩio kyalonĩ.
translation: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.

text: Nĩ ĩtũetee ngalĩ ya mwaki, ngali nini, na syĩndũ ingĩ mbingĩ sya ũkua andũ na mĩio kyalonĩ.
translation: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.

text: ĩtheo wamo nĩ mbaka nĩnĩ ĩla syĩĩsa tũsamũ twĩna ũnĩnĩ wa mbũkũ na ũnene wa nthwalya.
translation: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.

text: ĩtheo wamo nĩ mbaka nĩnĩ ĩla syĩĩsa tũsamũ twĩna ũnĩnĩ wa mbũkũ na ũnene wa nthwalya.
translation: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.

text: Mwisowe, ve mbaka mbingi nini (vamwe na mbaka sya musyi itembove) ila siesaa syindu ta tusamu tunini, rodents, mangala, na nyunyi sya yayaya.
translation: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.

text: Mwisowe, ve mbaka mbingi nini (vamwe na mbaka sya musyi itembove) ila siesaa syindu ta tusamu tunini, rodents, mangala, na nyunyi sya yayaya.
translation: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.

text: kĩmbĩthĩ kya ũsĩndĩ woo nĩ kĩla mbaka kwĩkala vando vayo, na kĩla kĩtũmaa kĩla ĩmwe yĩkala ĩtekũsĩndana na ĩngĩ.
translation: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.

text: kĩmbĩthĩ kya ũsĩndĩ woo nĩ kĩla mbaka kwĩkala vando vayo, na kĩla kĩtũmaa kĩla ĩmwe yĩkala ĩtekũsĩndana na ĩngĩ.
translation: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.

text: Minyambu nisyo mbaka ila syendete utinda syi vamwe, iyikala nguthuni nene switawa prides.
translation: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.

text: Minyambu nisyo mbaka ila syendete utinda syi vamwe, iyikala nguthuni nene switawa prides.
translation: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.

text: Nguthu ya minyambu yithiawa na munyambu umwe kuvika itatu miume, vamwe na minyambu mika o ta miongo itatu na twana twayo.
translation: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.

text: Nguthu ya minyambu yithiawa na munyambu umwe kuvika itatu miume, vamwe na minyambu mika o ta miongo itatu na twana twayo.
translation: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.

text: Nga syasyo syithiawa na ngwatanio ya vakuvi, ni kwithiwa ni nyumba nene ya eitu masyaaniw'e na ma nyinya umwe.
translation: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.

text: Nga syasyo syithiawa na ngwatanio ya vakuvi, ni kwithiwa ni nyumba nene ya eitu masyaaniw'e na ma nyinya umwe.
translation: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.

text: Nguthu sya mĩnyambu syĩthĩawa o ta nguthu sya nzũi mbai kana ngitĩ, nyamũ ila kwa ũsengy'a sithaneene na mĩnyambu (ĩndĩ ti mbaka ĩla ingĩi nene) kĩ'mĩĩkanilye, o na syĩ mbai mũno kwĩ nyamũ sya lĩu syasyo.
translation: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.

text: Nguthu sya mĩnyambu syĩthĩawa o ta nguthu sya nzũi mbai kana ngitĩ, nyamũ ila kwa ũsengy'a sithaneene na mĩnyambu (ĩndĩ ti mbaka ĩla ingĩi nene) kĩ'mĩĩkanilye, o na syĩ mbai mũno kwĩ nyamũ sya lĩu syasyo.
translation: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.

text: Muthauki museo ngaliko syonthe, ngo no ilise (ateo ti vyu), kutuva, kutaanyuka kundu kuasa na kwikoota mavinda atano kwi mundu mulumu.
translation: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.

text: Muthauki museo ngaliko syonthe, ngo no ilise (ateo ti vyu), kutuva, kutaanyuka kundu kuasa na kwikoota mavinda atano kwi mundu mulumu.
translation: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.

text: Ngo yi kikundi kimwe (Genus Panthera) ta munyambu, ngo na jaguaa, mbaka isu syi inya nisyo itonya ukooma.
translation: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.

text: Ngo yi kikundi kimwe (Genus Panthera) ta munyambu, ngo na jaguaa, mbaka isu syi inya nisyo itonya ukooma.
translation: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.

text: Kũluma kwa kĩkoyo tĩ undũ umwe na kũluma kwa mũnyambũ indĩ ufwanene na ndeto sya wasya wĩ ĩũlu.
translation: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.

text: Kũluma kwa kĩkoyo tĩ undũ umwe na kũluma kwa mũnyambũ indĩ ufwanene na ndeto sya wasya wĩ ĩũlu.
translation: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.

text: Tukoyo twa maei ni twendete kuya tusamu tunini. Nikwataa nguli, nzoka, mbia na nyunyi kethiwa nitonya. Vakuvi nyamu syoonthe ila kako ka maei kasyimaa ni nini muno kwi ko.
translation: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.

text: Tukoyo twa maei ni twendete kuya tusamu tunini. Nikwataa nguli, nzoka, mbia na nyunyi kethiwa nitonya. Vakuvi nyamu syoonthe ila kako ka maei kasyimaa ni nini muno kwi ko.
translation: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.

text: Andu ma saienzi mesilasya mbaka sya kithekani (ocelots) syatiaa nyamu sya kuya kwa munyungo, syiinyugia kula syii.
translation: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.

text: Andu ma saienzi mesilasya mbaka sya kithekani (ocelots) syatiaa nyamu sya kuya kwa munyungo, syiinyugia kula syii.
translation: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.

text: Nisyonaa nthi nesa muno kivinduni syina kwona wiyoo, na siendaa syisuvie. Ocelots isyimaa na nzia ya kuvyanany'e mwii wasyo na mawithyululuko na indi iy'ulukila nzyima yoo.
translation: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.

text: Nisyonaa nthi nesa muno kivinduni syina kwona wiyoo, na siendaa syisuvie. Ocelots isyimaa na nzia ya kuvyanany'e mwii wasyo na mawithyululuko na indi iy'ulukila nzyima yoo.
translation: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.

text: Ila nguluvu nini ya tusamu tunini (utalo munini) wataananw'a kuma kwa utalo ula munene maumie vo (ta kethwa nituuthi kiimani kana usini, kana kethwa nituuthi kwa kithama kyeu nikenda withie tuisyoka mituki) muno muno nitukwiyithia kwa mawithyululuko kivathukany'o kwi vala twi ii mbeeni.
translation: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.

text: Ila nguluvu nini ya tusamu tunini (utalo munini) wataananw'a kuma kwa utalo ula munene maumie vo (ta kethwa nituuthi kiimani kana usini, kana kethwa nituuthi kwa kithama kyeu nikenda withie tuisyoka mituki) muno muno nitukwiyithia kwa mawithyululuko kivathukany'o kwi vala twi ii mbeeni.
translation: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.

text: mawithyululuko aa mena maundu kivathukany'o na asindani kivathukany'o, kwoou utalo mweu wienda maundu kivathukany'o nikenda syithwe na vinya kwi undu mekwendaa mbeangeni.
translation: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.

text: mawithyululuko aa mena maundu kivathukany'o na asindani kivathukany'o, kwoou utalo mweu wienda maundu kivathukany'o nikenda syithwe na vinya kwi undu mekwendaa mbeangeni.
translation: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.

text: Namba isu ya mbee ndyaaisa kuvinduka, no ikwenda mivinduile o isu ta tene.
translation: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.

text: Namba isu ya mbee ndyaaisa kuvinduka, no ikwenda mivinduile o isu ta tene.
translation: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.

text: kwa ĩvinda, oũndũ andũ maendeĩ kũmanyĩa mawĩtyũlũlũko moo, nĩ mambĩĩe kwĩtha meanĩnĩ ta maũtalo ala angĩ.
translation: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.

text: kwa ĩvinda, oũndũ andũ maendeĩ kũmanyĩa mawĩtyũlũlũko moo, nĩ mambĩĩe kwĩtha meanĩnĩ ta maũtalo ala angĩ.
translation: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.

text: Mwisowe, itina wa myaka makili ka mamilioni, utalo wa andu ukeethwa wi kivathukany'o vyu withie meona ta mate ma mutuo umwe.
translation: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.

text: Mwisowe, itina wa myaka makili ka mamilioni, utalo wa andu ukeethwa wi kivathukany'o vyu withie meona ta mate ma mutuo umwe.
translation: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.

text: Twitaa nzia ino speciation, o kila kiminiaa useuvya mweu wa species. Speciation nundu utasieeka na kilungu kya vata muno kwa evolution.
translation: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.

text: Twitaa nzia ino speciation, o kila kiminiaa useuvya mweu wa species. Speciation nundu utasieeka na kilungu kya vata muno kwa evolution.
translation: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.

text: Miti niyo iseuvasya nzeve ila nzeo tuvevaa, na ingi nivevaa nthini nzeve ila andu mavevaa nza.
translation: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).

text: Miti niyo iseuvasya nzeve ila nzeo tuvevaa, na ingi nivevaa nthini nzeve ila andu mavevaa nza.
translation: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).

text: Miti iseuvasya liu wayo kumana na sua kwisila votosinthesisi. Na ingi nitunengae muunyi.
translation: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.

text: Miti iseuvasya liu wayo kumana na sua kwisila votosinthesisi. Na ingi nitunengae muunyi.
translation: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli

text: Tuseovasya nyumba syitu na ngua kuma mitini. Leu mwingi ula tuisaa ni miti. Vate miti, nyamu syiitha thayu.
translation: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.

text: Tuseovasya nyumba syitu na ngua kuma mitini. Leu mwingi ula tuisaa ni miti. Vate miti, nyamu syiitha thayu.
translation: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.

text: Mosasaurus niyo yai nyamu ya uya ila ingi ya iulu vyu ivindani yamy'o, kwoou ndyakiaa kindu kyonthe, eka o Mosasaurus iingi.
translation: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

text: Mosasaurus niyo yai nyamu ya uya ila ingi ya iulu vyu ivindani yamy'o, kwoou ndyakiaa kindu kyonthe, eka o Mosasaurus iingi.
translation: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.

text: Ngambu syayo iseuvitwe na maeo 70 moi ta kawembe, na angi yiulu wa ngambu syayo, kumini vai kindu kyai kivita ila kyamitangana nziani.
translation: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.

text: Ngambu syayo iseuvitwe na maeo 70 moi ta kawembe, na angi yiulu wa ngambu syayo, kumini vai kindu kyai kivita ila kyamitangana nziani.
translation: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.

text: Ow'o tuyisi nesa, ateo no yithwe na ũimi wina ngolya. Liu wayo ni vamwe na nguu sya kiwũni, makuyũ manene, syoka ila ingi sya kiwũni na no yithwe yaisaa ingi syivyaa tayo.
translation: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.

text: Ow'o tuyisi nesa, ateo no yithwe na ũimi wina ngolya. Liu wayo ni vamwe na nguu sya kiwũni, makuyũ manene, syoka ila ingi sya kiwũni na no yithwe yaisaa ingi syivyaa tayo.
translation: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.

text: Ona nĩyavithũkĩaa kindu kyonthe kyalikaa kiwuni; ona ndainosa nene ta T. rex ndyaĩtonyana nayo.
translation: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.

text: Ona nĩyavithũkĩaa kindu kyonthe kyalikaa kiwuni; ona ndainosa nene ta T. rex ndyaĩtonyana nayo.
translation: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.

text: O vala lĩu mwĩngĩ woo twĩthwa tũwĩsĩ, Romans maĩ na undu ute wa kawaita kana syindu sya mboka nzaanu, vamwe na boar ya kitheka, tausi, manyonga, na syindu ingi syitawa dormouse.
translation: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse

text: O vala lĩu mwĩngĩ woo twĩthwa tũwĩsĩ, Romans maĩ na undu ute wa kawaita kana syindu sya mboka nzaanu, vamwe na boar ya kitheka, tausi, manyonga, na syindu ingi syitawa dormouse.
translation: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse

text: Kivathuky'o kingi ni kana ila andu ngya na kiveti maie liu woo mekalile ivila, athui mendeew'e ni kwithwa na mboka ya kutanania vala mesilaa ngaliko yoo maendee uya liu.
translation: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.

text: Kivathuky'o kingi ni kana ila andu ngya na kiveti maie liu woo mekalile ivila, athui mendeew'e ni kwithwa na mboka ya kutanania vala mesilaa ngaliko yoo maendee uya liu.
translation: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.

text: Malĩu ma tene ma Loman mayinthwa mai na maleu ala maumaa Amelika kana Asia mokute Eulope mwaka ila yatiiye.
translation: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.

text: Malĩu ma tene ma Loman mayinthwa mai na maleu ala maumaa Amelika kana Asia mokute Eulope mwaka ila yatiiye.
translation: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o, matyaina mbemba, kana manyanya, kana maluu, kana koko, na vatingwa mulomi wa tene waasama mbata musinga.
translation: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o, matyaina mbemba, kana manyanya, kana maluu, kana koko, na vatingwa mulomi wa tene waasama mbata musinga.
translation: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.

text: Ambaviloni makiite kila ngai woo ithembo kila umwi, ila yeethiwa niwo musyi wa ngai.
translation: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.

text: Ambaviloni makiite kila ngai woo ithembo kila umwi, ila yeethiwa niwo musyi wa ngai.
translation: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.

text: Andu maetae nthembo kwa ngai sya mivw'ano na athembi mathembeaa ngai isu kwisila mbokani na kutanania.
translation: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.

text: Andu maetae nthembo kwa ngai sya mivw'ano na athembi mathembeaa ngai isu kwisila mbokani na kutanania.
translation: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.

text: kĩla ĩkalũ yaĩ na kĩwanza nza na kĩngĩ nthĩnĩ kya athembĩ memoka malikĩlaa.
translation: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.

text: kĩla ĩkalũ yaĩ na kĩwanza nza na kĩngĩ nthĩnĩ kya athembĩ memoka malikĩlaa.
translation: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.

text: Mavĩnda amwe ĩsũkũũ syĩna mũvwano wa ngolova, syitawa zĩggũrats, nĩsyakĩwe syĩthĩwe syĩ ĩmwe katĩ ya makalũ.
translation: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.

text: Mavĩnda amwe ĩsũkũũ syĩna mũvwano wa ngolova, syitawa zĩggũrats, nĩsyakĩwe syĩthĩwe syĩ ĩmwe katĩ ya makalũ.
translation: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.

text: Iulu wa mwako usu mutulu ve vandu ve vata muno kwa ngai sya mivw'ano.
translation: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
