text: Mausungio angi ma biorhythm meethiawa ni kunywa kyaunywa kingi (muno muno kiwũ kana kyai duiretici yisikie) kumanwa na too, kuilasimithya umwi kuamka athi akaumae.
translation: Chaguo zingine za midundobayolojia huhusisha unywaji mwingi (hususan wa maji au chai, dawa maarufu) kabla ya kulala, hali inayomlazimu mtu kuamka ili kwenda haja ndogo.

text: Undu mũũo wa mũndũ wa nthĩnĩ wĩtha ũendete ũvĩtũkanu na kuteelema kwa mwĩĩ na veva wake.
translation: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one's body and spirit.

text: Undu mũũo wa mũndũ wa nthĩnĩ wĩtha ũendete ũvĩtũkanu na kuteelema kwa mwĩĩ na veva wake.
translation: Kiwango cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu humiliki huhusiana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo ndani ya mwili na roho yake.

text: O undu kutelema kwi nthi, now'o useo wa maisa kwithwaa kwi vo. Kila mundu e na vinya wa kwithwa na muuo musuu na kuaniwa.
translation: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.

text: O undu kutelema kwi nthi, now'o useo wa maisa kwithwaa kwi vo. Kila mundu e na vinya wa kwithwa na muuo musuu na kuaniwa.
translation: Kadiri mvuto ulivyo chini, ndivyo nguvu za maisha zilizoko zilivyo chanya. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na kuridhika zaidi.

text: Kĩla mũndũ no eyũĩvye.kĩla kĩũngũme nzĩanĩ ĩsyũ nĩ mesyĩlya mathũkũ.
translation: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.

text: Kĩla mũndũ no eyũĩvye.kĩla kĩũngũme nzĩanĩ ĩsyũ nĩ mesyĩlya mathũkũ.
translation: Kila mtu anaweza kupata uelewa. Kitu kimoja kinachosimama njiani mwa lengo hili ni wasiwasi na uhasi wetu wenyewe.

text: Buddi ya Tibet yumanitwe na maumanyithya ma Buddha, lakini nimaendeewi ni nzia ya mahayana ya wendi na nzia mbingi kya yoga ya india.
translation: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.

text: Buddi ya Tibet yumanitwe na maumanyithya ma Buddha, lakini nimaendeewi ni nzia ya mahayana ya wendi na nzia mbingi kya yoga ya india.
translation: Ubuddha wa Tibetani una msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini ulipanuliwa na njia ya mahayana ya upendo na mbinu nyingi za kutoka kwa Yoga ya India.

text: Buddhism ya Tibetan ni kĩndu kya kilaisi. Yĩthiawa na Yoga ya Kundalini, kũsũanĩa na nzia ya wendo.
translation: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.

text: Buddhism ya Tibetan ni kĩndu kya kilaisi. Yĩthiawa na Yoga ya Kundalini, kũsũanĩa na nzia ya wendo.
translation: Katika kanuni, Ubudha wa Kitibeti ni rahisi sana. Una Yoga ya Kundalini, kutafakari na njia ya upendo unaokumbatia yote.

text: Wina Kundalini Yoga vinya wa Kundalini (vinya wa kuivya) nukwatawa kwisila yoga, masoesi ma kuveva, mantras na mawoni.
translation: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.

text: Wina Kundalini Yoga vinya wa Kundalini (vinya wa kuivya) nukwatawa kwisila yoga, masoesi ma kuveva, mantras na mawoni.
translation: Kupitia Yoga ya Kundalini, nguvu za Kundalini (nguvu za mwangaza) huibushwa kupitia mkao wa yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, urudiaji maneno au sauti na taswira.

text: Katĩ katĩ wa masuania ma Tibetan nĩ Deity Yoga. Kwisila maĩsyo kĩvathũkanyo methaa na ikundi syĩna vĩnya ntheu, Chakras nĩ syakanaw'a nasĩyonanya kyenĩ.
translation: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.

text: Katĩ katĩ wa masuania ma Tibetan nĩ Deity Yoga. Kwisila maĩsyo kĩvathũkanyo methaa na ikundi syĩna vĩnya ntheu, Chakras nĩ syakanaw'a nasĩyonanya kyenĩ.
translation: Kitovu cha fikira za Tibet ni Yoga ya Uungu. Kupitia taswira ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati zinasafishwa, chakra zinaamilishwa na fahamu ya wongofu inaamshwa.

text: Germany yai nthu ya kila mundu ivinda ya kau wa keli wa ndunia, na kwoou yothoothea ngwatanio ya USSR na USA. Kau wethela ngusanisya sya utongoi, I nzia na kithio nisyothotheeie kuemanwa kwoo.
translation: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.

text: Germany yai nthu ya kila mundu ivinda ya kau wa keli wa ndunia, na kwoou yothoothea ngwatanio ya USSR na USA. Kau wethela ngusanisya sya utongoi, I nzia na kithio nisyothotheeie kuemanwa kwoo.
translation: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, hivyo kupelekea ushirikiano wa USSR na Marekani. Kwa kumalizika kwa vita mgongano wa mfumo, mchakato na utamaduni vilipelekea kutengana kwa nchi.

text: Vena myaka ĩlĩ ĩtina wa kaũ kũthela, ala maĩ ngwatanĩo mbeenĩ yu maĩ matwĩkie nthũ na nĩw'o kaũ wa ndeto wambĩĩe.
translation: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.

text: Vena myaka ĩlĩ ĩtina wa kaũ kũthela, ala maĩ ngwatanĩo mbeenĩ yu maĩ matwĩkie nthũ na nĩw'o kaũ wa ndeto wambĩĩe.
translation: Na miaka mbili ya kumalizika kwa vita, washirika wa zamani waligeuka kuwa maadui na Vita Baridi vikaanza.

text: Wai wikale myaka 40 na vai vokitwe kya w'o, ni anyanya ma ita, kuu iwanzani sya kau kuma Avilika kuthi Asia, kuu Afghanistan, Cuba na kundu kungi kwingi.
translation: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.

text: Wai wikale myaka 40 na vai vokitwe kya w'o, ni anyanya ma ita, kuu iwanzani sya kau kuma Avilika kuthi Asia, kuu Afghanistan, Cuba na kundu kungi kwingi.
translation: Ilikuwa idumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingepigwa kwa kweli na vikosi vya kiwakala, katika nyanja za vita toka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistani, Kuba na sehemu nyingine nyingi

text: Matuku 17, Mwai wa Kenda Mwaka wa 1939 matanamba kuvika, ngaliko ya ũteti ya Poland yaimbanangikũ na yai itonya kũtungianiwa ni Romania.
translation: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.

text: Matuku 17, Mwai wa Kenda Mwaka wa 1939 matanamba kuvika, ngaliko ya ũteti ya Poland yaimbanangikũ na yai itonya kũtungianiwa ni Romania.
translation: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Kipolishi ulivunjwa, na tumaini la pekee lilikuwa kurudi na kujipanga tena kwa darajakuu la Kiromania.

text: Ona vamwe na ũu, mĩvango ii niyanaangiwe vakuvi kiwiyooni kimwe, ila asikali mbee wa 800,000 kuma jeshi ndune ya Soviet Union malikile na maseuvya kundu kwa kuukitia kwa Belarussia na Ukrain itina wa ulika na vinya ilungu sya ngaliko ya utee wa Poland na kutula mukatava wa muuo wa Riga, mukatava waumina kau wa Soviet-Polish, na mikatava ingi ya nthi yonthe, sya kati wa nthi ili o na nthi mbingi.
translation: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.

text: Ona vamwe na ũu, mĩvango ii niyanaangiwe vakuvi kiwiyooni kimwe, ila asikali mbee wa 800,000 kuma jeshi ndune ya Soviet Union malikile na maseuvya kundu kwa kuukitia kwa Belarussia na Ukrain itina wa ulika na vinya ilungu sya ngaliko ya utee wa Poland na kutula mukatava wa muuo wa Riga, mukatava waumina kau wa Soviet-Polish, na mikatava ingi ya nthi yonthe, sya kati wa nthi ili o na nthi mbingi.
translation: Hata hivyo, mipango hii ilipitwa na wakati usiku mmoja, wakati zaidi ya askari 800,000 kutoka Jeshi Jekundu la Umoja wa Kisovyeti lilipoingia na kuunda mipaka ya Belarusiani na Ukreini baada ya kuvamia maeneo ya mashariki mwa Polandi kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mapatano ya Kisovyeti-Polishi Yasiyo ya Uchokozi, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, pande mbili na pande nyingi.

text: Uitumia masiwa kukua miio nundu museo na mwailu kwa ukua andu aingi na miio kukilanily'a ukanga.
translation: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.

text: Uitumia masiwa kukua miio nundu museo na mwailu kwa ukua andu aingi na miio kukilanily'a ukanga.
translation: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha halaiki ya watu na bidhaa nyingi baharini.

text: Wia wa andu ma navy withiitwe wi kuikiithya kana nthi yaku yina uweso wa kukua andu maku na miio, o ila ingi, iyukitana na amaitha maku maikakue andu na miio.
translation: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.

text: Wia wa andu ma navy withiitwe wi kuikiithya kana nthi yaku yina uweso wa kukua andu maku na miio, o ila ingi, iyukitana na amaitha maku maikakue andu na miio.
translation: Kazi ya Jeshi la wanamaji kwa kiasili imekuwa ni kuhakikisha kuwa nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zako, wakati huo huo, kuzuia uwezo wa adui wako wa kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.

text: Ngelekany'o imwe ya vata ya mituki vyu inai kambeni sya Atlantic ya Iulu ya WWII. A Amelika matatithasya usongya andu na syindu muingo wa ukanga wa Atlantic kutethya Britain.
translation: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.

text: Ngelekany'o imwe ya vata ya mituki vyu inai kambeni sya Atlantic ya Iulu ya WWII. A Amelika matatithasya usongya andu na syindu muingo wa ukanga wa Atlantic kutethya Britain.
translation: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ya hivi karibuni ni kampeni ya Kaskazini mwa Atlantiki ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Waingereza.

text: Masaani o asu, navi ya germani, matumiite masiwa, maendee utata kuungamya musavala usu.
translation: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.

text: Masaani o asu, navi ya germani, matumiite masiwa, maendee utata kuungamya musavala usu.
translation: Wakati huo huo, askari wa majeshi ya Ujerumani, kwa kutumia nyambizi, yalikuwa yakijaribu kuzuia trafiki hii.

text: Keka anyanyae nimavalukile, Germany yithwa yasindie Uungelesa undu yasindite nthi ila ingi sya Europe.
translation: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.

text: Keka anyanyae nimavalukile, Germany yithwa yasindie Uungelesa undu yasindite nthi ila ingi sya Europe.
translation: Ikiwa Muungano ungeshindwa, pengine Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama vile ilivyokuwa imeshinda Uropa.

text: Mbui syonanasya ta syaithaw'a musyi myaka 10,000 mithelu kuu iimani sya Zagros sya Iran.
translation: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

text: Mbui syonanasya ta syaithaw'a musyi myaka 10,000 mithelu kuu iimani sya Zagros sya Iran.
translation: Yaelekea mbuzi walianza kufugwa takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagrosi ya Irani.

text: Syithio sya tene na mbai syambiie kusia nikenda makwate iia kwa mituki, nzwii, nyama na ithuuma.
translation: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.

text: Syithio sya tene na mbai syambiie kusia nikenda makwate iia kwa mituki, nzwii, nyama na ithuuma.
translation: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwafuga kwa ufikiaji rahisi wa maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.

text: Ikundi sya mbui ila syatuuwaa iimani na uiini ni syaithyawa muno ni syana kana andu ma muika mesikie ta aithi. Nzia ii sya ndithya no syithiawa vo umunthi.
translation: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.

text: Ikundi sya mbui ila syatuuwaa iimani na uiini ni syaithyawa muno ni syana kana andu ma muika mesikie ta aithi. Nzia ii sya ndithya no syithiawa vo umunthi.
translation: Kijumla, mbuzi wa nyumbani walianza kufugwa kwa makundi yaliyotangatanga milimani au maeneo mengine ya malisho, huku yakisimamiwa na walinzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana wachanga, sawia na wachungaji wanaofahamika sana. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hata leo.

text: Nzia sya makasya ni syaseoviswe England mbee wa myaka ya 1600.
translation: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.

text: Nzia sya makasya ni syaseoviswe England mbee wa myaka ya 1600.
translation: Magari yanayosukokotwana farasi yalijengwa huko Uingereza mapema kama karne ya 16.

text: O na kau nzia sya milau syai o na iting'I sya miti ivangitwe vamwe, nisyetikilasya mbalasi ila simikuusitye kuvikiia mituki mbingi na kukua miio minene leluni ila syai nthuku munango ivindani yiu.
translation: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.

text: O na kau nzia sya milau syai o na iting'I sya miti ivangitwe vamwe, nisyetikilasya mbalasi ila simikuusitye kuvikiia mituki mbingi na kukua miio minene leluni ila syai nthuku munango ivindani yiu.
translation: Ingawa njia za magari zilisheheni magogo sambamba ya miti, zilihuruhusu farasi kuzivuta kwa kasi zaidi na kuvuta mizigo mikubwa kiasi kwa barabara mbaya za siku.

text: Crossties syaetetwe tene kukwatiia nzia nzia isu. Indi, o kavola, nivamanyikie kana nzia isu syesaa kwithiwa syina mituki keka syai na kyuma iulu wasyo.
translation: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.

text: Crossties syaetetwe tene kukwatiia nzia nzia isu. Indi, o kavola, nivamanyikie kana nzia isu syesaa kwithiwa syina mituki keka syai na kyuma iulu wasyo.
translation: Nguzomlalo zilianzishwa mapema kiasi ili kushikilia reli mahali pake. Hata hivyo, kadiri muda ulivyoendelea iligunduliwa kwamba reli hizo zingefanya kazi bora zaidi ikiwa kipande cha chuma kingewekelewa juu.

text: kĩĩ kyatwĩkĩe kĩndũ kya kĩla ĩvĩnda onakaũ ĩ kyũma kyatũmaa ndĩa sya makasya ĩthela.
translation: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

text: kĩĩ kyatwĩkĩe kĩndũ kya kĩla ĩvĩnda onakaũ ĩ kyũma kyatũmaa ndĩa sya makasya ĩthela.
translation: Hii ilikuja kuwa desturi, lakini chuma kilisababisha kuharibika kwa magurudumu ya mbao ya magari ya kukokotwa.

text: Ĩtinanĩ, ndĩa sya mbwaũ nĩsyaumisw'e vo nĩ ndĩa sya syũma. Mwakanĩ wa 1767, isiĩi sya mbee vyũ sya syũma nĩsyamanyĩisw'e.
translation: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.

text: Ĩtinanĩ, ndĩa sya mbwaũ nĩsyaumisw'e vo nĩ ndĩa sya syũma. Mwakanĩ wa 1767, isiĩi sya mbee vyũ sya syũma nĩsyamanyĩisw'e.
translation: Hatimaye, magurudumu ya mbao yalibadilishwa na magurudumu ya vyuma. Mnamo 1767, reli za kwanza za vyuma kamili zilianzishwa.

text: Nzia ya mbee ya ukui yeesiwe ta kutembea, andu mambiiie kutembea malungele myaka milioni ili mivituku kwa kumila kwa Homo Erectus.
translation: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).

text: Nzia ya mbee ya ukui yeesiwe ta kutembea, andu mambiiie kutembea malungele myaka milioni ili mivituku kwa kumila kwa Homo Erectus.
translation: Namna yak kwanza ya uchukuzi iliyofahamika ni kutembea, binadaum walianza kutembea wima miaka milioni mbili iliyopita, baada ya kuibuka kwa wanadamu wima.

text: Ala maimbee wamo, Australopithecus wayatembeaa maungeme nesa.
translation: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.

text: Ala maimbee wamo, Australopithecus wayatembeaa maungeme nesa.
translation: Watangulizi wao, Australopithecus hawakutembea wima kama kawaida.

text: Nyamu kya mauu eli syithiawa nthini wa matialyo ma Australopithecus kuma miaka 4.2- 3.9 tene muno, onaketha Sahelanthropus no itonye kwitha kyatembei na mauu eli ta miaka mini na millioni muonza mivituku.
translation: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.

text: Nyamu kya mauu eli syithiawa nthini wa matialyo ma Australopithecus kuma miaka 4.2- 3.9 tene muno, onaketha Sahelanthropus no itonye kwitha kyatembei na mauu eli ta miaka mini na millioni muonza mivituku.
translation: Utaalamu wa bipedali unapatikana katika visukuku vya Australopithekasi kuanzia miaka milion 4.2 hadi 3.9 iliyopita, ingawa inawezekana kuwa Sahelanthropasi walitembea kwa miguu miwili takriban miaka milioni saba iliyopita.

text: No twambiie kwikalany'a nesa na mawithyululuko maitu, no tukwatane na kikundi kya kusuvia mawithyululuko, na no twithwe tuitetea ni kenda tuole wanangiku mwingi ivinda yukite.
translation: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.

text: No twambiie kwikalany'a nesa na mawithyululuko maitu, no tukwatane na kikundi kya kusuvia mawithyululuko, na no twithwe tuitetea ni kenda tuole wanangiku mwingi ivinda yukite.
translation: Tunaweza kuanza kuishi kama marafiki wazuri wa mazingira, tunaweza kujiunga na harakati za mazingira, na hata pia tunaweza kuwa wanaharakati ili kupunguza dhiki ya baadaye kwa kiwango fulani.

text: Uu no ta uiiti wina ndalili kwa mowau maingi. Ateo, kethwa tuikwenda usungio wa ivinda ikuvi, nitwaile ithwa indi tuikyungusa umo wa mathina aa, na tuimamina vyu.
translation: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.

text: Uu no ta uiiti wina ndalili kwa mowau maingi. Ateo, kethwa tuikwenda usungio wa ivinda ikuvi, nitwaile ithwa indi tuikyungusa umo wa mathina aa, na tuimamina vyu.
translation: Hii ni sawa na matibabu ya dalili katika hali nyingi. Hata hivyo, ikiwa hatutaki tu suluhisho la muda mfupi, basi tunastahili kupata shina la matatizo, nasi tupate kuizima.

text: Ni kindu kisikie kana ndunia ni sesyete mũno nũndũ wa maendeeo ya saenzi na teknolonji ya andũ na mathina nimanenevete nũndũ wa kwongeleka kwa ũtalo wa andũ na mikalile ya andũ.
translation: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.

text: Ni kindu kisikie kana ndunia ni sesyete mũno nũndũ wa maendeeo ya saenzi na teknolonji ya andũ na mathina nimanenevete nũndũ wa kwongeleka kwa ũtalo wa andũ na mikalile ya andũ.
translation: Ni wazi kabisa kuwa ulimwengu umebadilika sana kwa sababu ya maendeleo ya kibinadamu katika sayansi na teknolojia, nayo matatizo yameongezeka kwa sababu ya watu kuwa wengi kupita kiasi na mitindo ya ubadhirifu ya maisha ya wanadamu.

text: Itina wa kwitikilwa ni Congress matuku 4 mwai wamuonza, ithangu yiandike na kw'oko na yikekiwa saii ni musumbi wa Congress John Hancock na muandiki Charles Thomson indi niyatumiwe ndukani ya kumithya mavuku ya John Dunlap ila yai nyumba kauta kuma vau.
translation: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.

text: Itina wa kwitikilwa ni Congress matuku 4 mwai wamuonza, ithangu yiandike na kw'oko na yikekiwa saii ni musumbi wa Congress John Hancock na muandiki Charles Thomson indi niyatumiwe ndukani ya kumithya mavuku ya John Dunlap ila yai nyumba kauta kuma vau.
translation: Baada ya kukubaliwa na Kongresi mnamo Julai 4, rasimu iliyoandikwa kwa hati ya mkono na kutiwa sahihi na Rais wa Kongresi John Hancock na Katibu Charles Thomson ilitumwa vitalu vichache kwa duka la uchapishaji la John Dunlap.

text: Utuu wonthe kati wa mathangu 150 na 200 ni maseuviw'e, yu ala mesiwe ta "Dunlap broadsides".
translation: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".

text: Utuu wonthe kati wa mathangu 150 na 200 ni maseuviw'e, yu ala mesiwe ta "Dunlap broadsides".
translation: Usiku kucha kati ya nakala 150 na 200 zilitengenezwa, ambazo sasa zinajulikana kama "Vikaratasi vya Dunlop".

text: Ĩita ya mbee vyũ ĩthangũ yĩu yasomiwe mbee wa nguthu ya andũ nĩ John Nixon kũu kĩwanzanĩ kya ũthaw'a.
translation: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.

text: Ĩita ya mbee vyũ ĩthangũ yĩu yasomiwe mbee wa nguthu ya andũ nĩ John Nixon kũu kĩwanzanĩ kya ũthaw'a.
translation: Usomaji wa kwanza kwa umma wa hati hiyo ulifanywa na John Nixon katika yadi ya Ukumbi wa Uhuru mnamo Julai 8.

text: Umwe watumiiwe George Washington matũkũ 6 mwai wa 7, na asikali make masomewa matũkũ 9 mwai wa 7. Ũvoo uũ wavikie London matũkũ 10, mwai wa Nyanya.
translation: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.

text: Umwe watumiiwe George Washington matũkũ 6 mwai wa 7, na asikali make masomewa matũkũ 9 mwai wa 7. Ũvoo uũ wavikie London matũkũ 10, mwai wa Nyanya.
translation: Moja ilitumwa kwa George Washington mnamo Julai 6, ambaye aliifanya isomewe vikosi vyake katika New York mnamo Julai 9. Nakala ilifika London mnamo Agosti 10.

text: Mavũkũ ma Dunlap 25 nĩmo maũtũmbĩthyo ala makũũ vyũ mevo ma maandĩko ma maandĩko asũ. Maandĩko ala mambee kũandĩkwa na kw'oko mayaakwatĩkana.
translation: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.

text: Mavũkũ ma Dunlap 25 nĩmo maũtũmbĩthyo ala makũũ vyũ mevo ma maandĩko ma maandĩko asũ. Maandĩko ala mambee kũandĩkwa na kw'oko mayaakwatĩkana.
translation: Nakala 25 za Dunlap zenye cheche za mashambulizi zinazojulikana kuwahi kuwepo ndizo nakala kongwe zaidi za hati hiyo zinazopatikana. Nakala asili iliyoandikwa kwa mkono haipo.

text: Palaentologists aĩngĩ ũmũnthĩ nĩmaĩĩkĩa kana ve ĩkũndĩ sya ndaĩnosa ĩla ũmũnthĩ syĩo thayũ. No tũtonye kũsyita nyũnyĩ.
translation: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.

text: Palaentologists aĩngĩ ũmũnthĩ nĩmaĩĩkĩa kana ve ĩkũndĩ sya ndaĩnosa ĩla ũmũnthĩ syĩo thayũ. No tũtonye kũsyita nyũnyĩ.
translation: Wanapaleontolojia wengi leo hii wanaamini kuwa kikundi kimoja cha dinosau kiliponea na kingali hai hata sasa. Tunawaita ndege.

text: Andu aingi mayisilasya iulu wasyo ta ndainosa nundu syi mawia na nisyulukaa.
translation: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.

text: Andu aingi mayisilasya iulu wasyo ta ndainosa nundu syi mawia na nisyulukaa.
translation: Watu wengi hawawachukuliii kuwa dinosau kwa sababu wana manyoya na wanaweza kupaa.

text: Ateo veo syindu mbingi sya nyunyi sya yayaya syithwaa mbato syíilye ta ndainosa.
translation: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.

text: Ateo veo syindu mbingi sya nyunyi sya yayaya syithwaa mbato syíilye ta ndainosa.
translation: Lakini kuna mambo mengi juu ya ndege ambao bado wanaonekana kama dinosau.

text: Syi maúú me makwaú na mbwaa, nilekasya matumbi, na itembeaa na maúú elí ma ítina ta T-Rex.
translation: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.

text: Syi maúú me makwaú na mbwaa, nilekasya matumbi, na itembeaa na maúú elí ma ítina ta T-Rex.
translation: Wana miguu yenye magamba na makucha, hutaga mayai na hutembea kwa miguu yake miwili ya nyuma kama T-Rex.

text: Kalivu kombyuta syoonthe matuku aa syithwaa syimanipuleted na uvoo ula withwaa wi coded kwa nzia ya namba sya binary.
translation: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.

text: Kalivu kombyuta syoonthe matuku aa syithwaa syimanipuleted na uvoo ula withwaa wi coded kwa nzia ya namba sya binary.
translation: Karibu kompyuta zote zinazotumika leo zimekitwa katika kuendeshwa kwa habari ambayo imewekwa katika msimbo ulio katika hali ya nambari za bainari.

text: Namba ya ũmwe ĩtonya o kwĩthĩwa vandũ vamwe katĩ wa kwĩlĩ, kũla nĩkw'o 0 kana 1, na namba ii syĩtawa namba sya ũmwe - kana tũlungu, tũitũmĩa kĩthyomo kya kĩ kombyũta.
translation: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.

text: Namba ya ũmwe ĩtonya o kwĩthĩwa vandũ vamwe katĩ wa kwĩlĩ, kũla nĩkw'o 0 kana 1, na namba ii syĩtawa namba sya ũmwe - kana tũlungu, tũitũmĩa kĩthyomo kya kĩ kombyũta.
translation: Nambari ya bainari yaweza tu kuwa na thamani moja kati ya mbili, yaani 0 au 1, na hizi nambari zinajulikana kama takwimu jozi, au biti, katika msamiati wa kompyuta.

text: Sumu ya nthini ti lasima ukoneka saa isu, dalili, ta kutavika ni sianyite kunania diagnosis yailite kwikwa kwa mituki.
translation: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.

text: Sumu ya nthini ti lasima ukoneka saa isu, dalili, ta kutavika ni sianyite kunania diagnosis yailite kwikwa kwa mituki.
translation: Sumu ya ndani inaweza kukosa kuwa dhahiri papo hapo. Dalili, kama vile kutapika ni jumla kiasi kwamba utambuzi wa mara moja hauwezi kufanywa.

text: Wonany'o ula museo wa sumu wa nthĩnĩ nĩ kwĩthĩwa na mũtũngĩ mũvĩngũe wa dawa kana syĩndũ nthũkũ ĩla ĩtũmĩawa mũsyĩ.
translation: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.

text: Wonany'o ula museo wa sumu wa nthĩnĩ nĩ kwĩthĩwa na mũtũngĩ mũvĩngũe wa dawa kana syĩndũ nthũkũ ĩla ĩtũmĩawa mũsyĩ.
translation: Dalili bora ya sumu ya ndani inaweza kuwa kuwepo kwa chombo wazi cha dawa ama kemikali za kaya zenye sumu.

text: Isya uvano umanye mutalatala wa first aidi wa sumu ũsu.
translation: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.

text: Isya uvano umanye mutalatala wa first aidi wa sumu ũsu.
translation: Angalia lebo kwa maagizo maalum ya huduma ya kwanza ya sumu hiyo.

text: Isyitwa "bug" ni itumiawa ni asomi ma tumitutu kwita nguthu ino ya tumitutu.
translation: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.

text: Isyitwa "bug" ni itumiawa ni asomi ma tumitutu kwita nguthu ino ya tumitutu.
translation: Neno mdudu hutumiwa na wanaentomolojia katika matumizi rasmi ya kikundi hiki cha wadudu.

text: Isyĩtwa yĩĩ yumanite na umanyi wa tene wa ngũngũni, tũla ni tusamu tutengemeaa andu.
translation: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.

text: Isyĩtwa yĩĩ yumanite na umanyi wa tene wa ngũngũni, tũla ni tusamu tutengemeaa andu.
translation: Nenohili limetoka kwenye kufahamiana kwa kale na Kunguni, ambao wana ustadi mkubwa wa kumelea binadamu.

text: Assassin-bugs na ngunguni ila syikalaa vala sikuya na syoseyaa ndalani syoo.
translation: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.

text: Assassin-bugs na ngunguni ila syikalaa vala sikuya na syoseyaa ndalani syoo.
translation: Wadudu Assasin-bugs na Kunguni wana uzoefu wa kuishi katika kiota ama makazi ya mwenyeji wao.

text: Kukĩlanĩlya Amelika, ve makesi ta 400,000 syisikie yiulu wa mamutha makunikite naavu, undu uu utumite uwau uu utongosya kwa andu ma muika na muika wa katikati.
translation: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.

text: Kukĩlanĩlya Amelika, ve makesi ta 400,000 syisikie yiulu wa mamutha makunikite naavu, undu uu utumite uwau uu utongosya kwa andu ma muika na muika wa katikati.
translation: Katika Amerika yote, kuna takribani kesi 400,000 zinazojulikana za Sklerosisi ya Sehemu Nyingi (MS), na kuuwacha kuwa ugonjwa wa neva unaoongoza katika vijana na watu wazima wenye umri wa kati.

text: MS nĩ ũwaũ ũlaa ũkwataa imutha ya katikati ya naavu, ĩla yĩthaa ĩseũvĩtw'e nĩ kiliko, ĩvĩndĩ ya mũongo na navusi sya metho.
translation: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.

text: MS nĩ ũwaũ ũlaa ũkwataa imutha ya katikati ya naavu, ĩla yĩthaa ĩseũvĩtw'e nĩ kiliko, ĩvĩndĩ ya mũongo na navusi sya metho.
translation: Selerosisiwingi ni ugonjwa unaoathiri mfumo mkuu wa neva, ambao unajumuisha ubongo, uti wa mgongo na neva ya macho.

text: Ukunikili wonanisye kana aka nomakwate uwau wa MS maita eli kwi aume.
translation: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.

text: Ukunikili wonanisye kana aka nomakwate uwau wa MS maita eli kwi aume.
translation: Utafiti umebainisha kuwa wanawake wana uwezekano maradufu wa kuugua selerosisiwingi kuliko wanaume.

text: Endwa no maamũe tĩ wendĩ ũla mũseo vyũ kwoo, kana kwa syana syoo, kũea kana.
translation: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.

text: Endwa no maamũe tĩ wendĩ ũla mũseo vyũ kwoo, kana kwa syana syoo, kũea kana.
translation: Wenzi wawili huenda wakaamua si kwa masilahi yao bora, au masilahi ya mtoto wao, kumlea mtoto.

text: Endwa aa no mavange kwosa kana mekalae nako.
translation: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.

text: Endwa aa no mavange kwosa kana mekalae nako.
translation: Wanandoa hawa wanaweza kuchagua kutengeneza mpango wa ulezi wa mtoto wao.

text: Ila muua kana, asyai ala masyaite kana kau methwaa mayumanwa na vinya wa kumesya kana na kwoou asyai angi methwaa matonya umesya kana kau.
translation: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.

text: Ila muua kana, asyai ala masyaite kana kau methwaa mayumanwa na vinya wa kumesya kana na kwoou asyai angi methwaa matonya umesya kana kau.
translation: Katika kuchukua ulezi, wazazi wa kuzaa hukomesha haki zao za mzazi ili wazazi wengine waweze kumlea mtoto huyo.

text: Mbao nene ya sayanzi ni kumanya undu nthi ithukumaa na nzia kya kisayanzi. nzia itongoeaya ukunikili mwingi wa sayanzi.
translation: Science's main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.

text: Mbao nene ya sayanzi ni kumanya undu nthi ithukumaa na nzia kya kisayanzi. nzia itongoeaya ukunikili mwingi wa sayanzi.
translation: Lengo kuu la Sayansi ni kubaini njia ambayo ulimwengu utaendeshwa kwa mbinu za kisayansi. Kwa kweli, mbinu hii huongoza tafiti nyingi za kisayansi.

text: Ndi yoka, kuexperiment, experiment ni undu withwaa uiminana na kutatithya, kukulya makulyo, na kulyaiilye na kwony'a ukunikili nzia.
translation: It isn't alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.

text: Ndi yoka, kuexperiment, experiment ni undu withwaa uiminana na kutatithya, kukulya makulyo, na kulyaiilye na kwony'a ukunikili nzia.
translation: Haiko peke yake hata hivyo, majaribio, na jaribio ni upimaji ambao hutumiwa kuondoa nadharia moja au mbili zinazowezekana, kuuliza maswali, na kufanya uchunguzi pia huongoza utafiti wa kisayansi.

text: Asomi ma miti vamwe na asomi ma mavuku matungite mesilya mavuku ala maandikitwe myakani ya kati kati na muno muno mbivilia ila ya kilatini.
translation: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.

text: Asomi ma miti vamwe na asomi ma mavuku matungite mesilya mavuku ala maandikitwe myakani ya kati kati na muno muno mbivilia ila ya kilatini.
translation: Wataalam wa asili na wanafalsafa waliangazia matini za jadi, na hususan, Biblia ya Kilatini.

text: Kila kyeetikilitwe ni mawoni ma Aristotle kwa maundu oonthe ma saenzi, o vamwe na kiliko.
translation: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.

text: Kila kyeetikilitwe ni mawoni ma Aristotle kwa maundu oonthe ma saenzi, o vamwe na kiliko.
translation: Maoni ya Aristotle juu ya mambo yote ya sayansiyalikubalika, ikiwemo saikolojia.

text: O ũndũ ũmanyĩ wa Ngiliki watheeie, andu ma ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa meyĩthĩĩye maumitw'e mĩaonĩ ya Greek na syĩndũnĩ sya saenzi.
translation: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.

text: O ũndũ ũmanyĩ wa Ngiliki watheeie, andu ma ũthũĩlonĩ wa sũa meyĩthĩĩye maumitw'e mĩaonĩ ya Greek na syĩndũnĩ sya saenzi.
translation: Jinsi maarifa ya Wagiriki yalivyopungua, Magharibi ilijikuta ikikatwa kutoka kwa asili za kifalsafa na kisayansi ya Kigiriki.

text: Mitũo mbingi ya masomo ma tavia sya andũ yiilyene mũno na syĩndũ sya nthi na undũ isyũkaa ivinda kũthi ĩvinda.
translation: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.

text: Mitũo mbingi ya masomo ma tavia sya andũ yiilyene mũno na syĩndũ sya nthi na undũ isyũkaa ivinda kũthi ĩvinda.
translation: Wengi walifuata mtindo katika fiziolojia na tabia ambazo mara nyingi hutegemea uwepo wa vipindi vya kiasili na uzalishaji wao kupitia mida za kibiolojia.

text: Mivango ya ĩvinda kwa ĩvinda, ĩla ĩtethĩawa o ũsũngĩo wa wa kĩ nza, nĩmbaandĩke nũndũ wa syĩndũ mbingĩ syĩ thayũ, vamwe na tũsamũ tũini twĩ seli ĩmwe, tũla twĩ seli mbingĩ, mĩtĩ, na nyamũ.
translation: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.

text: Mivango ya ĩvinda kwa ĩvinda, ĩla ĩtethĩawa o ũsũngĩo wa wa kĩ nza, nĩmbaandĩke nũndũ wa syĩndũ mbingĩ syĩ thayũ, vamwe na tũsamũ tũini twĩ seli ĩmwe, tũla twĩ seli mbingĩ, mĩtĩ, na nyamũ.
translation: Midundo ya mara kwa mara, ambayo si jibu tu kwa ishara za nje za mara kwa mara, imerekodiwa kwa viumbe wengi wenye uhai, zikiwemo bakteria, kuvu, mimea na wanyama,

text: Saa sya ũĩma wa mwĩĩ nĩsyĩ yĩanĩĩsye na nĩsiendeeaa kũthũkuma ona yĩla vate kĩndũ kya kũtũma syĩendeea kũma ũtee.
translation: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.

text: Saa sya ũĩma wa mwĩĩ nĩsyĩ yĩanĩĩsye na nĩsiendeeaa kũthũkuma ona yĩla vate kĩndũ kya kũtũma syĩendeea kũma ũtee.
translation: Saa za kibiolojia ni osileta zinazojimudu ambazo zitaendeleza kipindi cha ujiendeshaji wa mzunguko hata pasipo na vidokezo vya nje.

text: Utatithyo uu wa Hershey na Chase niw'o unatongoetye kana DNA yai kindu kya ngyenetiks.
translation: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.

text: Utatithyo uu wa Hershey na Chase niw'o unatongoetye kana DNA yai kindu kya ngyenetiks.
translation: Jaribio la Hershey na Chase lilikuwa mojawapo ya mapendekezo kwamba DNA ilikuwa nyenzo za nasaba.

text: Hershey na Chase matumiie phages, kana vailasi, kwikia DNA yoo kwa mbakitelia.
translation: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.

text: Hershey na Chase matumiie phages, kana vailasi, kwikia DNA yoo kwa mbakitelia.
translation: Hershey na Chase walitumia virusi kuchomeka DNA yao wenyewe ndani ya bakteria.

text: Maneekie ukunikili keli mavanite kila imwe ya DNA isu syi nthini wa vailasi isu na posipolasi kana vulotini ya vilasi isu na salupa.
translation: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.

text: Maneekie ukunikili keli mavanite kila imwe ya DNA isu syi nthini wa vailasi isu na posipolasi kana vulotini ya vilasi isu na salupa.
translation: Walifanya majaribio mawili kuashiria DNA kwenye virusi kwa fosforasi nururifuau protini ya virusi kwa salfa nururishi.

text: Kuvinduka kula kukaa na musyawa ni kwithaa na syindũ mbingi kulingana na ni kuvinduka kwa mũthemba wiva, vata wa pale vavindũkũ na ketha ni vandu ve cells syiendeeye kuongeleka.
translation: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.

text: Kuvinduka kula kukaa na musyawa ni kwithaa na syindũ mbingi kulingana na ni kuvinduka kwa mũthemba wiva, vata wa pale vavindũkũ na ketha ni vandu ve cells syiendeeye kuongeleka.
translation: Mabadiliko yanaweza kuwa na athari tofauti kutegemea aina ya mabadiliko, umuhimu wa kifaa cha maumbile kilichoathiriwa na ikiwa seli zilizoathiriwa ni seli za vijidudu.

text: No mawalyuku ala me ilembetani sya "germ-line" ala matonya kwitha syanani syasyawa indi mawalyuku ma kundu kungi no mauwae ilembeta ii kana makaete kanza.
translation: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.

text: No mawalyuku ala me ilembetani sya "germ-line" ala matonya kwitha syanani syasyawa indi mawalyuku ma kundu kungi no mauwae ilembeta ii kana makaete kanza.
translation: Ni mabadiliko ya seli za vijidudu tu ambayo yanaweza kusambazwa kwa watoto, huku mabadiliko kwingineko yakiweza kusababisha seli za kifo au saratani.

text: Utalii iulu wa mawithyululuko wendeesya andũ ala mekwenda kwona kũndũ kwondũ wa kwitanĩthya na ũseo ũla wĩ kw'o yĩkwo, vamwe na mĩtĩ na nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ.
translation: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.

text: Utalii iulu wa mawithyululuko wendeesya andũ ala mekwenda kwona kũndũ kwondũ wa kwitanĩthya na ũseo ũla wĩ kw'o yĩkwo, vamwe na mĩtĩ na nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ.
translation: Utalii wa asili huvutia watu walio na nia ya kutembelea maeneo ya asili kwa sababu ya kuburudishwa na maadhari, pamoja na mimea na wanyama.

text: Ngelekany'o ya syindu ila syikawa kuu ni kusyima, kutea makuyu, kukuna visa, kusyiisya tusuni, kuthi kwiloela kundu na kusoma syindu iulu wa kwikala iulu wa nthi.
translation: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.

text: Ngelekany'o ya syindu ila syikawa kuu ni kusyima, kutea makuyu, kukuna visa, kusyiisya tusuni, kuthi kwiloela kundu na kusoma syindu iulu wa kwikala iulu wa nthi.
translation: Mifano ya shughuli za eneoni ni pamoja na uwindaji, uvuvi, upigaji picha, kutazama ndege, na kutembelea mbuga na kusoma habari za mfumo wa ikolojia.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o nĩ kũtembea, kũkũna visa na kũsoma iulu wa organgatũangs kũu Borneo.
translation: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o nĩ kũtembea, kũkũna visa na kũsoma iulu wa organgatũangs kũu Borneo.
translation: Mfano ni kutembelea, kupiga picha, na kujifunza juu ya nyani wakubwa huko Borneo.

text: Kĩla kwakya, andũ matĩaa tũmĩsyĩ tũnĩnĩ mengalĩnĩ syoo maendete kũla mathũkũmaa na maĩvĩtwa nĩ angĩ ala mathũkũmĩlaa kũndũ kũla asũ maũma.
translation: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.

text: Kĩla kwakya, andũ matĩaa tũmĩsyĩ tũnĩnĩ mengalĩnĩ syoo maendete kũla mathũkũmaa na maĩvĩtwa nĩ angĩ ala mathũkũmĩlaa kũndũ kũla asũ maũma.
translation: Kila asubuhi, watu huondoka miji midogo mashambani ndani ya magari wakielekea kazini wakipitana na wengine ambao wanaelekea kazini walikotoka wao.

text: Nthini wa nzia ii sya ukũwi syi uvinduka mituki, kila mundu no mukwatanye na, na nekwenda, nzia kya ukuani kya ngali sya mweene.
translation: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.

text: Nthini wa nzia ii sya ukũwi syi uvinduka mituki, kila mundu no mukwatanye na, na nekwenda, nzia kya ukuani kya ngali sya mweene.
translation: Katika chombo hiki imara cha usafiri, kila mtu kwa njia fulani ameunganishwa na, na kuunga mkono, mfumo wa usafiri unaotegemea magari ya kibinafsi.

text: Saenzi yionania kana kũtumĩa makaa mũno ni kwanangĩte yayaya yila nĩyo yitetheetye mbaa andũ kũvĩnduka kwa myaka milioni ilĩ.
translation: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.

text: Saenzi yionania kana kũtumĩa makaa mũno ni kwanangĩte yayaya yila nĩyo yitetheetye mbaa andũ kũvĩnduka kwa myaka milioni ilĩ.
translation: Sayansi sasa inaashiria kuwa uchumi huu mkubwa wa kaboni umeondoa nyanjahai ya dunia kutoka mojawapo ya hali zake imara ambayo ilipaswa kushikilia mageuzi ya mwanadamu kwa miaka milioni mbili iliyopita.

text: Kila mundu ni wikaa kindu kimwe kana kingi kisioni na nutumiaa nzia. Andu aingi ni matetaa nundu wa nzia.
translation: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.

text: Kila mundu ni wikaa kindu kimwe kana kingi kisioni na nutumiaa nzia. Andu aingi ni matetaa nundu wa nzia.
translation: Kila mtu hushiriki katika jamii na kutumia mifumo ya uchukuzi. Karibu kila mtu hulalamika kuhusu mifumo ya uchukuzi.

text: Nthini wa nthi ili mbendeeu ni wiwaa iwango ta isu sya kutetea kiwu kana syiao kuvaluka.
translation: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.

text: Nthini wa nthi ili mbendeeu ni wiwaa iwango ta isu sya kutetea kiwu kana syiao kuvaluka.
translation: Katika nchi zilizostawi ni nadra kusikia viwango sawa vya malalamiko kuhusu ubora wa maji au uporomokaji wa madaraja.

text: Niki sistemu sya mukuile syithwaa na minyungunyanisyo, niki mavalukaa kila muthenya? Mo mavundi ma ukui methwaa me kulutu? Kana ni ve undu ungi uendee?
translation: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?

text: Niki sistemu sya mukuile syithwaa na minyungunyanisyo, niki mavalukaa kila muthenya? Mo mavundi ma ukui methwaa me kulutu? Kana ni ve undu ungi uendee?
translation: Ni kwa nini mifumo ya usafiri huweka hisia kwenye malalamiko kama hayo, kwa nini wao hufeli kila siku? Ni kwamba wahandisi wa usafiri hawajiwezi? Au kuna kitu cha msingi zaidi kinachoendelea?

text: kũthũkũma kũseo kwa malelũ nĩ kũsoma ĩũlũ wa kũthĩ kwa mateleva na ngalĩ syoo kũma vandũ vamwe kũthĩ vangĩ na ũndũ syĩvũlanaa syĩna ĩla ĩngĩ.
translation: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.

text: kũthũkũma kũseo kwa malelũ nĩ kũsoma ĩũlũ wa kũthĩ kwa mateleva na ngalĩ syoo kũma vandũ vamwe kũthĩ vangĩ na ũndũ syĩvũlanaa syĩna ĩla ĩngĩ.
translation: Mtiririko wa Trafiki ni utafiti wa mwondoko wa madereva binafsi na magari kati ya sehemu mbili na mwingiliano wanaofanya na wenzao.

text: Vaati muthuku, kusoma undu lelu siutumiwa ni kumu nundu tavia sya mateleva iyamba umanyikana mbeeni na uw'o wa iana kwa iana.
translation: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.

text: Vaati muthuku, kusoma undu lelu siutumiwa ni kumu nundu tavia sya mateleva iyamba umanyikana mbeeni na uw'o wa iana kwa iana.
translation: Kwa bahati mbaya, kutafiti mtiririko wa trafiki ni vigumu kwa sababu tabia ya dereva haiwezi kutabiriwa kwa uhakika wa asilimia mia moja.

text: Kwa vaati museo, mateleva matataa kwithiwa na tavia syi nthini wa kiatianisyo kiseo; kw'ou, wendu wa ngali niwithiawa na uatianisyo museo na wandikike ki masavu.
translation: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.

text: Kwa vaati museo, mateleva matataa kwithiwa na tavia syi nthini wa kiatianisyo kiseo; kw'ou, wendu wa ngali niwithiawa na uatianisyo museo na wandikike ki masavu.
translation: Kwa bahati, madereva huwa na mazoea kwa upatano fulani; kwa hivyo, misongamano ya trafiki huwa na uthabiti fulani na inaweza kuwakilishwa haswa kitakwimu.

text: Ni kenda wonany'e tilaviki undu yiilye, ve wonany'o wa kati wa kalakita itatu: (1) fuloo, (2) kukwatana, na (3) mutheele.
translation: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.

text: Ni kenda wonany'e tilaviki undu yiilye, ve wonany'o wa kati wa kalakita itatu: (1) fuloo, (2) kukwatana, na (3) mutheele.
translation: Ili kuwakilisha mtiririko wa trafiki vizuri, uhusiano umeanzishwa kati ya hali tatu kuu: (1) mtiririko, (2) uzito, (3) kasimwelekeo.

text: Ndũũ ithi itetheeasya kũplani, kundisaini, na mũthũkũmĩle wa syindu sya leluni.
translation: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.

text: Ndũũ ithi itetheeasya kũplani, kundisaini, na mũthũkũmĩle wa syindu sya leluni.
translation: Mahusiano haya husaidia katika upangaji, kubuni, na uendeshaji wa welekevu barabarani.

text: Tusamu tula tulukaa ni tw'o twai twa mbee kulika nzeveni. Utonyi woo wa kuluka ni kwa tutetheeisye kũvetangana na amaitha na kũmantha leũ na anyanya.
translation: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.

text: Tusamu tula tulukaa ni tw'o twai twa mbee kulika nzeveni. Utonyi woo wa kuluka ni kwa tutetheeisye kũvetangana na amaitha na kũmantha leũ na anyanya.
translation: Wadudu ndio waliokuwa wanyama wa kwanza kupaa angani. Uwezo wao wa kupaa uliwasaidia kuwakwepa maadui kwa urahisi na kupata chakula na wenzi wao kwa urahisi.

text: Tũsamũ twingĩ tunini twĩthwaa twĩ na ũtonyi wa ũkũnza nthwau syasyo ĩngĩ mĩĩnĩ yoo.
translation: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.

text: Tũsamũ twingĩ tunini twĩthwaa twĩ na ũtonyi wa ũkũnza nthwau syasyo ĩngĩ mĩĩnĩ yoo.
translation: Wadudu wengi wana bahati ya kuweza kufunga mbawa zao mwilini.

text: Ii imanengaa ivuso iseo yakwivitha kumana na ay'i.
translation: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.

text: Ii imanengaa ivuso iseo yakwivitha kumana na ay'i.
translation: Hii huwapa fursa pana ya sehemu ndogondogo za kujificha na adui wao.

text: Umunthi, kasamu kana katakunza nthwau ni yiimu ila yulukaa na maydlies.
translation: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.

text: Umunthi, kasamu kana katakunza nthwau ni yiimu ila yulukaa na maydlies.
translation: Siku hizi, wadudu pekee ambao hawawezi kukunja mabawa yao kwenda nyuma ni kerengende na kipupe.

text: Makili ma myaka mithelu, munduume wetawa Aristarchus aisye kana solar system yathyululuka sua.
translation: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.

text: Makili ma myaka mithelu, munduume wetawa Aristarchus aisye kana solar system yathyululuka sua.
translation: Maelfu ya miaka iliyopita, mwanamume aliyeitwa Aristarchus alisema kwamba Mfumo wa Jua ulizunguka Jua.

text: Andu amwe moona tote ivityo ateo andu aingi maikiiye unduungi; ati sola sistemu yathyuukaa nthi, vamwe na sua (ona ndata iingi).
translation: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).

text: Andu amwe moona tote ivityo ateo andu aingi maikiiye unduungi; ati sola sistemu yathyuukaa nthi, vamwe na sua (ona ndata iingi).
translation: Baadhi ya watu walidhani alikuwa sahihi lakini watu wengi waliamini kinyume chake; kwamba Mfumo wa Jua huzunguuka Dunia, pamoja na Jua (na hat nyota nyinginezo).

text: Uu woneka wisililw'e, nundu nthi ndyonekaa ta yiendete, niyiendaa indi?
translation: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?

text: Uu woneka wisililw'e, nundu nthi ndyonekaa ta yiendete, niyiendaa indi?
translation: Hii inaonekana kuwa busara, kwa sababu Dunia haionekani kana kwamba inasonga, au sivyo?

text: Usi wa Amazon ni usi wa keli kwa uasa na ula munene ula wa nthi. Ukuaa kiwu mala 8 ma kila ki usi ula ni wa keli kwa unene.
translation: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.

text: Usi wa Amazon ni usi wa keli kwa uasa na ula munene ula wa nthi. Ukuaa kiwu mala 8 ma kila ki usi ula ni wa keli kwa unene.
translation: Mto wa Amazon ndiyo mto wa pili kwa urefu na kubwa zaidi Duniani. Inachukua maji zaidi ya mara 8 kama mto wa pili mkubwa.

text: Amazon o nayo niyo usi ula muthanthau vyu nthi ino, saa ingi mavinda mala maili thanthatu kwa uthanthau.
translation: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.

text: Amazon o nayo niyo usi ula muthanthau vyu nthi ino, saa ingi mavinda mala maili thanthatu kwa uthanthau.
translation: Amazon pia ni mto mpana zaidi Duniani, wakati mwingine maili sita kwa upana.

text: Kĩlungu kya 20 ĩũlũ wa ĩana kĩ kya kĩw'ũ kĩla kĩtĩkaa kuma mbũsi sya nthĩ yonthe kyumaa Amazon.
translation: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.

text: Kĩlungu kya 20 ĩũlũ wa ĩana kĩ kya kĩw'ũ kĩla kĩtĩkaa kuma mbũsi sya nthĩ yonthe kyumaa Amazon.
translation: Asilimia 20 kamili ya maji ambayo yanatoka kwenye mito ya sayari kuenda ndani ya bahari hutoka kwenye Amazoni.

text: Ũsi mũnene wa Amazon wĩ kĩlomita 6,387 (maĩli 3,980). Umasya kĩw'ũ makilinĩ ma tũlũsi tũnini.
translation: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.

text: Ũsi mũnene wa Amazon wĩ kĩlomita 6,387 (maĩli 3,980). Umasya kĩw'ũ makilinĩ ma tũlũsi tũnini.
translation: Mto mkuu wa Amazon una kilomita 6,387 (maili 3,980). Hukusanya maji kutoka maelfu ya mito midogo.

text: O na kau waki wa syindu sithyaa ta syi mby'a itatu na mavia waendeeie nginya mwisho wa usumbi, mwakile wa syindu sya Gaza ndwavitukwa ki unene na umanyi wa mwako.
translation: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.

text: O na kau waki wa syindu sithyaa ta syi mby'a itatu na mavia waendeeie nginya mwisho wa usumbi, mwakile wa syindu sya Gaza ndwavitukwa ki unene na umanyi wa mwako.
translation: Ingawa ujenzi wa piramidi kwa mawe uliendelea hadi mwishoni mwa Ufalme Mzee, piramidi za Giza hazikuwahi kupitwa katika saizi yazo na ubora wa kiufundi wa ujenzi wazo.

text: A Misili ma usumbi mweu masaniaw'a ni miw'ano ya ala mai mbee woo, ila syai ivindani yiu syina myaka mivituku ngili imwe.
translation: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.

text: A Misili ma usumbi mweu masaniaw'a ni miw'ano ya ala mai mbee woo, ila syai ivindani yiu syina myaka mivituku ngili imwe.
translation: Wamisri wa kale wa Ufalme mpya walishangazwa na minara ya watangulizi wao, ambayo ilikuwa wakati huo na zaidi ya miaka elfu.

text: Utalo wa eakli ma musyi munene wa Vatican ni ta 800. Niyo nthi niini vyu yiulu wa nthi yisumbikite na ila yi utalo muniini wa ekali.
translation: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.

text: Utalo wa eakli ma musyi munene wa Vatican ni ta 800. Niyo nthi niini vyu yiulu wa nthi yisumbikite na ila yi utalo muniini wa ekali.
translation: Idadi ya watu Jijini Vatican ni takriban 800. Ndio taifa ndogo kabisa duniani lililo huru na nchi yenye idadi ndogo kabisa ya watu.

text: Taoni ya Vatican itumiaa kĩthyomo kya Italian syĩndũnĩ syĩkonetwe na mĩao na mukumukanilye wa kiuvisi.
translation: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.

text: Taoni ya Vatican itumiaa kĩthyomo kya Italian syĩndũnĩ syĩkonetwe na mĩao na mukumukanilye wa kiuvisi.
translation: Jiji la Vatikani hutumia Kiitaliano katika sheria zake na mawasiliano rasmi.

text: Ki Itali no kyo kithyomo kitumiawa kila muthenya ni aingi ala mathukumaa selikalini nakyo ki Latini kitumiangawa ma umbanoni ma ndini.
translation: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.

text: Ki Itali no kyo kithyomo kitumiawa kila muthenya ni aingi ala mathukumaa selikalini nakyo ki Latini kitumiangawa ma umbanoni ma ndini.
translation: Kiitaliano pia ni lugha ya kila siku inayotumika na wengi wa wale wanaofanya kazi katika serikali huku Kilatini mara nyingi kikitumika katika sherehe za kidini.

text: Andũ onthe ala mekalaa mũsyĩ wa vatikani nĩ ma katolekĩ.
translation: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.

text: Andũ onthe ala mekalaa mũsyĩ wa vatikani nĩ ma katolekĩ.
translation: Wananchi wote wa Mji wa Vatican ni Wakatoliki ya Kiroma.

text: Andu nimesi iulu wa syindu syakemikoo ila itee muo ta thaavu, vetha, na kĩaa kuma tene vyu, tondu ii syonthe no sikwatikane nthini wa syindu mbumbe sya kila muthenya syi sya ntheu vyu na ni mbuthangu kuseuvithya na miio itai myongele maundu maingi.
translation: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.

text: Andu nimesi iulu wa syindu syakemikoo ila itee muo ta thaavu, vetha, na kĩaa kuma tene vyu, tondu ii syonthe no sikwatikane nthini wa syindu mbumbe sya kila muthenya syi sya ntheu vyu na ni mbuthangu kuseuvithya na miio itai myongele maundu maingi.
translation: Watu wameshajua kuhusu elementi za kimsingi za kemikali kama vile dhahabu, fedha, na shaba kutoka zamani, kwani hizi zote zinaweza kugunduliwa kwa maumbile katika hali ya asili na ni rahisi kuchimbuliwa kwa kutumia zana za zamani.

text: Aristotle, musomi, aisye kana kila kindu kiseuvitwe na kuvulany'a kwa kindu kimwe kana syindu inya. Syai nthi, kiw'u, nzeve na mwaki.
translation: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.

text: Aristotle, musomi, aisye kana kila kindu kiseuvitwe na kuvulany'a kwa kindu kimwe kana syindu inya. Syai nthi, kiw'u, nzeve na mwaki.
translation: Aristotle, mwanafalsafa, alitoa dhana kuwa kila kitu kimetengenezwa kwa mchanganyiko wa kitu kimoja au zaidi kati ya vitu vinne. Vitu hivyo ni ardhi, maji, hewa na moto.

text: Ii yai muno ta nthi inya sya undu (syiatinie uu) : soliti, likwiti, ngasi, na vulasima, ateo niwawetie kana nisenzasya ikatwika kindu kingi ni kenda iseuvye kindu twiona na metho.
translation: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.

text: Ii yai muno ta nthi inya sya undu (syiatinie uu) : soliti, likwiti, ngasi, na vulasima, ateo niwawetie kana nisenzasya ikatwika kindu kingi ni kenda iseuvye kindu twiona na metho.
translation: Hii ilikuwa kama hali nne za mata (kwa mpangilio huohuo): mango, uoevu, gesi na utegili, ingawa pia alitoa nadharia kwamba hugeuka kuwa vitu vipya ili kuunda tunachoona.

text: Alloy no muvulanyo wa kyuma ili kana kyuma mbingangi. na ndukolwe kana ve elemendi mbingi kati wa periodic table.
translation: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.

text: Alloy no muvulanyo wa kyuma ili kana kyuma mbingangi. na ndukolwe kana ve elemendi mbingi kati wa periodic table.
translation: Aloi kimsingi ni mchanganyiko wa metali mbili au zaidi. Usisahau kwamba kuna elementi nyingi kwenye jedwali la elementi.

text: Syindu muvai wa calcium na potassium italikanaa ta syuma. Kwa uw'o, ve o syuma ingi ta vetha na thaavu.
translation: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.

text: Syindu muvai wa calcium na potassium italikanaa ta syuma. Kwa uw'o, ve o syuma ingi ta vetha na thaavu.
translation: Elementi kama Kalsiamu na Potasiamu huwa zinachukuliwa kama vyuma. kwa kweli kuna vyuma vingine kama fedha na dhahabu .

text: No withe na syuma ingi ila ni ta ite sya kyuma syiilye ta makaa.
translation: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.

text: No withe na syuma ingi ila ni ta ite sya kyuma syiilye ta makaa.
translation: Pia unaweza kuwa na alo ambazo zinajumuisha viwango vidogo vya vipengele visivyo vya chuma kamavile kaboni.

text: Kila kindu nthi ino kiseuvitw'e na kilungu, ilungu syonthe iseuvitw'e na tulungu tunini twitawa atomu.
translation: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.

text: Kila kindu nthi ino kiseuvitw'e na kilungu, ilungu syonthe iseuvitw'e na tulungu tunini twitawa atomu.
translation: Kila kitu katika ulimwengu kimeundwa kutokana na dutu. Dutu zote zimeundwa kutokana na chembe ndogo ndogo zinazoitwa atomi.

text: Atom syĩthĩaa niini mũno vyũ nginya ma trillion ma'syo nomeanĩe nthĩnĩ wa kavinda ka mũthia wa kĩlungu kĩĩ kya kũandĩka.
translation: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.

text: Atom syĩthĩaa niini mũno vyũ nginya ma trillion ma'syo nomeanĩe nthĩnĩ wa kavinda ka mũthia wa kĩlungu kĩĩ kya kũandĩka.
translation: Atomu huwa ndogo ajabu kiasi kwamba trilioni nyingi zaweza kutoshea katika kipindicha mwisho wa sentensi hii.

text: Kwoou venzoo yai munyanya wa andu aingi ila yaumie.
translation: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.

text: Kwoou venzoo yai munyanya wa andu aingi ila yaumie.
translation: Kwa hivyo hiyo penseli ilikua rafiki mzuri kwa watu wengi wakati ilitokea.

text: Ni kimako, nundu oundu nzia nzau sya kuandika iendee na kumila, mawia ma penzoo maendee na kuthela.
translation: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.

text: Ni kimako, nundu oundu nzia nzau sya kuandika iendee na kumila, mawia ma penzoo maendee na kuthela.
translation: Kwa huzuni, kadiri mbinu mpya za kuandika zinavyotokea, ndivyo penseli inavyoshushwa kwenye hadhi na matumizi duni.

text: Andu mithenya ii mandikaa iyooni sya kombyuta na mayiungamasya mambe kuasuvya kalamu.
translation: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.

text: Andu mithenya ii mandikaa iyooni sya kombyuta na mayiungamasya mambe kuasuvya kalamu.
translation: Watu sasa wanaandika jumbe kwenye skrini za kompyuta, kamwe bila haja ya kutumia kichongeo.

text: Mũndũ no aseng'e kĩla kĩkeekĩna na kiimboti ũndũ mweũ wasindũlĩwa.
translation: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.

text: Mũndũ no aseng'e kĩla kĩkeekĩna na kiimboti ũndũ mweũ wasindũlĩwa.
translation: Mtu anaweza kujiuliza kibodi itakuwa nini wakati kitu kipya kitakapokuja.

text: Mbomu ya Fission uthukumaa na nzia ya vinya wa nucleus vamwe na protons na neutrons syakwatanw'a.
translation: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.

text: Mbomu ya Fission uthukumaa na nzia ya vinya wa nucleus vamwe na protons na neutrons syakwatanw'a.
translation: Bomu hii gawanyiki hufanya kazi kwa kanuni kwamba nguvu huhitajika katika uundaji wa viini vyenye protoni na nutroni nyingi.

text: Ta muthemba wa kukunza ikasya ilumu wambatitye kilisoni. Kutilany'a nucleus ingi na indi iyathukia vinya usu.
translation: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.

text: Ta muthemba wa kukunza ikasya ilumu wambatitye kilisoni. Kutilany'a nucleus ingi na indi iyathukia vinya usu.
translation: Kama vile kuviringisha rukwama nzito kuelekea mlimani. Kugawanya nyuklia mara nyingine tena kisha kutoa baadhi ya nishati hiyo.

text: Mbeke ĩmwe syĩthaa syĩtena vĩnya ũanene ũla ĩtũmaa ĩtĩlĩkana syatĩnwa vanĩnĩ kana ona ĩtendĩne.
translation: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.

text: Mbeke ĩmwe syĩthaa syĩtena vĩnya ũanene ũla ĩtũmaa ĩtĩlĩkana syatĩnwa vanĩnĩ kana ona ĩtendĩne.
translation: Atomu zingine huwa na viini visivyo imara kwa maana kwamba huwa na mazoea ya kuachana hata kwa mguso kidogo tu.

text: Ũthyũ wa mwei ũseũvĩtw'e na mavia na kĩtoo. Ngalĩko ya ĩũlũ ya mwei ĩĩtawa crust.
translation: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.

text: Ũthyũ wa mwei ũseũvĩtw'e na mavia na kĩtoo. Ngalĩko ya ĩũlũ ya mwei ĩĩtawa crust.
translation: Uso wa mwezi umeundwa kwa mawe na vumbi. Safu ya nje ya mwezi hujulikana kama ganda.

text: Mwalĩka ũsũ waĩna ũthanthaũ wa kĩlomita 70 ngalĩko ya nthĩnĩ na ũthanthaũ wa kĩlomita 100 ngalĩko ya nza.
translation: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.

text: Mwalĩka ũsũ waĩna ũthanthaũ wa kĩlomita 70 ngalĩko ya nthĩnĩ na ũthanthaũ wa kĩlomita 100 ngalĩko ya nza.
translation: Uso wa dunia una upana wa karibu kilomita 70 kwa ukaribu na upana wa kilomita100 kwa umbali.

text: Ni mosu ndiĩnĩ na syikathanthaa iĩmanĩ.
translation: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.

text: Ni mosu ndiĩnĩ na syikathanthaa iĩmanĩ.
translation: Chini ya maria huwa nyembamba lakini nzito chini ya nyanda za juu.

text: Vatonya kwĩthwa ve maria kauta vakuvĩ na ngalĩko nũndũ ĩsyũlyo nĩ ĩtheke. Vaĩ laisi kwa lava kwambata nginya yumĩle.
translation: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.

text: Vatonya kwĩthwa ve maria kauta vakuvĩ na ngalĩko nũndũ ĩsyũlyo nĩ ĩtheke. Vaĩ laisi kwa lava kwambata nginya yumĩle.
translation: Kunaweza kuwa na maria zaidi upande wa karibu kwa sababu ganda huwa jembamba. Ilikuwa rahisi kwa lava kupanda juu hadi usoni.

text: maũmanyi ma maũelesyo methaa melekelwe kũmanya nĩ kyaũ kyendeeasya andũ.
translation: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.

text: maũmanyi ma maũelesyo methaa melekelwe kũmanya nĩ kyaũ kyendeeasya andũ.
translation: Nadharia za maudhui hulenga kupata kinachowafanya watu waendelee au kinachowavutia.

text: Syĩndũ iyi sitavanĩtw'e syonanya kana andũ methĩawa na syĩndũ mendaa na/kana matamanĩa ila syĩthĩĩtwe ilikĩte nthĩnĩ woo kũvikĩĩa makethĩa andũ aima.
translation: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.

text: Syĩndũ iyi sitavanĩtw'e syonanya kana andũ methĩawa na syĩndũ mendaa na/kana matamanĩa ila syĩthĩĩtwe ilikĩte nthĩnĩ woo kũvikĩĩa makethĩa andũ aima.
translation: Nadharia hizi zinapendekeza kwamba watu wana mahitaji fulani na/au tamaa ambazo zimekita mizizi jinsi wanavyokomaa katika utu uzima.

text: Maelesyo aa maeleasya kĩla kĩtũmaa andũ meka maũndũ ala mekaa na syĩndũ ĩla syĩ mathyũlũlũkĩte ĩtũma mekaa syĩndũ ĩmwe na mayĩema kwĩka ĩngĩ.
translation: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.

text: Maelesyo aa maeleasya kĩla kĩtũmaa andũ meka maũndũ ala mekaa na syĩndũ ĩla syĩ mathyũlũlũkĩte ĩtũma mekaa syĩndũ ĩmwe na mayĩema kwĩka ĩngĩ.
translation: Nadharia hizi huangalia ni nini kinachowahusu watu fulani ambacho huwafanya watake vitu wanavyofanya na ni mambo gani katika mazingira yao yanayowafanya kufanya au kutofanya mambo fulani.

text: Ngewa ĩla nene syĩ sĩkanĩe nĩ ũsũmbĩ wa wendĩ wa Maslow na ngewa ĩlĩ sya ĩtũmĩ sya hertzberg's.
translation: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.

text: Ngewa ĩla nene syĩ sĩkanĩe nĩ ũsũmbĩ wa wendĩ wa Maslow na ngewa ĩlĩ sya ĩtũmĩ sya hertzberg's.
translation: Nadharia mbili maarufu za maudhui ni Udadisi wa Maslow wa Mahitaji na Nadharia ya Vipengele Viwili ya Hertzberg.

text: Tũneenete kwa vamwe, mĩkalĩle ĩlĩ noyũmĩle ĩla anene meũtongoesya athũkũmĩ moo. Ngalĩko ĩmwe kĩkũndĩ kĩũ nĩkitataa vethĩwe "ũmwe wa ĩmwana" (kana eetũ).
translation: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain "one of the guys" (or gals).

text: Tũneenete kwa vamwe, mĩkalĩle ĩlĩ noyũmĩle ĩla anene meũtongoesya athũkũmĩ moo. Ngalĩko ĩmwe kĩkũndĩ kĩũ nĩkitataa vethĩwe "ũmwe wa ĩmwana" (kana eetũ).
translation: Kwa ujumla, tabia mbili zinaweza kuibuka wakati wasimamizi wanaanza kuwaongoza wenzao wa awali. Kwa upande mmoja watajaribu kujinasibisha kama ''mmojawapo wa wanaume'' (au wanawake).

text: Mũnene to'yũ ethĩawa na ũũmũ kũtw'a ũndũ ũtaĩ wa kawaita, kwosa ĩtambya ya kũalyũũla tavia, kũlilya ũndũ wĩa ũthũkũmĩtwe, kũaanya wĩa, na kũtavya andũ ylaĩ mena makosa.
translation: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.

text: Mũnene to'yũ ethĩawa na ũũmũ kũtw'a ũndũ ũtaĩ wa kawaita, kwosa ĩtambya ya kũalyũũla tavia, kũlilya ũndũ wĩa ũthũkũmĩtwe, kũaanya wĩa, na kũtavya andũ ylaĩ mena makosa.
translation: Aina hii ya meneja huwa na ugumu kufanya maamuzi yasiyopendeza wengi, kuchukua hatua za kinidhamu, kutathmini utendakazi, kuwatwika watu majukumu, na kuwajibisha watu.

text: Mũthianĩ wa kĩlungu kĩu, mũĩndũ asenzasya akethĩwa ataeleeka na akeew'a ta nonginya aalyũũle kĩla kĩndũ timũ ĩsu ĩthĩĩtwe ĩkwĩka na kũmĩtw'a yake.
translation: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.

text: Mũthianĩ wa kĩlungu kĩu, mũĩndũ asenzasya akethĩwa ataeleeka na akeew'a ta nonginya aalyũũle kĩla kĩndũ timũ ĩsu ĩthĩĩtwe ĩkwĩka na kũmĩtw'a yake.
translation: Katika mwisho mwingine wa upinde, mtu hubadilika kuwa mtu asiyetambulika ambaye huhisi kwamba ni lazima abadilishe kila kitu ambacho timu imekuwa ikifanya na kukifanya kuwa chake.

text: Itina wa maundu monthe, mutongoi niwe withiawa waukulw'a iulu wa usindi kana kusindwa kwa kilungu.
translation: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.

text: Itina wa maundu monthe, mutongoi niwe withiawa waukulw'a iulu wa usindi kana kusindwa kwa kilungu.
translation: Baada ya yote, ni kiongozi ndiye huwajibika mwishoni kwa ufanisi au kuanguka kwa timu.

text: Tavia ii kaingi ietae kuemanwa kati kati wa aungamii na andu ala angi kikundini.
translation: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.

text: Tavia ii kaingi ietae kuemanwa kati kati wa aungamii na andu ala angi kikundini.
translation: Tabia hiyo mara nyingi husababisha migawanyiko kati ya viongozi na timu nzima.

text: Timu ila itethwaa syaw'o ikuawa undumwe na timu ila ingi kwa nzia nzeo, ateo ve kiwathukany'o kila kya kawaita.
translation: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.

text: Timu ila itethwaa syaw'o ikuawa undumwe na timu ila ingi kwa nzia nzeo, ateo ve kiwathukany'o kila kya kawaita.
translation: Timu za kawaida zinashikiliwa kwa viwango sawa vya ubora kama timu za kawaida lakini kuna tofauti hila.

text: Amemba ala makomaniaa mitandaoni mavinda maingi methiawa ta mo mambee kwa ngwatanio ya kiimwii ya amemba asu.
translation: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.

text: Amemba ala makomaniaa mitandaoni mavinda maingi methiawa ta mo mambee kwa ngwatanio ya kiimwii ya amemba asu.
translation: Memba pepe wa timu mara nyingi hutumika kama mahali pa mawasiliano kwa kikundi chao cha kimwili cha wakati huo.

text: Maita maingi methiawa na uthasyo mwingi kwi ikundi ila ingi sya uthukumi nikwithiwa ikundi syoo no ikomane masaa mataendanitye o kindu kila silikali yoo itonya kuema kuelewa nikyo.
translation: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.

text: Maita maingi methiawa na uthasyo mwingi kwi ikundi ila ingi sya uthukumi nikwithiwa ikundi syoo no ikomane masaa mataendanitye o kindu kila silikali yoo itonya kuema kuelewa nikyo.
translation: Mara nyingi wao huwa na uhuru zaidi kuliko wanachama wa kawaida wa timu kwani timu zao zinaweza kukutana kulingana na maeneo ya wakati yanayotofautiana na inaweza kutoeleweka kwa usimamizi wao.

text: Wĩthĩo waw'o wa "kĩkũndĩ kĩtonekaa" (Larson na LaFasto, 1989, p109) nĩ ũndũ wa mwanya wa kĩkũndĩ kyaw'o.
translation: The presence of a true "invisible team" (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.

text: Wĩthĩo waw'o wa "kĩkũndĩ kĩtonekaa" (Larson na LaFasto, 1989, p109) nĩ ũndũ wa mwanya wa kĩkũndĩ kyaw'o.
translation: Uwepo wa "timu isiyoonekana" ya kweli (Larson na LaFasto, 1989, uk109) ni kipengele cha kipekee cha timu pepe.

text: Ila "timu itonekaa" niyo timu ya kuvanga o vala kila memba ulivotiaa. Timu isu otonekaa niyikiaa miao ya kila mumemba.
translation: The "invisible team" is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.

text: Ila "timu itonekaa" niyo timu ya kuvanga o vala kila memba ulivotiaa. Timu isu otonekaa niyikiaa miao ya kila mumemba.
translation: "Timu isiyoonekana" ni timu ya usimamizi ambapo kila memba huripoti. Timu isiyoonekana huweka viwango kwa kila memba.

text: Niki kambuni yenda kutumia ivinda yiiseuvya muvango wa kusoma? Lengo imwe ya kwithwa na kisomo kya muvango ni kwithwa na kuseuvya syindu imbya.
translation: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.

text: Niki kambuni yenda kutumia ivinda yiiseuvya muvango wa kusoma? Lengo imwe ya kwithwa na kisomo kya muvango ni kwithwa na kuseuvya syindu imbya.
translation: Kwa nini shirika lipitie mchakato wa muda mrefu ili kuanzisha shirika la mafunzo? Lengo moja la kuanzisha dhana za shirika la mafunzo katika matendo ni uvumbuzi.

text: Yila syindu ila syi vakuvi syatumiwa undu vaile nthini wa mivea ila itethasya wia, utuika na umanyi nutonya kumbuka.
translation: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.

text: Yila syindu ila syi vakuvi syatumiwa undu vaile nthini wa mivea ila itethasya wia, utuika na umanyi nutonya kumbuka.
translation: Wakati rasilimali zote zinazopatikana zinatumiwa kwa ufanisi katika idara zenye utendaji za shirika, ubunifu na ustadi unaweza kutokea.

text: O na ingi ndinaina mwanya ma kuvetanga miao ya kumya koti na wiw'ano wa nthi.
translation: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.

text: O na ingi ndinaina mwanya ma kuvetanga miao ya kumya koti na wiw'ano wa nthi.
translation: Kama matokeo, mchakato wa shirika kufanya kazi pamoja kushinda kizuizi unaweza kupelekea mchakato mpya mbunifu wa kuhudumia mahitaji ya wateja.

text: Mbee wa kambũni itanamba ambiia kuseuvya syĩndũ nzau, ũtongoi no nginya witikilye kithio kya useuvya wa syindu nzau na ingi meimasomethya athukumi na muvango wa kii wia.
translation: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.

text: Mbee wa kambũni itanamba ambiia kuseuvya syĩndũ nzau, ũtongoi no nginya witikilye kithio kya useuvya wa syindu nzau na ingi meimasomethya athukumi na muvango wa kii wia.
translation: Kabla ya shirika kuwa bunifu, ni lazima uongozi uunde utamaduni wa ubunifu vilevile maarifa yaliyoshirikishwa na mafunzo ya kishirika.

text: Angel (2006) aeleasya nzia ya Continuum ta nzia ila ikutumiwa kutetheesya kambuni kwambatya uthukumi.
translation: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.

text: Angel (2006) aeleasya nzia ya Continuum ta nzia ila ikutumiwa kutetheesya kambuni kwambatya uthukumi.
translation: Angel (2006), anaeleza mbinu ya Msururu kama njia inayotumika kusaidia mashirika kufikia kiwango cha juu cha utenda kazi.

text: Ũvoo yĩũlũ wa ũndũ ĩlũngĩ ya nĩnĩ vyũ ĩseũvĩtye mwĩĩ nĩnengatĩte ũtonyĩ wa kũkũnĩkĩla ũndũ andũ matonyaa kũelewa nĩ syĩndũ na kwĩka. Kwooũ nĩ nĩyĩolete wĩa mwĩngĩ wa kũkũnĩkĩla yĩũlũ wa ũndũ ũsũ na kũtonyenya kũnenganya maũndũ me na ũw'o mwĩngĩ.
translation: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.

text: Ũvoo yĩũlũ wa ũndũ ĩlũngĩ ya nĩnĩ vyũ ĩseũvĩtye mwĩĩ nĩnengatĩte ũtonyĩ wa kũkũnĩkĩla ũndũ andũ matonyaa kũelewa nĩ syĩndũ na kwĩka. Kwooũ nĩ nĩyĩolete wĩa mwĩngĩ wa kũkũnĩkĩla yĩũlũ wa ũndũ ũsũ na kũtonyenya kũnenganya maũndũ me na ũw'o mwĩngĩ.
translation: Data ya neurobayolojia inatoa ushahidi wa mwili kwa mtazamo wa kinadharia kuhusu uchunguzi wa utambuzi. Kwa hivyo, inapunguza eneo la utafiti na kulifanya liwe maalum zaidi.

text: Kuvyanana kwa akili na mwĩkalĩle nikukwataa mbau asomi ma saensi ũthianini woo.
translation: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.

text: Kuvyanana kwa akili na mwĩkalĩle nikukwataa mbau asomi ma saensi ũthianini woo.
translation: Mshabaha uliopo kati ya patholojia ya ubongo na tabia inaunga mkono wanasayansi katika utafiti wao.

text: Nĩmanyĩkanĩte kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasa vyũ kana mĩthemba mingĩ ya akili kwanangĩka, kũthokoeka kĩlĩko nũndũ wa kũkwatwa nĩ mũisyo mũna, kũũmĩa kĩlũngũ kya mwĩĩ, na tyũma nĩsietae ũvathũkanũ wa mĩthũkũmĩle ĩmwe ya akili.
translation: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.

text: Nĩmanyĩkanĩte kwa ĩvĩnda yĩasa vyũ kana mĩthemba mingĩ ya akili kwanangĩka, kũthokoeka kĩlĩko nũndũ wa kũkwatwa nĩ mũisyo mũna, kũũmĩa kĩlũngũ kya mwĩĩ, na tyũma nĩsietae ũvathũkanũ wa mĩthũkũmĩle ĩmwe ya akili.
translation: Imejulikana kwa muda mrefu kwamba aina tofauti za uharibifu wa ubongo, majeraha, vidonda, na uvimbe huathiri tabia na kusababisha mabadiliko katika baadhi ya kazi za kiakili.

text: Kuka kwa tekinolongyi nzau kutwikilasya kwona na kulilya kwa nthini undu iliko syumbikite na miikile ya maundu itaoneka mbeeni.
translation: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.

text: Kuka kwa tekinolongyi nzau kutwikilasya kwona na kulilya kwa nthini undu iliko syumbikite na miikile ya maundu itaoneka mbeeni.
translation: Uibukaji wa teknolojia mpya hutuwezesha kuona na kuchunguza miundo na michakato ya ubongo ambayo haijawahi kuonekana awali.

text: Kii kitunengaa umanyi mwingi na mioo ya kwaka stimulation models ila itutetheesya kuelewa mivango akilini kwitu.
translation: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.

text: Kii kitunengaa umanyi mwingi na mioo ya kwaka stimulation models ila itutetheesya kuelewa mivango akilini kwitu.
translation: Hii inatupa habari na nyenzo nyingi za kujenga mifano ya kuiga ambayo hutusaidia kuelewa michakato katika akili zetu.

text: Ona vala AI ni yisikie mũno kwa saienzi syite sya wo, AI ni isevitye ũvonge wa vata mũno wa saienzi ya kombyuta ya mikanilye, kusoma na ũi wa maasini.
translation: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.

text: Ona vala AI ni yisikie mũno kwa saienzi syite sya wo, AI ni isevitye ũvonge wa vata mũno wa saienzi ya kombyuta ya mikanilye, kusoma na ũi wa maasini.
translation: Ingawa Akili Bandia inahusishwa sana na tungo za kisayansi, Akili Bandia huunda sehemu muhimu sana ya tawi la sayansi ya kompyuta, kushughulikia tabia, mafunzo na marekebisho ya akili kwa mashine.

text: Ukunikili nthini wa AI withwaa ukonanitw'e na kuseuvya maasini nikenda mawia mathukumawe kwa imwe kwa ala mekwenda mituo myui.
translation: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.

text: Ukunikili nthini wa AI withwaa ukonanitw'e na kuseuvya maasini nikenda mawia mathukumawe kwa imwe kwa ala mekwenda mituo myui.
translation: Utafiti katika Al unajumuisha kutengeneza mashine za kufanya kazi zinazohitaji tabia za busara kuwa otomatiki.

text: Kwa mũvwano nĩ kũsũvĩa, kũvangĩthya na kũvangĩĩa, ũndũ wa kũsũngĩa makũlyo ma mũũĩ, o vamwe na kũelewa mũandĩko, wasya na ũthyũ.
translation: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.

text: Kwa mũvwano nĩ kũsũvĩa, kũvangĩthya na kũvangĩĩa, ũndũ wa kũsũngĩa makũlyo ma mũũĩ, o vamwe na kũelewa mũandĩko, wasya na ũthyũ.
translation: Mfano ni pamoja na kudhibiti, kupanga na kuratibu, uwezo wa kujibu utambuzi na maswali ya wateja, pamoja na utambuzi wa maandishi, sauti na uso.

text: Syindu ii kivathukany'o na syitetheeasya kutatua mathina ma kila muthenya.
translation: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.

text: Syindu ii kivathukany'o na syitetheeasya kutatua mathina ma kila muthenya.
translation: Mambo kama hayo yamekuwa taaluma tofauti, zinazotazamia kutoa suluhu kwa shida za maisha.

text: Sisitemu ya AI nitumiawa yu miveani ya ukwati, uiiti, engyiniaring na usikalini, yakitwe kompyutani sya misyini na mathau ma vitio.
