translation: Wadudu waharibifu wanaweza kuharibu chakula, kusababisha maudhi, au katika hali mbaya kusababisha athari za mzio, kueneza sumu au kusambaza maambukizi.

text: Mowau makwatanaw'a mweene, kana nyamu mbai ila itonya kuumisya kana kuaa andu kya vinya, sitaile kwithwa syiithaw'a misyini.
translation: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.

text: Mowau makwatanaw'a mweene, kana nyamu mbai ila itonya kuumisya kana kuaa andu kya vinya, sitaile kwithwa syiithaw'a misyini.
translation: Maradhi yenyewe ya kuambukiza, au wanyama hatari ambao wanaweza kujeruhi au kuua watu kwa nguvu, kwa kawaida hawahitimu kama wanyama-vipenzi.

text: Kuthooa syindu itena koti ni ivuso ya kuthooa syindu ite koti kana ndivi ingi ta isu kundu kivathukany'o.
translation: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.

text: Kuthooa syindu itena koti ni ivuso ya kuthooa syindu ite koti kana ndivi ingi ta isu kundu kivathukany'o.
translation: Ununuzi bila ushuru ni nafasi ya kununua bidhaa zisizo na ushuru na kodi katika maeneo fulani.

text: Atembei ala maendaa nthi syi koti wi yiulu saa ingi nimaseiviaa mbesa nzeo, muno muno kwa syindu ta mbaa mbuki na kumbatu.
translation: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.

text: Atembei ala maendaa nthi syi koti wi yiulu saa ingi nimaseiviaa mbesa nzeo, muno muno kwa syindu ta mbaa mbuki na kumbatu.
translation: Wasafiri katika nchi zinazotoza ushuru wa juu wakati mwingine wanaweza kuokoa kiwango kikubwa cha pesa, hasa kwa bidhaa kama vinywaji vyenye vileo na tumbaku.

text: Mwanya ula wi kati kati wa Marion na Fairmont nundu wi vinya ila utwaite ngali leluni wa Buffalo-Pittsburgh wisile kundu kuilye ta kwatiiwe.
translation: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.

text: Mwanya ula wi kati kati wa Marion na Fairmont nundu wi vinya ila utwaite ngali leluni wa Buffalo-Pittsburgh wisile kundu kuilye ta kwatiiwe.
translation: Eneo katikati mwa Point Marion na Fairmont hutoa hali za uendeshaji gari zenye changamoto zaidi katika Barabara Kuu ya Buffalo-Pittsburgh, inayopitia mara kwa mara kwenye maeneo ya ardhi yaliyo katika misitu iliyotengwa.

text: Ethĩwa ndũmanyĩĩtwe ũtwaa ngalĩ lelũnĩ sya nza wa mĩsyĩ mĩnene, lilikana ũũ: iĩma ndũlu, tũlelũ tũtheke, na ilingo nthũku nĩsyo mbingĩ kũũ.
translation: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.

text: Ethĩwa ndũmanyĩĩtwe ũtwaa ngalĩ lelũnĩ sya nza wa mĩsyĩ mĩnene, lilikana ũũ: iĩma ndũlu, tũlelũ tũtheke, na ilingo nthũku nĩsyo mbingĩ kũũ.
translation: Kama hujazoea kuendesha gari katika barabara za mashambani, kaa chonjo: miinuko mikali, njia nyembamba, na na pembe kali zimejaa.

text: Isiĩi sya ĩsemba ila syonanĩtw'e syoneka syĩ nthĩ kwĩ vau mbeenĩ na ĩtinanĩ - mũno mũno kĩlomita 35 kũthi 40 kĩla ĩsaa (kĩlomita 56 kũthi 64 kĩla ĩsaa) - na kũsiatĩĩa nĩkw'o kwĩ vata mũnango kwĩ ũndũ ũngĩ w'onthe.
translation: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.

text: Isiĩi sya ĩsemba ila syonanĩtw'e syoneka syĩ nthĩ kwĩ vau mbeenĩ na ĩtinanĩ - mũno mũno kĩlomita 35 kũthi 40 kĩla ĩsaa (kĩlomita 56 kũthi 64 kĩla ĩsaa) - na kũsiatĩĩa nĩkw'o kwĩ vata mũnango kwĩ ũndũ ũngĩ w'onthe.
translation: Viwango vya kasi vilivyotumwa viko chini kabisa kuliko vya sehemu za zamani na zilizofuata — kawaida maili 35-40 kwa saa (kilomita 56-64 kwa saa) — na utii mkali kwavyo ni muhimu zaidi kuliko vinginevyo.

text: Kwa kwenda kũmanya, ĩndĩ, ũthũkũmi wa simũ sya moko wĩna vinya vaa kwĩ kũndũ kũngĩ nziani ĩsu, ta Pennsylvania Wilds.
translation: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.

text: Kwa kwenda kũmanya, ĩndĩ, ũthũkũmi wa simũ sya moko wĩna vinya vaa kwĩ kũndũ kũngĩ nziani ĩsu, ta Pennsylvania Wilds.
translation: Cha kushangaza hata hivyo, huduma ya simu ya rununu ina nguvu sana hapa kuliko tandaa zingine za njia kama Pennsylvania Wilds.

text: Maandasi ma Germany ni maseo, namo ma Bavaria, nimethiawa na syindu mbingi na syikivathukany'o, mavw'anene na ala ma atui moo, Austria.
translation: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.

text: Maandasi ma Germany ni maseo, namo ma Bavaria, nimethiawa na syindu mbingi na syikivathukany'o, mavw'anene na ala ma atui moo, Austria.
translation: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.

text: Malĩu mbaa imutũ syuĩtwe na matunda syĩkw'o mũno, vamwe na matũvaa mauĩtwe imutũnĩ mwaka w'onthe, na tũtunga tũini na tũtune tũyonekana ĩvindanĩ ya syũa.
translation: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.

text: Malĩu mbaa imutũ syuĩtwe na matunda syĩkw'o mũno, vamwe na matũvaa mauĩtwe imutũnĩ mwaka w'onthe, na tũtunga tũini na tũtune tũyonekana ĩvindanĩ ya syũa.
translation: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.

text: Syindu mbuue mbingi sya Germany no syithiawa na ndende, nzuu, na mithemba ingi ya nzuu sya miti. Keki syi nguma muno muno ni silikanaa nesa na kikombe kya kaawa kalulu vyu.
translation: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.

text: Syindu mbuue mbingi sya Germany no syithiawa na ndende, nzuu, na mithemba ingi ya nzuu sya miti. Keki syi nguma muno muno ni silikanaa nesa na kikombe kya kaawa kalulu vyu.
translation: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.

text: Kethwa nukwenda pastries nini na nzeo, tata kila kitawa kutengemea ngaliko kitawa Berliner, Pfannkuchen kana Krapfen.
translation: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.

text: Kethwa nukwenda pastries nini na nzeo, tata kila kitawa kutengemea ngaliko kitawa Berliner, Pfannkuchen kana Krapfen.
translation: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.

text: Curry ni liu uwitwe na ndawa sya kithekani na sivaisisi, vamwe na nyama kana mbaa mboka.
translation: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.

text: Curry ni liu uwitwe na ndawa sya kithekani na sivaisisi, vamwe na nyama kana mbaa mboka.
translation: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.

text: Mboka nowĩthe yĩnyaũ kana yĩ mbololo kwĩanana na ũndũ weekĩa sũvũ wĩana.
translation: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.

text: Mboka nowĩthe yĩnyaũ kana yĩ mbololo kwĩanana na ũndũ weekĩa sũvũ wĩana.
translation: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.

text: Ngaliko sya India ya iulu na Pakistani, yongati nitumiawa kwa curries; Na India ya itheo na ngaliko sya kisoani kya kondineti nini, iia ya nathi nitumiawa muno.
translation: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.

text: Ngaliko sya India ya iulu na Pakistani, yongati nitumiawa kwa curries; Na India ya itheo na ngaliko sya kisoani kya kondineti nini, iia ya nathi nitumiawa muno.
translation: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.

text: Yina ithama 17,000 sya kusakua, liu wa Indonesia ni muthemba ta mwavuli withwaa ukavite maliu ma kundu kwingi withwaa nthi ii.
translation: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.

text: Yina ithama 17,000 sya kusakua, liu wa Indonesia ni muthemba ta mwavuli withwaa ukavite maliu ma kundu kwingi withwaa nthi ii.
translation: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.

text: Ateo, yatumiwa vate syindu ingi, ndeto isu yithwaa yiimini umo wa liu kuma ngaliko sya katikati na uthuo wa syua wa kithama kya Java kila kinene.
translation: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.

text: Ateo, yatumiwa vate syindu ingi, ndeto isu yithwaa yiimini umo wa liu kuma ngaliko sya katikati na uthuo wa syua wa kithama kya Java kila kinene.
translation: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.

text: Yũ ĩkwatĩkanaa mũno vyũ kũũ archipelago, Javanese Cuisine methaa na maleũ maseo, mĩsamo yita nzũũ kalanga, ndũlũ, sũkalĩ (mũnomũno sũkalĩ wa nathĩ sya Javanisi) na mĩsamo ĩngĩ mĩseo.
translation: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.

text: Yũ ĩkwatĩkanaa mũno vyũ kũũ archipelago, Javanese Cuisine methaa na maleũ maseo, mĩsamo yita nzũũ kalanga, ndũlũ, sũkalĩ (mũnomũno sũkalĩ wa nathĩ sya Javanisi) na mĩsamo ĩngĩ mĩseo.
translation: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.

text: Itwĩĩkĩ sya maaũ ma atwaĩ ma ĩsũlũlũ syĩtha syĩ ngalĩ ĩsũ ĩngĩ ya ũĩto.
translation: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.

text: Itwĩĩkĩ sya maaũ ma atwaĩ ma ĩsũlũlũ syĩtha syĩ ngalĩ ĩsũ ĩngĩ ya ũĩto.
translation: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning'inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.

text: Nitumaa mutwai ethwa atatonya uvaluka mituki ateo ni syithwaa na muisyo wa usuvííku nundu wa maúú ma mutwai nomalume kwasyo.
translation: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.

text: Nitumaa mutwai ethwa atatonya uvaluka mituki ateo ni syithwaa na muisyo wa usuvííku nundu wa maúú ma mutwai nomalume kwasyo.
translation: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.

text: Etha mũtwaĩ wa mbalasĩ nĩ wekywa kũma mbalasĩnĩ na kũũ kwakwatwa nĩ ĩkanda, no akũsĩthwe nĩ mbalasĩ yasemba.kũola thĩna ta ũũ, syĩndũ na nĩsyaĩle kwĩkĩwa maananĩ.
translation: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.

text: Etha mũtwaĩ wa mbalasĩ nĩ wekywa kũma mbalasĩnĩ na kũũ kwakwatwa nĩ ĩkanda, no akũsĩthwe nĩ mbalasĩ yasemba.kũola thĩna ta ũũ, syĩndũ na nĩsyaĩle kwĩkĩwa maananĩ.
translation: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.

text: Mbee, atwaithya aingi mekiaa mbuti sya kutwaithya syina kitiinyo na mbololo, ntheke muno, solo.
translation: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.

text: Mbee, atwaithya aingi mekiaa mbuti sya kutwaithya syina kitiinyo na mbololo, ntheke muno, solo.
translation: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.

text: Kila kiatiie, matandiko amwe, na muno muno ma ungelesa, nimethiawa na syuma sya kwisuviana na muisyo ila syitikilasya musivi kuvaluka kuma itandikoni yiu ila mukuwa wavaluka na itina.
translation: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.

text: Kila kiatiie, matandiko amwe, na muno muno ma ungelesa, nimethiawa na syuma sya kwisuviana na muisyo ila syitikilasya musivi kuvaluka kuma itandikoni yiu ila mukuwa wavaluka na itina.
translation: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.

text: Mwanda wa Kokiamo - Kilisilo kila kitongoety'e Chile, wisikie ta Yosemaiti ya Amerika ya itheo, yina mokuta manene na myanda.
translation: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.

text: Mwanda wa Kokiamo - Kilisilo kila kitongoety'e Chile, wisikie ta Yosemaiti ya Amerika ya itheo, yina mokuta manene na myanda.
translation: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.

text: Samiti syithwaa na kundu kwa kusengy'a uyiloela kuma vandu vatũlu. Alisi kuma ngaliko yonthe ya nthi maendee na kumantha nzia ingi nzau kati wa nguta itathelaa.
translation: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.

text: Samiti syithwaa na kundu kwa kusengy'a uyiloela kuma vandu vatũlu. Alisi kuma ngaliko yonthe ya nthi maendee na kumantha nzia ingi nzau kati wa nguta itathelaa.
translation: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.

text: Mathau ma itheeo mbalavuni, ala methiawa kitheea mbalauni na kuulukila iulu wa mbalavu kutumia mbwau, methiawa mathau mesiiwe me vamwe na kutheea nthi wa kundu kuvw'ikitwe ni mbalavu wina mwau sya utheea mbalavuni kana syindu syauthaukia mbalavuni syoveewe mauuni maku.
translation: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.

text: Mathau ma itheeo mbalavuni, ala methiawa kitheea mbalauni na kuulukila iulu wa mbalavu kutumia mbwau, methiawa mathau mesiiwe me vamwe na kutheea nthi wa kundu kuvw'ikitwe ni mbalavu wina mwau sya utheea mbalavuni kana syindu syauthaukia mbalavuni syoveewe mauuni maku.
translation: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.

text: Kusiuuka iani ni iseso inene ya kutembea na andu ala mayendete, kwa imwe yitawa "kusiiuka na bums" kuvanga vacation nima usiuuka vandu vulani.
translation: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.

text: Kusiuuka iani ni iseso inene ya kutembea na andu ala mayendete, kwa imwe yitawa "kusiiuka na bums" kuvanga vacation nima usiuuka vandu vulani.
translation: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.

text: Isuania ya kusiiuka ni ya tene-mavisa ma kusola monanasw'a kuma myaka ya 5000 BC mithelu!
translation: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!

text: Isuania ya kusiiuka ni ya tene-mavisa ma kusola monanasw'a kuma myaka ya 5000 BC mithelu!
translation: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!

text: Kusiuuka utheete iĩma ta ithau kwambĩĩe myakanĩ ya 17th century, na vala kĩkũndi kya mbee kya kusiuuka kyavingũiwe twi1861 nĩ andũ ma Norway ku Australia.
translation: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.

text: Kusiuuka utheete iĩma ta ithau kwambĩĩe myakanĩ ya 17th century, na vala kĩkũndi kya mbee kya kusiuuka kyavingũiwe twi1861 nĩ andũ ma Norway ku Australia.
translation: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.

text: Kupaki twina ski: Iseso yii o ingi niyisikie ta backcountry ski, kutambuka kwa ski kana kulisa kwa ski.
translation: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.

text: Kupaki twina ski: Iseso yii o ingi niyisikie ta backcountry ski, kutambuka kwa ski kana kulisa kwa ski.
translation: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.

text: Ĩkonetye ĩndĩ ti o ĩũlũ wa nzĩa ya ũtembei wa kwĩtaanĩthya wa alpine kana ũlĩsa iĩma, sya mũthia siyĩkwa kũndũ kũtheeu mũno na iyenda mbwaũ sya mbalavu na mbuti nũmangũ.
translation: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.

text: Ĩkonetye ĩndĩ ti o ĩũlũ wa nzĩa ya ũtembei wa kwĩtaanĩthya wa alpine kana ũlĩsa iĩma, sya mũthia siyĩkwa kũndũ kũtheeu mũno na iyenda mbwaũ sya mbalavu na mbuti nũmangũ.
translation: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.

text: vĩndĩĩsyaa nzĩa sya kũũlũka syĩ ũndũ ũmwe na nzĩa sya kũtembeela.
translation: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.

text: vĩndĩĩsyaa nzĩa sya kũũlũka syĩ ũndũ ũmwe na nzĩa sya kũtembeela.
translation: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.

text: Ila wetha nzeo nitonya kuenda muendo muasa utembeete - indi no mavinda kauta ukwataa siviti sya kusiuukila iani ithekani kethiwa ndwina muvuko muito na ndwisile nziani sya kusiuukila.
translation: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.

text: Ila wetha nzeo nitonya kuenda muendo muasa utembeete - indi no mavinda kauta ukwataa siviti sya kusiuukila iani ithekani kethiwa ndwina muvuko muito na ndwisile nziani sya kusiuukila.
translation: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.

text: Europe ilembeta inini indi yi na nthi mbingi nthasye. Nthi wa hali ya kawaita, kutemba nthi mbingi ni lasima withe na VISA na PASSPORT.
translation: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.

text: Europe ilembeta inini indi yi na nthi mbingi nthasye. Nthi wa hali ya kawaita, kutemba nthi mbingi ni lasima withe na VISA na PASSPORT.
translation: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.

text: Ndua ya Schengen, o na vamwe na uu, ithukumaa ta imwe ya nthi ii syi vaa.
translation: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.

text: Ndua ya Schengen, o na vamwe na uu, ithukumaa ta imwe ya nthi ii syi vaa.
translation: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.

text: O we watwika nukwikala kisioni kii, no ukilanilye mivaka utekwisila kundu kwa kusikya pasipoti ingi.
translation: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.

text: O we watwika nukwikala kisioni kii, no ukilanilye mivaka utekwisila kundu kwa kusikya pasipoti ingi.
translation: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.

text: O undu umwe na kwithwa na valua ula waile wa kuthi Schengen, vai vata wa kúandikithisya valua kivathukany'o kwa nthi sya ikonyo sya Schengen, kwoou uyiokoa ivinda, mbesa na wia wa mathangú.
translation: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.

text: O undu umwe na kwithwa na valua ula waile wa kuthi Schengen, vai vata wa kúandikithisya valua kivathukany'o kwa nthi sya ikonyo sya Schengen, kwoou uyiokoa ivinda, mbesa na wia wa mathangú.
translation: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.

text: Vayingwa maana mbitikile ni andu oonthe ila syindu sya kuseuviw'a kambunini syaile kutw'ika syindu nguu sya mwanya. Makundi amwe ma kuivithya koti matusaa miio yina mwaka mbee wa 100 ta syindu nguu sya lato.
translation: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.

text: Vayingwa maana mbitikile ni andu oonthe ila syindu sya kuseuviw'a kambunini syaile kutw'ika syindu nguu sya mwanya. Makundi amwe ma kuivithya koti matusaa miio yina mwaka mbee wa 100 ta syindu nguu sya lato.
translation: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.

text: Kuelesya kuu kwi ivathukany'o kulingana na kisio, vala kiwango kya ukuu no kithe ki kikuvi kundu ta North America kute Europe.
translation: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.

text: Kuelesya kuu kwi ivathukany'o kulingana na kisio, vala kiwango kya ukuu no kithe ki kikuvi kundu ta North America kute Europe.
translation: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.

text: Mali ya Handicraft noyitwe ta antiques, o na kutwika ni nini kwi mali ingi ta isu iseuvaw'a kwa wingi.
translation: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.

text: Mali ya Handicraft noyitwe ta antiques, o na kutwika ni nini kwi mali ingi ta isu iseuvaw'a kwa wingi.
translation: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.

text: Kuithya Reindeer ni kindu kya maana vala ve Sami na kithio kila withululukite, viasala wi maana vamwe na mawia angi.
translation: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.

text: Kuithya Reindeer ni kindu kya maana vala ve Sami na kithio kila withululukite, viasala wi maana vamwe na mawia angi.
translation: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.

text: Na ivinda ya tene, onaketha, ti Asámi onthe maithasya ilong'a kwa wingi, lakini mekalaa kwa kutea makuyu, kusyima na sindu taisu, kwitha na ilong'a muno muno ta nyamu ya kawaida.
translation: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.

text: Na ivinda ya tene, onaketha, ti Asámi onthe maithasya ilong'a kwa wingi, lakini mekalaa kwa kutea makuyu, kusyima na sindu taisu, kwitha na ilong'a muno muno ta nyamu ya kawaida.
translation: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.

text: Umunthi andu aiingi ma kuma Sami makthukumaa mawia ma mutuku aya. Utalii ni nzia imwe yi mwanya ila ietae mbesa ku Sapmi, kisio kiku Sami.
translation: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.

text: Umunthi andu aiingi ma kuma Sami makthukumaa mawia ma mutuku aya. Utalii ni nzia imwe yi mwanya ila ietae mbesa ku Sapmi, kisio kiku Sami.
translation: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.

text: Ona kwithiwa nitumiawa muno, na muno kati wa andu mate Alomi, ndeto ino "mwoni", niyonekaa yi yauthatya nundu yosaniaw'a na tavia nthuku ya Alomi.
translation: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.

text: Ona kwithiwa nitumiawa muno, na muno kati wa andu mate Alomi, ndeto ino "mwoni", niyonekaa yi yauthatya nundu yosaniaw'a na tavia nthuku ya Alomi.
translation: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.

text: Kethwa nthĩ ĩla ũũthokea yĩna wasiwasi wa kũthokewa, ĩnisualanzĩ yakũ ya ũĩĩti kana ĩnisualanzĩ ya kũekana na kũtambũka kwakũ noyĩthwe na maũvĩndũkũ.
translation: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.

text: Kethwa nthĩ ĩla ũũthokea yĩna wasiwasi wa kũthokewa, ĩnisualanzĩ yakũ ya ũĩĩti kana ĩnisualanzĩ ya kũekana na kũtambũka kwakũ noyĩthwe na maũvĩndũkũ.
translation: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.

text: No wendeew'e nĩkũkũlya ũtao kũma vala ve silĩkalĩ ũtee na ũla wakũ, ateo ũtao wa silĩkasĩ ũseũvĩtw'e nũndũ wa andũ manthĩ yoo.
translation: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.

text: No wendeew'e nĩkũkũlya ũtao kũma vala ve silĩkalĩ ũtee na ũla wakũ, ateo ũtao wa silĩkasĩ ũseũvĩtw'e nũndũ wa andũ manthĩ yoo.
translation: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o ĩmwe, ene nthĩ ma Amelika ala me Middle East nomakomane na mawetu kĩvathũkany'o kuma kwa andu ma Eulope kana Alavu.
translation: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.

text: Kwa ngelekany'o ĩmwe, ene nthĩ ma Amelika ala me Middle East nomakomane na mawetu kĩvathũkany'o kuma kwa andu ma Eulope kana Alavu.
translation: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.

text: Atai methwaa meo samli nini ya ivinda ya siasa sya nthi.
translation: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.

text: Atai methwaa meo samli nini ya ivinda ya siasa sya nthi.
translation: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.

text: Mawoni ala maandikĩtwe ni maelesye kwa ulikũ mbee wa ĩlungu ingi syi kũndũ kũngi.
translation: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.

text: Mawoni ala maandikĩtwe ni maelesye kwa ulikũ mbee wa ĩlungu ingi syi kũndũ kũngi.
translation: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.

text: Nzeve nthũku ni isyitwa yitumiawa kwonany'a ivinda ya nzeve nthũku yĩna mũisyo wa kwananga, wanango wa mwikalile, kana wasyo wa maisa ma mũndũ.
translation: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.

text: Nzeve nthũku ni isyitwa yitumiawa kwonany'a ivinda ya nzeve nthũku yĩna mũisyo wa kwananga, wanango wa mwikalile, kana wasyo wa maisa ma mũndũ.
translation: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.

text: Maũthũlũlũko mathũkũ na maũmĩle vandũ vovote nthĩ yo nthe, na nĩsya kĩvathũkanganyo, ala matengemea maũthũlũlũko na ũndũ maĩlye na ũndũ kĩsevenĩ kũĩlye.
translation: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.

text: Maũthũlũlũko mathũkũ na maũmĩle vandũ vovote nthĩ yo nthe, na nĩsya kĩvathũkanganyo, ala matengemea maũthũlũlũko na ũndũ maĩlye na ũndũ kĩsevenĩ kũĩlye.
translation: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.

text: Kiseve kingi, mbua mbingi, na myaki ya kithekani nundu wa nzeve nthuku, onasyo itundumo, kilingi, kiw'u kingi na nzeve mbai.
translation: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.

text: Kiseve kingi, mbua mbingi, na myaki ya kithekani nundu wa nzeve nthuku, onasyo itundumo, kilingi, kiw'u kingi na nzeve mbai.
translation: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.

text: Movinduku ma nzeve ma kusengy'a na ala makusiiawa kundu kumwe ni vamwe na mbua ya ia, mbua ya mbalavu, na mbua ya kitoo.
translation: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.

text: Movinduku ma nzeve ma kusengy'a na ala makusiiawa kundu kumwe ni vamwe na mbua ya ia, mbua ya mbalavu, na mbua ya kitoo.
translation: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.

text: Atembei nimeukulw'a methwe me ngunuu iulu wa muisyo wa nzeve nthuku ila ikuthua ngaliko yoo nundu no ithue mivango yoo ya kutembea.
translation: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.

text: Atembei nimeukulw'a methwe me ngunuu iulu wa muisyo wa nzeve nthuku ila ikuthua ngaliko yoo nundu no ithue mivango yoo ya kutembea.
translation: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.

text: Mundu uvangite kuthi nthi yisikie ta yi kau aile ivundisya kau.
translation: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.

text: Mundu uvangite kuthi nthi yisikie ta yi kau aile ivundisya kau.
translation: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.

text: Kumantha kwa indaneti iulu wa "Koosi ya mawithyululuko mathuku" noethwa itwony'a vala kambuni isu yii.
translation: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.

text: Kumantha kwa indaneti iulu wa "Koosi ya mawithyululuko mathuku" noethwa itwony'a vala kambuni isu yii.
translation: Utafutaji wa 'Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama' kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.

text: koosĩ nĩkũsomethya syĩndũ syoonthe ĩla syĩneenewe vaa kwa ũlĩkũ, ovamwe na k2onanya mĩvyano.
translation: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.

text: koosĩ nĩkũsomethya syĩndũ syoonthe ĩla syĩneenewe vaa kwa ũlĩkũ, ovamwe na k2onanya mĩvyano.
translation: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.

text: Koosi ĩkuaa mithenya 2-5 na yĩĩthwa na muthukumile, uiiti wa mbee na saa ingi kũvundĩw'a ĩũlũ wa mĩio ya kaũ.
translation: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.

text: Koosi ĩkuaa mithenya 2-5 na yĩĩthwa na muthukumile, uiiti wa mbee na saa ingi kũvundĩw'a ĩũlũ wa mĩio ya kaũ.
translation: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.

text: Mavuku na makaseti ala mathukumana na kwikala kithekana ni maingi muno, lakini mavuku yiulu wa kau ni manini muno.
translation: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.

text: Mavuku na makaseti ala mathukumana na kwikala kithekana ni maingi muno, lakini mavuku yiulu wa kau ni manini muno.
translation: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.

text: Atembeĩ ala maendaa kũvĩndũwa mamũtha moo ma kĩmbĩthĩ nthĩ sya nza nĩmaĩlwe nĩ kũkũa mavalũa ala metĩkĩlĩthĩtw'e kũtũmĩka ndambũkanĩ yoo ya kũsyoka.
translation: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.

text: Atembeĩ ala maendaa kũvĩndũwa mamũtha moo ma kĩmbĩthĩ nthĩ sya nza nĩmaĩlwe nĩ kũkũa mavalũa ala metĩkĩlĩthĩtw'e kũtũmĩka ndambũkanĩ yoo ya kũsyoka.
translation: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.

text: Wendi wa selikali kunengane ivande sya kuthi nthi ingi syina vandu va mundu muka kana munduume vataandikitwe (X) kana mathangu maseuvitw'e weu kwonany'a isyitwa yila mundu ukwenda withiawa na kivathukany'o.
translation: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.

text: Wendi wa selikali kunengane ivande sya kuthi nthi ingi syina vandu va mundu muka kana munduume vataandikitwe (X) kana mathangu maseuvitw'e weu kwonany'a isyitwa yila mundu ukwenda withiawa na kivathukany'o.
translation: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.

text: Wendi wa silikali sya nthi syanza kumanya ndokyumendi ii ni undu kivathukany'o vyu.
translation: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.

text: Wendi wa silikali sya nthi syanza kumanya ndokyumendi ii ni undu kivathukany'o vyu.
translation: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.

text: Misako kundu kwi isiio sya kuikiithya muuo ni siendee na kukila mivaka ilungu ya kuma mwai wa kenda matuku 11 mwaka wa 2001.
translation: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.

text: Misako kundu kwi isiio sya kuikiithya muuo ni siendee na kukila mivaka ilungu ya kuma mwai wa kenda matuku 11 mwaka wa 2001.
translation: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.

text: Andũ mena syĩmbithi sya eetũ na aũme syĩ ilĩ ikwatene mayaĩlĩte kwĩkatya kũvĩtĩla mitambonĩ ya kusikani syĩmbĩthe sya mĩĩ yoo itekũmanyĩkana.
translation: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.

text: Andũ mena syĩmbithi sya eetũ na aũme syĩ ilĩ ikwatene mayaĩlĩte kwĩkatya kũvĩtĩla mitambonĩ ya kusikani syĩmbĩthe sya mĩĩ yoo itekũmanyĩkana.
translation: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.

text: Makumbo ma livu ni itulumo ila ikilaa syi mbumu, maita maingi uvaini kana kindu kya muthemba usu.
translation: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.

text: Makumbo ma livu ni itulumo ila ikilaa syi mbumu, maita maingi uvaini kana kindu kya muthemba usu.
translation: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.

text: Nundu wa topology ya nthi ya kiwu kusyoka kwaflow yithiwa vandu valikangu vaini, na fast current kwa kiwũ kiliku itonya usoovewa vaũ.
translation: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.

text: Nundu wa topology ya nthi ya kiwu kusyoka kwaflow yithiwa vandu valikangu vaini, na fast current kwa kiwũ kiliku itonya usoovewa vaũ.
translation: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.

text: Ikw'u mbingi syithiawa nundu wa minoo ya kutata kuthambia undu kiw'u kita endete, ula nita undu utatonyeka.
translation: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.

text: Ikw'u mbingi syithiawa nundu wa minoo ya kutata kuthambia undu kiw'u kita endete, ula nita undu utatonyeka.
translation: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.

text: O waũma vanĩnĩ vale ve ĩtũlũmo, nĩ vĩnya mũno kũsyoka ĩngĩ ta tena.
translation: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.

text: O waũma vanĩnĩ vale ve ĩtũlũmo, nĩ vĩnya mũno kũsyoka ĩngĩ ta tena.
translation: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.

text: Tata ũsyaĩsya vandũ ũteũkwatw'a ĩngĩ kana, kwĩanana na ũmanyi waku na ethĩwa n'ũmanyĩkĩte, no wende kweteela ũtethyo.
translation: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.

text: Tata ũsyaĩsya vandũ ũteũkwatw'a ĩngĩ kana, kwĩanana na ũmanyi waku na ethĩwa n'ũmanyĩkĩte, no wende kweteela ũtethyo.
translation: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.

text: Kĩtelemo kya'ũlika ĩngĩ kyũkaa mĩtũkangĩ kwĩ kĩtelemo kya syĩthĩo (nĩvethĩawa ĩvinda ĩnini ya ũthũmũa na ũtaanĩa), yĩkalangaa mũno, na noyĩthĩwe nthũku mũnango.
translation: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.

text: Kĩtelemo kya'ũlika ĩngĩ kyũkaa mĩtũkangĩ kwĩ kĩtelemo kya syĩthĩo (nĩvethĩawa ĩvinda ĩnini ya ũthũmũa na ũtaanĩa), yĩkalangaa mũno, na noyĩthĩwe nthũku mũnango.
translation: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.

text: atembeĩ ala meethĩĩwe na ĩvĩnda yololo ya kũvĩndũka kũthĩ ka mĩkalĩle myeũ saa ĩmwe methaa na thĩna wakũvĩndũka kũsyoka mĩtĩndonĩ ya kĩkwoo.
translation: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.

text: atembeĩ ala meethĩĩwe na ĩvĩnda yololo ya kũvĩndũka kũthĩ ka mĩkalĩle myeũ saa ĩmwe methaa na thĩna wakũvĩndũka kũsyoka mĩtĩndonĩ ya kĩkwoo.
translation: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.

text: Ivinda ya kusyoka musyi itina wa kkwikala nthi sya nza withaa wamanyie kithio kieni na kulwa ni syindu imwe sya kithio kya musyi kwoo.
translation: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.

text: Ivinda ya kusyoka musyi itina wa kkwikala nthi sya nza withaa wamanyie kithio kieni na kulwa ni syindu imwe sya kithio kya musyi kwoo.
translation: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.

text: Yila waendie muingo kwa ivinda yambee, andu mayakukalaataa na makakuelewa, mesi kana atalii nimendaa ivinda maimanyia.
translation: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.

text: Yila waendie muingo kwa ivinda yambee, andu mayakukalaataa na makakuelewa, mesi kana atalii nimendaa ivinda maimanyia.
translation: Wakati ulienda ng'ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.

text: Andu nomaeme kwona kana kwithwa na umiisyo na kuelewa ta undu mwailu kwa atembei kusyoka musyi.
translation: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.

text: Andu nomaeme kwona kana kwithwa na umiisyo na kuelewa ta undu mwailu kwa atembei kusyoka musyi.
translation: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.

text: Wasya na kyeni cha "pyramid" ni kati wa syindu ila syendeeasya syana muno.
translation: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.

text: Wasya na kyeni cha "pyramid" ni kati wa syindu ila syendeeasya syana muno.
translation: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.

text: Nowone ila vilamindi kivinduni na no umyone kuvinditye shoo itanambiia.
translation: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.

text: Nowone ila vilamindi kivinduni na no umyone kuvinditye shoo itanambiia.
translation: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.

text: Kwa kawaita nukwiw'a wasya wa atalii na athoosya. Ngewa ya wasya na kyeni no undumwe na mbano.
translation: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.

text: Kwa kawaita nukwiw'a wasya wa atalii na athoosya. Ngewa ya wasya na kyeni no undumwe na mbano.
translation: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.

text: sphinx nivo maundu asu mabiaa na munengani wa ngewa ndaasa.
translation: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.

text: sphinx nivo maundu asu mabiaa na munengani wa ngewa ndaasa.
translation: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.

text: Kundu kwonanitw'e kwa vilamindi na vilamindi kivathukany'o ikakwatw'a taa.
translation: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.

text: Kundu kwonanitw'e kwa vilamindi na vilamindi kivathukany'o ikakwatw'a taa.
translation: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.

text: Nthi mbingi ni syendaa isiwa sya South Shetland ila sya manyikanie mwaka wa 1819 na syithiawa na ilembeta mbingi, 16 syithukuma mwakani wa 2020.
translation: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.

text: Nthi mbingi ni syendaa isiwa sya South Shetland ila sya manyikanie mwaka wa 1819 na syithiawa na ilembeta mbingi, 16 syithukuma mwakani wa 2020.
translation: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.

text: Archĩpelago yĩthĩawa kĩlomita 120 yĩũlũ wa penĩnsũla. Kĩthũkũma kĩla kĩnene kya mũsũmbĩ george kĩtwĩwe nĩ vĩlla LaS Estrellas.
translation: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.

text: Archĩpelago yĩthĩawa kĩlomita 120 yĩũlũ wa penĩnsũla. Kĩthũkũma kĩla kĩnene kya mũsũmbĩ george kĩtwĩwe nĩ vĩlla LaS Estrellas.
translation: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.

text: Ingĩ nĩsyo Livingstone Island, na Deception vala kasiĩo kavwĩke nĩ kĩw'ũ ka watũku wa mwaki ũtonya kwatũka ĩvinda o yonthe ũnenganae vandũ va ũthũmũa ve woneki wa'ũsengy'a mũno.
translation: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.

text: Ingĩ nĩsyo Livingstone Island, na Deception vala kasiĩo kavwĩke nĩ kĩw'ũ ka watũku wa mwaki ũtonya kwatũka ĩvinda o yonthe ũnenganae vandũ va ũthũmũa ve woneki wa'ũsengy'a mũno.
translation: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.

text: Ellsworth Land ni kilungu itheo wa peninsula, kikelanitw'e ni Ukanga wa Bellingshausen.
translation: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.

text: Ellsworth Land ni kilungu itheo wa peninsula, kikelanitw'e ni Ukanga wa Bellingshausen.
translation: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.

text: Iima sya Peninsula ikomanie vaa tambalale, na indi ikakomana ingi kuseuvya kuatiania kwa kilomita 360 kwa Ellsworth Mountains, itilanitw'e ni Minnesota Glacier.
translation: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.

text: Iima sya Peninsula ikomanie vaa tambalale, na indi ikakomana ingi kuseuvya kuatiania kwa kilomita 360 kwa Ellsworth Mountains, itilanitw'e ni Minnesota Glacier.
translation: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.

text: Ngalĩko ya yĩũlũ kana iĩm sya Sentinel nĩyo yĩthaa na kĩĩma kĩla kĩnenene vyũ kũũ Antarctica, kĩĩma kya Vinson Massif, kĩla kĩna ũasa wa 4892m.
translation: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.

text: Ngalĩko ya yĩũlũ kana iĩm sya Sentinel nĩyo yĩthaa na kĩĩma kĩla kĩnenene vyũ kũũ Antarctica, kĩĩma kya Vinson Massif, kĩla kĩna ũasa wa 4892m.
translation: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.

text: Kũndũ kũla limoti, kũtena mitambo ya sĩmũ sya kwoko, sĩmũ sya setilaiti nosyo itumika syisyoka.
translation: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.

text: Kũndũ kũla limoti, kũtena mitambo ya sĩmũ sya kwoko, sĩmũ sya setilaiti nosyo itumika syisyoka.
translation: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.

text: Simu ya setilaiti ti yotumiwa vandu va simu ya ukua, nundu no nginya withwe wi nza vandu wene I setilaiti nesa nikenda ukune simu.
translation: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.

text: Simu ya setilaiti ti yotumiwa vandu va simu ya ukua, nundu no nginya withwe wi nza vandu wene I setilaiti nesa nikenda ukune simu.
translation: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.

text: Ũtethyo ũsũ nũtũmĩawa mũno ũkuinĩ, o vamwe na ndeke sya kwitanĩthya, o ũndũ ũmwe na syalo ĩla ĩtena ũvoo wĩanĩte na mawasya mena mathĩna.
translation: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.

text: Ũtethyo ũsũ nũtũmĩawa mũno ũkuinĩ, o vamwe na ndeke sya kwitanĩthya, o ũndũ ũmwe na syalo ĩla ĩtena ũvoo wĩanĩte na mawasya mena mathĩna.
translation: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.

text: mũtetheesya wa sĩmũ yakũ aĩle kwĩtha atonya kũkũtavya mũno ĩũlũ wa kũthũkũma na ũtetheesya ũsũ.
translation: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.

text: mũtetheesya wa sĩmũ yakũ aĩle kwĩtha atonya kũkũtavya mũno ĩũlũ wa kũthũkũma na ũtetheesya ũsũ.
translation: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.

text: Undu uendee kwongeleka kwa ala matembeaa ni kuvanga mwanya wa mwaka umwe nikenda masome.
translation: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.

text: Undu uendee kwongeleka kwa ala matembeaa ni kuvanga mwanya wa mwaka umwe nikenda masome.
translation: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.

text: Nikisikie mũno ni ala maminie sukulu, kiimanenga mwanya wa kwikala mwaka ũmwe nza matanamba kuthi yunivasiti, vate kwananga masomo.
translation: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.

text: Nikisikie mũno ni ala maminie sukulu, kiimanenga mwanya wa kwikala mwaka ũmwe nza matanamba kuthi yunivasiti, vate kwananga masomo.
translation: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.

text: Mavindani maingi, kulika koosini yina mwanya wa mwaka umwe nthi sya nza ni kwongeleelaa ivuso ya kuendeesya masomo maku ila wasyoka nthi yaku.
translation: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.

text: Mavindani maingi, kulika koosini yina mwanya wa mwaka umwe nthi sya nza ni kwongeleelaa ivuso ya kuendeesya masomo maku ila wasyoka nthi yaku.
translation: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.

text: Kawaita nimeithwa na mbesa sya ielo nikenda ulike kwa muvango wa kisomo kii.
translation: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.

text: Kawaita nimeithwa na mbesa sya ielo nikenda ulike kwa muvango wa kisomo kii.
translation: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.

text: Finland ni vandu ve mwanya va utwai wa masiwa. "Nthi isu ya maia ngili" ingi yusiwe ni makili ma maia ithamani syayo, na ku iiani na kisoani kya archipelagos.
translation: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.

text: Finland ni vandu ve mwanya va utwai wa masiwa. "Nthi isu ya maia ngili" ingi yusiwe ni makili ma maia ithamani syayo, na ku iiani na kisoani kya archipelagos.
translation: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. "Nchi ya maziwa elfu" ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.

text: Ti lasima withe na isiwa ithamani na maiani.
translation: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.

text: Ti lasima withe na isiwa ithamani na maiani.
translation: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.

text: Onakaũ ũkanga wa archĩpelagos na masĩwa ala manene nĩ meanũ kwa ĩsĩwa yonthe yĩla, tũsĩwa tũnĩnĩ kana matalũ methaa na mwĩw'ĩle wamo.
translation: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.

text: Onakaũ ũkanga wa archĩpelagos na masĩwa ala manene nĩ meanũ kwa ĩsĩwa yonthe yĩla, tũsĩwa tũnĩnĩ kana matalũ methaa na mwĩw'ĩle wamo.
translation: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.

text: Kũthi na masiwa ni kindũ kya kuvĩtya masaa Finland, vala wĩtiaa kila andũ 7 kana nyanya mena ĩsiwa.
translation: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.

text: Kũthi na masiwa ni kindũ kya kuvĩtya masaa Finland, vala wĩtiaa kila andũ 7 kana nyanya mena ĩsiwa.
translation: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
