text: Savali mbingi sya mwanya sya ukangani wa Baltic syithiawa na ilungu yiasa ya kwikalanga St. Petersburg, Russia.
translation: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.

text: Savali mbingi sya mwanya sya ukangani wa Baltic syithiawa na ilungu yiasa ya kwikalanga St. Petersburg, Russia.
translation: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.

text: Ii yimaanisha no utembee taoni ii ya tene mithenya kauta uisyokethya kukoma melini wiyoo.
translation: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.

text: Ii yimaanisha no utembee taoni ii ya tene mithenya kauta uisyokethya kukoma melini wiyoo.
translation: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.

text: Wakilanilya ũkanga na isiwa ndukenda VISA ĩngi. (Kuambiliĩlya mwaka wa 2009).
translation: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).

text: Wakilanilya ũkanga na isiwa ndukenda VISA ĩngi. (Kuambiliĩlya mwaka wa 2009).
translation: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).

text: Syalo imwe sya meli syithiawa na Berlin, Germany nthini wa mathangu masyo. O undu ukwona kuma visani wa kwonany'a kundu uu wi vau iulu Berlin ndii o na vakuvi na ukanga na kutembea musyini usu kwithiaa kwongele nthini wa thooa.
translation: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.

text: Syalo imwe sya meli syithiawa na Berlin, Germany nthini wa mathangu masyo. O undu ukwona kuma visani wa kwonany'a kundu uu wi vau iulu Berlin ndii o na vakuvi na ukanga na kutembea musyini usu kwithiaa kwongele nthini wa thooa.
translation: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.

text: Kuuluka na ndeke no kwithwe kwi undu wi wia kwa andu ma ukuu oonthe na kusyoka itina, muno muno kethwa mayaathi na ndeke mbeangeni kana nimavitiie undu wi muisyo.
translation: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.

text: Kuuluka na ndeke no kwithwe kwi undu wi wia kwa andu ma ukuu oonthe na kusyoka itina, muno muno kethwa mayaathi na ndeke mbeangeni kana nimavitiie undu wi muisyo.
translation: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.

text: Ti kindu kya kwithiwa na nthoni nakyo: kii kivathukany'o na maundu ma kimundu ma w'ia na kwithiwa utendeta syindu imwe ila syithiawa na andu aingi.
translation: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.

text: Ti kindu kya kwithiwa na nthoni nakyo: kii kivathukany'o na maundu ma kimundu ma w'ia na kwithiwa utendeta syindu imwe ila syithiawa na andu aingi.
translation: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.

text: Kwa amwe, kuelewa ni kindu yiulu wa undu ndeke ithukumaa na kila kikikaa ila ikuuluka no matetheke kumina wia ula uetawe ni kwithwa ute na utonyi wa kusyiia.
translation: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.

text: Kwa amwe, kuelewa ni kindu yiulu wa undu ndeke ithukumaa na kila kikikaa ila ikuuluka no matetheke kumina wia ula uetawe ni kwithwa ute na utonyi wa kusyiia.
translation: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.

text: kampuni sya ukui siivawa nesa kwa kuvisya mioo mituki, muno muno, ivinda ni ya maana muno kwa mavalua ma piasala, mioo kana spare part kwa kusoovwa kwa mituki.
translation: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.

text: kampuni sya ukui siivawa nesa kwa kuvisya mioo mituki, muno muno, ivinda ni ya maana muno kwa mavalua ma piasala, mioo kana spare part kwa kusoovwa kwa mituki.
translation: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.

text: Kwa nzia imwe, kambuni ila nene ni syithaa na ndeke syasyo, ateo kwa nzia imwe na kambuni ila nini syai na thina.
translation: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.

text: Kwa nzia imwe, kambuni ila nene ni syithaa na ndeke syasyo, ateo kwa nzia imwe na kambuni ila nini syai na thina.
translation: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.

text: Kethwa matumie syindu na ndeke, nzia imwe yíkua mithenya kauta kúmyumya na kuclear kwa koti.
translation: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.

text: Kethwa matumie syindu na ndeke, nzia imwe yíkua mithenya kauta kúmyumya na kuclear kwa koti.
translation: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.

text: Nzia yoka ya kumivitithya na mitumi ni kumituma ta miio isiitwe. Miao ya ndeke yiimitikilya itumwe vate mundu aendete yo, vau nivo ulikilaa.
translation: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.

text: Nzia yoka ya kumivitithya na mitumi ni kumituma ta miio isiitwe. Miao ya ndeke yiimitikilya itumwe vate mundu aendete yo, vau nivo ulikilaa.
translation: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.

text: Nzia ila yaile ya kuthi na kilasi kya iulu kana kya viasala ni kumya mbesa mbingi (kana, kwosa kambuni yaku ikwikie úu.
translation: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).

text: Nzia ila yaile ya kuthi na kilasi kya iulu kana kya viasala ni kumya mbesa mbingi (kana, kwosa kambuni yaku ikwikie úu.
translation: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).

text: O na vamwe na ũu, ũũ ũyũkaa laisi: ta mĩao ndũmu ya kawaita, manya kana no ũĩve kũvikĩĩa maita ana ĩũlũ wa ĩĩvi ya tikiti ya kawaita ya viasala, na maita ĩkũmi na yĩmwe kũĩvĩa kĩlasi kya ĩũlũ vyũ!
translation: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!

text: O na vamwe na ũu, ũũ ũyũkaa laisi: ta mĩao ndũmu ya kawaita, manya kana no ũĩve kũvikĩĩa maita ana ĩũlũ wa ĩĩvi ya tikiti ya kawaita ya viasala, na maita ĩkũmi na yĩmwe kũĩvĩa kĩlasi kya ĩũlũ vyũ!
translation: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!

text: Kwa kuneena tu, vai vata wa kumantha thoowa muole wa ivila sya ndeke sya kilasi kya viasala na kilasi kya mbee ndekeni sya imwe kwa imwe kuma A kuthi B.
translation: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.

text: Kwa kuneena tu, vai vata wa kumantha thoowa muole wa ivila sya ndeke sya kilasi kya viasala na kilasi kya mbee ndekeni sya imwe kwa imwe kuma A kuthi B.
translation: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.

text: ĩkũndĩ sya ũũngamĩĩ wa ũkũĩ ndeke nĩsyĩsĩ kana ve andũ matonya kũĩva mbesa onaketha nĩana nĩkana matwawe vala maendete mĩtũkĩ na maĩkũwa nesa.
translation: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.

text: ĩkũndĩ sya ũũngamĩĩ wa ũkũĩ ndeke nĩsyĩsĩ kana ve andũ matonya kũĩva mbesa onaketha nĩana nĩkana matwawe vala maendete mĩtũkĩ na maĩkũwa nesa.
translation: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.

text: Musyi munene wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Kithyomo kila kineenawa ni Romanian, ateo kya Russia nikitumiawa muno.
translation: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.

text: Musyi munene wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Kithyomo kila kineenawa ni Romanian, ateo kya Russia nikitumiawa muno.
translation: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.

text: Moldova nĩ nthĩ ya maũkoo maingĩ ĩla yĩthĩtwe na kau wa kĩ'ũkoo.
translation: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.

text: Moldova nĩ nthĩ ya maũkoo maingĩ ĩla yĩthĩtwe na kau wa kĩ'ũkoo.
translation: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.

text: Mwaka wa 1994, maũemano aya nĩmatũmĩe kũseũvw'a nthĩ ya Transnistria kũũ ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa wa Moldova, ĩla yĩthaa na silĩkalĩ yayo na mbesa syoo ateo ĩyĩsĩkanĩwe nĩ nthĩ ona ĩmwe sya UN.
translation: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.

text: Mwaka wa 1994, maũemano aya nĩmatũmĩe kũseũvw'a nthĩ ya Transnistria kũũ ũmĩlonĩ wa sũa wa Moldova, ĩla yĩthaa na silĩkalĩ yayo na mbesa syoo ateo ĩyĩsĩkanĩwe nĩ nthĩ ona ĩmwe sya UN.
translation: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.

text: Ngwatanĩo ya ũkwati nĩseũvĩtwe katĩ wa kũndũ kwĩlĩ kwa Moldova ona kwĩthĩwa ve ũvalũku wa kĩsiasa.
translation: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.

text: Ngwatanĩo ya ũkwati nĩseũvĩtwe katĩ wa kũndũ kwĩlĩ kwa Moldova ona kwĩthĩwa ve ũvalũku wa kĩsiasa.
translation: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.

text: Ndini ila nene Moldova ni ila ite ya kawaida.
translation: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.

text: Ndini ila nene Moldova ni ila ite ya kawaida.
translation: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.

text: Izmir nĩ wyo mũsyĩ ũlala wakatatũ mũnene tũrkey wĩna ũtalo kalĩvũ 3.7 mĩlĩonĩ, vandũ vakelĩ vanene va ũngamaa meli, na vandũ vaseo va kũsĩla ngalĩ.
translation: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.

text: Izmir nĩ wyo mũsyĩ ũlala wakatatũ mũnene tũrkey wĩna ũtalo kalĩvũ 3.7 mĩlĩonĩ, vandũ vakelĩ vanene va ũngamaa meli, na vandũ vaseo va kũsĩla ngalĩ.
translation: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.

text: Ivindani yimwe musyi munene wa tene wa Smyrna, oyu ni wa kisasa, muendeeu, na ukwatene ta soko, wai na vandu vanene na ukethyululukwa ni iíma.
translation: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.

text: Ivindani yimwe musyi munene wa tene wa Smyrna, oyu ni wa kisasa, muendeeu, na ukwatene ta soko, wai na vandu vanene na ukethyululukwa ni iíma.
translation: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.

text: Lelu mbaamu, nyumba syi ukuta wa isisyo, na nduny'u sya matuku aa syanakavitw'e na siitiitwe na tailo ndune sya tene, ndunyu ya myaka maana ya ikumi na nyanya, na misikiti na makanisa makuu, o na kau musyi munene wina kiseve kya Europe ya Mediterranea kwi ya Turkey ya kawaita.
translation: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.

text: Lelu mbaamu, nyumba syi ukuta wa isisyo, na nduny'u sya matuku aa syanakavitw'e na siitiitwe na tailo ndune sya tene, ndunyu ya myaka maana ya ikumi na nyanya, na misikiti na makanisa makuu, o na kau musyi munene wina kiseve kya Europe ya Mediterranea kwi ya Turkey ya kawaita.
translation: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.

text: Utui wa Haldarsvik withwaa na kundu kuseo vakuvi na kithama kya Eysturoy na yithwaa na ikanisa ite ya kawaita ya octagonal.
translation: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.

text: Utui wa Haldarsvik withwaa na kundu kuseo vakuvi na kithama kya Eysturoy na yithwaa na ikanisa ite ya kawaita ya octagonal.
translation: Kijiji cha Haldarsvik kina mtazamo wa kisiwa kilicho karibu cha Eysturoi na kina kanisa lenye umbo lisilo la kawaida la pembe nane.

text: Kiwanza cha ikanisa kwi mavui mase kumana na ivia iũlu wa tũvuli.
translation: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.

text: Kiwanza cha ikanisa kwi mavui mase kumana na ivia iũlu wa tũvuli.
translation: Katika uwanja wa kanisa, kuna vinyago vya kuvutia vya marumaru vya njiwa juu ya kaburi.

text: Mundu akuaa nusu isaa kutembea utũini uũ wa kwendeesya.
translation: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.

text: Mundu akuaa nusu isaa kutembea utũini uũ wa kwendeesya.
translation: Inafaa nusu saa kutembeatembea katika kijiji hicho ambacho kinavutia.

text: Ngalikoni ya iulu na ivikiika kwa uvuthu ni musyi museo na wauseny'a wa Sintra na ula wanewe nguma mbee wa andu ma kuma nthi ingi itina wa uelesyo museo muno wa mauseo maw'o ma usengy'o ula wandikiwe ni Lord Byron.
translation: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.

text: Ngalikoni ya iulu na ivikiika kwa uvuthu ni musyi museo na wauseny'a wa Sintra na ula wanewe nguma mbee wa andu ma kuma nthi ingi itina wa uelesyo museo muno wa mauseo maw'o ma usengy'o ula wandikiwe ni Lord Byron.
translation: Upande wa kaskazini na mahali rahisi kufika kuna mji wa mahaba na wa kuvutia, uliofanywa maarufu na wageni baada ya kusimulia mapambo yake ya kung'aa kama yalivyorekodiwa na Lord Byron.

text: Mbasi ya Scotturb 403 niyiendaa muno kuuya Sintra, niyiungamaa Cabo da Roca.
translation: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.

text: Mbasi ya Scotturb 403 niyiendaa muno kuuya Sintra, niyiungamaa Cabo da Roca.
translation: Basi la Skotabu 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na kusimama Kabo da Roka.

text: Ona ingi muthoko wa iulu wa Sanctuary nene ya Our Lady of Fatima (ithembo), vandu ve nguma nthi yonthe Marian apparitions.
translation: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.

text: Ona ingi muthoko wa iulu wa Sanctuary nene ya Our Lady of Fatima (ithembo), vandu ve nguma nthi yonthe Marian apparitions.
translation: Pia upande wa kaskazini tembelea Hekalu la Mama Yetu Fatima (Madhabahu), mahali maarufu duniani pa maonyesho ya Maria.

text: Mwa lilikanai kana mwitembelea tuvuli twa andu aingi, na ingi vandu ve vata muno vyu kwa andu ma nthi yonthe matatalika.
translation: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.

text: Mwa lilikanai kana mwitembelea tuvuli twa andu aingi, na ingi vandu ve vata muno vyu kwa andu ma nthi yonthe matatalika.
translation: Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa hasa unatembelea mahali penye kaburi la watu wengi, na pia mahali ambapo pana maana isiyoweza kutabiriwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu ulimwenguni.

text: Mbato ve o aume na aka aingi methau ala mavitie ivinda yoo me vaa, na angi aingi ala maina endwa moo ala mooaiwe kana mathukumie nginya kukwa me vau, Ayuti na ala mateayuti undumwe.
translation: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.

text: Mbato ve o aume na aka aingi methau ala mavitie ivinda yoo me vaa, na angi aingi ala maina endwa moo ala mooaiwe kana mathukumie nginya kukwa me vau, Ayuti na ala mateayuti undumwe.
translation: Kungali kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai walioishi muda wao hapa, na wengine wengi ambao wapendwa wao waliuawa au walifanyishwa kazi hadi kufa, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi vilevile.

text: Nuukulwa ukue vandu vaa na ndaia ila yaile. Nduka vue ngui na Holocaust kana Nazis.
translation: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.

text: Nuukulwa ukue vandu vaa na ndaia ila yaile. Nduka vue ngui na Holocaust kana Nazis.
translation: Tafadhali tendea mahali hapo kwa hadhi yote, utaratibu na heshima inayostahiki. Usifanye utani juu ya Maangamizo au Wanazi.

text: Ndukanange vandu vau kwa kumaka kana kukuluta grafiti itwike syindu.
translation: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.

text: Ndukanange vandu vau kwa kumaka kana kukuluta grafiti itwike syindu.
translation: Usiumbue tovuti kwa kuashiria au kukata michoro kwenye miundo.

text: Kithyomo kila kĩtĩkĩlithitw'e Barcelona ni Kiikalatini na Kiispanish. Vakũvĩ nusu manenaa Kiikalatini, na aĩngĩ nĩmaeleawa nĩkyo, na ta vakuvi kila mundu niwisi Kispanish.
translation: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.

text: Kithyomo kila kĩtĩkĩlithitw'e Barcelona ni Kiikalatini na Kiispanish. Vakũvĩ nusu manenaa Kiikalatini, na aĩngĩ nĩmaeleawa nĩkyo, na ta vakuvi kila mundu niwisi Kispanish.
translation: Lugha rasmi za Baselona Kikatalani na Kihispania. Takribani nusu yao wanapendelea kuongea Kikatalani, idadi kubwa wanaielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.

text: Ona vamwe na ũu, syonany'o mbingĩ syandĩkĩtwe na kĩ Katalan tondũ nĩkyo kyũngamĩtw'e nĩ mĩĩao ta kĩthyomo kya mbee kĩĩtĩkĩle.
translation: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.

text: Ona vamwe na ũu, syonany'o mbingĩ syandĩkĩtwe na kĩ Katalan tondũ nĩkyo kyũngamĩtw'e nĩ mĩĩao ta kĩthyomo kya mbee kĩĩtĩkĩle.
translation: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.

text: Kithyomo kya Spanish ni kitũmiawa mũno ukũini na syindũni ingi.
translation: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.

text: Kithyomo kya Spanish ni kitũmiawa mũno ukũini na syindũni ingi.
translation: Kihispania bado hutumika sana katika uchukuzi wa umma na maeneo mengine.

text: Matangaso ma kila indi kuu Metro matangaasawa na Catalan tu, ateo maundu matavangiiwe matangaasawa ni maasini isetiitwe na ithyomo kivathukany'o vamwe na Kiispanishi, Kiisungu, Kifrench, Kialavu, na Kijapanisi.
translation: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.

text: Matangaso ma kila indi kuu Metro matangaasawa na Catalan tu, ateo maundu matavangiiwe matangaasawa ni maasini isetiitwe na ithyomo kivathukany'o vamwe na Kiispanishi, Kiisungu, Kifrench, Kialavu, na Kijapanisi.
translation: Matangazo ya mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kitalani, lakini usumbufu usiopangwa hutangazwa kwa mifumo otomatiki kwa kutumia lugha mbalimbali zikiwemo Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapanisi.

text: Andu ma Paris ni mesikie kwa mĩyono, ngũlũ na mĩng'athĩlĩlyo.
translation: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.

text: Andu ma Paris ni mesikie kwa mĩyono, ngũlũ na mĩng'athĩlĩlyo.
translation: Waparisi wana sifa ya kujipenda, jeuri na wenye kiburi.

text: O na vala kĩĩ kĩyaĩ kya w'o, nzĩa ĩla yaĩ nzeo kũvĩka Parĩs nĩ kwĩthĩwa wĩna mwikalo mũseo, nakwĩtha wĩmũndũ "beĩn eleve" (ũetwe nesa). Nĩ kwethĩawa kũũvĩkya laisi.
translation: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.

text: O na vala kĩĩ kĩyaĩ kya w'o, nzĩa ĩla yaĩ nzeo kũvĩka Parĩs nĩ kwĩthĩwa wĩna mwikalo mũseo, nakwĩtha wĩmũndũ "beĩn eleve" (ũetwe nesa). Nĩ kwethĩawa kũũvĩkya laisi.
translation: Wakati hii mara nyingi ni aina ya dhana tu isiyofaa, njia nzuri ya kupatana kule Paris bado ni kuwa katika tabia yako njema, kufanya kama mtu ambaye ni "bien e'lev'e" (amelelewa vizuri). Itafanya kupatana rahisi mno.

text: Ngalĩko sya nza sya ngavula sya andũ ma Paris no sitwĩke ta kĩseve mĩtũkĩ ethĩwa no ũmony'e ũseo wa nthĩ vyũ.
translation: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.

text: Ngalĩko sya nza sya ngavula sya andũ ma Paris no sitwĩke ta kĩseve mĩtũkĩ ethĩwa no ũmony'e ũseo wa nthĩ vyũ.
translation: Umbo za nje za ghafla za Parisiani zitayeyuka haraka ikiwa unaonyesha ustahifu kadhaa za kimsingi.

text: Kĩlũngũ kya anthĩ kĩla kĩtengetwe kwoondũ wa nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ kya Plĩtvĩce Lakes kĩthaa na kĩtheka kĩthũngũ mũno, mũno mnũno na mĩtĩ ya mũthemba wa mitalakwe na beech, na mũvũlano wa mĩtĩ ya Alpĩne na Medĩterranean.
translation: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.

text: Kĩlũngũ kya anthĩ kĩla kĩtengetwe kwoondũ wa nyamũ sya kĩthekanĩ kya Plĩtvĩce Lakes kĩthaa na kĩtheka kĩthũngũ mũno, mũno mnũno na mĩtĩ ya mũthemba wa mitalakwe na beech, na mũvũlano wa mĩtĩ ya Alpĩne na Medĩterranean.
translation: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Plitvice Lakes ina misitu sana, hususan mifune, misonobari, na miti ya misonobari, na mchanganyiko wa uoto wa safu ya milima ya Alp na mediterania.

text: Ve mithemba mingi muno ya miti, nundu wa mithemba mingi ya nzeve, mithanga kivathukany'o na utulu utianite.
translation: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.

text: Ve mithemba mingi muno ya miti, nundu wa mithemba mingi ya nzeve, mithanga kivathukany'o na utulu utianite.
translation: Ina aina anuwai za jamii za mimea, kutokana na masafa yake ya hali ndogondogo za anga, mchanga tofauti na kutofautiana kwa viwango vya urefu.

text: Kĩsio kĩũ naĩngĩ no mũsyĩ wa nyamũ kĩvathũkanyo na nyũnyĩ sha mĩvaĩ mĩngĩ.
translation: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.

text: Kĩsio kĩũ naĩngĩ no mũsyĩ wa nyamũ kĩvathũkanyo na nyũnyĩ sha mĩvaĩ mĩngĩ.
translation: Eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani mwa aina nyingi sana mbalimbali za spishi za wanyama na ndege.

text: Fauna itesikie muno ta nduva ya langi wa muthanga ya yulovu, nzui, kilui, ndunduli, kakoyo ka kitheka, mbaka ya kitheka na capercaillie noikwatikane kũu, na nyamu ingi mbingi.
translation: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species

text: Fauna itesikie muno ta nduva ya langi wa muthanga ya yulovu, nzui, kilui, ndunduli, kakoyo ka kitheka, mbaka ya kitheka na capercaillie noikwatikane kũu, na nyamu ingi mbingi.
translation: Wanyama nadra kama vile Dubu wa hudhurungi wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, bundi, simba-mangu, paka mwitu na kware wa Ulaya wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.

text: Yila ĩvetĩ syaenda kutembea nyumbani sya ndini, nĩsyailite kwĩkĩa sĩkatĩ syĩ vyĩkĩte maũ na ĩtũa syĩ yĩthĩwa syĩ mbwĩke.
translation: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.

text: Yila ĩvetĩ syaenda kutembea nyumbani sya ndini, nĩsyailite kwĩkĩa sĩkatĩ syĩ vyĩkĩte maũ na ĩtũa syĩ yĩthĩwa syĩ mbwĩke.
translation: Wakati wa kutembelea nyumba za watawa, wanawake wanatarajiwa kuvaa sketi zinazofunika magoti na pia wafunike mabega yao.

text: Monasteries aingi nimanengae aka suka wa kwivwika ngingo ila mooka mateyumbanitye, ateo wooka na yaku, muno muno yina malangi meukenga, nuu simailiwa ni Monk kana Nun ngeitini.
translation: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.

text: Monasteries aingi nimanengae aka suka wa kwivwika ngingo ila mooka mateyumbanitye, ateo wooka na yaku, muno muno yina malangi meukenga, nuu simailiwa ni Monk kana Nun ngeitini.
translation: Nyingi za monasteri hutoa kanga kwa wanawake wanaokuja bila, lakini ukija na kanga yako, haswa iliyo na rangi kali, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa monaki au sista kwenye kiingilio.

text: O lainini usu umwe, anduume ni mailite kwikia mivũuto ivwikite mau.
translation: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.

text: O lainini usu umwe, anduume ni mailite kwikia mivũuto ivwikite mau.
translation: Vile vile, wanaume wanahitajika kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.

text: Oneno no yivoywe kuma kwa sitoko vau muomoni ateo ngua isu nivuawa itina wa kila mundu atumia kwoou nowiw'e utemwianie wikiite malinda aa. Saisi imwe yiviti aume oonthe!
translation: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!

text: Oneno no yivoywe kuma kwa sitoko vau muomoni ateo ngua isu nivuawa itina wa kila mundu atumia kwoou nowiw'e utemwianie wikiite malinda aa. Saisi imwe yiviti aume oonthe!
translation: Hii pia inaweza kuombwa kutoka kwa akiba kwenye lango lakini nguo hizo hazifuliwi baada ya kila mtumiaji kwa hivyo huenda usijihisi mwenye starehe unapovaa sketi hizo. Saizi moja hutosha wote kwa wanaume!

text: Leu wa Majorcan, ta ula ungi wa kũndũ kwi Mediterranean withaa wa mũkate, mboka na nyama (ya ngũlũwe) na maũta ma mĩtĩ ya mĩthata kila saa.
translation: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.

text: Leu wa Majorcan, ta ula ungi wa kũndũ kwi Mediterranean withaa wa mũkate, mboka na nyama (ya ngũlũwe) na maũta ma mĩtĩ ya mĩthata kila saa.
translation: Vyakula vya Majokan, kama vile vya sehemu nyingine kwenye kanda ya bahari ya Mediterranean, vimetengenezwa kwa mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mizeituni nyakati zote.

text: Leu wĩsĩkanĩe wa wĩyoo, kwanza ĩvĩndanĩ ya sũa, n Pa amb Olĩ: mũkate wĩna maũta ma olĩve, manyanya na syĩndũ ĩa syĩvo ta cheese, na makũyũ ma tũna, etc.
translation: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.

text: Leu wĩsĩkanĩe wa wĩyoo, kwanza ĩvĩndanĩ ya sũa, n Pa amb Olĩ: mũkate wĩna maũta ma olĩve, manyanya na syĩndũ ĩa syĩvo ta cheese, na makũyũ ma tũna, etc.
translation: Chakula rahisi cha jioni, hasa wakati wa kiangazi, huwa ni Pa ambi Oli: Mkate wa mafuta ya mizeituni, nyanya, na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana kama vile jibini na samakituna.

text: Naoni syoonthe, vamwe na ndeto ii kwaku, syambiaa na ndeto nene saa syoonthe, onethwa ni kati kati wa sendenzi.
translation: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.

text: Naoni syoonthe, vamwe na ndeto ii kwaku, syambiaa na ndeto nene saa syoonthe, onethwa ni kati kati wa sendenzi.
translation: Nomino zote, ikiwemo Sie kwa wewe, daima huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katika katikati mwa sentensi.

text: Ii ni nzea nzeo ya kuvathukany'a yiulu wa vaambu na syindu.
translation: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.

text: Ii ni nzea nzeo ya kuvathukany'a yiulu wa vaambu na syindu.
translation: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.

text: Ĩngĩ noĩtumaa kũsoma kwĩthĩwa kũvũthũ, o na kau kwandĩka kwĩ vinya vanini nũndũ wa wendekano wa ũmanya kana ndeto ya kwĩka kana ya vandũ ĩtũmĩĩtwe kwa nthĩa mbaĩlu.
translation: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.

text: Ĩngĩ noĩtumaa kũsoma kwĩthĩwa kũvũthũ, o na kau kwandĩka kwĩ vinya vanini nũndũ wa wendekano wa ũmanya kana ndeto ya kwĩka kana ya vandũ ĩtũmĩĩtwe kwa nthĩa mbaĩlu.
translation: Pia bila shaka inafanya kusoma rahisi, ingawa kuandika kwa kiasi fulani ni ngumu kwa haja ya kutaka kujua kama kitenzi au kivumishi kinatumika kwa umuhimu.

text: Kutamuka kithyomo kya Italy ni laisi nundu ndeto mbingi syitamukawa undu syandikietwe.
translation: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written

text: Kutamuka kithyomo kya Italy ni laisi nundu ndeto mbingi syitamukawa undu syandikietwe.
translation: Matamshi ni rahisi kiasi kwa Kiitaliano kwani maneno mengi hutamkwa hasa yalivyoandikwa

text: Leta ila waile kusisya muno ni c na g, nundu mutamukile wasyo nuvindukaa kuatiania na voweo ila iatiie.
translation: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.

text: Leta ila waile kusisya muno ni c na g, nundu mutamukile wasyo nuvindukaa kuatiania na voweo ila iatiie.
translation: Herufi muhimu za kuzingatia ni c na g, kwani matamshi yake hubadilika kulingana na vokali inayofuata.

text: Na ingi, uililikana kutamuka r na rr kivathukanio: caro iungamiaa mwendwa, nayo carro iungamiaa ikasya ya kau.
translation: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.

text: Na ingi, uililikana kutamuka r na rr kivathukanio: caro iungamiaa mwendwa, nayo carro iungamiaa ikasya ya kau.
translation: Pia, hakikisha kutamka r na rr tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpenzi, ilhali carro inamaanisha gari la kuvurutwa na farasi.

text: Kithyomo kya Kiipashia kiyingwa vinya na miao ya uneeni wakyo ndi vinya.
translation: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.

text: Kithyomo kya Kiipashia kiyingwa vinya na miao ya uneeni wakyo ndi vinya.
translation: Kiajemi ina sarufi rahisi kiasi, na mara nyingi ya kawaida.

text: Kwoou kusoma mwambiliilyo uũ wa kĩthyomo no uũtetheesye kusoma kĩthyomo cha Persia na kukielewa nesa.
translation: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.

text: Kwoou kusoma mwambiliilyo uũ wa kĩthyomo no uũtetheesye kusoma kĩthyomo cha Persia na kukielewa nesa.
translation: Kwa hivyo, kusoma chanzo hiki cha sarufi kutakusaidia wewe kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kiajemi na kuelewa bora zaidi.

text: Vai vata wa kuweta, kethwa niwisi kithyomo kya wendo, ni laisi kusoma kithyomo kya vokyongisi.
translation: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.

text: Vai vata wa kuweta, kethwa niwisi kithyomo kya wendo, ni laisi kusoma kithyomo kya vokyongisi.
translation: Bila haja ya kusema, ikiwa unaifahamu lugha ya mahaba, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.

text: O na vamwe na uu, and ala mesi kiisivania kinini nomatw'e o mituki kana kityomo kya ki Portuguese kithyaanene muno na kiaililwe usomewa utee.
translation: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.

text: O na vamwe na uu, and ala mesi kiisivania kinini nomatw'e o mituki kana kityomo kya ki Portuguese kithyaanene muno na kiaililwe usomewa utee.
translation: Hata hivyo, watu wanaofahamu Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kuhitimisha kwa haraka kuwa Kireno kinakaribiana sana na kwamba hakihitaji kusomwa kando.

text: Mawoni ma mbee wa matuku aya methiawa matai vata umunthu, na matialaa o ta kundu kwa kwiia syindu sya ulilikanaa, kama kundu kwa usoma tu.
translation: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.

text: Mawoni ma mbee wa matuku aya methiawa matai vata umunthu, na matialaa o ta kundu kwa kwiia syindu sya ulilikanaa, kama kundu kwa usoma tu.
translation: Uchunguzi kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida hautumiki leo, na hubaki kama makavazi, ama sehemu za elimu.

text: Mithenya isu kuthokoanwa kwa nzeve kwai kunini kute umunthi. Meethiawa taonini, yunivasitini, ni makwatikanaa mituki kute umunthi.
translation: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.

text: Mithenya isu kuthokoanwa kwa nzeve kwai kunini kute umunthi. Meethiawa taonini, yunivasitini, ni makwatikanaa mituki kute umunthi.
translation: Kwani uchafuzi wa mwanga nyakati zao haukuwa shida kama ilivyo leo, mara nyingi wako mijini au katikavyuo vikuu, rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zimejengwa siku za kisasa.

text: Telesĩkovũ nyĩngĩ sya ĩvĩnda yĩĩ sya kwĩka ũkũnĩkĩlĩ syĩthaa syĩthaa syakĩwe masũmba manene ala methaa makĩtwe kũndũ nza wa taonĩ kũla kwĩ nzeve yakwendeesya.
translation: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.

text: Telesĩkovũ nyĩngĩ sya ĩvĩnda yĩĩ sya kwĩka ũkũnĩkĩlĩ syĩthaa syĩthaa syakĩwe masũmba manene ala methaa makĩtwe kũndũ nza wa taonĩ kũla kwĩ nzeve yakwendeesya.
translation: Darubini nyingi za utafiti za kisasa ni vifaa kuu katika maeneo ya mbali yaliyo na hali nzuri za angahewa.

text: Iseso ya kusisya malaa yila yisiwe ta hanami ku Japan, yithiitwe yi kilungu kimwe kya kithio kya kuma myakani ya maana 8.
translation: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.

text: Iseso ya kusisya malaa yila yisiwe ta hanami ku Japan, yithiitwe yi kilungu kimwe kya kithio kya kuma myakani ya maana 8.
translation: Utazamaji wa maua ya cheri, inayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.

text: Umanyi ũsu waumie China vala plum blossom mai malaa ma kwisakuiya.
translation: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.

text: Umanyi ũsu waumie China vala plum blossom mai malaa ma kwisakuiya.
translation: Dhana hiyo ilitoka Uchina ambapo maua ya plamu ndiyo yaliyokuwa maua yaliyopendelewa.

text: Nthi ya Japan ila malaa ma cherry maumila ya mbee, syathe ni syeekiawa ni musumbi na andu ala ma kĩlasi kyake vau kotini ya usumbi.
translation: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.

text: Nthi ya Japan ila malaa ma cherry maumila ya mbee, syathe ni syeekiawa ni musumbi na andu ala ma kĩlasi kyake vau kotini ya usumbi.
translation: Huko Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya mcheri ziliandaliwa na maliki kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa upatanishi waliozunguka Mahakama ya Imperi.

text: Miti yithwaa iyoneka yi mbianíe íla yi kwa mawithyululuko natural, kwoou ndukatate kumya spesimeni "ona imwe".
translation: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.

text: Miti yithwaa iyoneka yi mbianíe íla yi kwa mawithyululuko natural, kwoou ndukatate kumya spesimeni "ona imwe".
translation: Mimea inaonekana bora ikiwa katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka kishawishi cha kutoa hata kiolezo "kimoja tu".

text: Ethĩwa kũtembea mũũndanĩ mũvange nesa, ũyosanya "syĩndũ sya ũsianĩsya na ũsoma" ingĩ no itume ũlũngw'a, vate kũneenea.
translation: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.

text: Ethĩwa kũtembea mũũndanĩ mũvange nesa, ũyosanya "syĩndũ sya ũsianĩsya na ũsoma" ingĩ no itume ũlũngw'a, vate kũneenea.
translation: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya "violezo" pia kutakufanya uodolewe, bila majadiliano.

text: Singapore ni nthi nzuviiku muno uyikala na yi laisi kuma vandu kuthi vangi, na noutonye kuthooa vakuvi kila ukwenda itina wa uvika kuu.
translation: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.

text: Singapore ni nthi nzuviiku muno uyikala na yi laisi kuma vandu kuthi vangi, na noutonye kuthooa vakuvi kila ukwenda itina wa uvika kuu.
translation: Singapori kwa ujumla ni mahali salama zaidi kuwa na rahisi sana kuabiri, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.

text: Indi kwiwa kuuya "kukuvi na ikweta" ndikilii nini ngaliko yeulu ya ikweta wienda kukitana na ivyuvi (mala maingi) na syua ivyu (ila itu itheu, na ti muno).
translation: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).

text: Indi kwiwa kuuya "kukuvi na ikweta" ndikilii nini ngaliko yeulu ya ikweta wienda kukitana na ivyuvi (mala maingi) na syua ivyu (ila itu itheu, na ti muno).
translation: Lakini kwa kuwekwa katika "tropiki za juu" digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa istiwai utahitaji kukabiliana na joto jingi (kila wakati) na jua kali (wakati anga ni safi, nadra zaidi).

text: Ve o mbasi nini siendete iulu ya Hebron, vala Patriarch ma mbivilia ta Avalaamu, Isaka, Yakovo, na iveti syoo kawaita mathikawa.
translation: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.

text: Ve o mbasi nini siendete iulu ya Hebron, vala Patriarch ma mbivilia ta Avalaamu, Isaka, Yakovo, na iveti syoo kawaita mathikawa.
translation: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoelekea kaskazini mwa Hebroni, mahali pa makaburi ya jadi ya mashujaa wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.

text: Lilya kana mbasi ila uusuania kulisa yiendete Hebron na ti vakuvi na utuo wa Ayuti ma Kiryat Arba.
translation: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.

text: Lilya kana mbasi ila uusuania kulisa yiendete Hebron na ti vakuvi na utuo wa Ayuti ma Kiryat Arba.
translation: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalofikiria kuabiri linaenda Hebron na si katika makazi ya karibu ya Kiyahudi ya Kiryat Arba tu.

text: Nzia sya kulikya kiwũ no syithe vandũ vaseo vya kuthyũmũa.
translation: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.

text: Nzia sya kulikya kiwũ no syithe vandũ vaseo vya kuthyũmũa.
translation: Njia za maji za barani zinaweza kuwa mandhari mzuri ya kufanyia likizo.

text: Kwang'elekanyo kũthĩ kũsyĩsya ng'ome mwandanĩ wa loĩre, mwanda wa rhĩne kana kũtwaa andũ kũndũ kwĩkwendeesya Danũbe kana kũtwaa masĩwa vakũvĩ na kalũsĩ ka Erie.
translation: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.

text: Kwang'elekanyo kũthĩ kũsyĩsya ng'ome mwandanĩ wa loĩre, mwanda wa rhĩne kana kũtwaa andũ kũndũ kwĩkwendeesya Danũbe kana kũtwaa masĩwa vakũvĩ na kalũsĩ ka Erie.
translation: Kwa mfano, kutembelea ngome katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri katika maeneo ya kuvutia kwa Danube au kusafiri kwa mashua upande wa Mfereji wa Erie.

text: Na o ingi nimavanaa nzia ila itumiawa muno kwa ku hike na kutwaa.
translation: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.

text: Na o ingi nimavanaa nzia ila itumiawa muno kwa ku hike na kutwaa.
translation: Pia wao hufafanua njia maarufu za matembezi na uendeshaji baiskeli.

text: Kilisimasi nĩ ĩmwe ya sikũkũũ sya vata mũno sya kĩ kilisito, na ĩtanĩawa ta ĩsyawa ya Yesu.
translation: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.

text: Kilisimasi nĩ ĩmwe ya sikũkũũ sya vata mũno sya kĩ kilisito, na ĩtanĩawa ta ĩsyawa ya Yesu.
translation: Krismasi ni moja ya likizo muhimu zaidi ya Ukristo, na inaadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.

text: Mbingi sya syithio ila syithyululukite muthenya usu wa sikuku nisyoseleelwe ni ala mataikiiaa nthi syi uklisito na iulu wanthi.
translation: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.

text: Mbingi sya syithio ila syithyululukite muthenya usu wa sikuku nisyoseleelwe ni ala mataikiiaa nthi syi uklisito na iulu wanthi.
translation: Nyingi za tamaduni zinazozunguka likizo zimesilikwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo duniani kote.

text: Ve kĩĩthĩo kya kũema kukoma ũtukũ wonthe wa Vasaka vandũnĩ venekee nĩ kana wone syũa ĩyuma kwakya.
translation: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.

text: Ve kĩĩthĩo kya kũema kukoma ũtukũ wonthe wa Vasaka vandũnĩ venekee nĩ kana wone syũa ĩyuma kwakya.
translation: Kuna desturi ya kukesha usiku wa Pasaka katika sehemu fulani wazi ili kuona jua likichomoza.

text: Nongĩnya vethe ve maũelesyo ma kanĩsa yĩũlũ wa ũtamadũnĩ ũũ, ona kaũ nĩ vatonya kwĩtha na ĩmwe sya mbee wa andũ kũtwĩka nĩ ma kanĩsa na ĩngĩ sya kĩthĩo kya kwĩtha na vĩnya wa kũsyaa.
translation: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.

text: Nongĩnya vethe ve maũelesyo ma kanĩsa yĩũlũ wa ũtamadũnĩ ũũ, ona kaũ nĩ vatonya kwĩtha na ĩmwe sya mbee wa andũ kũtwĩka nĩ ma kanĩsa na ĩngĩ sya kĩthĩo kya kwĩtha na vĩnya wa kũsyaa.
translation: Kwa kweli kuna maelezo ya thiolojia ya Kikristo ya utamaduni huu, lakini pia huenda ikawa ibada ya Majira ya kuchipua na Uzazi kabla ya Ukristo.

text: Makanisa maingi ma tene nimethiawa na kesha ya pasaka wathanthatu wioo ila kwina wikendi ya pasaka, makomano maingi maikuna ngemi syaungama saa sita sya utuku kutania kuthayuuka kwa yesu.
translation: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.

text: Makanisa maingi ma tene nimethiawa na kesha ya pasaka wathanthatu wioo ila kwina wikendi ya pasaka, makomano maingi maikuna ngemi syaungama saa sita sya utuku kutania kuthayuuka kwa yesu.
translation: Makanisa zaidi ya jadi huwa na Mkesha wa Pasaka usiku wa Jumamosi wakati wa wikendi ya Pasaka, waumini wakisherehekea saa sita kamili za usiku kuadhimisha ufufuo wa Kristo.

text: Nyamũ syonthe ila syavikĩe kĩthamanĩ kĩĩ syookĩe ithambĩĩte, syũlũkĩte kana syĩlelete.
translation: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.

text: Nyamũ syonthe ila syavikĩe kĩthamanĩ kĩĩ syookĩe ithambĩĩte, syũlũkĩte kana syĩlelete.
translation: Wanyama wote asili waliofika katika visiwa hivi walikuja hapa pengine kwa kuogelea, kupaa au kuelea.

text: Nũndũ wa mwanya mũasa kuma nthĩ ĩsu nyamũ sya kwongya ityatonya kũthi kyalo na syatumwa nguu nene vyũ yĩthĩwa nyamũ yoka ya kũĩthya kũu Galapagos.
translation: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.

text: Nũndũ wa mwanya mũasa kuma nthĩ ĩsu nyamũ sya kwongya ityatonya kũthi kyalo na syatumwa nguu nene vyũ yĩthĩwa nyamũ yoka ya kũĩthya kũu Galapagos.
translation: Kwa sababu ya masafa marefu kutoka kwa bara, mamalia walishindwa kumalize mwendo, huku mzee kobe jitu akiwa mnyama wa kimsingi mla nyasi katika Galapagosi.

text: Kuma ila mundu wavikie kuu Galapagos, nyamu mbingi vamwe na mbui, mbalasi, ng'ombe, mbia, mbaka na ngiti nisyambiiw'e.
translation: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.

text: Kuma ila mundu wavikie kuu Galapagos, nyamu mbingi vamwe na mbui, mbalasi, ng'ombe, mbia, mbaka na ngiti nisyambiiw'e.
translation: Tangu kuwasili kwa mwanadamu katika Galapagos, mamalia wengi wamewasilishwa pamoja na mbuzi, farasi, ng'ombe, panya, paka na mbwa.

text: Kethwa nuutembea kuthi ngaliko sya Arctic kana Antarctic musimuni wa mbevo nuukitany'a na kiwiyoo kya polar, kula ni kwasya kana sua iyumiliilaa iulu wa horizon.
translation: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.

text: Kethwa nuutembea kuthi ngaliko sya Arctic kana Antarctic musimuni wa mbevo nuukitany'a na kiwiyoo kya polar, kula ni kwasya kana sua iyumiliilaa iulu wa horizon.
translation: Ukitembelea maeneo ya Aktiki na Antaktiki msimu wa baridi utapata tajriba ya usiku wa pola, ambayo ina maana kuwa jua halichomozi juu ya upeo wa macho.

text: Yii yinengane ivuso iseo kwona Aurora borealis, nundu yayaya yiithwa yi ituku munango kana ilee ithwa ite saa syonthe.
translation: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.

text: Yii yinengane ivuso iseo kwona Aurora borealis, nundu yayaya yiithwa yi ituku munango kana ilee ithwa ite saa syonthe.
translation: Hii inatoa fursa nzuri ya kuona mwanga wa Aurora, kwani anga itakuwa giza kwa kadiri fulani mchana na usiku.

text: Nundu isio isu syi andu anini, na kyeni kiikethiawa na thina, kwoou ona ukeethiawa utonya kutania ndata.
translation: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.

text: Nundu isio isu syi andu anini, na kyeni kiikethiawa na thina, kwoou ona ukeethiawa utonya kutania ndata.
translation: Kwa kuwa maeneo hayo hayana idadi kubwa ya watu, na uchafuzi kidogo aghalabu huwa si tatizo, pia utaweza kufuruhia nyota.

text: Kithio kya mũthũkũmĩle wa a Japani kĩthĩawa na mũvango wa kũatĩĩa kwĩ ũla andũ ma mũingo mamanyĩĩte.
translation: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.

text: Kithio kya mũthũkũmĩle wa a Japani kĩthĩawa na mũvango wa kũatĩĩa kwĩ ũla andũ ma mũingo mamanyĩĩte.
translation: Desturi ya kazi ya Kijapani ni ya kimfumo na rasmi kuliko mazoea ya Wanamagharibi.

text: Suti ni ngua sya viasala, na athukumi wenzao metaa aangi na isyitwa ya vamili kana taitoo ya wiani.
translation: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.

text: Suti ni ngua sya viasala, na athukumi wenzao metaa aangi na isyitwa ya vamili kana taitoo ya wiani.
translation: Suti ni mavazi ya kawaida ya kibiashara, na wafanyikazi huita wenzao kwa majina ya familia zao au kwa majina ya kikazi.

text: Uũmwe wa vandũ va ũthũkũmĩ wĩ maana mũno, kũĩkĩĩtya kũthũkũma vame vandũ va kũkaathĩa meko ma mũndũ ũmwe.
translation: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.

text: Uũmwe wa vandũ va ũthũkũmĩ wĩ maana mũno, kũĩkĩĩtya kũthũkũma vame vandũ va kũkaathĩa meko ma mũndũ ũmwe.
translation: Ulinganifu katika mahali pa kazi ni muhimu, kusisitiza juhudi za vikundi badala ya kusifu mafanikio ya kibinafsi.

text: Athũkũmĩ maĩle kũkũlasya anene moo matanamba kwĩsyĩlya nzĩa ĩla me kũatĩĩa, na nĩ maĩlĩte kũatĩaa kĩla matavywa vate makũlyo.
translation: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.

text: Athũkũmĩ maĩle kũkũlasya anene moo matanamba kwĩsyĩlya nzĩa ĩla me kũatĩĩa, na nĩ maĩlĩte kũatĩaa kĩla matavywa vate makũlyo.
translation: Mara kwa mara wafanyakazi hupata kibali cha maamuzi yoyote wanayofanya kutoka kwa wasimamizi wao, na wanatarajiwa kutii maagizo ya wakuu wao bila maswali.
